english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: O Lord of all masters of mystic power, I have heard Your words, but the doubt in my heart does not go away; thus my mind is bewildered.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
य एष जीवो विवरप्रसूतिः प्राणेन घोषेण गुहां प्रविष्टः।
मनोमयं सूक्ष्ममुपैति रूपं मात्रा स्वरो वर्ण इति स्थविष्ठम्॥ ११/१२/१७॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, the Supreme Lord gives life to every living being and is situated within the heart along with the life air and primal sound vibration. The Lord can be perceived in His subtle form within the heart by one’s mind, since the Lord controls the minds of everyone, even great gods like Lord Śiva. The Supreme Lord also assumes a gross form as the various sounds of the Vedas, composed of short and long vowels and consonants of different intonations.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
य एष जीवो विवरप्रसूतिः प्राणेन घोषेण गुहां प्रविष्टः।
मनोमयं सूक्ष्ममुपैति रूपं मात्रा स्वरो वर्ण इति स्थविष्ठम्॥ ११/१२/१७॥

गोपिका अपि मामापुः किमु वाय्वाद्या इति दर्शयितुं गोपिकाप्रशंसनम्। सर्वैर्गुणैः सर्वोत्तमस्तु वायुरेव। स एव च हिरण्यगर्भ इति दर्शयितुमाह- य एष जीवो विवरप्रसूतिरित्यादि॥ विशेषेण वराणामहङ्कारादीनामपि प्रसूतिः उत्पत्तिकर्ता। प्राणेन विष्णुना। घोषेण वेदात्मिकया प्रकृत्या। मनोमात्रादयश्च हिरण्यगर्भस्य देव्याः परमात्मनश्च व्यक्तिस्थानानीत्युक्तम्। प्राणेन घोषेन च सह विवरप्रसूतिर्मनोमयं रूपमुपैतीत्यादिना ॥ १७॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, the Supreme Lord gives life to every living being and is situated within the heart along with the life air and primal sound vibration. The Lord can be perceived in His subtle form within the heart by one’s mind, since the Lord controls the minds of everyone, even great demigods like Lord Śiva. The Supreme Lord also assumes a gross form as the various sounds of the Vedas, composed of short and long vowels and consonants of different intonations.

units.sanskrit:
यथाऽनलः खेऽनिलबन्धुरूष्मा बलेन दारुण्यधिमथ्यमानः।
अणुः प्रजातो हविषा समिद्ध्यते तथैव मे व्यक्तिरियं हि वाणी॥ ११/१२/१८॥
units.english: When sticks of kindling wood are vigorously rubbed together, heat is produced by contact with air, and a spark of fire appears. Once the fire is kindled, ghee is added and the fire blazes. Similarly, I become manifest in the sound vibration of the Vedas.

parts.sanskrit:
यथाऽनलः खेऽनिलबन्धुरूष्मा बलेन दारुण्यधिमथ्यमानः।
अणुः प्रजातो हविषा समिद्ध्यते तथैव मे व्यक्तिरियं हि वाणी॥ ११/१२/१८॥
तत्रापि विशेषतो भगवत एव व्यक्तिस्थानमित्याह- यथानल इत्यादिना॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: When sticks of kindling wood are vigorously rubbed together, heat is produced by contact with air, and a spark of fire appears. Once the fire is kindled, ghee is added and the fire blazes. Similarly, I become manifest in the sound vibration of the Vedas.

units.sanskrit:
एवं गतिः कर्म रतिर्विसर्गो घ्राणो रसो दृक् स्पर्शः श्रुतिश्च।
सङ्कल्पविज्ञानमथाभिमानः सूत्रं रजः सत्वतमो विकारः॥ ११/१२/१९॥
units.english: The functions of the working senses — the organ of speech, the hands, the legs, the genitals and the anus — and the functions of the knowledge-acquiring senses — the nose, tongue, eyes, skin and ears — along with the functions of the subtle senses of mind, intelligence, consciousness and false ego, as well as the function of the subtle pradhāna and the interaction of the three modes of material nature — all these should be understood as My materially manifest form.

meta.english_verbatim: The functions of the working senses — the organ of speech, the hands, the legs, the genitals and the anus — and the functions of the knowledge-acquiring senses — the nose, tongue, eyes, skin and ears — along with the functions of the subtle senses of mind, intelligence, consciousness and false ego, as well as the function of the subtle pradhāna and the interaction of the three modes of material nature — all these should be understood as My materially manifest form.

units.sanskrit:
अयं हि जीवस्त्रिवृदब्जयोनिरव्यक्त एको जगतामथाऽद्यः।
विश्लिष्टशक्तिर्बहुधैव भाति बीजानि योनिं प्रतिपद्य यद्वत्॥ ११/१२/२०॥
units.english: When many seeds are placed in an agricultural field, innumerable manifestations of trees, bushes, vegetables and so on will arise from a single source, the soil. Similarly, the Lord, who gives life to all and is eternal, originally exists beyond the scope of the cosmic manifestation. In the course of time, however, the Lord, who is the resting place of the three modes of nature and the source of the universal lotus flower, in which the cosmic manifestation takes place, divides His material potencies and thus appears to be manifest in innumerable forms, although He is one.

parts.sanskrit:
अयं हि जीवस्त्रिवृदब्जयोनिरव्यक्त एको जगतामथाऽद्यः।
विश्लिष्टशक्तिर्बहुधैव भाति बीजानि योनिं प्रतिपद्य यद्वत्॥ ११/१२/२०॥

विशेषेण श्लिष्टशक्तिः अनपगतसामर्थ्यः। यथैकं कलमादिबीजं भूमावुप्तं बह्वङ्कुरं भवति एवं परमात्मानुगृहीतो ब्रह्माऽहङ्कारादिषु बहुधा व्यक्तीभवति।
“सुपर्णशेषरुद्रादिप्रसूतिश्च चतुर्मुखः।
सर्वजीवोत्तमो जीवो गुणैर्ज्ञानसुखादिभिः।
विष्णुभक्त्यादिभिः सर्वैर्नियमात्
सार्वकालिकम्।
मुक्तावपि न सन्देहः स हि देवेन विष्णुना।
प्राणप्राणेन
जगतामीशेन रमया तथा।
वेदात्मिक्या च सहितः सूक्ष्मः सन् मनसि स्थितः।
वीन्द्रादीनां तु सर्वेषां मात्रावर्णस्वरेषु च।
स्थूलरूपी सदा तिष्ठन्नेवं श्रोत्रादिखेषु च।
सर्वेषां प्रेरको ह्येको ज्ञानान्दबलैस्त्रिवृत्।
नित्यशक्तिः सर्वगः सन् बहुधेव प्रतीयते।
तस्मिन्नोतमिदं सर्वं पटे लक्षणतन्तुवत्।
स एव वायुरुद्दिष्टो वायुर्हि ब्रह्मतामगात्।
विशेषतो हरेर्व्यक्तिस्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः।
मनआदीन्यहङ्कारो ब्रह्मा वेदात्मिका रमा।
त्रिगुणात्मिका च सैव श्रीः सैवोक्ता संविदात्मिका।
तस्या अपि नियन्तैको विष्णुः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः।
यथा दारुषु सूक्ष्मः सन् मथितोऽग्निः समिद्ध्यते।
तथा वेदादिषु हरिर्मथितः सम्प्रदृश्यते।
व्यक्तिस्थानान्यथैतानि वेदादीनि हरेर्विदुः॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते।
“मनसि व्यक्ततां यामि तस्माद् व्यक्तिर्हि मे मनः” इति भारते॥ २०॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: When many seeds are placed in an agricultural field, innumerable manifestations of trees, bushes, vegetables and so on will arise from a single source, the soil. Similarly, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who gives life to all and is eternal, originally exists beyond the scope of the cosmic manifestation. In the course of time, however, the Lord, who is the resting place of the three modes of nature and the source of the universal lotus flower, in which the cosmic manifestation takes place, divides His material potencies and thus appears to be manifest in innumerable forms, although He is one.

units.sanskrit:
यस्मिन्निदं प्रोतमशेषमोतं पटे यथा तन्तुवितानसंस्था।
य एष संसारतरुः पुराणः कर्मात्मकः पुष्पफले प्रसूते॥ ११/१२/२१॥
units.english: Just as woven cloth rests on the expansion of lengthwise and crosswise threads, similarly the entire universe is expanded on the lengthwise and crosswise potency of the Lord and is situated within Him. The conditioned soul has been accepting material bodies since time immemorial, and these bodies are like great trees sustaining one’s material existence. Just as a tree first blossoms and then produces fruit, similarly the tree of material existence, one’s material body, produces the various results of material existence.

parts.sanskrit:
यस्मिन्निदं प्रोतमशेषमोतं पटे यथा तन्तुवितानसंस्था।
य एष संसारतरुः पुराणः कर्मात्मकः पुष्पफले प्रसूते॥ ११/१२/२१॥

“यथैव वस्त्रे दीर्घं च तिर्यक् चापि सुसंस्थिता।
तन्तुभिः क्रियमाणैव पद्माद्याकारसंस्थितिः।
यथा जीर्णानि वस्त्राणि तन्त्वाधाराणि वा पुनः।
कन्थावयवभूतानि तद्वदेतच्चतुर्मुखे।
सोऽपि तद्वद्धरौ नित्यं संस्थितः श्रीरपि स्फुटम्॥”
इति प्रातिस्विके॥ २१॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: Just as woven cloth rests on the expansion of lengthwise and crosswise threads, similarly the entire universe is expanded on the lengthwise and crosswise potency of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and is situated within Him. The conditioned soul has been accepting material bodies since time immemorial, and these bodies are like great trees sustaining one’s material existence. Just as a tree first blossoms and then produces fruit, similarly the tree of material existence, one’s material body, produces the various results of material existence.

units.sanskrit:
द्वे अस्य बीजे शतमूलस्त्रिनाळः पञ्चस्कन्धः पञ्चरसप्रसूतिः।
दशैकशाखो द्विसुपर्णनीडस्त्रिवल्कलो द्विफलः खं प्रविष्टः॥ ११/१२/२२॥
अदन्ति चैकं फलमस्य गृध्रा ग्रामेचरा एकमरण्यवासाः।
हंसा य एवं बहुरूपमिष्टं मायामयं वेद स वेद वेदम्॥ ११/१२/२३॥
units.english: This tree of material existence has two seeds, hundreds of roots, three lower trunks and five upper trunks. It produces five flavors and has eleven branches and a nest made by two birds. The tree is covered by three types of bark, gives two fruits and extends up to the sun. Those lusty after material enjoyment and dedicated to family life enjoy one of the tree’s fruits, and swanlike men in the renounced order of life enjoy the other fruit. One who with the help of the bona fide teachers can understand this tree to be a manifestation of the potency of the one Supreme Truth appearing in many forms actually knows the meaning of the Vedic literature.

meta.english_verbatim: This tree of material existence has two seeds, hundreds of roots, three lower trunks and five upper trunks. It produces five flavors and has eleven branches and a nest made by two birds. The tree is covered by three types of bark, gives two fruits and extends up to the sun. Those lusty after material enjoyment and dedicated to family life enjoy one of the tree’s fruits, and swanlike men in the renounced order of life enjoy the other fruit. One who with the help of the bona fide spiritual masters can understand this tree to be a manifestation of the potency of the one Supreme Truth appearing in many forms actually knows the meaning of the Vedic literature.

units.sanskrit:
एवं गुरूपासनयैकभक्त्या विद्याकुठारेण शितेन धीरः।
विवृश्च्य जीवाशयमप्रमत्तः सम्पद्य चात्मानमथ त्यजास्त्रम्॥ ११/१२/२४॥
units.english: With steady intelligence you should develop unalloyed devotion by careful worship of the teacher, and with the sharpened ax of transcendental knowledge you should cut off the subtle material covering of the soul. Upon realizing the Lord, you should then give up that ax of analytic knowledge.

parts.sanskrit:
एवं गुरूपासनयैकभक्त्या विद्याकुठारेण शितेन धीरः।
विवृश्च्य जीवाशयमप्रमत्तः सम्पद्य चात्मानमथ त्यजास्त्रम्॥ ११/१२/२४॥

“जगद्वृक्षस्य बीजे द्वे ब्रह्मा चैव सरस्वती।
मूलभूतानि कर्माणि मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कृतिः।
नाळत्वेन
समुद्दिष्टाः खमाद्याः स्कन्धसञ्ज्ञिताः।
एकादशेन्द्रियाण्येव शाखास्तु त्रिगुणास्त्वचः।
प्रवृत्तं च निवृत्तं च फले अस्य प्रकीर्तिते।
पुष्पमैहिकमुद्दिष्टं रसाः शब्दादयस्तयोः।
प्रवृत्ताश्च निवृत्ताश्च पक्षिणस्तत्र संस्थिताः।
वृक्षस्य पृथिवीवच्छ्रीर्विष्णुराकाशवायुवत्।
तस्या अपि सदाधार एवं ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते॥”
इति निवृत्ते॥
“प्राकृतान्तःकरणजं ज्ञानमस्त्रं सृतिच्छिदम्।
तदेव तेन सञ्छेद्यं चित्तं प्रकृतिसम्भवम्।
तेनैव सह सन्त्याज्यं नैव पूर्वं कथञ्चन।
ज्ञानं प्रकृतिजं चापि मूलनाशे विनश्यति।
ततः परं स्वरूपेण ज्ञानेनैव जनार्दनम्।
वेत्ति मुक्तस्तथाऽऽत्मानं जीवानन्यांश्च सर्वशः॥”
इति माहात्म्ये॥
“बीजभूतावपि ह्यस्य ब्रह्मा चैव सरस्वती।
न रिष्यतो जगत्सृष्टौ वटवृक्षादिबीजवत्।
स्वकार्यतो महान्तौ च गुणतो रूपतस्तथा।
पृथिव्युदकवत् तस्माद् बीजत्वं नतु बीजवत्।
व्यञ्जकत्वान्नचाल्पत्वान्महाक्ष्मावद् रमा स्मृता।
अण्डो महाक्ष्मा सम्प्रोक्तस्ततः पृथ्व्युदकं तथा।
जायते नित्यशस्तस्माद् भुक्तम्भुक्तं न हीयते।
तत्राप्युदकवद् ब्रह्मा मृद्वच्चापि सरस्वती।
जलाधारा यतो मृच्च सर्वत्रापि व्यवस्थिता।
अन्यथा तु रजोभूता नीयते वायुनाऽखिला।
अथवा सर्वनाशः स्याज्जलाधारा ततः स्मृता।
वटादिबीजवत् तस्य पुण्यापुण्यमुदीरितम्।
बाह्योदवच्चाग्निवच्च विष्णुरेव प्रकीर्तितः॥”
इति सत्यसंहितायाम्।
श्रियादेरप्याप्यायनत्वाद् बाह्योदवत्। ब्रह्मादेरपि लयकर्तृत्वादग्निवत्। आधारत्वात् सुखदत्वाच्च वायुवत्। अवकाशप्रदत्वाद् व्योमवद् विष्णुः।
“व्रीह्यादिवत् तु मूलत्वं कर्मणां जगतः स्मृतम्।
उदवत् पृथिवीवच्च ब्रह्मणो वाच एव च।
मूलभूवच्छ्रियश्चैव मूलभूरण्डमुच्यते।
बाह्योदाग्नीरखंवत् तु विष्णोर्बीजत्वमिष्यते॥”
इति विश्वसंहितायाम्।
“देहेन्द्रियमनोवाक्षु स्थितो भक्त्यादिसाधकः।
सुपर्णशेषरुद्रादेरपि ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः।
अतो भक्त्यादिकाः सर्वे गुणास्तस्यैव सर्वगाः।
अतिरिक्ताश्च सम्पूर्णाः सुपर्णादेः शताधिकाः।
सुपर्णादिभिरज्ञातास्तदभीमानवर्जिताः।
ब्रह्मणस्तु पुनः सन्ति तेषां कर्ता जनार्दनः।
तस्मात् सर्वाधिको ब्रह्मा गुणैः सर्वैर्न संशयः।
वर्णस्थो वर्णनामाऽसौ स्वरस्थः स्वरनामकः।
मनस्थश्च मनोनामा तन्नामा चक्षुरादिगः।
तस्य सर्वाणि नामानि मुख्यतः कवयो विदुः।
तत्स्थानत्वादिन्द्रियादेर्वर्णादेश्चोपचारतः।
एवमस्योपचारेण विष्णोः साक्षात् तु मुख्यतः॥”
इति शब्दनिर्णये।
“कृष्णप्रियाभ्यो गोपीभ्यो भक्तितो द्विगुणाधिकाः।
महिष्योऽष्टौ विना यास्ताः कथिताः कृष्णवल्लभाः।
ताभ्यः सहस्रसमिता यशोदा नन्दगेहिनी।
ततोऽप्यभ्यधिका देवी देवकी भक्तितस्ततः।
वसुदेवस्ततो जिष्णुस्ततो रामो महाबलः।
न ततोऽभ्यधिकः कश्चिद् भक्त्यादौ पुरुषोत्तमे।
विना ब्रह्माणमीशेशं स हि सर्वाधिकः स्मृतः॥”
इत्यन्तर्यामिसंहितायाम्।
“पापद्वेषादिका दोषा अवराणां न संशयः।
भक्त्यादिगुणपूगस्तु पराणामा विरिञ्चतः।
स्वातन्त्र्यात् सर्वदेहेषु स्थितानामपि सर्वशः।
स्पृश्यन्ते नैव दोषैस्ते गुणादानैकतत्पराः॥”
इति विवेके।
“यदु किञ्चेमाः प्रजाः शोचन्त्यमैवासां तद् भवति पुण्यमेवामुं गच्छति न ह वै देवान् पापं गच्छति” इति च॥ २२-२४॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: With steady intelligence you should develop unalloyed devotional service by careful worship of the spiritual master, and with the sharpened ax of transcendental knowledge you should cut off the subtle material covering of the soul. Upon realizing the Supreme Personality of Godhead, you should then give up that ax of analytic knowledge.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सत्वं रजस्तम इति गुणा बुद्धेर्न चात्मनः।
सत्वेनान्यतमौ हन्यात् सत्वं सत्वेन चैव हि॥ ११/१३/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: The three modes of material nature, namely goodness, passion and ignorance, pertain to material intelligence and not to the spirit soul. By development of material goodness one can conquer the modes of passion and ignorance, and by cultivation of transcendental goodness one may free oneself even from material goodness.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: The three modes of material nature, namely goodness, passion and ignorance, pertain to material intelligence and not to the spirit soul. By development of material goodness one can conquer the modes of passion and ignorance, and by cultivation of transcendental goodness one may free oneself even from material goodness.

units.sanskrit:
सत्वाद् धर्मो भवेच्छुद्धात् पुंसो मद्भक्तिलक्षणः।
सात्विकोपात्तया ज्ञानं ततो धर्मः प्रवर्तते॥ ११/१३/२॥
units.english: When the living being becomes strongly situated in the mode of goodness, then religious principles, characterized by devotion to Me, become prominent. One can strengthen the mode of goodness by cultivation of those things that are already situated in goodness, and thus religious principles arise.

parts.sanskrit:
सत्वाद् धर्मो भवेच्छुद्धात् पुंसो मद्भक्तिलक्षणः।
सात्विकोपात्तया ज्ञानं ततो धर्मः प्रवर्तते॥ ११/१३/२॥
धर्मात् पुनः सत्त्वोद्रेकः। सत्त्वोद्रिक्तया बुद्ध्या पुनः सत्त्वोद्रेकात् पुनर्धर्मोद्रेकः॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: When the living entity becomes strongly situated in the mode of goodness, then religious principles, characterized by devotional service to Me, become prominent. One can strengthen the mode of goodness by cultivation of those things that are already situated in goodness, and thus religious principles arise.

units.sanskrit:
धर्मो रजस्तमो हन्यात् सत्ववृत्तिरनुत्तमा।
आशु नश्यति तन्मूलो ह्यधर्म उभये हते॥ ११/१३/३॥
units.english: Religious principles, strengthened by the mode of goodness, destroy the influence of passion and ignorance. When passion and ignorance are overcome, their original cause, irreligion, is quickly vanquished.

meta.english_verbatim: Religious principles, strengthened by the mode of goodness, destroy the influence of passion and ignorance. When passion and ignorance are overcome, their original cause, irreligion, is quickly vanquished.

units.sanskrit:
आगमो यजनं देशः कालः कर्म च जन्म च।
ध्यानं मन्त्रोऽथ संस्कारो नवैते गुणहेतवः॥ ११/१३/४॥
units.english: According to the quality of religious scriptures, water, one’s association with one’s children or with people in general, the particular place, the time, activities, birth, meditation, chanting of mantras, and purificatory rituals, the modes of nature become differently prominent.

meta.english_verbatim: According to the quality of religious scriptures, water, one’s association with one’s children or with people in general, the particular place, the time, activities, birth, meditation, chanting of mantras, and purificatory rituals, the modes of nature become differently prominent.

units.sanskrit:
तत्तत् सात्विकमेवैषां यद्यद् वृद्धाः प्रचक्षते।
निन्दन्ति तामसं तत्तद् राजसं तदुपेक्षितम्॥ ११/१३/५॥
units.english: Among the ten items I have just mentioned, the great sages who understand Vedic knowledge have praised and recommended those that are in the mode of goodness, criticized and rejected those in the mode of ignorance, and shown indifference to those in the mode of passion.

meta.english_verbatim: Among the ten items I have just mentioned, the great sages who understand Vedic knowledge have praised and recommended those that are in the mode of goodness, criticized and rejected those in the mode of ignorance, and shown indifference to those in the mode of passion.

units.sanskrit:
सात्विकान्येव सेवेत पुमान् सत्वविवृद्धये।
ततो धर्मस्ततो ज्ञानं वाचः स्मृतिरपोहनम्॥ ११/१३/६॥
units.english: Until one revives one’s direct knowledge of the spirit soul and drives away the illusory identification with the material body and mind caused by the three modes of nature, one must cultivate those things in the mode of goodness. By increasing the mode of goodness, one automatically can understand and practice religious principles, and by such practice transcendental knowledge is awakened.

meta.english_verbatim: Until one revives one’s direct knowledge of the spirit soul and drives away the illusory identification with the material body and mind caused by the three modes of nature, one must cultivate those things in the mode of goodness. By increasing the mode of goodness, one automatically can understand and practice religious principles, and by such practice transcendental knowledge is awakened.

units.sanskrit:
वेणुसङ्घर्षजो वह्निर्दग्ध्वा शाम्यति तद्वनम्।
एवं गुणव्यत्ययजो वेदः शाम्यति तद् यथा॥ ११/१३/७॥
units.english: In a bamboo forest the wind sometimes rubs the bamboo stalks together, and such friction generates a blazing fire that consumes the very source of its birth, the bamboo forest. Thus, the fire is automatically calmed by its own action. Similarly, by the competition and interaction of the material modes of nature, the subtle and gross material bodies are generated. If one uses his mind and body to cultivate knowledge, then such enlightenment destroys the influence of the modes of nature that generated one’s body. Thus, like the fire, the body and mind are pacified by their own actions in destroying the source of their birth.

parts.sanskrit:
वेणुसङ्घर्षजो वह्निर्दग्ध्वा शाम्यति तद्वनम्।
एवं गुणव्यत्ययजो वेदः शाम्यति तद् यथा॥ ११/१३/७॥

वेदो वृत्तिज्ञानम्।
“मुक्ताश्चाधीयते वेदान् जडज्ञानबहिष्कृताः।
स्वरूपभूतज्ञानेन पश्यन्तः सर्वमञ्जसा॥”
इति तात्त्विके॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: In a bamboo forest the wind sometimes rubs the bamboo stalks together, and such friction generates a blazing fire that consumes the very source of its birth, the bamboo forest. Thus, the fire is automatically calmed by its own action. Similarly, by the competition and interaction of the material modes of nature, the subtle and gross material bodies are generated. If one uses his mind and body to cultivate knowledge, then such enlightenment destroys the influence of the modes of nature that generated one’s body. Thus, like the fire, the body and mind are pacified by their own actions in destroying the source of their birth.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
विदन्ति मर्त्याः प्रायेण विषयान् पदमापदाम्।
अथापि भुञ्जते कृष्ण तत् कथं श्वखराजवत्॥ ११/१३/८॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Kṛṣṇa, generally human beings know that material life brings great future unhappiness, and still they try to enjoy material life. My dear Lord, how can one in knowledge act just like a dog, an ass or a goat?

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Kṛṣṇa, generally human beings know that material life brings great future unhappiness, and still they try to enjoy material life. My dear Lord, how can one in knowledge act just like a dog, an ass or a goat?

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
अहमित्यन्यथाबुद्धिः प्रमत्तस्य यदा हृदि।
उत्सर्पति रजो घोरं ततो वैकारिकं मनः॥ ११/१३/९॥
रजोयुक्तस्य मनसः सङ्कल्पः सविकल्पकः।
ततः कामो गुणध्यानाद् दुःसहः स्याद् हि दुर्मतेः॥ ११/१३/१०॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, a person bereft of intelligence first falsely identifies himself with the material body and mind, and when such false knowledge arises within one’s consciousness, material passion, the cause of great suffering, pervades the mind, which by nature is situated in goodness. Then the mind, contaminated by passion, becomes absorbed in making and changing many plans for material advancement. Thus, by constantly thinking of the modes of material nature, a foolish person is afflicted with unbearable material desires.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, a person bereft of intelligence first falsely identifies himself with the material body and mind, and when such false knowledge arises within one’s consciousness, material passion, the cause of great suffering, pervades the mind, which by nature is situated in goodness. Then the mind, contaminated by passion, becomes absorbed in making and changing many plans for material advancement. Thus, by constantly thinking of the modes of material nature, a foolish person is afflicted with unbearable material desires.

units.sanskrit:
करोति कामवशगः कर्माण्यविजितेन्द्रियः।
दुःखोदर्काणि संपश्यन् रजोवेगविमोहितः॥ ११/१३/११॥
units.english: One who does not control the material senses comes under the control of material desires and is thus bewildered by the strong waves of the mode of passion. Such a person executes material activities, although clearly seeing that the result will be future unhappiness.

meta.english_verbatim: One who does not control the material senses comes under the control of material desires and is thus bewildered by the strong waves of the mode of passion. Such a person executes material activities, although clearly seeing that the result will be future unhappiness.

units.sanskrit:
रजस्तमोभ्यां यदपि विद्वान् विक्षिप्तधीः पुनः।
अतन्द्रितो मनो युञ्जन् दोषदृष्टिर्न सज्जते॥ ११/१३/१२॥
units.english: Although the intelligence of a learned person may be bewildered by the modes of passion and ignorance, he should again carefully bring the mind under control. By clearly seeing the contamination of the modes of nature, he does not become attached.

meta.english_verbatim: Although the intelligence of a learned person may be bewildered by the modes of passion and ignorance, he should again carefully bring the mind under control. By clearly seeing the contamination of the modes of nature, he does not become attached.

units.sanskrit:
अप्रमत्तो हि युञ्जीत मनो मय्यर्पयन् शनैः।
अनिर्विण्णो यथाकालं जितश्वासो जितासनः॥ ११/१३/१३॥
units.english: A person should be attentive and grave and never lazy or morose. Mastering the yoga procedures of breathing and sitting properly, one should practice fixing the mind on Me at dawn, noon and sunset, and thus gradually the mind should be completely absorbed in Me.

meta.english_verbatim: A person should be attentive and grave and never lazy or morose. Mastering the yoga procedures of breathing and sitting properly, one should practice fixing the mind on Me at dawn, noon and sunset, and thus gradually the mind should be completely absorbed in Me.

units.sanskrit:
एतावान् योग आदिष्टो मच्छिष्यैः सनकादिभिः।
सर्वतो मन आकृष्य मय्यद्धाऽऽवेश्यते यथा॥ ११/१३/१४॥
units.english: The actual yoga system as taught by My devotees, headed by Sanaka-kumāra, is simply this: Having withdrawn the mind from all other objects, one should directly and appropriately absorb it in Me.

meta.english_verbatim: The actual yoga system as taught by My devotees, headed by Sanaka-kumāra, is simply this: Having withdrawn the mind from all other objects, one should directly and appropriately absorb it in Me.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
यदा त्वं सनकादिभ्यो येन रूपेण केशव।
योगमादिष्टवानेतद् रूपमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥ ११/१३/१५॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Keśava, at what time and in what form did You instruct the science of yoga to Sanaka and his brothers? I now desire to know about these things.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Keśava, at what time and in what form did You instruct the science of yoga to Sanaka and his brothers? I now desire to know about these things.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
पुत्रा हिरण्यगर्भस्य मानसाः सनकादयः।
पप्रच्छुः पितरं सूक्ष्मां योगस्यैकान्तिकां गतिम्॥ ११/१३/१६॥
units.english: The Lord said: Once, the mental sons of Lord Brahmā, namely, the sages headed by Sanaka, inquired from their father about the difficult subject matter of the supreme goal of yoga.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Once, the mental sons of Lord Brahmā, namely, the sages headed by Sanaka, inquired from their father about the difficult subject matter of the supreme goal of yoga.

units.sanskrit:
सनकादय ऊचुः
गुणेष्वाविशते चेतो गुणाश्चेतसि च प्रभो।
कथमन्योन्यसन्त्यागो मुमुक्षोः संतितीर्षोः॥ ११/१३/१७॥
units.english: The sages headed by Sanaka said: O Lord, people’s minds are naturally attracted to material sense objects, and similarly the sense objects in the form of desire enter within the mind. Therefore, how can a person who desires liberation, who desires to cross over activities of sense enjoyment, destroy this mutual relationship between the sense objects and the mind? Please explain this to us.

meta.english_verbatim: The sages headed by Sanaka said: O Lord, people’s minds are naturally attracted to material sense objects, and similarly the sense objects in the form of desire enter within the mind. Therefore, how can a person who desires liberation, who desires to cross over activities of sense gratification, destroy this mutual relationship between the sense objects and the mind? Please explain this to us.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
एवं पृष्टो महान् देवः स्वयम्भूर्भूतभावनः।
ध्यायमानः प्रश्नबीजं नाभ्यपद्यत कर्मधीः॥ ११/१३/१८॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, Brahmā himself, who is born directly from the body of the Lord and who is the creator of all living beings within the material world, being the best of the gods, seriously contemplated the question of his sons headed by Sanaka. The intelligence of Brahmā, however, was affected by his own activities of creation, and thus he could not discover the essential answer to this question.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
एवं पृष्टो महान् देवः स्वयम्भूर्भूतभावनः।
ध्यायमानः प्रश्नबीजं नाभ्यपद्यत कर्मधीः॥ ११/१३/१८॥

प्रश्नो बीजमस्येति प्रश्नबीजं परिहारम्। गुणानां चेतसश्च कर्म कारणमिति मन्वानः कर्मधीः।
“ब्रह्मा पृष्टस्तु योगीन्द्रैः सनकाद्यैर्मनोगतेः।
कारणं विषयेष्वद्धा कर्मेति प्रत्यपद्यत।
हेतुरन्योऽपि तत्रास्तीत्येवं जानन्नपि प्रभुः।
विशेषतो मनस्तत्र नाधाज्जानन् हरेः प्रियम्।
स्वात्मना परिहारोक्तिस्तदा ह्यासीद्धरेः प्रिया।
अतः स तत्प्रियं जानन् नाकरोत् तद्विचारणम्।
तमेवाचिन्तयद् देवः प्रश्ननिर्णयकारणात्।
भ्रमतीव मनः क्वापि ब्रह्मणो विष्णुमायया।
सर्वज्ञस्यापि तत्रात्मा वक्तुमिच्छेज्जनार्दनः।
तज्ज्ञात्वा चिन्तितं तस्य चिन्तयत्यमुमेव तु।
न स्वयं चिन्तयत्यर्थं स हि तद्भाववित् सदा।
अन्ये त्वज्ञानसंयुक्ता मोहमीयुर्यथाक्रमम्।
तस्य
माध्यन्दिने सूर्ये क्षोभवत्
क्षोभमात्रकम्।
नैवाज्ञानं यथा सूर्ये तमो नास्ति कदाचन॥”
इति भावविवेके॥ १८॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, Brahmā himself, who is born directly from the body of the Lord and who is the creator of all living entities within the material world, being the best of the demigods, seriously contemplated the question of his sons headed by Sanaka. The intelligence of Brahmā, however, was affected by his own activities of creation, and thus he could not discover the essential answer to this question.

units.sanskrit:
स मामचिन्तयद् देवः प्रश्नपारविनिश्चयम्।
तस्याहं हंसरूपेण समीपमगमं तदा॥ ११/१३/१९॥
units.english: Lord Brahmā desired to attain the answer to the question that was puzzling him, and thus he fixed his mind on Me, the Supreme Lord. At that time, in My form of Haṁsa, I became visible to Lord Brahmā.

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Brahmā desired to attain the answer to the question that was puzzling him, and thus he fixed his mind on Me, the Supreme Lord. At that time, in My form of Haṁsa, I became visible to Lord Brahmā.

units.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा मां त उपाव्रज्य कृत्वा पादाभिवन्दनम्।
ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा पप्रच्छुः को भवानिति॥ ११/१३/२०॥
units.english: Thus seeing Me, the sages, placing Brahmā in the lead, came forward and worshiped My lotus feet. Then they frankly asked Me, “Who are You?”

meta.english_verbatim: Thus seeing Me, the sages, placing Brahmā in the lead, came forward and worshiped My lotus feet. Then they frankly asked Me, “Who are You?”

units.sanskrit:
इत्यहं मुनिभिः पृष्टस्तत्वजिज्ञासुभिस्तदा।
यदवोचमहं तेभ्यस्तदुद्धव निबोध मे॥ ११/१३/२१॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, the sages, being eager to understand the ultimate truth of the yoga system, thus inquired from Me. Now please hear as I explain that which I spoke unto the sages.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, the sages, being eager to understand the ultimate truth of the yoga system, thus inquired from Me. Now please hear as I explain that which I spoke unto the sages.

units.sanskrit:
वस्तुनो यद्यनानात्व१ आत्मनः प्रश्नः ईदृशः।
कथं घटेत वो विप्रा वक्तुं वाऽनेक आश्रयः॥ ११/१३/२२॥
units.english: My dear brāhmaṇas, if, when asking Me who I am, you believe that I am also a jīva soul and that there is no ultimate difference between us — since all souls are ultimately one without individuality — then how is your question possible or appropriate? Ultimately, what is the real situation or resting place both of yourselves and of Me?

meta.english_verbatim: My dear brāhmaṇas, if, when asking Me who I am, you believe that I am also a jīva soul and that there is no ultimate difference between us — since all souls are ultimately one without individuality — then how is your question possible or appropriate? Ultimately, what is the real situation or resting place both of yourselves and of Me?

units.sanskrit:
पञ्चात्मकेषु भूतेषु समानेषु च वस्तुतः।
को भवानिति वः प्रश्नो वाचारम्भो निरर्थकः॥ ११/१३/२३॥
units.english: If by asking Me “Who are You?” you were referring to the material body, then I must point out that all material bodies are constituted of five elements, namely earth, water, fire, air and ether. Thus, you should have asked, “Who are you five?” If you consider that all material bodies are ultimately one, being constituted essentially of the same elements, then your question is still meaningless, since there would be no deep purpose in distinguishing one body from another. Thus, it appears that in asking My identity, you are merely speaking words, without any real meaning or purpose.

meta.english_verbatim: If by asking Me “Who are You?” you were referring to the material body, then I must point out that all material bodies are constituted of five elements, namely earth, water, fire, air and ether. Thus, you should have asked, “Who are you five?” If you consider that all material bodies are ultimately one, being constituted essentially of the same elements, then your question is still meaningless, since there would be no deep purpose in distinguishing one body from another. Thus, it appears that in asking My identity, you are merely speaking words, without any real meaning or purpose.

units.sanskrit:
मनसा वचसा दृष्ट्या गृह्यतेऽन्यैरपीन्द्रियैः।
अहमेव न मत्तोऽन्यदिति बुद्ध्यध्वमञ्जसा॥ ११/१३/२४॥
units.english: Within this world, whatever is perceived by the mind, speech, eyes or other senses is Me alone and nothing besides Me. All of you please understand this by a straightforward analysis of the facts.

parts.sanskrit:
मनसा वचसा दृष्ट्या गृह्यतेऽन्यैरपीन्द्रियैः।
अहमेव न मत्तोऽन्यदिति बुद्ध्यध्वमञ्जसा॥ ११/१३/२४॥

आत्मनो वस्तुनः परमात्मवस्तुन एकत्वं यद्यङ्गीकृतम्, तदा कथं प्रश्नो घटेत? नहि परमात्मनोऽन्यो ब्रह्मणा पूज्यः स्यादभिवन्दनादिना। तस्माद् ब्रह्मणो वन्द्यः परमात्मैव, स चैक एव, अतः कथं प्रश्नः परिहारो वा॥
वस्तुतः समानेषु हिरण्यगर्भावरत्वात् तद्वन्द्यत्वाभावापेक्षया। तस्माद् ब्रह्मणो वन्दनानन्तरं विचारो न घटते। तस्मात् को भवानिति वाचा प्रारब्धः प्रश्नो निरर्थकः॥
यस्मान्मनआदिभिर्गृह्यमाणमहं न भवाम्येव। स्वयमपि प्रसादात् कथञ्चिद् गृह्यत इत्यत आह- मत्तोऽन्यदिति॥ यन्मनआदिभिर्विचार्य मत्तोऽन्यत्वेनैव ज्ञायते, तदहं न भवाम्येवेति बुध्यध्वम्। विचारितस्यापि पुनः संशयकारणं परिकल्प्य संशयो न कर्तव्यः। अतः को भवानिति नारब्धव्यः। गुणेष्वाविशते चेत इत्येव प्रश्न आरब्धव्यः।
“न
युष्माकं मयि प्रश्नो घटतेऽयं
कथञ्चन।
मामृते नहि वन्द्योऽस्ति विरिञ्चेः क्वापि कश्चन।
अभिवन्दितपादं मां विरिञ्चेन कथं पुनः।
पृच्छथान्ये समा यस्मादवरत्वे चतुर्मुखात्।
देवा मनुष्याः पितरो गन्धर्वा असुरास्तथा।
इति पञ्चात्मकं सर्वं ब्रह्मणस्त्ववरं यतः।
यन्मदन्यद् विचारेण गृह्यते तन्नचास्म्यहम्।
इति जानीध्वमद्धैव मत्प्रसादाद्धि मद्दृशिः।
अन्यत् स्वभावतो दृश्यं मम प्रेरणयैव तु।
तस्माद् विवक्षितार्थे तु प्रश्नारम्भो न मद्गतः॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते।
“इदं हि
विश्वं
भगवानिवेतरः”
इति च।
“प्रकृतेर्व्यतिरिक्तो यः पुरुषश्चेति कथ्यते।
तं विद्यात् परमात्मानं वासुदेवेति यं विदुः॥”
इति भारते।
“प्रकृतेः प्राकृताच्चैव व्यतिरिक्तं गुणाधिकम्।
ये विदुः परमात्मानं ते यान्ति परमं पदम्॥”
इति च।
“नैतदिच्छन्ति पुरुषमेकं कुरुकुलोद्वह।
बहूनां पुरुषाणां हि यथैका योनिरुच्यते॥
तथा तं पुरुषं विश्वमाख्यास्यामि गुणाधिकम्॥”
इति च॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Within this world, whatever is perceived by the mind, speech, eyes or other senses is Me alone and nothing besides Me. All of you please understand this by a straightforward analysis of the facts.

units.sanskrit:
गुणेष्वाविशते चेतो गुणाश्चेतसि वः प्रजाः।
जीवस्य देह उभयं गुणाश्चेतो मदात्मनः॥ ११/१३/२५॥
units.english: My dear sons, the mind has a natural proclivity to enter into the material sense objects, and similarly the sense objects enter into the mind; but both this material mind and the sense objects are merely designations that cover the spirit soul, who is part and parcel of Me.

parts.sanskrit:
गुणेष्वाविशते चेतो गुणाश्चेतसि वः प्रजाः।
जीवस्य देह उभयं गुणाश्चेतो मदात्मनः॥ ११/१३/२५॥
मय्येवात्मा मनो यस्य स मदात्मा तस्योभयं देहे दग्धमभवत्॥ २५॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear sons, the mind has a natural proclivity to enter into the material sense objects, and similarly the sense objects enter into the mind; but both this material mind and the sense objects are merely designations that cover the spirit soul, who is part and parcel of Me.

units.sanskrit:
गुणेषु वा विशेच्चितमभीक्ष्णं गुणसेवया।
गुणाश्च चित्तप्रभवा मद्रूप उभयं त्यजेत्॥ ११/१३/२६॥
units.english: A person who has thus achieved Me by understanding that he is not different from Me realizes that the material mind is lodged within the sense objects because of constant sense enjoyment, and that the material objects are existing prominently within the material mind. Having understood My transcendental nature, he gives up both the material mind and its objects.

parts.sanskrit:
गुणेषु वा विशेच्चितमभीक्ष्णं गुणसेवया।
गुणाश्च चित्तप्रभवा मद्रूप उभयं त्यजेत्॥ ११/१३/२६॥

मत्स्वरूपे तदुभयं त्यजेत्। मयि स्थिताश्चेतो गुणाश्चेति।
“विष्णुस्था विषयाः सर्वे विष्णावेव मनो मम।
इति मय्यर्प्य तत् सर्वं त्यजेत् तत् तन्न बाधते॥”
इति साम्ये॥ २६॥

meta.english_verbatim: A person who has thus achieved Me by understanding that he is not different from Me realizes that the material mind is lodged within the sense objects because of constant sense gratification, and that the material objects are existing prominently within the material mind. Having understood My transcendental nature, he gives up both the material mind and its objects.

units.sanskrit:
जाग्रत् स्वप्नः सुषुप्तिश्च गुणतो बुद्धिवृत्तयः।
तासां विलक्षणो जीवः साक्षित्वेन विनिश्चितः॥ ११/१३/२७॥
units.english: Waking, sleeping and deep sleep are the three functions of the intelligence and are caused by the modes of material nature. The living being within the body is ascertained to possess characteristics different from these three states and thus remains as a witness to them.

meta.english_verbatim: Waking, sleeping and deep sleep are the three functions of the intelligence and are caused by the modes of material nature. The living entity within the body is ascertained to possess characteristics different from these three states and thus remains as a witness to them.

units.sanskrit:
यर्हि संसृतिबन्धोऽयमात्मनो गुणवृत्तितः।
मयि तुर्ये स्थितो जह्यात् त्यागस्तु गुणचेतसाम्॥ ११/१३/२८॥
units.english: The spirit soul is trapped in the bondage of material intelligence, which awards him constant engagement in the illusory modes of nature. But I am the fourth stage of consciousness, beyond wakefulness, dreaming and deep sleep. Becoming situated in Me, the soul should give up the bondage of material consciousness. At that time, the living being will automatically renounce the material sense objects and the material mind.

parts.sanskrit:
यर्हि संसृतिबन्धोऽयमात्मनो गुणवृत्तितः।
मयि तुर्ये स्थितो जह्यात् त्यागस्तु गुणचेतसाम्॥ ११/१३/२८॥
गुणचेतसां त्याग एव बन्धत्यागः॥ २८॥

units.sanskrit:
अहङ्कारकृतं बन्धमात्मनोऽर्थविपर्ययम्।
विद्वान् निर्विद्य संसारचिन्तां तुर्ये स्थितस्त्यजेत्॥ ११/१३/२९॥
units.english: The false ego of the living being places him in bondage and awards him exactly the opposite of what he really desires. Therefore, an intelligent person should give up his constant anxiety to enjoy material life and remain situated in the Lord, who is beyond the functions of material consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: The false ego of the living entity places him in bondage and awards him exactly the opposite of what he really desires. Therefore, an intelligent person should give up his constant anxiety to enjoy material life and remain situated in the Lord, who is beyond the functions of material consciousness.

units.sanskrit:
यावन्नानार्थधीः पुंसो न निवर्तेत युक्तिभिः।
जाग्रत्यपि स्वपन्नज्ञः स्वप्ने जागरणं यथा॥ ११/१३/३०॥
units.english: According to My instructions, one should fix the mind on Me alone. If, however, one continues to see many different values and goals in life rather than seeing everything within Me, then although apparently awake, one is actually dreaming due to incomplete knowledge, just as one may dream that one has wakened from a dream.

parts.sanskrit:
यावन्नानार्थधीः पुंसो न निवर्तेत युक्तिभिः।
जाग्रत्यपि स्वपन्नज्ञः स्वप्ने जागरणं यथा॥ ११/१३/३०॥

“भिन्नस्य त्वेकभावेन तथैकस्य च भेदतः।
ज्ञानं नानार्थधीः प्रोक्ता नानात्वादर्थतद्धियोः॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के॥ ३०॥

meta.english_verbatim: According to My instructions, one should fix the mind on Me alone. If, however, one continues to see many different values and goals in life rather than seeing everything within Me, then although apparently awake, one is actually dreaming due to incomplete knowledge, just as one may dream that one has wakened from a dream.

units.sanskrit:
असत्त्वादात्मनोऽन्येषां भावानां किंकृताऽभिदा।
गतयो हेतवश्चास्य मृषा स्वप्नदृशो यथा॥ ११/१३/३१॥
units.english: Those states of existence that are conceived of as separate from the Lord have no actual existence, although they create a sense of separation from the Absolute Truth. Just as the seer of a dream imagines many different activities and rewards, similarly, because of the sense of an existence separate from the Lord’s existence, the living being falsely performs actions aimed at results, thinking them to be the cause of future rewards and destinations.

parts.sanskrit:
असत्त्वादात्मनोऽन्येषां भावानां किंकृताऽभिदा।
गतयो हेतवश्चास्य मृषा स्वप्नदृशो यथा॥ ११/१३/३१॥

“अभिदा किङ्कृतैतेषां भावानां परमेश्वरे।
यतोऽसत्वमशक्तत्वाद् भावानां तस्य शक्तता।
ततः सत्त्वं साधुभावः सत्त्वमित्युच्यते बुधैः।
साधुभावश्च शक्तस्य ततोऽन्याऽसाधुता ततः।
अभेदे जगतो विष्णोर्या वाचो ये च हेतवः।
स्वप्नजाग्रत्कल्पकवत् सर्वे ते भ्रमदर्शिताः॥”
इति शश्वत्संहितायाम् ॥ ३१॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Those states of existence that are conceived of as separate from the Supreme Personality of Godhead have no actual existence, although they create a sense of separation from the Absolute Truth. Just as the seer of a dream imagines many different activities and rewards, similarly, because of the sense of an existence separate from the Lord’s existence, the living entity falsely performs fruitive activities, thinking them to be the cause of future rewards and destinations.

units.sanskrit:
यो जागरे बहुविधान् क्षणधर्मिणोऽर्थान्
भुङ्क्ते समस्तकरणो हृदि तत्सदृक्षान्।
स्वप्नेऽथ सुप्त उपसंहरते स एकः
स्मृत्यन्वयात् त्रिगुणवृत्तिदृगिन्द्रियेशः॥ ११/१३/३२॥
units.english: While awake the living being enjoys with all of his senses the fleeting characteristics of the material body and mind; while dreaming he enjoys similar experiences within the mind; and in deep dreamless sleep all such experiences merge into ignorance. By remembering and contemplating the succession of wakefulness, dreaming and deep sleep, the living being can understand that he is one throughout the three stages of consciousness and is transcendental. Thus, he becomes the lord of the senses.

parts.sanskrit:
यो जागरे बहुविधान् क्षणधर्मिणोऽर्थान्
भुङ्क्ते समस्तकरणो हृदि तत्सदृक्षान्।
स्वप्नेऽथ सुप्त उपसंहरते स एकः
स्मृत्यन्वयात् त्रिगुणवृत्तिदृगिन्द्रियेशः॥ ११/१३/३२॥

“दक्षिणाक्षिस्थितो विष्णुर्भुङ्क्तेऽर्थान् जाग्रदास्थितान्।
कण्ठसंस्थस्तथा स्वप्नान् जीवानन्दं च सुप्तिगः।
श्रुत्यन्वयात् स्मृतिभ्यश्च स एकः परमेश्वरः।
अस्वतन्त्रस्य जीवस्य स्वतन्त्रो जाग्रदादिदः।
स्वयं स्वप्नादिहीनः सन् क्रीडते पुरुषोत्तमः॥”
इति सत्तत्त्वे।
“स्वप्नेन शारीरमभिप्रहत्यासुप्तः सुप्तानभिचाकशीति” इत्यादि च॥ ३२॥

units.sanskrit:
एवं विमृश्य गुणतो मनसस्त्र्यवस्था
मन्मायया मयि कृता इति निश्चितार्थाः।
सञ्छिद्य हार्दमनुमानसदुक्तितीक्ष्ण-
ज्ञानासिना भजत माऽखिलसंशयाधिम्॥ ११/१३/३३॥
units.english: You should consider how, by the influence of My illusory energy, these three states of the mind, caused by the modes of nature, have been artificially imagined to exist in Me. Having definitely ascertained the truth of the soul, you should utilize the sharpened sword of knowledge, acquired by logical reflection and from the instructions of sages and Vedic literatures, to completely cut off the false ego, which is the breeding ground of all doubts. All of you should then worship Me, who am situated within the heart.

units.sanskrit:
वीक्षेत विभ्रममिमं मनसो विलासं
दृष्टं विनष्टमतिलोलमलातचक्रम्।
विज्ञानमेकमुरुधेव विभाति माया स्वप्ने
यथा त्रिगुणसर्गकृतो विकल्पः॥ ११/१३/३४॥
units.english: One should see that the material world is a distinct illusion appearing in the mind, because material objects have an extremely flickering existence and are here today and gone tomorrow. They can be compared to the streaking red line created by whirling a fiery stick. The spirit soul by nature exists in the single state of pure consciousness. However, in this world he appears in many different forms and stages of existence. The modes of nature divide the soul’s consciousness into normal wakefulness, dreaming and dreamless sleep. All such varieties of perception, however, are actually māyā and exist only like a dream.

parts.sanskrit:
वीक्षेत विभ्रममिमं मनसो विलासं
दृष्टं विनष्टमतिलोलमलातचक्रम्।
विज्ञानमेकमुरुधेव विभाति माया स्वप्ने
यथा त्रिगुणसर्गकृतो विकल्पः॥ ११/१३/३४॥

जाग्रदादिषु परमात्मभेदं विभ्रमं वीक्षेत।
“जाग्रदादिकरो देवः परमात्मैक एव तु।
इति वीक्षेत सततं मुच्यते संसृतेरतः॥”
इति प्रकाशसंहितायाम्।
यदा विभ्रमोऽयमिति दृष्टस्तदैव विनष्टः। श्रुतियुक्तिभिर्विचारितेऽतिलोलः। क्षिप्रं विनश्यतीत्यर्थः। अलातस्य चक्राकारत्वभ्रमवत् परमात्मभेदभ्रमः। त्रिगुणैस्तत्कायैः पापादिभिश्च बद्धः सन् विज्ञानरूपं परमात्मानं भ्रान्त्या बहुधा पश्यति।
“देहभेदेष्ववस्थासु प्रादुर्भावेषु चैकलम्।
ज्ञानानन्दैकसद्रूपं भ्रान्त्या भिन्नं प्रपश्यति।
सा च भ्रान्तिर्विनश्येत यदा भ्रान्तित्ववेदनम्।
अतिक्षिप्रं विनश्येच्च न स्थिरं दिग्भ्रमादिवत्।
त्रिगुणैर्बन्धिता जीवा ज्ञप्तिमात्रं जनार्दनम्।
पश्यन्ति बहुधा स्वप्ने यथैकं बहुधा क्वचित्।
अभिन्नोऽपि विभिन्नेषु व्यवहारो यथा भवेत्।
तथैव व्यवहाराय शक्तत्वान्नैव दूषणम्।
ईशस्य तु तदन्येषामपि यच्छक्तिदायकः॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के।
अलातभ्रामको यदा निवर्तते तदैव भ्रमो निवर्तते। तद्वद् यदा भ्रमनिवृत्तिमिच्छति तदैव गुरूपसदनान्निवर्तयितुं शक्यः।
“अशक्योऽप्यतिशक्योऽयं विनिवर्तयितुं भ्रमः।
ईशस्थो गुरुसम्पत्त्या यदि शुद्धमनाः पुमान्॥”
इति सम्यग्ज्ञाने॥ ३४॥

meta.english_verbatim: One should see that the material world is a distinct illusion appearing in the mind, because material objects have an extremely flickering existence and are here today and gone tomorrow. They can be compared to the streaking red line created by whirling a fiery stick. The spirit soul by nature exists in the single state of pure consciousness. However, in this world he appears in many different forms and stages of existence. The modes of nature divide the soul’s consciousness into normal wakefulness, dreaming and dreamless sleep. All such varieties of perception, however, are actually māyā and exist only like a dream.

units.sanskrit:
दृष्टिं ततः प्रतिनिवर्त्य निवृत्ततर्षस्तूष्णीं
भवेन्निजसुखानुभवो निरीहः।
सन्दृश्यते क्वच यदीदमवस्तुबुद्ध्या
त्यक्तं भ्रमाय न भवेत् स्मृतिरानिपातात्॥ ११/१३/३५॥
units.english: Having understood the temporary illusory nature of material things, and thus having pulled one’s vision away from illusion, one should remain without material desires. By experiencing the happiness of the soul, one should give up material speaking and activities. If sometimes one must observe the material world, one should remember that it is not ultimate reality and therefore one has given it up. By such constant remembrance up till the time of death, one will not again fall into illusion.

parts.sanskrit:
दृष्टिं ततः प्रतिनिवर्त्य निवृत्ततर्षस्तूष्णीं
भवेन्निजसुखानुभवो निरीहः।
सन्दृश्यते क्वच यदीदमवस्तुबुद्ध्या
त्यक्तं भ्रमाय न भवेत् स्मृतिरानिपातात्॥ ११/१३/३५॥
निपातमन्धन्तमः। मोक्षमारभ्य तावत्पर्यन्तं स्मृतिर्यस्माज्ज्ञानिनो वर्तते, अतो मूढेषु स्थितो भ्रमो यद्यपि सन्दृश्यते तेन तथाऽपि भ्रमाय न भवति। फलं हि निपातं स्मरति॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Having understood the temporary illusory nature of material things, and thus having pulled one’s vision away from illusion, one should remain without material desires. By experiencing the happiness of the soul, one should give up material speaking and activities. If sometimes one must observe the material world, one should remember that it is not ultimate reality and therefore one has given it up. By such constant remembrance up till the time of death, one will not again fall into illusion.

units.sanskrit:
देहं च नश्वरमवस्थितमुत्थितं वा
सिद्धो न पश्यति यतोऽध्यगमत् स्वरूपम्।
दैवादुपेतमथ दैववशादपेतं
वासो यथा परिवृतं मदिरामदान्धः॥ ११/१३/३६॥
units.english: Just as a drunken man does not notice if he is wearing his coat or shirt, similarly, one who is perfect in self-realization and who has thus achieved his eternal identity does not notice whether the temporary body is sitting or standing. Indeed, if by God’s will the body is finished or if by God’s will he obtains a new body, a self-realized soul does not notice, just as a drunken man does not notice the situation of his outward dress.

parts.sanskrit:
देहं च नश्वरमवस्थितमुत्थितं वा
सिद्धो न पश्यति यतोऽध्यगमत् स्वरूपम्।
दैवादुपेतमथ दैववशादपेतं
वासो यथा परिवृतं मदिरामदान्धः॥ ११/१३/३६॥
त्रिगुणसर्गकृतो विकल्प इत्युक्तं ज्ञानिनोऽपि देहवत्त्वेन त्रिगुणित्वाद् विकल्पो भवतीत्यत आह- देहं च नश्वरमिति ॥ ३६॥

meta.english_verbatim: Just as a drunken man does not notice if he is wearing his coat or shirt, similarly, one who is perfect in self-realization and who has thus achieved his eternal identity does not notice whether the temporary body is sitting or standing. Indeed, if by God’s will the body is finished or if by God’s will he obtains a new body, a self-realized soul does not notice, just as a drunken man does not notice the situation of his outward dress.

units.sanskrit:
देहोऽपि दैववशगः खलु कर्म यावत्
स्वारम्भकं प्रति समीक्षत एव सासुः।
तं सप्रपञ्चमधिरूढसमाधियोगः
स्वाप्नं पुनर्न भजते प्रतिबुद्धवत् सः॥ ११/१३/३७॥
units.english: The material body certainly moves under the control of supreme destiny and therefore must continue to live along with the senses and vital air as long as one’s karma is in effect. A self-realized soul, however, who is awakened to the absolute reality and who is thus highly situated in the perfect stage of yoga, will never again surrender to the material body and its manifold manifestations, knowing it to be just like a body visualized in a dream.

parts.sanskrit:
देहोऽपि दैववशगः खलु कर्म यावत्
स्वारम्भकं प्रति समीक्षत एव सासुः।
तं सप्रपञ्चमधिरूढसमाधियोगः
स्वाप्नं पुनर्न भजते प्रतिबुद्धवत् सः॥ ११/१३/३७॥

“आदरो भजनं भक्तिर्बहुमानं च सेवनम्।
पर्यायवाचकाः सर्वे स्मृतिस्तज्जन्म कर्म च॥”
इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ ३७॥

meta.english_verbatim: The material body certainly moves under the control of supreme destiny and therefore must continue to live along with the senses and vital air as long as one’s karma is in effect. A self-realized soul, however, who is awakened to the absolute reality and who is thus highly situated in the perfect stage of yoga, will never again surrender to the material body and its manifold manifestations, knowing it to be just like a body visualized in a dream.

units.sanskrit:
मयैतदुक्तं वो विप्रा गुह्यं यत् साङ्ख्ययोगयोः।
जानीत माऽऽगतं यज्ञं युष्मद्धर्मविवक्षया॥ ११/१३/३८॥
units.english: My dear brāhmaṇas, I have now explained to you the confidential knowledge of Sāṅkhya, by which one philosophically distinguishes matter from spirit, and of aṣṭāṅga-yoga, by which one links up with the Supreme. Please understand that I am the Lord, Viṣṇu, and that I have appeared before you desiring to explain your actual religious duties.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: My dear brāhmaṇas, I have now explained to you the confidential knowledge of Sāṅkhya, by which one philosophically distinguishes matter from spirit, and of aṣṭāṅga-yoga, by which one links up with the Supreme. Please understand that I am the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Viṣṇu, and that I have appeared before you desiring to explain your actual religious duties.

units.sanskrit:
अहं योगस्य साङ्ख्यस्य सत्यस्यर्तस्य तेजसः।
परायणं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः श्रियः कार्तेर्दमस्य च॥ ११/१३/३९॥
units.english: O best of the brāhmaṇas, please know that I am the supreme shelter of the yoga system, analytic philosophy, virtuous action, truthful religious principles, power, beauty, fame and self-control.

meta.english_verbatim: O best of the brāhmaṇas, please know that I am the supreme shelter of the yoga system, analytic philosophy, virtuous action, truthful religious principles, power, beauty, fame and self-control.

units.sanskrit:
मां भजन्ति गुणाः सर्वे निर्गुणं निरपेक्षकम्।
सुहृदं प्रियमात्मानं साम्यासङ्गादयो गुणाः॥ ११/१३/४०॥
units.english: All superior transcendental qualities, such as being beyond the modes of nature, detached, the well-wisher, the most dear, the Supreme Self, equally situated everywhere, and free from material entanglement — all such qualities, free from the transformations of material qualities, find their shelter and worshipable object in Me.

parts.sanskrit:
मां भजन्ति गुणाः सर्वे निर्गुणं निरपेक्षकम्।
सुहृदं प्रियमात्मानं साम्यासङ्गादयो गुणाः॥ ११/१३/४०॥

“अपूर्णगुणरूपास्तु सम्पूर्णगुणरूपकम्।
भजन्ति परमं ब्रह्म देवास्त्रिगुणवर्जितम्॥”
इति कालसंहितायाम्॥ ४०॥

meta.english_verbatim: All superior transcendental qualities, such as being beyond the modes of nature, detached, the well-wisher, the most dear, the Supersoul, equally situated everywhere, and free from material entanglement — all such qualities, free from the transformations of material qualities, find their shelter and worshipable object in Me.

units.sanskrit:
इति ते च्छिन्नसन्देहा मुनयः सनकादयः।
सभाजयित्वा परया भक्त्या गृणत संस्तवैः॥ ११/१३/४१॥
units.english: [Lord Kṛṣṇa continued:] My dear Uddhava, thus all of the doubts of the sages headed by Sanaka were destroyed by My words. Fully worshiping Me with transcendental love and devotion, they chanted My glories with excellent hymns.

meta.english_verbatim: [Lord Kṛṣṇa continued:] My dear Uddhava, thus all of the doubts of the sages headed by Sanaka were destroyed by My words. Fully worshiping Me with transcendental love and devotion, they chanted My glories with excellent hymns.

units.sanskrit:
तैरहं पूजितः सम्यक् संस्तुतः परमर्षिभिः।
प्रत्येयाय स्वकं धाम पश्यतः परमेष्ठिनः॥ ११/१३/४२॥
units.english: The greatest of sages, headed by Sanaka Ṛṣi, thus perfectly worshiped and glorified Me, and as Lord Brahmā looked on, I returned to My own abode.

meta.english_verbatim: The greatest of sages, headed by Sanaka Ṛṣi, thus perfectly worshiped and glorified Me, and as Lord Brahmā looked on, I returned to My own abode.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
वदन्ति कृष्ण श्रेयांसि बहूनि ब्रह्मवादिनः।
तेषां विकल्पः प्राधान्यमुताहो एकमुख्यता॥ ११/१४/१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Kṛṣṇa, the learned sages who explain Vedic literature recommend various processes for perfecting one’s life. Considering these varieties of viewpoint, my Lord, please tell me whether all these processes are equally important, or whether one of them is supreme.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Kṛṣṇa, the learned sages who explain Vedic literature recommend various processes for perfecting one’s life. Considering these varieties of viewpoint, my Lord, please tell me whether all these processes are equally important, or whether one of them is supreme.

units.sanskrit:
भवतोदाहृतः स्वामिन् भक्तियोगोऽनपेक्षितः।
निरस्य सर्वतः सङ्गं येन त्वय्याविशेन्मनः॥ ११/१४/२॥
units.english: My dear Lord, You have clearly explained the process of unalloyed devotion, by which a devotee removes all material association from his life, enabling him to fix his mind on You.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord, You have clearly explained the process of unalloyed devotional service, by which a devotee removes all material association from his life, enabling him to fix his mind on You.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
कालेन नष्टा प्रलये वाणीयं वेदसञ्ज्ञिता।
मयाऽऽदौ ब्रह्मणे प्रोक्ता धर्मो यस्यां मदात्मकः॥ ११/१४/३॥
units.english: The Lord said: By the influence of time, the transcendental sound of Vedic knowledge was lost at the time of annihilation. Therefore, when the subsequent creation took place, I spoke the Vedic knowledge to Brahmā because I Myself am the religious principles enunciated in the Vedas.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: By the influence of time, the transcendental sound of Vedic knowledge was lost at the time of annihilation. Therefore, when the subsequent creation took place, I spoke the Vedic knowledge to Brahmā because I Myself am the religious principles enunciated in the Vedas.

units.sanskrit:
तेन प्रोक्ता च पुत्राय मनवे पूर्वजाय सा।
ततो भृग्वादयोऽगृह्णन् सप्त ब्रह्ममहर्षयः॥ ११/१४/४॥
units.english: Lord Brahmā spoke this Vedic knowledge to his eldest son, Manu, and the seven great sages headed by Bhṛgu Muni then accepted the same knowledge from Manu.

parts.sanskrit:
तेन प्रोक्ता च पुत्राय मनवे पूर्वजाय सा।
ततो भृग्वादयोऽगृह्णन् सप्त ब्रह्ममहर्षयः॥ ११/१४/४॥

“रुद्रमिन्द्रं कुमारं च विनैवान्याग्रजो मनुः।
ब्रह्मपुत्रेष्वादिसृष्टावन्यथात्वं पुनर्जनेः॥”
इति स्कान्दे।
“आदिसृष्टौ पूर्वजा ये तेऽधिकाः सर्वतो गुणैः।
अनाद्यनन्तकालेषु मुक्तावपि यथाक्रमम्॥”
इति निबन्धे॥ ४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Brahmā spoke this Vedic knowledge to his eldest son, Manu, and the seven great sages headed by Bhṛgu Muni then accepted the same knowledge from Manu.

units.sanskrit:
तेभ्यो मुनिभ्यस्तत्पुत्रा देवदानवगुह्यकाः।
मनुष्याः सिद्धगन्धर्वाः सविद्याधरचारणाः॥ ११/१४/५॥
किन्देवाः किन्नरा नागा रक्षःकिम्पुरुषादयः।
बह्व्यस्तेषां प्रकृतयो रजःसत्वतमोभुवः॥ ११/१४/६॥
याभिर्भूतानि भिद्यन्ते भूतानां मतयस्तथा।
यथाप्रकृति सर्वेषां चित्रा वाचः स्रवन्ति हि॥ ११/१४/७॥
units.english: From the forefathers headed by Bhṛgu Muni and other sons of Brahmā appeared many children and descendants, who assumed different forms as gods, demons, human beings, Guhyakas, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, Cāraṇas, Kindevas, Kinnaras, Nāgas, Kimpuruṣas, and so on. All of the many universal species, along with their respective leaders, appeared with different natures and desires generated from the three modes of material nature. Therefore, because of the different characteristics of the living beings within the universe, there are a great many Vedic rituals, mantras and rewards.

meta.english_verbatim: From the forefathers headed by Bhṛgu Muni and other sons of Brahmā appeared many children and descendants, who assumed different forms as demigods, demons, human beings, Guhyakas, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, Cāraṇas, Kindevas, Kinnaras, Nāgas, Kimpuruṣas, and so on. All of the many universal species, along with their respective leaders, appeared with different natures and desires generated from the three modes of material nature. Therefore, because of the different characteristics of the living entities within the universe, there are a great many Vedic rituals, mantras and rewards.

units.sanskrit:
एवं प्रकृतिवैचित्र्याद् भिद्यन्ते मतयो नृणाम्।
पारम्पर्येण केषाञ्चित् पाषण्डमतयोऽपरे॥ ११/१४/८॥
units.english: Thus, due to the great variety of desires and natures among human beings, there are many different theistic philosophies of life, which are handed down through tradition, custom and disciplic succession. There are other teachers who directly support atheistic viewpoints.

parts.sanskrit:
एवं प्रकृतिवैचित्र्याद् भिद्यन्ते मतयो नृणाम्।
पारम्पर्येण केषाञ्चित् पाषण्डमतयोऽपरे॥ ११/१४/८॥
अनेन पारम्पर्येण केषाञ्चिदेव देवादीनाम्॥ ८॥

meta.english_verbatim: Thus, due to the great variety of desires and natures among human beings, there are many different theistic philosophies of life, which are handed down through tradition, custom and disciplic succession. There are other teachers who directly support atheistic viewpoints.

units.sanskrit:
मन्मायामोहितधियः पुरुषाः पुरुषर्षभ।
श्रेयो वदन्त्यनेकान्तं यथाकर्म यथारुचि॥ ११/१४/९॥
units.english: O best among men, the intelligence of human beings is bewildered by My illusory potency, and thus, according to their own activities and whims, they speak in innumerable ways about what is actually good for people.

meta.english_verbatim: O best among men, the intelligence of human beings is bewildered by My illusory potency, and thus, according to their own activities and whims, they speak in innumerable ways about what is actually good for people.

units.sanskrit:
धर्ममेके यशश्चान्ये कामं सत्यं दमं शमम्।
अन्ये वदन्ति चार्थं वा ऐश्वर्यं त्यागभोजनम्।
केचिद् यज्ञं तपो दानं व्रतानि नियमान् यमान्॥ ११/१४/१०॥
units.english: Some say that people will be happy by performing pious religious activities. Others say that happiness is attained through fame, sense enjoyment, truthfulness, self-control, peace, self-interest, political influence, opulence, renunciation, consumption, sacrifice, penance, charity, vows, regulated duties or strict disciplinary regulation. Each process has its proponents.

meta.english_verbatim: Some say that people will be happy by performing pious religious activities. Others say that happiness is attained through fame, sense gratification, truthfulness, self-control, peace, self-interest, political influence, opulence, renunciation, consumption, sacrifice, penance, charity, vows, regulated duties or strict disciplinary regulation. Each process has its proponents.

units.sanskrit:
आद्यन्तवन्त एवैषां लोकाः कर्मविनिर्मिताः।
दुःखोदर्कास्तमोनिष्ठाः क्षुद्रानन्दाः शुचार्पिताः॥ ११/१४/११॥
units.english: All the persons I have just mentioned obtain temporary fruits from their material work. Indeed, the meager and miserable situations they achieve bring future unhappiness and are based on ignorance. Even while enjoying the fruits of their work, such persons are filled with lamentation.

parts.sanskrit:
आद्यन्तवन्त एवैषां लोकाः कर्मविनिर्मिताः।
दुःखोदर्कास्तमोनिष्ठाः क्षुद्रानन्दाः शुचार्पिताः॥ ११/१४/११॥

“मद्भक्तिवर्जितं श्रेयो ये मन्यन्ते दुराशयाः।
तेषामन्ते तमो घोरमनन्तं प्राप्यते ध्रुवम्॥”
इति मान्यसंहितायाम्॥ ११॥

meta.english_verbatim: All the persons I have just mentioned obtain temporary fruits from their material work. Indeed, the meager and miserable situations they achieve bring future unhappiness and are based on ignorance. Even while enjoying the fruits of their work, such persons are filled with lamentation.

units.sanskrit:
मय्यर्पितात्मनः सत्ये निरपेक्षस्य सर्वतः।
मदात्मकं सुखं यत् तत् कुतः स्याद् विषयात्मनाम्॥ ११/१४/१२॥
units.english: O learned Uddhava, those who fix their consciousness on Me, giving up all material desires, share with Me a happiness that cannot possibly be experienced by those engaged in sense enjoyment.

meta.english_verbatim: O learned Uddhava, those who fix their consciousness on Me, giving up all material desires, share with Me a happiness that cannot possibly be experienced by those engaged in sense gratification.

units.sanskrit:
अकिञ्चनस्य दान्तस्य शान्तस्य समचेतसः।
मया सन्तुष्टमनसः सर्वाः सुखमया दिशः॥ ११/१४/१३॥
units.english: One who does not desire anything within this world, who has achieved peace by controlling his senses, whose consciousness is equal in all conditions and whose mind is completely satisfied in Me finds only happiness wherever he goes.

meta.english_verbatim: One who does not desire anything within this world, who has achieved peace by controlling his senses, whose consciousness is equal in all conditions and whose mind is completely satisfied in Me finds only happiness wherever he goes.

units.sanskrit:
न पारमेष्ठ्यं न महेन्द्रधिष्ण्यं न सार्वभौमं न रसाधिपत्यम्।
न योगसिद्धीरपुनर्भवं वा मय्यर्पितात्मेच्छति मद् विनाऽन्यत्॥ ११/१४/१४॥
units.english: One who has fixed his consciousness on Me desires neither the position or abode of Lord Brahmā or Lord Indra, nor an empire on the earth, nor sovereignty in the lower planetary systems, nor the eightfold perfection of yoga, nor liberation from birth and death. Such a person desires Me alone.

meta.english_verbatim: One who has fixed his consciousness on Me desires neither the position or abode of Lord Brahmā or Lord Indra, nor an empire on the earth, nor sovereignty in the lower planetary systems, nor the eightfold perfection of yoga, nor liberation from birth and death. Such a person desires Me alone.

units.sanskrit:
न तथा मे प्रियतम आत्मयोनिर्न शङ्करः।
न च सङ्कर्षणो न श्रीर्नैवात्मा च यथा भवान्॥ ११/१४/१५॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, neither Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva, Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa, the goddess of fortune nor indeed My own self are as dear to Me as you are.

parts.sanskrit:
न तथा मे प्रियतम आत्मयोनिर्न शङ्करः।
न च सङ्कर्षणो न श्रीर्नैवात्मा च यथा भवान्॥ ११/१४/१५॥

“कृपानिमित्ता या प्रीतिर्नीचभक्तेषु साऽधिका।
आन्तरैव
च या प्रीतिः सा तूच्चेषु यथाक्रमम्।
यथा कश्चित् स्वमात्मानं प्रियां पुत्रमथापि वा।
अतिहाय कृपायुक्तो भिक्षवेऽन्नं ददात्यपि।
कदाचिदेव न पुनः स्वात्मादेः सार्वकालिकम्।
योगक्षेमवहत्वं च नित्यं स्वात्मादिषु स्फुटम्।
एवमेव परेशस्य भक्तेषु श्रियजादिषु॥”
इति प्रियविवेके।
“यादवेभ्यस्तु सर्वेभ्य उद्धवो भगवत्प्रियः।
उद्धवाच्च प्रियतमः प्रद्युम्नस्तु महारथः।
तस्मादपि प्रियतमो रामः कृष्णस्य सर्वदा।
नैव तस्मात् प्रियतमो विनैकं तु चतुर्मुखम्।
सर्वेभ्योऽपि प्रियतमा हरेः श्रीरेव वल्लभा।
नैव तस्याः प्रियतमो विना स्वात्मानमेव तु॥”
इति यादवाध्यात्मे॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, neither Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva, Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa, the goddess of fortune nor indeed My own self are as dear to Me as you are.

units.sanskrit:
निरपेक्षं मुनिं शान्तं निर्वैरं समदर्शनम्।
अनुव्रजाम्यहं नित्यं पूयेयेत्यङ्घ्रिरेणुभिः॥ ११/१४/१६॥
units.english: With the dust of My devotees’ lotus feet I desire to purify the material worlds, which are situated within Me. Thus, I always follow the footsteps of My devotees, who are free from all personal desire, rapt in thought of My pastimes, peaceful, without any feelings of enmity, and of equal disposition everywhere.

parts.sanskrit:
निरपेक्षं मुनिं शान्तं निर्वैरं समदर्शनम्।
अनुव्रजाम्यहं नित्यं पूयेयेत्यङ्घ्रिरेणुभिः॥ ११/१४/१६॥

स्वाङ्घ्रिरेणुभिस्तं शोधयामीत्यनुव्रजामि।
“अनुगच्छति विष्णुस्तु स्वभक्तं तस्य शुद्धये।
तस्याङ्घ्रिरेणुभिर्वातनीतैरग्रेसरैः शुचिः।
अग्रतो गमने विष्णोः पदा स्पृष्टं रजो भवेत्।
अतः स्वभक्तं पूयेयेत्यनुव्रजति केशवः॥”
इति सङ्ख्याने॥ १६॥

meta.english_verbatim: With the dust of My devotees’ lotus feet I desire to purify the material worlds, which are situated within Me. Thus, I always follow the footsteps of My pure devotees, who are free from all personal desire, rapt in thought of My pastimes, peaceful, without any feelings of enmity, and of equal disposition everywhere.

units.sanskrit:
निष्किञ्चना मय्यनुरक्तचेतसः शान्ता महान्तोऽखिलजीववत्सलाः।
कामैरनालब्धधियोऽजुषो ये ते नैरपेक्ष्यं हि विदुः सुखं मम॥ ११/१४/१७॥
units.english: Those who are without any desire for personal gratification, whose minds are always attached to Me, who are peaceful, without false ego and merciful to all living beings, and whose consciousness is never affected by opportunities for sense enjoyment — such persons enjoy in Me a happiness that cannot be known or achieved by those lacking such detachment from the material world.

meta.english_verbatim: Those who are without any desire for personal gratification, whose minds are always attached to Me, who are peaceful, without false ego and merciful to all living entities, and whose consciousness is never affected by opportunities for sense gratification — such persons enjoy in Me a happiness that cannot be known or achieved by those lacking such detachment from the material world.

units.sanskrit:
बाध्यमानोऽपि मद्भक्तो विषयैरजितेन्द्रियः।
प्रशस्तया हि मद्भक्त्या विषयैर्नाभिभूयते॥ ११/१४/१८॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, if My devotee has not fully conquered his senses, he may be harassed by material desires, but because of his unflinching devotion for Me, he will not be defeated by sense enjoyment.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, if My devotee has not fully conquered his senses, he may be harassed by material desires, but because of his unflinching devotion for Me, he will not be defeated by sense gratification.

units.sanskrit:
यथाग्निः सुसमिद्धार्चिः करोत्येधांसि भस्मसात्।
तथा मद्विषया भक्तिरुद्धवैनांसि कृत्स्नशः॥ ११/१४/१९॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, just as a blazing fire turns firewood into ashes, similarly, devotion unto Me completely burns to ashes sins committed by My devotees.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, just as a blazing fire turns firewood into ashes, similarly, devotion unto Me completely burns to ashes sins committed by My devotees.

units.sanskrit:
न साधयति मां योगो न साङ्ख्यं धर्म उद्धव।
न स्वाध्यायस्तपस्त्यागो यथा भक्तिर्ममोर्जिता॥ ११/१४/२०॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, the unalloyed devotion rendered to Me by My devotees brings Me under their control. I cannot be thus controlled by those engaged in mystic yoga, Sāṅkhya philosophy, pious work, Vedic study, austerity or renunciation.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, the unalloyed devotional service rendered to Me by My devotees brings Me under their control. I cannot be thus controlled by those engaged in mystic yoga, Sāṅkhya philosophy, pious work, Vedic study, austerity or renunciation.

units.sanskrit:
भक्त्याऽहमेकया ग्राह्यः शुद्धयाऽऽत्मा प्रियः सताम्।
भक्तिः पुनाति मन्निष्ठा सकामानपि सम्भवात्॥ ११/१४/२१॥
units.english: Only by practicing unalloyed devotion with full faith in Me can one obtain Me, the Lord. I am naturally dear to My devotees, who take Me as the only goal of their loving service. By engaging in such pure devotion, even the dog-eaters can purify themselves from the contamination of their low birth.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: Only by practicing unalloyed devotional service with full faith in Me can one obtain Me, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. I am naturally dear to My devotees, who take Me as the only goal of their loving service. By engaging in such pure devotional service, even the dog-eaters can purify themselves from the contamination of their low birth.

units.sanskrit:
धर्मः सत्यदयोपेतो विद्या वा तपसाऽन्विता।
मद्भक्त्यपेतमात्मानं न सम्यक् प्रपुनाति हि॥ ११/१४/२२॥
units.english: Neither religious activities endowed with honesty and mercy nor knowledge obtained with great penance can completely purify one’s consciousness if they are bereft of loving service to Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Neither religious activities endowed with honesty and mercy nor knowledge obtained with great penance can completely purify one’s consciousness if they are bereft of loving service to Me.

units.sanskrit:
कथं विना रोमहर्षं द्रवता चेतसा विना।
विनाऽऽनन्दाश्रुकलया तुष्येद् भक्त्याऽखिलेश्वरः॥ ११/१४/२३॥
units.english: If one’s hairs do not stand on end, how can the heart melt? And if the heart does not melt, how can tears of love flow from the eyes? If one does not cry in spiritual happiness, how can one render loving service to the Lord? And without such service, how can the consciousness be purified?

meta.english_verbatim: If one’s hairs do not stand on end, how can the heart melt? And if the heart does not melt, how can tears of love flow from the eyes? If one does not cry in spiritual happiness, how can one render loving service to the Lord? And without such service, how can the consciousness be purified?

units.sanskrit:
वाग् गद्गदा द्रवते यस्य चित्तं रुदत्यभीक्ष्णं हसति क्वचिच्च।
विलज्ज उद्गायति नृत्यते च मद्भक्तियुक्तो भुवनं पुनाति॥ ११/१४/२४॥
units.english: A devotee whose speech is sometimes choked up, whose heart melts, who cries continually and sometimes laughs, who feels ashamed and cries out loudly and then dances — a devotee thus fixed in loving service to Me purifies the entire universe.

parts.sanskrit:
वाग् गद्गदा द्रवते यस्य चित्तं रुदत्यभीक्ष्णं हसति क्वचिच्च।
विलज्ज उद्गायति नृत्यते च मद्भक्तियुक्तो भुवनं पुनाति॥ ११/१४/२४॥

“चित्तद्रवस्तथा स्थैर्यं प्रसादो भक्तिलक्षणम्।
आधिक्येन तु तत्रापि स्थैर्यमेव विशेषतः।
दम्भस्य चलभक्तेश्च यस्मादश्व्रादिकं भवेत्।
दम्भादिपरिहारार्थं निगृह्णीयाच्च धीरधीः।
अत आध्यात्मिकक्लेशैराधिभूताधिदैविकैः।
वाक्यैश्च वेदतन्त्राद्यैरुपदेशैश्च तादृशैः।
बलवच्छासनैर्वाऽपि यस्य भक्तिर्न चाल्यते।
स एव परमो भक्तो विष्णोर्हृदयवल्लभः॥”
इति भक्तिविवेके॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: A devotee whose speech is sometimes choked up, whose heart melts, who cries continually and sometimes laughs, who feels ashamed and cries out loudly and then dances — a devotee thus fixed in loving service to Me purifies the entire universe.

units.sanskrit:
यथाऽग्निना हेम मलं जहाति ध्मातं पुनः स्वं भजते च रूपम्।
आत्मा च कर्मानुशयं विधूय मद्भक्तियोगेन भजत्यथो माम्॥ ११/१४/२५॥
units.english: Just as gold, when smelted in fire, gives up its impurities and returns to its pure brilliant state, similarly, the spirit soul, absorbed in the fire of bhakti-yoga, is purified of all contamination caused by previous actions aimed at results and returns to its original position of serving Me in the spiritual world.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Just as gold, when smelted in fire, gives up its impurities and returns to its pure brilliant state, similarly, the spirit soul, absorbed in the fire of bhakti-yoga, is purified of all contamination caused by previous fruitive activities and returns to its original position of serving Me in the spiritual world.

units.sanskrit:
यथायथाऽऽत्मा परिमृज्यतेऽसौ मत्पुण्यगाधाश्रवणाभिधानैः।
तथातथा पश्यति सूक्ष्मतत्वं चक्षुर्यथैवाञ्जनसम्प्रयुक्तम्॥ ११/१४/२६॥
units.english: When a diseased eye is treated with medicinal ointment it gradually recovers its power to see. Similarly, as a conscious living being cleanses himself of material contamination by hearing and chanting the pious narrations of My glories, he regains his ability to see Me, the Absolute Truth, in My subtle spiritual form.

meta.english_verbatim: When a diseased eye is treated with medicinal ointment it gradually recovers its power to see. Similarly, as a conscious living entity cleanses himself of material contamination by hearing and chanting the pious narrations of My glories, he regains his ability to see Me, the Absolute Truth, in My subtle spiritual form.

units.sanskrit:
विषयान् ध्यायतश्चित्तं विषयेषु विषज्जते।
मामनुस्मरतश्चित्तं मय्येव प्रविलीयते॥ ११/१४/२७॥
units.english: The mind of one meditating upon the objects of sense enjoyment is certainly entangled in such objects, but if one constantly remembers Me, then the mind is absorbed in Me.

meta.english_verbatim: The mind of one meditating upon the objects of sense gratification is certainly entangled in such objects, but if one constantly remembers Me, then the mind is absorbed in Me.

units.sanskrit:
तस्मादसदभिध्यानं यथा स्वप्नमनोरथम्।
हित्वा मयि समाधत्स्व मनो मद्भावभावितम्॥ ११/१४/२८॥
units.english: Therefore, one should reject all material processes of elevation, which are like the mental creations of a dream, and should completely absorb one’s mind in Me. By constantly thinking of Me, one becomes purified.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, one should reject all material processes of elevation, which are like the mental creations of a dream, and should completely absorb one’s mind in Me. By constantly thinking of Me, one becomes purified.

units.sanskrit:
स्त्रीसङ्गसङ्गिनां सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा दूरत आत्मवान्।
क्षेमे विविक्त आसीनश्चिन्तयेन्मामतन्द्रितः॥ ११/१४/२९॥
units.english: Being conscious of the eternal self, one should give up association with women and those intimately associated with women. Sitting fearlessly in a solitary place, one should concentrate the mind on Me with great attention.

meta.english_verbatim: Being conscious of the eternal self, one should give up association with women and those intimately associated with women. Sitting fearlessly in a solitary place, one should concentrate the mind on Me with great attention.

units.sanskrit:
न तथाऽस्य भवेत् क्लेशो बन्धश्चान्यप्रसङ्गतः।
योषित्सङ्गाद् यथा पुंसो यथा तत्सङ्गिसङ्गतः॥ ११/१४/३०॥
units.english: Of all kinds of suffering and bondage arising from various attachments, none is greater than the suffering and bondage arising from attachment to women and intimate contact with those attached to women.

parts.sanskrit:
न तथाऽस्य भवेत् क्लेशो बन्धश्चान्यप्रसङ्गतः।
योषित्सङ्गाद् यथा पुंसो यथा तत्सङ्गिसङ्गतः॥ ११/१४/३०॥

“केशवे त्वन्यथाबुद्धिः सैव स्त्री सम्प्रकीर्तिता।
त्रिकालदुःखदत्वेन पुंसा सह निवासनात्।
जुष्टत्वाद् योषिदित्युक्ता वननाद् वनितेति च।
प्रमादकरणत्वात् तु प्रमदेति च गीयते।
त्यजेत् तत्सङ्गिनां सङ्गं बुभूषुः पुरुषः सदा।
न तादृशः क्वचिद् दोषः पुरुषस्यासुखावहः।
क्षुद्रपापानि पापानि चोपपातकपातके।
महापातकनामानि सुमहापातकान्यपि।
तथा
स्वतिमहान्तीति
पातकानि विदो विदुः।
पिपीलिकावधादीनि क्षुद्रपापोदितानि च।
पापमस्थिमतां हत्या फलचौर्यादिरेव वा।
परदारादिकं चापि ह्युपपातकसञ्ज्ञितम्।
पातकं शूद्रहत्यादि ब्रह्महत्यादिकं महत्।
देवस्वहरणादीनि सुमहान्ति विदो विदुः।
देवावज्ञा सतां चैव ततोऽपि सुमहत्तरा।
महन्महत्तरा
तस्या अवज्ञा
केशवे तु या।
केशवस्य समोऽस्तीति केशवोऽस्म्यहमित्यपि।
ब्रह्माद्याः केशवात्मानः श्रीर्वा निर्गुण इत्यपि।
मुक्तस्य तद्भावमतिररूपत्वमतिस्तथा।
त्रिगुणात्मकदेहोऽस्याप्यस्तीत्यपि तु या मतिः।
जन्ममृत्यादिबुद्धिर्वा
दुःखाज्ञानादिबोधनम्।
तस्यापि परतन्त्रत्वविज्ञानं च तदुत्तमः।
अस्तीति या मतिस्तस्य वशादन्यस्य कस्यचित्।
अस्तीति भावनेत्याद्या अवज्ञाः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः॥”
इति धर्मविवेके।
“अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्”
“अपि चेत् सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्”
इत्यादि च।
“बाध्यमानोऽपि मद्भक्तः” इत्यादि च।
“परदारदृशिः प्रोक्ता क्षुद्रपातकसञ्ज्ञिता।
उपपातकं तद्गतिश्च वर्णबाह्येषु पातकम्।
महापातकसञ्ज्ञं तु पित्रादेर्दारधर्षणम्।
दारदृष्टिः स्वोत्तमानां मानुषाणां स्वभावतः।
सुमहापातकं प्रोक्तं तद्गतिः
सुमहत् ततः।
ऋषिदारेषु मनसो गतिरेव ततोऽधिका।
देवदाराभिकामानां सङ्गिसङ्गस्ततोऽधिकः।
किमु विष्णोस्ततो योषित्सङ्गस्य व्यत्ययस्थितेः।
न समं पातकं क्वापि नहि
स्वस्त्र्यभिकामतः।
अवज्ञाता माधवादेस्तस्मात् तं दूरतस्त्यजेत्।
मानुषेषु तु दुःखित्वं क्षुद्रपापफलं स्मृतम्।
पापात् तु वर्णबाह्यत्वं तिर्यग्योनिगतिस्तथा।
सहस्रवर्षनरकं क्षुद्रपातकजं फलम्।
उपपातकतश्चापि नरकं युगमात्रकम्।
चतुर्युगावसानं तु पातकस्य फलं स्मृतम्।
महापातकजन्यं च कल्पावधि समीरितम्।
सुमहापातकाच्चापि यावद् ब्रह्मलयो भवेत्।
तत्पराणां पातकानां फलमन्धन्तमः स्मृतम्।
अधोऽधो दुःखबहुलं विष्णुदाराभिमर्शनात्।
वधादपि हि दाराणां धर्षणं कोपकारणम्।
तस्माद् देव्यः सदा वन्द्या अग्निवन्नाभिकामतः॥”
इति धर्मतत्त्वे॥३०॥

meta.english_verbatim: Of all kinds of suffering and bondage arising from various attachments, none is greater than the suffering and bondage arising from attachment to women and intimate contact with those attached to women.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
यथा त्वामरविन्दाक्ष यादृशं वा यदात्मकम्।
ध्यायेन्मुमुक्षुरेतन्मे ध्यानं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥ ११/१४/३१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, by what process should one who desires liberation meditate upon You, of what specific nature should his meditation be, and upon which form should he meditate? Kindly explain to me this topic of meditation.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, by what process should one who desires liberation meditate upon You, of what specific nature should his meditation be, and upon which form should he meditate? Kindly explain to me this topic of meditation.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सम आसन आसीनः समकायो यथासुखम्।
हस्तावुत्सङ्ग आधाय स्वनासाग्रकृतेक्षणः॥ ११/१४/३२॥
प्राणस्य शोधयेन्मार्गं पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः।
विपर्ययेणापि शनैरभ्यसेन्निर्जितेन्द्रियः॥ ११/१४/३३॥
units.english: The Lord said: Sitting on a level seat that is not too high or too low, keeping the body straight and erect yet comfortable, placing the two hands on one’s lap and focusing the eyes on the tip of one’s nose, one should purify the pathways of breathing by practicing the mechanical exercises of pūraka, kumbhaka and recaka, and then one should reverse the procedure (recaka, kumbhaka, pūraka). Having fully controlled the senses, one may thus practice prāṇāyāma step by step.

units.sanskrit:
हृद्यविच्छिन्नमोङ्कारं घण्टानादं बिसोर्णवत्।
प्राणेनोदीर्य तत्राथ पुनः संवेशयेत् स्वरम्॥ ११/१४/३४॥
units.english: Beginning from the mūlādhāra-cakra, one should move the life air continuously upward like the fibers in the lotus stalk until one reaches the heart, where the sacred syllable om is situated like the sound of a bell. One should thus continue raising the sacred syllable upward the distance of twelve aṅgulas, and there the oṁkāra should be joined together with the fifteen vibrations produced with anusvāra.
