units.sanskrit:
एवं प्रणवसंयुक्तं प्राणसंयममभ्यसेत्।
दशकृत्वस्त्रिषवणं मासादर्वाग् जितोऽनिलः॥ ११/१४/३५॥
units.english: Being fixed in the oṁkāra, one should carefully practice the prāṇāyāma system ten times at each sunrise, noon and sunset. Thus, after one month one will have conquered the life air.

parts.sanskrit:
एवं प्रणवसंयुक्तं प्राणसंयममभ्यसेत्।
दशकृत्वस्त्रिषवणं मासादर्वाग् जितोऽनिलः॥ ११/१४/३५॥

“उपास्य प्राणतोऽनुज्ञां हृदिस्थात् प्राप्य सेवकः।
अनुज्ञानन्तरं मासाद् वशे प्राणो भविष्यति।
प्रसादभाक्त्वं सम्प्रोक्तं प्राणविष्ण्वोर्जयस्त्विति।
नहि सर्वविजेतारौ विजेयौ केनचित् क्वचित्।
अपेक्षितं फलं येन दीयते तज्जितं त्विति।
यथा जिता वसुमती यथा मोक्षपदं जितम्॥”
इति प्रभञ्जने॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Being fixed in the oṁkāra, one should carefully practice the prāṇāyāma system ten times at each sunrise, noon and sunset. Thus, after one month one will have conquered the life air.

units.sanskrit:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमन्तःस्थमूर्ध्वनाळमधोमुखम्।
ध्यात्वोर्ध्वमुखमुन्निद्रमष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम्॥ ११/१४/३६॥
कर्णिकायां न्यसेत् सूर्यसोमाग्नीनुत्तरोत्तरम्।
वह्निमध्ये स्मरेद् रूपं ममैतद् ध्यानमङ्गलम्॥ ११/१४/३७॥
समं प्रशान्तं सुमुखं दीर्घचारुचतुर्भुजम्।
सुचारुसुन्दरग्रीवं सुकपोलं शुचिस्मितम्॥ ११/१४/३८॥
समानकर्णविन्यस्तस्फुरन्मकरकुण्डलम्।
हेमाम्बरं घनश्यामं श्रीवत्सं श्रीनिकेतनम्॥ ११/१४/३९॥
शङ्खचक्रगदापदम्वनमालाविभूषितम्।
नूपुरैर्विलसत्पादं कौस्तुभप्रभया युतम्॥ ११/१४/४०॥
द्युमत्किरीटकटककटिसूत्राङ्गदैर्युतम्।
सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरं हृद्यं प्रसादसुमुखेक्षणम्॥ ११/१४/४१॥
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यो मनसाऽऽकृष्य तन्मनाः।
बुद्ध्या सारथिना धीरः प्रणयेन्मयि सर्वतः॥ ११/१४/४२॥
units.english: Keeping the eyes half closed and fixed on the tip of one’s nose, being enlivened and alert, one should meditate on the lotus flower situated within the heart. This lotus has eight petals and is situated on an erect lotus stalk. One should meditate on the sun, moon and fire, placing them one after the other within the whorl of that lotus flower. Placing My transcendental form within the fire, one should meditate upon it as the auspicious goal of all meditation. That form is perfectly proportioned, gentle and cheerful. It possesses four beautiful long arms, a charming, beautiful neck, a handsome forehead, a pure smile and glowing, shark-shaped earrings suspended from two identical ears. That spiritual form is the color of a dark rain cloud and is garbed in golden-yellowish silk. The chest of that form is the abode of Śrīvatsa and the goddess of fortune, and that form is also decorated with a conchshell, disc, club, lotus flower and garland of forest flowers. The two brilliant lotus feet are decorated with ankle bells and bracelets, and that form exhibits the Kaustubha gem along with an effulgent crown. The upper hips are beautified by a golden belt, and the arms are decorated with valuable bracelets. All of the limbs of that beautiful form capture the heart, and the face is beautified by merciful glancing. Pulling the senses back from the sense objects, one should be grave and self-controlled and should use the intelligence to strongly fix the mind upon all of the limbs of My transcendental body. Thus one should meditate upon that most delicate transcendental form of Mine.

units.sanskrit:
तत् सर्वव्यापकं चित्तमाकृष्यैकत्र धारयेत्।
नान्यानि चिन्तयेद् भूयः सुस्मितं भावयेन्मुखम्॥ ११/१४/४३॥
units.english: One should then pull the consciousness back from all the limbs of that transcendental body. At that time, one should meditate only on the wonderfully smiling face of the Lord.

meta.english_verbatim: One should then pull the consciousness back from all the limbs of that transcendental body. At that time, one should meditate only on the wonderfully smiling face of the Lord.

units.sanskrit:
तत्र लब्धपदं चित्तमाकृष्य व्योम्नि धारयेत्।
तच्च त्यक्त्वा मदारोहो न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्॥ ११/१४/४४॥
units.english: Being established in meditation on the Lord’s face, one should then withdraw the consciousness and fix it in the sky. Then giving up such meditation, one should become established in Me and give up the process of meditation altogether.

parts.sanskrit:
तत्र लब्धपदं चित्तमाकृष्य व्योम्नि धारयेत्।
तच्च त्यक्त्वा मदारोहो न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्॥ ११/१४/४४॥

“व्योमेति व्याप्तशब्दः स्याद् विशेषादोतता यतः”
इति शब्दनिर्णये। व्योम्नि धारयेत् सर्वाङ्गेषु धारयेदित्यर्थः। तच्च धारणं त्यक्त्वा स्वत एव मनसस्तत्रैव समाहितत्वादन्यत् किमपि न चिन्तयेत्।
“यावत् समग्रस्मरणमचलं केशवे भवेत्।
समग्रं चिन्तयेत् तावद् यदा तु विचलेत् ततः।
प्रत्यङ्गं धारणं कुर्यान्मनो यावत् समग्रगम्।
प्रत्यङ्गाभ्यासतो यावत् समग्रे सुस्थिरं मनः।
तदा पुनः समग्रं तु धारयेद् यत्नतो बुधः।
यदा तु धारणोत्साहं विना तत्राचलं मनः।
तिष्ठेत् त्यक्त्वा तमुद्योगं शङ्खचक्राम्बुजाङ्किते।
आरूढचेताः परमे शृङ्गाराद्येकधामनि।
नैवान्यच्चिन्तयेत् तस्मात् पूर्णानन्दाच्चतुर्भुजात्।
यतोऽन्यस्मरणे तस्मान्मनश्चलति सुस्थिरम्।
धारणार्थप्रयत्नेन तस्मात् तदुभयं त्यजेत्।
यावत् स्वारूढचेताः स्याद् विष्णो रूपे चतुर्भुजे॥”
इति ध्यानयोगे॥ ४४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Being established in meditation on the Lord’s face, one should then withdraw the consciousness and fix it in the sky. Then giving up such meditation, one should become established in Me and give up the process of meditation altogether.

units.sanskrit:
एवं समाहितमतिर्मामेवात्मानमात्मनि।
विचष्टे मयि सर्वात्मन् ज्योतिर्ज्योतिषि संयुतम्॥ ११/१४/४५॥
units.english: One who has completely fixed his mind on Me should see Me within his own soul and should see the individual soul within Me, the Lord. Thus, he sees the individual souls united with the Supreme Soul, just as one sees the sun’s rays completely united with the sun.

parts.sanskrit:
एवं समाहितमतिर्मामेवात्मानमात्मनि।
विचष्टे मयि सर्वात्मन् ज्योतिर्ज्योतिषि संयुतम्॥ ११/१४/४५॥

परमात्मानं मां स्वदेहे पश्यति। जीवं ज्योतिर्मयि संयुतं पश्यति।
“समाधियोगे सम्पूर्णे हृदि पश्यति केशवम्।
जीवं तत्प्रतिबिम्बं च तेनैव सह संस्थितम्।
तदाधारं तदन्तस्थं तेनैव सदृशं तदा।
आनन्दज्ञानशक्त्याद्यैः सदा तदवरं गुणैः।
जीवन्मुक्तौ च मुक्तौ वा सततं तद्वशे स्थितम्॥”
इति।
“स्वयं प्रकाशरूपत्वाज्जीवोऽपि ज्योतिरुच्यते” इति च तत्त्वप्रतिपत्तौ॥ ४५॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: One who has completely fixed his mind on Me should see Me within his own soul and should see the individual soul within Me, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Thus, he sees the individual souls united with the Supreme Soul, just as one sees the sun’s rays completely united with the sun.

units.sanskrit:
ध्यानेनेत्थं सुतीव्रेण युञ्जतो योगिनो मनः।
संयास्यत्याशु निर्वाणं द्रव्यज्ञानक्रियाभ्रमम्॥ ११/१४/४६॥
units.english: When the yogī thus controls his mind by intensely concentrated meditation, his illusory identification with material objects, knowledge and activities is very quickly extinguished.

parts.sanskrit:
ध्यानेनेत्थं सुतीव्रेण युञ्जतो योगिनो मनः।
संयास्यत्याशु निर्वाणं द्रव्यज्ञानक्रियाभ्रमम्॥ ११/१४/४६॥
द्रव्यज्ञानक्रियाविषये भ्रमरूपं मनो लयं याति॥ ४६॥

meta.english_verbatim: When the yogī thus controls his mind by intensely concentrated meditation, his illusory identification with material objects, knowledge and activities is very quickly extinguished.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
जितेन्द्रियस्य युक्तस्य जितश्वासस्य योगिनः।
मयि धारयतश्चेत उपतिष्ठन्ति सिद्धयः॥ ११/१५/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, the mystic perfections of yoga are acquired by a yogī who has conquered his senses, steadied his mind, conquered the breathing process and fixed his mind on Me.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, the mystic perfections of yoga are acquired by a yogī who has conquered his senses, steadied his mind, conquered the breathing process and fixed his mind on Me.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
कया धारणया का स्वित् कथं वा सिद्धिरच्युत।
कति वा सिद्धयो ब्रूहि योगिनां सिद्धिदो भवान्॥ ११/१५/२॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord Acyuta, by what process can mystic perfection be achieved, and what is the nature of such perfection? How many mystic perfections are there? Please explain these things to me. Indeed, You are the bestower of all mystic perfections.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord Acyuta, by what process can mystic perfection be achieved, and what is the nature of such perfection? How many mystic perfections are there? Please explain these things to me. Indeed, You are the bestower of all mystic perfections.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सिद्धयोऽष्टादश प्रोक्ता धारणायोगपारगैः।
तासामष्टौ मत्प्रधाना ता एव१ गुणहेतवः॥ ११/१५/३॥
units.english: The Lord said: The masters of the yoga system have declared that there are eighteen types of mystic perfection and meditation, of which eight are primary, having their shelter in Me, and ten are secondary, appearing from the material mode of goodness.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सिद्धयोऽष्टादश प्रोक्ता धारणायोगपारगैः।
तासामष्टौ मत्प्रधाना ता एव१ गुणहेतवः॥ ११/१५/३॥

मय्येव प्राधान्येन सन्ति, अन्येषूपचारत इति मत्प्रधानाः।
“सर्वाधिका
अणीमाद्या
विष्णोर्नान्यस्य कस्यचित्।
स्वाभाविका विरिञ्चस्य तत्प्रसादात् पराधिकाः॥”
इति स्वाभाव्ये।
गुणभूतानामन्यासामपि सिद्धीनां ता एव हेतवः। स्वतस्तास्वेवाष्टस्वन्यासामन्तर्भावात्।
“निस्सीमाष्टगुणाभावात् सिद्धयोऽष्टादश स्मृताः।
देवेभ्योऽन्यत्र देवानां सिद्धयोऽष्टैव सम्मताः॥”
इति प्राकाश्ये॥ ३॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: The masters of the yoga system have declared that there are eighteen types of mystic perfection and meditation, of which eight are primary, having their shelter in Me, and ten are secondary, appearing from the material mode of goodness.

units.sanskrit:
अणिमा महिमा मूर्तेर्लघिमा प्राप्तिरिन्द्रियैः।
प्राकाश्यं श्रुतदृष्टेषु शक्तिप्रेरणमीशिता॥ ११/१५/४॥
गुणेष्वसङ्गो वशिता यत्कामस्तदवाप्स्यति।
एता मे सिद्धयः सौम्य अष्टावौत्पत्तिका मताः॥ ११/१५/५॥
units.english: Among the eight primary mystic perfections, the three by which one transforms one’s own body are aṇimā, becoming smaller than the smallest; mahimā, becoming greater than the greatest; and laghimā, becoming lighter than the lightest. Through the perfection of prāpti one acquires whatever one desires, and through prākāmya-siddhi one experiences any enjoyable object, either in this world or the next. Through īśitā-siddhi one can manipulate the subpotencies of māyā, and through the controlling potency called vaśitā-siddhi one is unimpeded by the three modes of nature. One who has acquired kāmāvasāyitā-siddhi can obtain anything from anywhere, to the highest possible limit. My dear gentle Uddhava, these eight mystic perfections are considered to be naturally existing and unexcelled within this world.

parts.sanskrit:
अणिमा महिमा मूर्तेर्लघिमा प्राप्तिरिन्द्रियैः।
प्राकाश्यं श्रुतदृष्टेषु शक्तिप्रेरणमीशिता॥ ११/१५/४॥
गुणेष्वसङ्गो वशिता यत्कामस्तदवाप्स्यति।
एता मे सिद्धयः सौम्य अष्टावौत्पत्तिका मताः॥ ११/१५/५॥

शक्तिप्रेरणमेवेशितृत्वम्। असङ्ग एव वशित्वम्।
“यादृशानन्दकामः स्यात् तादृशानन्दसम्भवः।
भोगान् विनैव प्राकाम्यमणिमादेः पृथक् ततः॥”
इति च॥ ४-५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among the eight primary mystic perfections, the three by which one transforms one’s own body are aṇimā, becoming smaller than the smallest; mahimā, becoming greater than the greatest; and laghimā, becoming lighter than the lightest. Through the perfection of prāpti one acquires whatever one desires, and through prākāmya-siddhi one experiences any enjoyable object, either in this world or the next. Through īśitā-siddhi one can manipulate the subpotencies of māyā, and through the controlling potency called vaśitā-siddhi one is unimpeded by the three modes of nature. One who has acquired kāmāvasāyitā-siddhi can obtain anything from anywhere, to the highest possible limit. My dear gentle Uddhava, these eight mystic perfections are considered to be naturally existing and unexcelled within this world.

units.sanskrit:
अनूर्मिमत्त्वं देहेऽस्मिन् दूरश्रवणदर्शनम्।
मनोजवः कामरूपं परकायप्रवेशनम्॥ ११/१५/६॥
स्वच्छन्दमृत्युर्देवानां सहक्रीडानुदर्शनम्।
यथासङ्कल्पसंसिद्धिराज्ञाऽप्रतिहतागतिः॥ ११/१५/७॥
units.english: The ten secondary mystic perfections arising from the modes of nature are the powers of freeing oneself from hunger and thirst and other bodily disturbances, hearing and seeing things far away, moving the body at the speed of the mind, assuming any form one desires, entering the bodies of others, dying when one desires, witnessing the pastimes between the gods and the celestial girls called Apsarās, completely executing one’s determination and giving orders whose fulfillment is unimpeded.

parts.sanskrit:
अनूर्मिमत्त्वं देहेऽस्मिन् दूरश्रवणदर्शनम्।
मनोजवः कामरूपं परकायप्रवेशनम्॥ ११/१५/६॥
स्वच्छन्दमृत्युर्देवानां सहक्रीडानुदर्शनम्।
यथासङ्कल्पसंसिद्धिराज्ञाऽप्रतिहतागतिः॥ ११/१५/७॥

अनूर्मिमत्वं प्राकाम्येऽन्तर्भूतम्। दूरश्रवणदर्शनं त्रिकालज्ञत्वम्। परचित्ताद्यभिज्ञता च प्राकाश्यन्तर्भूतानि। मनोजव इत्यादिषट्कं प्राप्त्यन्तर्भूतम्। अन्यत् सर्वमीशत्वान्तर्भूतमपि परमेशत्वाभावे पृथगित्यष्टादश। अग्न्यर्काम्बुविषादीनाम् इत्यादिशब्दोक्ताः शस्त्रास्त्रनखदन्तताडनशापादिभिरप्रतिहतिः पृथगेव सिद्धिः सप्तदशी। अप्रतिहता आ समन्ताद् गतिर्यस्या आज्ञायाः साऽप्रतिहतागतिः। अद्वन्द्वमप्रतिहतं त्रिकालज्ञत्वम्। अग्न्यर्काम्बुविषाणां प्रतिस्तम्भाश्चतस्रः सिद्धयः। दूरश्रवणदर्शने द्वे सिद्धी।
“गरिम्णः सैव हेतुः स्यान्महिमाहेतुधारणा।
प्रायोऽष्टसिद्धिकथनेष्वतो
न पृथगुच्यते॥”
इति च।
“प्राप्तिप्राकाश्ययोश्चापि धारणैकाऽपि सम्भवेत्।
अत ऐक्येन तामुक्त्वा गरिमाणं पृथक् क्वचित्॥”
इति च।
दूरश्रवणदर्शने द्वे सिद्धी।
“मूलभूतास्तु सिद्धीनां देवानामष्टसिद्धयः।
सर्वसिद्धिप्रधानास्तास्तज्जा अष्टादश स्मृताः।
अष्टस्वन्तर्गतास्तास्तु तदपेक्षतयाऽल्पकाः॥”
इति च।
कामरूपत्वस्याणिमादित्रयेेऽप्यन्तर्भावोऽष्टसिद्धिपक्षे। अग्न्यर्कस्तम्भ एकैव सिद्धिः, अदाहत्वात्। अग्न्यादिप्रतिस्तम्भस्य वशित्वेऽपि। अनूर्मिमत्त्वाद्यष्टादशपृथक्सिद्धिपक्षेऽग्न्यर्कस्तम्भयोः पृथक्त्वम्। तस्मिन् पक्षे तासां सकाशात् प्रधानाष्टौ मत्प्रधाना इति व्याख्या।
“अनूर्मिमत्त्वसिद्धिस्तु प्राकाम्यान्तर्गता मता।
दूरश्रुतिर्दूरदृष्टिस्त्रिकालज्ञत्वमेव च।
परचित्ताद्यभिज्ञानं प्राकाश्यान्तर्गतानि च।
अणिमादित्रयान्तश्च कामरूपत्वमिष्यते।
अग्न्यर्काम्बुविषादीनां प्रतिस्तम्भो वशित्वतः।
मनोजवः कामरूपं परकायप्रवेशनम्।
स्वच्छन्दमृत्युता देवैः सह क्रीडेष्टसाधनम्।
प्राप्तावन्तर्गतान्याहुराज्ञाप्रतिहतिस्तथा।
अग्निस्तम्भो रविस्तम्भ उदकस्तम्भ एव च।
विषस्तम्भस्तथा शस्त्रशापादिस्तम्भ एव च।
ईशत्वान्तर्गतान्याहुरपराजय एव च।
एवमष्टादशाष्टभ्यो जायन्ते सिद्धयः क्रमात्।
अष्टादशभ्यश्चान्यास्तु जायन्ते सिद्धयोऽमिताः।
अनूर्मिमत्त्वं दुःखस्याभावमात्रमुदाहृतम्।
यथेष्टानन्दसम्प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यमिति कीर्त्यते।
दुःखाभावोऽपि प्राकाम्ये नेतरे सुखितेष्यते।
प्राकाश्यं सर्ववेदादिज्ञानमेव विदो विदुः।
सहस्रयोजनान्ते तु दूरदर्शनमिष्यते।
दूरश्रवणमप्येवं तस्मिन्नेव युगे स्थिते।
वेदादिकं विना
प्रोक्ता
त्रिकालज्ञानिता बुधैः।
शरीरस्थं विना देहे परचित्ताद्यभिज्ञता।
अन्येन्द्रियैर्दर्शनादि यथासङ्कल्पवेगिता।
प्राप्तिरित्युच्यते सद्भिः स्वमनःसमवेगिता।
मनोजवः इति प्रोक्तः पश्वाद्याकारता तथा।
कामरूपत्वमुद्दिष्टं स्वदेहत्यागतः परे।
परकायप्रवेशः स्याद् युगादर्वाक्तना स्मृता।
स्वच्छन्दमृत्युता देवैः क्रीडा चेन्द्रादिभिर्विना।
यथासङ्कल्पसिद्धिश्चाप्यन्नपानसुतादिषु।
चक्षुर्दृश्येष्वणुत्वं तु अणिमा
सम्प्रकीर्तिता।
महिमा चापि
सम्प्रोक्ता त्रिलोकान्तरपूरणात्।
चक्षुर्दृश्यैर्विवाह्यत्वं लघिमा चापि
कीर्तिता।
त्रिलोकसमभारस्तु गरिमा चापि
कीर्तिता।
पूर्वशक्तेः
कोटिगुणशक्त्युद्रेकस्तथेशता।
भुविस्थैः
प्राणिभिः प्रोक्तकरणं
चापि कीर्त्यते।
आज्ञाऽप्रतिहतिर्ब्राह्मादर्वागस्त्रविघातनम्।
विना महातपस्वींश्च शापाप्रतिहतिः स्मृता।
अपराजयो मनुष्येभ्यो वशित्वं चाप्यलोलता।
दाहादिसहनं चापि प्रतिस्तम्भ इतीर्यते।
इति षड्विंशतिः प्रोक्ता गरिम्णा सह सप्त वा।
विंशतिश्च
सुरेभ्योऽन्यद् देवेष्वष्टैव
सिद्धयः।
यतो निस्सीमकास्तेषां देवानामष्टसिद्धयः।
अतोऽष्टादशसिद्धीनां तदन्तर्भाव इष्यते।
देवेष्विन्द्रेशवायुश्रीविष्णूनामुत्तरोत्तरम्।
सिद्धयः परिपूर्णास्तु विष्णोरेकस्य नान्यगाः॥”
इत्यैश्वर्ये।
“श्रुतेषु तु यथायोगं क्षिप्रग्रहणमेव तु।
उक्तं प्राकाश्यमन्येषां देवानामश्रुतेष्वपि।
ऋषीणां मिश्रभावेन भासते किञ्चिदश्रुतम्।
विषयेभ्योऽधिकसुखव्यक्तिः प्राकाम्यमेव तु।
इतरेषां सुराणां तु निस्सीमानन्दभोजनम्।
एवमेव तु निस्सीमा देवानामष्टसिद्धयः।
उत्तरोत्तरमत्रापि यावद् विष्णुः
सुपूर्णभुक्
॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु।
“अग्न्यादिशक्तिसंस्तम्भस्त्वग्न्यादिस्तम्भ इष्यते” इति कौर्मे।
“एकस्मात् सिद्धयो विष्णोः स्थानभेदात् पृथग्विधाः।
एकस्थानगताद् वा स्युः सुस्थिरोपासना यदि॥”
इति भारते॥ ६॥

meta.english_verbatim: The ten secondary mystic perfections arising from the modes of nature are the powers of freeing oneself from hunger and thirst and other bodily disturbances, hearing and seeing things far away, moving the body at the speed of the mind, assuming any form one desires, entering the bodies of others, dying when one desires, witnessing the pastimes between the demigods and the celestial girls called Apsarās, completely executing one’s determination and giving orders whose fulfillment is unimpeded.

units.sanskrit:
त्रिकालज्ञत्वमद्वन्द्वं परचित्ताद्यभिज्ञता।
अग्न्यर्काम्बुविषादीनां प्रतिस्तम्भोऽपराजयः॥ ११/१५/८॥
एताश्चाष्टादश प्रोक्ता योगधारणसिद्धयः।
यया धारणयाऽद्धा स्याद् यथा वा स्यान्निबोध मे॥ ११/१५/९॥
units.english: The power to know past, present and future; tolerance of heat, cold and other dualities; knowing the minds of others; checking the influence of fire, sun, water, poison, and so on; and remaining unconquered by others — these constitute five perfections of the mystic process of yoga and meditation. I am simply listing these here according to their names and characteristics. Now please learn from Me how specific mystic perfections arise from specific meditations and also of the particular processes involved.

meta.english_verbatim: The power to know past, present and future; tolerance of heat, cold and other dualities; knowing the minds of others; checking the influence of fire, sun, water, poison, and so on; and remaining unconquered by others — these constitute five perfections of the mystic process of yoga and meditation. I am simply listing these here according to their names and characteristics. Now please learn from Me how specific mystic perfections arise from specific meditations and also of the particular processes involved.

units.sanskrit:
भूतसूक्ष्मात्मनि मयि तन्मात्रं धारयन् मनः।
अणिमानमवाप्नोति तन्मात्रोपासको मम॥ ११/१५/१०॥
units.english: One who worships Me in My atomic form pervading all subtle elements, fixing his mind on that alone, obtains the mystic perfection called aṇimā.

parts.sanskrit:
भूतसूक्ष्मात्मनि मयि तन्मात्रं धारयन् मनः।
अणिमानमवाप्नोति तन्मात्रोपासको मम॥ ११/१५/१०॥

भूतसूक्ष्माणामात्मनि परमाणुस्थितेऽणुरूपे।
“तन्मात्रावयवे सूक्ष्मे परमाण्वभिधानके।
प्रत्येकमणुरूपं तु विष्णुं ध्यायन्नणुर्भवेत्॥”
इति कापिलेये।
“आकाशवत् सूक्ष्मतां यो व्यापित्वेनैव मन्यते।
तन्मात्रव्यापिनं विष्णुं चिन्तयन् स तथा भवेत्॥”
इति च॥ १०॥

meta.english_verbatim: One who worships Me in My atomic form pervading all subtle elements, fixing his mind on that alone, obtains the mystic perfection called aṇimā.

units.sanskrit:
महत्यात्मन् मयि परे यथासंस्थं मनो दधत्।
महिमानमवाप्नोति भूतानां च पृथक्पृथक्॥ ११/१५/११॥
units.english: One who absorbs his mind in the particular form of the mahat-tattva and thus meditates upon Me as the Supreme Soul of the total material existence achieves the mystic perfection called mahimā. By further absorbing the mind in the situation of each individual element such as the sky, air, fire, and so on, one progressively acquires the greatness of each material element.

parts.sanskrit:
महत्यात्मन् मयि परे यथासंस्थं मनो दधत्।
महिमानमवाप्नोति भूतानां च पृथक्पृथक्॥ ११/१५/११॥
महति व्याप्ते। महत्तत्त्वस्य पृथगुक्तेः। अस्मात् स्थूलतां प्राप्नुवानीत्यपेक्षायां तस्मात् प्राप्नोति। ततोऽन्यस्मादित्यपेक्षायां तस्मादिति पृथक्पृथक्॥ ११॥

meta.english_verbatim: One who absorbs his mind in the particular form of the mahat-tattva and thus meditates upon Me as the Supreme Soul of the total material existence achieves the mystic perfection called mahimā. By further absorbing the mind in the situation of each individual element such as the sky, air, fire, and so on, one progressively acquires the greatness of each material element.

units.sanskrit:
परमाणुमये चित्तं भूतानां मयि रञ्जयन्।
कालसूक्ष्मात्मके योगी लघिमानमवाप्नुयात्॥ ११/१५/१२॥
units.english: I exist within everything, and I am therefore the essence of the atomic constituents of material elements. By attaching his mind to Me in this form, the yogī may achieve the perfection called laghimā, by which he realizes the subtle atomic substance of time.

parts.sanskrit:
परमाणुमये चित्तं भूतानां मयि रञ्जयन्।
कालसूक्ष्मात्मके योगी लघिमानमवाप्नुयात्॥ ११/१५/१२॥
परमाणुमये भूतानां सकाशादतिशयेनाणुस्वरूपे। कालसूक्ष्माणामात्मनि॥ १२॥

meta.english_verbatim: I exist within everything, and I am therefore the essence of the atomic constituents of material elements. By attaching his mind to Me in this form, the yogī may achieve the perfection called laghimā, by which he realizes the subtle atomic substance of time.

units.sanskrit:
धारयन् मय्यहन्तत्वे मनो वैकारिकेऽखिलम्।
सर्वेन्द्रियाणामात्मत्वं प्राप्तिं प्राप्नोति मन्मनाः॥ ११/१५/१३॥
units.english: Fixing his mind completely in Me within the element of false ego generated from the mode of goodness, the yogī obtains the power of mystic acquisition, by which he becomes the proprietor of the senses of all living beings. He obtains such perfection because his mind is absorbed in Me.

parts.sanskrit:
धारयन् मय्यहन्तत्वे मनो वैकारिकेऽखिलम्।
सर्वेन्द्रियाणामात्मत्वं प्राप्तिं प्राप्नोति मन्मनाः॥ ११/१५/१३॥
अहन्तत्त्वे स्थिते मयि॥ १३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Fixing his mind completely in Me within the element of false ego generated from the mode of goodness, the yogī obtains the power of mystic acquisition, by which he becomes the proprietor of the senses of all living entities. He obtains such perfection because his mind is absorbed in Me.

units.sanskrit:
महत्यात्मनि यः सूत्रे धारयन् मयि मानसम्।
प्राकाश्यं पारमेष्ठ्यं मे विन्दतेऽव्यक्तजन्मनः॥ ११/१५/१४॥
units.english: One who concentrates all mental activities in Me as the Supreme Self of that phase of the mahat-tattva which manifests the chain of actions aimed at results obtains from Me, whose appearance is beyond material perception, the most excellent mystic perfection called prākāmya.

parts.sanskrit:
महत्यात्मनि यः सूत्रे धारयन् मयि मानसम्।
प्राकाश्यं पारमेष्ठ्यं मे विन्दतेऽव्यक्तजन्मनः॥ ११/१५/१४॥

सूत्रे स्थिते मयि। गृहे पीठ इतिवत्। अव्यक्तजन्मनः अव्यक्तस्यापि किञ्चित्स्थूलत्वकर्तुः।
“तस्मादव्यक्तमुत्पन्नं त्रिगुणं द्विजसत्तम” इति मोक्षधर्मेषु।
“अजरात् --- अमरात्  --- अमूर्तितः --- शाश्वततमसः” इति च।
“अव्यक्तस्याजन्मवतो विकारो जनिरुच्यते” इति हरिवंशेषु।
मे सकाशात् विन्दते। परमेष्ठिप्रसादादन्येषां भवतीति पारमेष्ठ्यम्। सर्वगुणानां ज्ञानमूलत्वादुपलक्षणत्वेन प्राकाश्यं पारमेष्ठ्यामित्युक्तम्।
“सर्वे गुणास्तु प्राणस्य परमात्मप्रसादतः।
प्राणविष्ण्वोः प्रसादेन भारत्याः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः।
प्रसादात् तु त्रयाणां वाऽप्यनन्तादेः सदा गुणाः॥”
इति माहात्म्ये॥ १४॥

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: One who concentrates all mental activities in Me as the Supersoul of that phase of the mahat-tattva which manifests the chain of fruitive activities obtains from Me, whose appearance is beyond material perception, the most excellent mystic perfection called prākāmya.

units.sanskrit:
विष्णौ चाधीश्वरे चित्तं धारयन् कालविग्रहे।
स ईशित्वमवाप्नोति क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञचोदनम्॥ ११/१५/१५॥
units.english: One who places his consciousness on Viṣṇu, the Supreme Self, the prime mover and Supreme Lord of the external energy consisting of three modes, obtains the mystic perfection of controlling other conditioned souls, their material bodies and their bodily designations.

parts.sanskrit:
विष्णौ चाधीश्वरे चित्तं धारयन् कालविग्रहे।
स ईशित्वमवाप्नोति क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञचोदनम्॥ ११/१५/१५॥

सर्वत्राधीश्वरत्वादौ विद्यमानेऽपि तत्रतत्रोक्तधीश्वरत्वादिगुणविशिष्टत्वेन तत्रतत्रोपासनमिति विशेषः।
“तं यथायथोपासते तदेव भवति” इति च श्रुतेः।
“उपासतः सत्य इति सत्यसङ्कल्पता भवेत्।
ईशत्वमीश्वर इति
गुणं तन्तं
यथा हरिम्॥”
इति विशेषे॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: One who places his consciousness on Viṣṇu, the Supersoul, the prime mover and Supreme Lord of the external energy consisting of three modes, obtains the mystic perfection of controlling other conditioned souls, their material bodies and their bodily designations.

units.sanskrit:
नारायणे तुरीयाख्ये भगवच्छब्दशब्दिते।
मनो मय्यादधद्योगी मद्धर्मो वशितामियात्॥ ११/१५/१६॥
units.english: The yogī who places his mind in My form of Nārāyaṇa, known as the fourth factor, full of all opulences, becomes endowed with My nature and thus obtains the mystic perfection called vaśitā.

meta.english_verbatim: The yogī who places his mind in My form of Nārāyaṇa, known as the fourth factor, full of all opulences, becomes endowed with My nature and thus obtains the mystic perfection called vaśitā.

units.sanskrit:
निर्गुणे ब्रह्मणि मयि धारयन् विशदं मनः।
परमानन्दमाप्नोति यत्र कामोऽवसीयते॥ ११/१५/१७॥
units.english: One who fixes his pure mind on Me in My manifestation as the impersonal Brahman obtains the greatest happiness, wherein all his desires are completely fulfilled.

meta.english_verbatim: One who fixes his pure mind on Me in My manifestation as the impersonal Brahman obtains the greatest happiness, wherein all his desires are completely fulfilled.

units.sanskrit:
श्वेतद्वीपपतौ चित्तं शुद्धे धर्ममये मयि।
धारयन् श्वेततां याति षडूर्मिरहितोऽमरः॥ ११/१५/१८॥
units.english: A human being who concentrates on Me as the upholder of religious principles, the personification of purity and the Lord of Śvetadvīpa obtains the pure existence in which he is freed from the six waves of material disturbance, namely hunger, thirst, decay, death, grief and illusion.

parts.sanskrit:
श्वेतद्वीपपतौ चित्तं शुद्धे धर्ममये मयि।
धारयन् श्वेततां याति षडूर्मिरहितोऽमरः॥ ११/१५/१८॥
“शुद्धः श्वेतः सुखी श्वेतः श्वेतवर्णः क्वचिद् भवेत्” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: A human being who concentrates on Me as the upholder of religious principles, the personification of purity and the Lord of Śvetadvīpa obtains the pure existence in which he is freed from the six waves of material disturbance, namely hunger, thirst, decay, death, grief and illusion.

units.sanskrit:
मय्याकाशात्मनि प्राणे मनसा घोषमुद्वहन्।
तत्रोपलब्धा भूतानां हंसो वाचः शृणोत्यसौ॥ ११/१५/१९॥
units.english: That purified living being who fixes his mind on the extraordinary sound vibrations occurring within Me as the personified sky and total life air is then able to perceive within the sky the speaking of all living beings.

parts.sanskrit:
मय्याकाशात्मनि प्राणे मनसा घोषमुद्वहन्।
तत्रोपलब्धा भूतानां हंसो वाचः शृणोत्यसौ॥ ११/१५/१९॥

आकाशस्यात्मनि। तत्राकाशे। उपलब्धानाम् आ समन्तात् स्थितानां भूतानां वाचः। हंसो जीवः।
“त्यागात् पूर्वशरीराणां नवानां सञ्चयेन च।
जीवं हंस इति प्राहुस्तद्धेतुत्वाद्धरिं परम्॥”
इति भारते॥ १९॥

meta.english_verbatim: That purified living entity who fixes his mind on the extraordinary sound vibrations occurring within Me as the personified sky and total life air is then able to perceive within the sky the speaking of all living entities.

units.sanskrit:
चक्षुस्त्वष्टरि संयोज्य त्वष्टारमपि चक्षुषि।
मां तत्र मनसा ध्यायन् विश्वं पश्यति सूक्ष्मदृक्॥ ११/१५/२०॥
units.english: Merging one’s sight into the sun planet and then the sun planet into one’s eyes, one should meditate on Me as existing within the combination of sun and vision; thus one acquires the power to see any distant thing.

meta.english_verbatim: Merging one’s sight into the sun planet and then the sun planet into one’s eyes, one should meditate on Me as existing within the combination of sun and vision; thus one acquires the power to see any distant thing.

units.sanskrit:
मनो मनसि संयोज्य देहं तदनु वायुना।
मद्धारणानुभावेन तत्रात्मा यत्र वै मनः॥ ११/१५/२१॥
units.english: The yogī who completely absorbs his mind in Me, and who then makes use of the wind that follows the mind to absorb the material body in Me, obtains through the potency of meditation on Me the mystic perfection by which his body immediately follows his mind wherever it goes.

parts.sanskrit:
मनो मनसि संयोज्य देहं तदनु वायुना।
मद्धारणानुभावेन तत्रात्मा यत्र वै मनः॥ ११/१५/२१॥
मनसि मनस्तत्त्वे। वायुना संयोज्य। मनोऽनु देहम्। मनस्तत्त्वे मद्धारणा ॥ २१॥

meta.english_verbatim: The yogī who completely absorbs his mind in Me, and who then makes use of the wind that follows the mind to absorb the material body in Me, obtains through the potency of meditation on Me the mystic perfection by which his body immediately follows his mind wherever it goes.

units.sanskrit:
यदा मन उपादाय यद्यद् रूपं बुभूषति।
तत्तद् भजेन्मनोरूपं मद्योगबलमाश्रितः॥ ११/१५/२२॥
units.english: When the yogī, applying his mind in a certain way, desires to assume a particular form, that very form immediately appears. Such perfection is possible by absorbing the mind in the shelter of My inconceivable mystic potency, by which I assume innumerable forms.

meta.english_verbatim: When the yogī, applying his mind in a certain way, desires to assume a particular form, that very form immediately appears. Such perfection is possible by absorbing the mind in the shelter of My inconceivable mystic potency, by which I assume innumerable forms.

units.sanskrit:
परकायं विशन् सिद्ध आत्मानं तत्र भावयेत्।
पिण्डं हित्वा विशेत् प्राणो वायुभूतः षडङ्घ्रिवत्॥ ११/१५/२३॥
units.english: When a perfect yogī desires to enter another’s body, he should meditate upon himself within the other body, and then, giving up his own gross body, he should enter the other’s body through the pathways of air, as easily as a bee leaves one flower and flies into another.

meta.english_verbatim: When a perfect yogī desires to enter another’s body, he should meditate upon himself within the other body, and then, giving up his own gross body, he should enter the other’s body through the pathways of air, as easily as a bee leaves one flower and flies into another.

units.sanskrit:
पाष्र्ण्याऽऽपीड्य गुदं प्राणं हृदुरःकण्ठमूर्धसु।
आरोप्य ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण ब्रह्म नीत्वोत्सृजेत् तनुम्॥ ११/१५/२४॥
units.english: The yogī who has achieved the mystic perfection called svacchanda-mṛtyu blocks the anus with the heel of the foot and then lifts the soul from the heart to the chest, to the neck and finally to the head. Situated within the brahma-randhra, the yogī then gives up his material body and guides the spirit soul to the selected destination.

meta.english_verbatim: The yogī who has achieved the mystic perfection called svacchanda-mṛtyu blocks the anus with the heel of the foot and then lifts the soul from the heart to the chest, to the neck and finally to the head. Situated within the brahma-randhra, the yogī then gives up his material body and guides the spirit soul to the selected destination.

units.sanskrit:
विहरिष्यन् सुराक्राडे मत्स्थं सत्वं विभावयेत्।
विमानेनोपतिष्ठन्ति सत्ववृत्तिं सुरस्त्रियः॥ ११/१५/२५॥
units.english: The yogī who desires to enjoy in the pleasure gardens of the gods should meditate on the purified mode of goodness, which is situated within Me, and then the heavenly women, generated from the mode of goodness, will approach him in airplanes.

meta.english_verbatim: The yogī who desires to enjoy in the pleasure gardens of the demigods should meditate on the purified mode of goodness, which is situated within Me, and then the heavenly women, generated from the mode of goodness, will approach him in airplanes.

units.sanskrit:
यथा सङ्कल्पयेद् बुद्ध्या यथा वा मत्परः पुमान्।
मयि सत्ये मनो युञ्जन् तथा तत् समवाप्नुते॥ ११/१५/२६॥
units.english: A yogī who has faith in Me, absorbing his mind in Me and knowing that My purpose is always fulfilled, will always achieve his purpose by the very means he has determined to follow.

meta.english_verbatim: A yogī who has faith in Me, absorbing his mind in Me and knowing that My purpose is always fulfilled, will always achieve his purpose by the very means he has determined to follow.

units.sanskrit:
यो वै मद्भावमापन्न ईशितुर्वशितुः पुमान्।
न कुतश्चन हन्येत तस्य चाज्ञा यथा मम॥ ११/१५/२७॥
units.english: A person who perfectly meditates on Me acquires My nature of being the supreme ruler and controller. His order, like Mine, can never be frustrated by any means.

meta.english_verbatim: A person who perfectly meditates on Me acquires My nature of being the supreme ruler and controller. His order, like Mine, can never be frustrated by any means.

units.sanskrit:
मद्भक्त्या शुद्धसत्वस्य योगिनो धारणाविदः।
तस्य त्रैकालिका बुद्धिर्जन्ममृत्यूपबृंहिता॥ ११/१५/२८॥
units.english: A yogī who has purified his existence by devotion to Me and who thus expertly knows the process of meditation obtains knowledge of past, present and future. He can therefore see the birth and death of himself and others.

meta.english_verbatim: A yogī who has purified his existence by devotion to Me and who thus expertly knows the process of meditation obtains knowledge of past, present and future. He can therefore see the birth and death of himself and others.

units.sanskrit:
अग्न्यादिभिर्न हन्येत मुनेर्योगमयं वपुः।
मद्योगश्रान्तचित्तस्य यादसामुदकैर्यथा॥ ११/१५/२९॥
units.english: Just as the bodies of aquatics cannot be injured by water, similarly, the body of a yogī whose consciousness is pacified by devotion to Me and who is fully developed in yoga science cannot be injured by fire, sun, water, poison, and so forth.

parts.sanskrit:
अग्न्यादिभिर्न हन्येत मुनेर्योगमयं वपुः।
मद्योगश्रान्तचित्तस्य यादसामुदकैर्यथा॥ ११/१५/२९॥

“गजादिरूपमाकाङ्क्षन् गजादिस्थितमीश्वरम्।
ध्यायन् गजादिरूपः स्यात् परकायस्थितं हरिम्।
-
-
ध्यायन् विशेत् परे काये वायावन्तर्गतः पुमान्।
प्राणनामा हरिः प्रोक्तस्तस्मिन् वायुः समाश्रितः।
वायावन्तर्गतो जीवो देहाद् देहं प्रयास्यति।
षडाधारस्थितं विष्णुं ध्यायन्नायुःक्षयं विना।
यदि मृत्युमभीप्सेत तथा प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्।
त्रिकालप्रेरकं विष्णुं ध्यातुः कालत्रयज्ञता।
अग्न्यादिषु हरिं ध्यायन् तत्प्रतिस्तम्भको भवेत्॥”
इति हरिसंहितायाम्।
आत्मानं परमात्मानं तत्र परकाये भावयेत्। तदा वायौ स्थितः प्राणः परमात्मा तत्र गच्छति। तमनु जीवोऽपि गच्छति। वायौ भूतो वायुभूतः।
प्राणं परे ब्रह्मणि नीत्वा।
“प्राणस्थं प्राणनामानं बहिष्ठे ब्रह्मनामके।
विष्णुं विष्णावनुस्मृत्य विसृजेद् देहमञ्जसा॥”
इति प्रभञ्जने।
“अनेयस्य हरेर्नीतिस्तद्गतस्य हरेः स्मृतिः।
नहि नेयः क्वचित् क्वापि केनचित् स्ववशत्वतः॥”
इति च।
मम भावना मद्भावः। “भावो मनश्च भक्तिश्च क्वचिदभ्यास इष्यते” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ २२-२९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Just as the bodies of aquatics cannot be injured by water, similarly, the body of a yogī whose consciousness is pacified by devotion to Me and who is fully developed in yoga science cannot be injured by fire, sun, water, poison, and so forth.

units.sanskrit:
मद्विभूतीरभिध्यायन् श्रीवत्सास्त्रविभूषिताः।
ध्वजातपत्रव्यजनैः स भवेदपराजितः॥ ११/१५/३०॥
units.english: My devotee becomes unconquerable by meditating on My opulent incarnations, which are decorated with Śrīvatsa and various weapons and are endowed with imperial paraphernalia such as flags, ornamental umbrellas and fans.

meta.english_verbatim: My devotee becomes unconquerable by meditating on My opulent incarnations, which are decorated with Śrīvatsa and various weapons and are endowed with imperial paraphernalia such as flags, ornamental umbrellas and fans.

units.sanskrit:
उपासकस्य मामेवं योगधारणया पुनः।
सिद्धयः पूर्वकथिता उपतिष्ठन्त्यशेषतः॥ ११/१५/३१॥
units.english: A learned devotee who worships Me through yoga meditation certainly obtains in all respects the mystic perfections that I have described.

parts.sanskrit:
उपासकस्य मामेवं योगधारणया पुनः।
सिद्धयः पूर्वकथिता उपतिष्ठन्त्यशेषतः॥ ११/१५/३१॥
उपासनयाऽपरोक्षं कृतवतः पुनरुपासनं कार्यकाले कुर्वतः कार्यसिद्धिरित्यतो योगधारणया पुनरित्युक्तम्॥ ३१॥

meta.english_verbatim: A learned devotee who worships Me through yoga meditation certainly obtains in all respects the mystic perfections that I have described.

units.sanskrit:
जितेन्द्रियस्य दान्तस्य जितश्वासात्मनो मुनेः।
मद्धारणां धारयतः का नु सिद्धिः सुदुर्लभा॥ ११/१५/३२॥
units.english: For a sage who has conquered his senses, breathing and mind, who is self-controlled and always absorbed in meditation on Me, what mystic perfection could possibly be difficult to achieve?

meta.english_verbatim: For a sage who has conquered his senses, breathing and mind, who is self-controlled and always absorbed in meditation on Me, what mystic perfection could possibly be difficult to achieve?

units.sanskrit:
अन्तरायान् वदन्त्येतान् युञ्जतो योगमुत्तमम्।
मया सम्पद्यमानस्य कालक्षेपणहेतवः॥ ११/१५/३३॥
units.english: Learned experts in devotion state that the mystic perfections of yoga that I have mentioned are actually impediments and are a waste of time for one who is practicing the supreme yoga, by which one achieves all perfection in life directly from Me.

parts.sanskrit:
अन्तरायान् वदन्त्येतान् युञ्जतो योगमुत्तमम्।
मया सम्पद्यमानस्य कालक्षेपणहेतवः॥ ११/१५/३३॥

“उपास्य वायुं प्रथमं वायौ सुष्ट्वपरोक्षिते।
अनुज्ञातस्ततस्तद्गं तत्रतत्र हरिं स्मरेत्।
कृत्वाऽपरोक्षं तं चापि कालेकाले स्मरेत् पुनः।
अभीष्टकार्यसिद्धिः स्यात् तस्य नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
अकामो यदि वायुं च ध्यात्वा दृष्ट्वा हरिं तथा।
न किञ्चित् कामयेत् पश्चात् स क्षिप्रं मुक्तिमेष्यति।
यदि योगैः फलं भुङ्क्ते पुनः काममपास्य तु।
तेनैव क्रमयोगेन वायुं दृष्ट्वा हरिं तथा।
एष्टव्या मुक्तिपदवी नान्यथा तु कथञ्चन।
पूर्वदृष्टिर्हि कामार्थे पश्चान्मोक्षार्थमिष्यते।
येषां तु जन्मतः सिद्धिस्तेषां दोषो न विद्यते॥”
इति निवृत्ते॥ ३३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Learned experts in devotional service state that the mystic perfections of yoga that I have mentioned are actually impediments and are a waste of time for one who is practicing the supreme yoga, by which one achieves all perfection in life directly from Me.

units.sanskrit:
जन्मौषधितपोमन्त्रैर्यावतीरिह सिद्धयः।
योगेनाप्नोति ताः सर्वा यैर्यैर्योगगतिं व्रजेत्॥ ११/१५/३४॥
units.english: Whatever mystic perfections can be achieved by good birth, herbs, austerities and mantras can all be achieved by devotion to Me; indeed, one cannot achieve the actual perfection of yoga by any other means.

parts.sanskrit:
जन्मौषधितपोमन्त्रैर्यावतीरिह सिद्धयः।
योगेनाप्नोति ताः सर्वा यैर्यैर्योगगतिं व्रजेत्॥ ११/१५/३४॥

यैर्यैः कैश्चित्कैश्चिदेव जन्मादिभिः योगगतिं व्रजेत्।
“जन्मादिभिः कैश्चिदेव प्राप्यते योगजं फलम्।
योगेन
सर्वैः
प्राप्येत योगे यत्नं ततः कुरु॥”
इति च।
“कश्चिदर्थे च यच्छब्दः प्रश्नार्थे च क्वचिद् भवेत्।
क्वचित् परामर्शवाची क्वचिदाक्षेपवाचकः॥”
इति तन्त्रनिरुक्ते॥ ३४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Whatever mystic perfections can be achieved by good birth, herbs, austerities and mantras can all be achieved by devotional service to Me; indeed, one cannot achieve the actual perfection of yoga by any other means.

units.sanskrit:
सर्वासामपि सिद्धीनां हेतुः पतिरहं प्रभुः।
अहं योगस्य साङ्ख्यस्य धर्मस्य ब्रह्मवादिनाम्॥ ११/१५/३५॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, I am the cause, the protector and the Lord of all mystic perfections, of the yoga system, of analytic knowledge, of pure activity and of the community of learned Vedic teachers.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, I am the cause, the protector and the Lord of all mystic perfections, of the yoga system, of analytic knowledge, of pure activity and of the community of learned Vedic teachers.

units.sanskrit:
अहमात्माऽन्तरो बाह्योऽनावृतः सर्वदेहिनाम्।
यथा भूतानि भूतेषु बहिरन्तस्त्वहं तथा॥ ११/१५/३६॥
units.english: Just as the same material elements exist within and outside of all material bodies, similarly, I cannot be covered by anything else. I exist within everything as the Supreme Self and outside of everything in My all-pervading feature.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as the same material elements exist within and outside of all material bodies, similarly, I cannot be covered by anything else. I exist within everything as the Supersoul and outside of everything in My all-pervading feature.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
त्वं ब्रह्म परमं साक्षादनाद्यन्तमपावृतम्।
सर्वेषामपि भावानां प्राणः स्थित्यप्ययोद्भवः॥ ११/१६/१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord, You are beginningless and endless, the Absolute Truth Himself, unlimited by anything else. You are the protector and life-giver, the destruction and creation of all things that exist.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord, You are beginningless and endless, the Absolute Truth Himself, unlimited by anything else. You are the protector and life-giver, the destruction and creation of all things that exist.

units.sanskrit:
उच्चावचेषु भूतेषु दुर्ज्ञेयमकृतात्मभिः।
उपासते त्वां भगवन् याथातथ्येन ब्राह्मणाः॥ ११/१६/२॥
units.english: My dear Lord, although it is difficult for the impious to understand that You are situated in all superior and inferior creations, those brāhmaṇas who are actual knowers of the Vedic conclusion worship You in truth.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord, although it is difficult for the impious to understand that You are situated in all superior and inferior creations, those brāhmaṇas who are actual knowers of the Vedic conclusion worship You in truth.

units.sanskrit:
येषु येषु च भावेषु यथा त्वां परमर्षयः।
उपासीनाः प्रपद्यन्ते संसिद्धिं तद् वदस्व मे॥ ११/१६/३॥
units.english: Please tell me of the perfections that great sages achieve by worshiping You with devotion. Also, kindly explain which of Your different forms they worship.

meta.english_verbatim: Please tell me of the perfections that great sages achieve by worshiping You with devotion. Also, kindly explain which of Your different forms they worship.

units.sanskrit:
गूढश्चरसि भूतेषु भूतात्मा भूतभावनः।
न त्वां पश्यन्ति भूतानि पश्यन्तं मोहितानि ते॥ ११/१६/४॥
units.english: O my Lord, maintainer of all, although You are the Supreme Self of the living beings, You remain hidden. Thus being bewildered by You, the living beings cannot see You, although You are seeing them.

meta.english_verbatim: O my Lord, maintainer of all, although You are the Supersoul of the living entities, You remain hidden. Thus being bewildered by You, the living entities cannot see You, although You are seeing them.

units.sanskrit:
याः काश्च भूमौ दिवि वै रसायां विभूतयो दिक्षु महाविभूतेः।
ता मह्यमाख्याह्यनुभावितास्ते नमामि ते तीर्थपदाङ्घ्रिपदम्म्॥ ११/१६/५॥
units.english: O supremely potent Lord, please explain to me Your innumerable potencies, which You manifest on the earth, in heaven, in hell and indeed in all directions. I offer my humble obeisances at Your lotus feet, which are the shelter of all holy places.

meta.english_verbatim: O supremely potent Lord, please explain to me Your innumerable potencies, which You manifest on the earth, in heaven, in hell and indeed in all directions. I offer my humble obeisances at Your lotus feet, which are the shelter of all holy places.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
एवमेतदहं पृष्टः प्रश्नं प्रश्नविदां वर।
युयुत्सुना विशसने सपत्नौरर्जुनेन वै॥ ११/१६/६॥
units.english: The Lord said: O best of those who know how to inquire, on the Battlefield of Kurukṣetra, Arjuna, desiring to fight with his rivals, asked Me the same question that you are now posing.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: O best of those who know how to inquire, on the Battlefield of Kurukṣetra, Arjuna, desiring to fight with his rivals, asked Me the same question that you are now posing.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञात्वा ज्ञातिवधं गर्ह्यमर्स्वग्यं राज्यहेतुकम्।
ततो निवृत्तो हन्ताऽहं हतोऽयमिति लौकिकः॥ ११/१६/७॥
units.english: On the Battlefield of Kurukṣetra Arjuna thought that killing his relatives would be an abominable, irreligious activity, motivated only by his desire to acquire a kingdom. He therefore desisted from the battle, thinking, “I would be the killer of my relatives. They would be destroyed.” Thus Arjuna was afflicted with mundane consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: On the Battlefield of Kurukṣetra Arjuna thought that killing his relatives would be an abominable, irreligious activity, motivated only by his desire to acquire a kingdom. He therefore desisted from the battle, thinking, “I would be the killer of my relatives. They would be destroyed.” Thus Arjuna was afflicted with mundane consciousness.

units.sanskrit:
स तदा पुरुषव्याघ्रो युक्त्या मे प्रतिबोधितः।
अभ्यभाषत मामेवं यथा त्वं रणमूर्धनि॥ ११/१६/८॥
units.english: At that time I enlightened Arjuna, the tiger among men, with logical arguments, and thus in the front of the battle Arjuna addressed Me with questions in the same way that you are now inquiring.

meta.english_verbatim: At that time I enlightened Arjuna, the tiger among men, with logical arguments, and thus in the front of the battle Arjuna addressed Me with questions in the same way that you are now inquiring.

units.sanskrit:
अहमात्मोद्धवामीषां भूतानां सुहृदीश्वरः।
अहं सर्वाणि भूतानि तेषां स्थित्युद्भवाप्ययः॥ ११/१६/९॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, I am the Supreme Self of all living beings, and therefore I am naturally their well-wisher and supreme controller. Being the creator, maintainer and annihilator of all entities, I am not different from them.

parts.sanskrit:
अहमात्मोद्धवामीषां भूतानां सुहृदीश्वरः।
अहं सर्वाणि भूतानि तेषां स्थित्युद्भवाप्ययः॥ ११/१६/९॥

“सृष्टिस्थित्यादिहेतुत्वाद् भूतानि हरिरुच्यते।
नतु भूतस्वरूपत्वात् स हि सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः॥”
इति वस्तुतत्त्वे॥ ९॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, I am the Supersoul of all living entities, and therefore I am naturally their well-wisher and supreme controller. Being the creator, maintainer and annihilator of all entities, I am not different from them.

units.sanskrit:
अहं गतिर्गतिमतां कालः कलयतामहम्।
गुणानामप्यहं सौम्यं गुणिन्यौत्पत्तिको गुणः॥ ११/१६/१०॥
units.english: I am the ultimate goal of all those seeking progress, and I am time among those who exert control. I am the equilibrium of the modes of material nature, and I am natural virtue among the pious.

meta.english_verbatim: I am the ultimate goal of all those seeking progress, and I am time among those who exert control. I am the equilibrium of the modes of material nature, and I am natural virtue among the pious.

units.sanskrit:
गुणिनामप्यहं सूत्रं महतां च महानहम्।
सूक्ष्माणामप्यहं जीवो दुर्जयानामहं मनः॥ ११/१६/११॥
units.english: Among things possessing qualities I am the primary manifestation of nature, and among great things I am the total material creation. Among subtle things I am the spirit soul, and of things that are difficult to conquer I am the mind.

parts.sanskrit:
गुणिनामप्यहं सूत्रं महतां च महानहम्।
सूक्ष्माणामप्यहं जीवो दुर्जयानामहं मनः॥ ११/१६/११॥

“स्वस्वजात्युत्तमत्वं तु भवेद् यद्रूपसन्निधेः।
विभूतिरूपं तत् प्रोक्तमिन्दिरादिषु संस्थितम्।
तथा बहिःस्थितं रूपं विभूतीत्येव शब्दितम्।
सर्वसाधारणं रूपमन्तर्यामीति चोच्यते।
यथा कृष्णात्मना दुष्टहन्ता व्यासात्मना समः।
असमोऽप्येकरूपोऽपि सामर्थ्यात् पुरुषोत्तमः॥”
इति च।
“ब्रह्मरुद्रेन्द्रजीवेभ्यः पृथगेव व्यवस्थितम्।
विभूतिरूपं विष्णोस्तु
तद्गश्रेष्ठ्यैककारणम्।
तदेव ब्रह्मरुद्रादिनामभिर्वाच्यमञ्जसा।
तदेव देवेष्विन्द्रोऽस्मि तथा रुद्रेषु शङ्करः।
इत्यादिनोक्तं कृष्णेन नेन्द्राद्या जीवसञ्चयाः॥”
इति गीताकल्पे।
गतिर्ज्ञानम्।
“प्रधानो ज्ञानिनां ब्रह्मा ज्ञानमानी हृदिस्थितः।
स एव कालमानी तु संहर्तॄणां प्रभुः स्मृतः॥”
इति विभूतौ।
“आनन्दानुभवस्तूम उत्कृष्टानुभवात् स्मृतः।
तद्युक्तत्वं
तथा
सौम्यं गुणानामधिकं हि तत्।
भक्त्यादिगुणपूगोऽपि दुःखहेतुत्वभावनात्।
निष्फलो भवति ह्यद्धा प्रीतस्य सफलो भवेत्।
तस्मादानन्दमानं तु गुणेषूत्कृष्टमुच्यते।
तस्याभिमानी ब्रह्मैको भक्तिज्ञानादिकस्य च।
श्रद्धाभिमानिनी देवी तथैव तु सरस्वती।
तदन्येषां गुणानां तु तदन्ये विबुधाः स्मृताः।
गुणानां तु प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा तस्मादेकश्चतुर्मुखः।
औत्पत्तिकगुणो नाम शुभप्राप्त्यैकयोग्यता।
तस्याभिमानी प्राणस्तु स हि सर्वगुणाधिकः॥”
इति च।
गुणिनां मध्ये गुणिनि स्थितमौत्पत्तिकगुणरूपं सूत्रमित्यर्थः।
“गुणिनां गुणयोग्यत्वं यत् सर्वगुणिषु स्थितम्।
वायुस्तदभिमान्येकः सर्वगुण्यधिकस्ततः॥”
इति प्रभञ्जने।
रूपान्तरत्वादेकस्यापि बहुस्थानेषु प्राधान्योक्तिर्नो विरुद्ध्यते। गुणान्तरोक्तेश्च। “रामः शस्त्रभृताम्” “वृष्णीनां वासुदेवः” इत्यादिवत्॥ १०-११॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among things possessing qualities I am the primary manifestation of nature, and among great things I am the total material creation. Among subtle things I am the spirit soul, and of things that are difficult to conquer I am the mind.

units.sanskrit:
हिरण्यगर्भो देवानां मन्त्राणां प्रणवस्त्रिवृत्।
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि पदानि च्छन्दसामहम्॥ ११/१६/१२॥
units.english: Among the Vedas I am their original teacher, Lord Brahmā, and of all mantras I am the three-lettered oṁkāra. Among letters I am the first letter, “a,” and among sacred meters I am the Gāyatrī mantra.

parts.sanskrit:
हिरण्यगर्भो देवानां मन्त्राणां प्रणवस्त्रिवृत्।
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि पदानि च्छन्दसामहम्॥ ११/१६/१२॥

पदानि वाच्यानि च्छन्दसां वेदानाम्।
“स्वयूथानामथाधिक्ये
स्वजातीनामथापि वा।
यत् कारणं विभूत्याख्यं विष्णोस्तद् रूपमुच्यते॥”
इति प्राधान्ये।
“वर्णेशानि पदान्याहुः पादाश्चापि तदीश्वराः।
पादानामीश्वराऽर्धर्चास्तदीशा ऋच एव तु।
ऋचामधीशा वर्गाश्च तेषां सूक्तमधीश्वरम्।
सूक्ताधीशास्तथाऽध्यायास्तदधीशास्तथाऽष्टकाः।
तदधीशास्तथा शाखा वेदाश्चापि तदीश्वराः।
वेदानामीश्वरा वाच्या वाच्यानामीश्वरो हरिः।
न हरेरीश्वरः कश्चित् कदाचित् क्वापि विद्यते॥”
इति च।
पद्यन्त इति पदानि वाच्यानि। “पदं पदसहस्रेण यश्चरन् नापराद्ध्यते” इतिवत्। “पदं तु वाचकं प्रोक्तं क्वचिद् वाच्यमपीष्यते” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ १२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among the Vedas I am their original teacher, Lord Brahmā, and of all mantras I am the three-lettered oṁkāra. Among letters I am the first letter, “a,” and among sacred meters I am the Gāyatrī mantra.

units.sanskrit:
इन्द्रोऽहं सर्वदेवानां वसूनामस्मि हव्यवाट्।
आदित्यानामहं विष्णू रुद्राणां नीललोहितः॥ ११/१६/१३॥
units.english: Among the gods I am Indra, and among the Vasus I am Agni, the god of fire. I am Viṣṇu among the sons of Aditi, and among the Rudras I am Lord Śiva.

parts.sanskrit:
इन्द्रोऽहं सर्वदेवानां वसूनामस्मि हव्यवाट्।
आदित्यानामहं विष्णू रुद्राणां नीललोहितः॥ ११/१६/१३॥

“सर्ववेदाभिमानिन्यो देव्यो लक्ष्मीस्ततोऽधिका।
वेदाभिमानिनी साक्षात् सा विष्णोर्दूरतः स्थिता।
यज्ञाख्या सैव विष्णोस्तु या तूरःस्थलमाश्रिता।
हरिणा रतियोगस्था दक्षिणाख्याऽपि सैव तु।
उत्तरोत्तरतः साऽपि विशिष्टा दक्षिणा
सुखे।
एवं वेदाभिमानिभ्यो देवीभ्यः सर्व एव तु।
तदर्थरूपाः पतयस्तस्यास्तस्यास्तथोत्तमाः।
शच्या इन्द्रस्ततश्चोमा तस्या रुद्रस्ततस्तथा।
भारती प्राण एवास्यास्ततः श्रीस्तद्वरो हरिः॥”
इति वैशेष्ये।
“ऋते रुद्रादिकानिन्द्रः सर्वदेवाधिकः स्मृतः।
ऋते भीमं फाल्गुनश्च पाण्डवेभ्यो वरस्तथा।
तथा शुक्रः कवीशस्तु बृहस्पत्यादिकानृते।
यमः संयमतामीशः शङ्करादीन् विनैव तु॥”
इति गीताकल्पे॥ १३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among the demigods I am Indra, and among the Vasus I am Agni, the god of fire. I am Viṣṇu among the sons of Aditi, and among the Rudras I am Lord Śiva.

units.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मर्षीणां भृगुरहं राजर्षीणामहं मनुः।
देवर्षीणां नारदोऽहं हविर्धान्यस्मि धेनुषु॥ ११/१६/१४॥
units.english: Among saintly brāhmaṇas I am Bhṛgu Muni, and I am Manu among saintly kings. I am Nārada Muni among saintly gods, and I am Kāmadhenu among cows.

meta.english_verbatim: Among saintly brāhmaṇas I am Bhṛgu Muni, and I am Manu among saintly kings. I am Nārada Muni among saintly demigods, and I am Kāmadhenu among cows.

units.sanskrit:
सिद्धेश्वराणां कपिलः सुपर्णोऽहं पतत्रिणाम्।
प्रजापतीनां दक्षोऽहं पितॄणामहमर्यमा॥ ११/१६/१५॥
units.english: I am Lord Kapila among perfected beings and Garuḍa among birds. I am Dakṣa among the progenitors of mankind, and I am Aryamā among the forefathers.

meta.english_verbatim: I am Lord Kapila among perfected beings and Garuḍa among birds. I am Dakṣa among the progenitors of mankind, and I am Aryamā among the forefathers.

units.sanskrit:
विद्ध्युद्धव त्वं दैत्यानां प्रह्लादमसुरर्षभम्।
सोमं नक्षत्रौषधीनां धनेशं यक्षरक्षसाम्॥ ११/१६/१६॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, among the demoniac sons of Diti know Me to be King Prahlāda, the saintly lord of the asuras. Among the stars and herbs I am their lord, Candra (the moon), and among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas I am the lord of wealth, Kuvera.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, among the demoniac sons of Diti know Me to be Prahlāda Mahārāja, the saintly lord of the asuras. Among the stars and herbs I am their lord, Candra (the moon), and among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas I am the lord of wealth, Kuvera.

units.sanskrit:
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां यादसां वरुणं प्रभुम्।
तपतां द्युमतां सूर्यं मनुष्याणां च भूपतिम्॥ ११/१६/१७॥
units.english: I am Airāvata among lordly elephants, and among aquatics I am Varuṇa, the lord of the seas. Among all things that heat and illuminate I am the sun, and among human beings I am the king.

meta.english_verbatim: I am Airāvata among lordly elephants, and among aquatics I am Varuṇa, the lord of the seas. Among all things that heat and illuminate I am the sun, and among human beings I am the king.

units.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवास्तुरङ्गाणां धातूनामस्मि काञ्चनम्।
यमः संयमतां चाहं सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः॥ ११/१६/१८॥
units.english: Among horses I am Uccaiḥśravā, and I am gold among metals. I am Yamarāja among those who suppress and punish, and among serpents I am Vāsuki.

meta.english_verbatim: Among horses I am Uccaiḥśravā, and I am gold among metals. I am Yamarāja among those who suppress and punish, and among serpents I am Vāsuki.

units.sanskrit:
नागेन्द्राणामनन्तोऽहं मृगेन्द्रः शृङ्गिदंष्ट्रिणाम्।
आश्रमाणामहं तुर्यो वर्णानां प्रथमोऽनघ॥ ११/१६/१९॥
units.english: O sinless Uddhava, among the best of snakes I am Anantadeva, and among those animals with sharp horns or teeth I am the lion. Among the social orders I am the fourth, or the renounced order of life, and among the occupational divisions I am the first, the brāhmaṇas.

parts.sanskrit:
नागेन्द्राणामनन्तोऽहं मृगेन्द्रः शृङ्गिदंष्ट्रिणाम्।
आश्रमाणामहं तुर्यो वर्णानां प्रथमोऽनघ॥ ११/१६/१९॥

“गार्हस्थ्यं च यतित्वं च देवेष्वेकत्वमागतम्।
प्राधान्योक्तिर्यतित्वस्य गार्हस्थ्यस्य क्वचित्क्वचित्॥”
इत्याश्रमविवेके॥ १९॥

meta.english_verbatim: O sinless Uddhava, among the best of snakes I am Anantadeva, and among those animals with sharp horns or teeth I am the lion. Among the social orders I am the fourth, or the renounced order of life, and among the occupational divisions I am the first, the brāhmaṇas.

units.sanskrit:
तीर्थानां स्रोतसां गङ्गा समुद्रः सरसामहम्।
आयुधानां धनुरहं त्रिपुरघ्नो धनुष्मताम्॥ ११/१६/२०॥
units.english: Among sacred and flowing things I am the holy Ganges, and among steady bodies of water I am the ocean. Among weapons I am the bow, and of the wielders of weapons I am Lord Śiva.

meta.english_verbatim: Among sacred and flowing things I am the holy Ganges, and among steady bodies of water I am the ocean. Among weapons I am the bow, and of the wielders of weapons I am Lord Śiva.

units.sanskrit:
गिरीणामस्म्यहं मेरुर्गहनानां हिमालयः।
वनस्पतीनामश्वत्थ ओषधीनामहं यवाः॥ ११/१६/२१॥
units.english: Among residences I am Mount Sumeru, and of impervious places I am the Himālayas. Among trees I am the holy fig tree, and among plants I am those that bear grains.

meta.english_verbatim: Among residences I am Mount Sumeru, and of impervious places I am the Himālayas. Among trees I am the holy fig tree, and among plants I am those that bear grains.

units.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां वसिष्ठोऽहं ब्रह्मिष्ठानां बृहस्पतिः।
स्कन्दोऽहं सर्वसेनान्यामग्रण्यां भगवानजः॥ ११/१६/२२॥
units.english: Among priests I am Vasiṣṭha Muni, and among those highly situated in Vedic culture I am Bṛhaspati. I am Kārtikeya among great military leaders, and among those advancing in superior ways of life I am the great personality Lord Brahmā.

parts.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां वसिष्ठोऽहं ब्रह्मिष्ठानां बृहस्पतिः।
स्कन्दोऽहं सर्वसेनान्यामग्रण्यां भगवानजः॥ ११/१६/२२॥
“वसिष्ठोऽभ्यधिकस्तेषु मानुषाणां पुरोधसाम्” इति त्रैकाल्ये॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among priests I am Vasiṣṭha Muni, and among those highly situated in Vedic culture I am Bṛhaspati. I am Kārtikeya among great military leaders, and among those advancing in superior ways of life I am the great personality Lord Brahmā.

units.sanskrit:
यज्ञानां ब्रह्मयज्ञोऽहं व्रतानामविहिंसनम्।
वाय्वग्न्यर्काम्बुवागात्मा शुचीनामप्यहं शुचिः॥ ११/१६/२३॥
units.english: Among sacrifices I am study of the Veda, and I am nonviolence among vows. Among all things that purify I am the wind, fire, the sun, water and speech.

meta.english_verbatim: Among sacrifices I am study of the Veda, and I am nonviolence among vows. Among all things that purify I am the wind, fire, the sun, water and speech.

units.sanskrit:
योगानामात्मसंरोधो मन्त्रोऽस्मि विजिगीषताम्।
आन्वीक्षिका कौशलानां विकल्पः ख्यातिवादिनाम्॥ ११/१६/२४॥
units.english: Among the eight progressive states of yoga I am the final stage, samādhi, in which the soul is completely separated from illusion. Among those desiring victory I am prudent political counsel, and among processes of expert discrimination I am the science of the soul, by which one distinguishes spirit from matter. Among all speculative philosophers I am diversity of perception.

parts.sanskrit:
योगानामात्मसंरोधो मन्त्रोऽस्मि विजिगीषताम्।
आन्वीक्षिका कौशलानां विकल्पः ख्यातिवादिनाम्॥ ११/१६/२४॥

जीवेशादिभेदवादी विकल्पः। ख्यातिवादिनां ज्ञानवादिनाम्।
“जीवेशादिविशेषं यो याथार्थ्येन प्रकल्पयेत्।
कलिमारभ्य वा विष्णोराधिक्यादुत्तरोत्तरम्।
नियमेनैव केनापि न हेयः स विकल्पकः।
सर्वज्ञानिविशेषेभ्यः स ज्ञानी सर्वथाऽधिकः॥”
इति विज्ञाने।
“भेददृष्ट्याऽभिमानेन” इत्युक्तम्। “विद्याऽऽत्मनि भिदाबोधः” इति च वक्ष्यति॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among the eight progressive states of yoga I am the final stage, samādhi, in which the soul is completely separated from illusion. Among those desiring victory I am prudent political counsel, and among processes of expert discrimination I am the science of the soul, by which one distinguishes spirit from matter. Among all speculative philosophers I am diversity of perception.

units.sanskrit:
स्त्रीणां तु शतरूपाऽहं पुंसां स्वायम्भुवो मनुः।
नारायणो मुनीनां च कुमारो ब्रह्मचारिणाम्॥ ११/१६/२५॥
units.english: Among ladies I am Śatarūpā, and among male personalities I am her husband, Svāyambhuva Manu. I am Nārāyaṇa among the sages and Sanat-kumāra among brahmacārīs.

parts.sanskrit:
स्त्रीणां तु शतरूपाऽहं पुंसां स्वायम्भुवो मनुः।
नारायणो मुनीनां च कुमारो ब्रह्मचारिणाम्॥ ११/१६/२५॥

“शतरूपा वरा स्त्रीणां पुंसामभ्यधिको मनुः।
तयोरप्यधिकौ नित्यमिन्द्राणीन्द्रौ शुभैर्गुणैः॥”
इति वैशेष्ये॥ २५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among ladies I am Śatarūpā, and among male personalities I am her husband, Svāyambhuva Manu. I am Nārāyaṇa among the sages and Sanat-kumāra among brahmacārīs.

units.sanskrit:
धर्माणामस्मि सन्त्यागः क्षेमाणामबहिर्मतिः।
गुह्यानां सततं मौनं मिथुनानां पुमानहम्॥ ११/१६/२६॥
units.english: Among religious principles I am renunciation, and of all types of security I am consciousness of the eternal soul within. Of secrets I am pleasant speech and silence, and among sexual pairs I am Brahmā.

meta.english_verbatim: Among religious principles I am renunciation, and of all types of security I am consciousness of the eternal soul within. Of secrets I am pleasant speech and silence, and among sexual pairs I am Brahmā.

units.sanskrit:
संवत्सरोऽस्म्यनिमिषामृतूनां मधुमाधवौ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहं नक्षत्राणां तथाऽभिजित्॥ ११/१६/२७॥
units.english: Among the vigilant cycles of time I am the year, and among seasons I am spring. Among months I am Mārgaśīrṣa, and among lunar houses I am the auspicious Abhijit.

meta.english_verbatim: Among the vigilant cycles of time I am the year, and among seasons I am spring. Among months I am Mārgaśīrṣa, and among lunar houses I am the auspicious Abhijit.

units.sanskrit:
अहं युगानां च कृतं धीराणां देवलोऽसितः।
द्वैपायनोऽस्मि व्यासानां कवीनां काव्य आत्मवान्॥ ११/१६/२८॥
units.english: Among ages I am the Satya-yuga, the age of truth, and among steady sages I am Devala and Asita. Among those who have divided the Vedas I am Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Vedavyāsa, and among learned scholars I am Śukrācārya, the knower of spiritual science.

meta.english_verbatim: Among ages I am the Satya-yuga, the age of truth, and among steady sages I am Devala and Asita. Among those who have divided the Vedas I am Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Vedavyāsa, and among learned scholars I am Śukrācārya, the knower of spiritual science.

units.sanskrit:
वासुदेवो भगवतां त्वं तु भागवतेष्वहम्।
किम्पुरुषाणां च हनुमान् विद्याध्राणां सुदर्शनः॥ ११/१६/२९॥
units.english: Among those entitled to the name Bhagavān I am Vāsudeva, and indeed, you, Uddhava, represent Me among the devotees. I am Hanumān among the Kimpuruṣas, and among the Vidyādharas I am Sudarśana.

parts.sanskrit:
वासुदेवो भगवतां त्वं तु भागवतेष्वहम्।
किम्पुरुषाणां च हनुमान् विद्याध्राणां सुदर्शनः॥ ११/१६/२९॥

“ऐश्वर्यादिगुणैः षड्भिः सामग्र्यात् सर्वदेवताः।
भगवच्छब्दवाच्याश्च साक्षात् तु भगवान् हरिः।
निरपेक्षं तु सामग्र्यं तस्य सर्वाधिकं यतः॥”
इति च।
अतो भगवतां देवानाम्।
“सर्वभागवताधीश उद्धवो भगवत्प्रियः।
तस्मादभ्यधिको जिष्णुः प्रियत्वे भक्तितो हरेः।
तस्मादभ्यधिको रामः कृष्णा त्वभ्यधिका ततः।
तस्या अभ्यधिको भीमो नतु तत्सदृशः क्वचित्॥”
इति च।
“यत् किञ्चात्मनि कल्याणं सम्भावयसि पाण्डव।
सहस्रगुणमप्येतत् त्वयि सम्भावयाम्यहम्।
धर्मो ज्ञानं तथा मोक्षो यशः कीर्तिस्तथैव च।
त्वय्यायत्तमिदं सर्वं लोकस्यापि न संशयः॥”
इति भारते॥ २९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among those entitled to the name Bhagavān I am Vāsudeva, and indeed, you, Uddhava, represent Me among the devotees. I am Hanumān among the Kimpuruṣas, and among the Vidyādharas I am Sudarśana.

units.sanskrit:
रत्नानां पदम्रागोऽस्मि पदम्कोशस्तु पेशसाम्।
कुशोऽस्मि दर्भजातीनां गव्यमाज्यं हविष्ष्वहम्॥ ११/१६/३०॥
units.english: Among jewels I am the ruby, and among beautiful things I am the lotus cup. Among all types of grass I am the sacred kuśa, and of oblations I am ghee and other ingredients obtained from the cow.

meta.english_verbatim: Among jewels I am the ruby, and among beautiful things I am the lotus cup. Among all types of grass I am the sacred kuśa, and of oblations I am ghee and other ingredients obtained from the cow.

units.sanskrit:
व्यवसायिनामहं लक्ष्मीः कितवानां छलग्रहः।
तितिक्षाऽस्मि तितिक्षूणां सत्वं सत्ववतामहम्॥ ११/१६/३१॥
units.english: Among the enterprising I am fortune, and among the cheaters I am gambling. I am the forgiveness of the tolerant and the good qualities of those in the mode of goodness.

meta.english_verbatim: Among the enterprising I am fortune, and among the cheaters I am gambling. I am the forgiveness of the tolerant and the good qualities of those in the mode of goodness.

units.sanskrit:
ओजः सहोबलवतां कर्माहं विद्धि सात्वताम्।
सात्वतां नवमूर्तीनामादिमूर्तिरहं पुरा॥ ११/१६/३२॥
units.english: Of the powerful I am bodily and mental strength, and I am the devotional activities of My devotees. My devotees worship Me in nine different forms, among which I am the original and primary Vāsudeva.

parts.sanskrit:
ओजः सहोबलवतां कर्माहं विद्धि सात्वताम्।
सात्वतां नवमूर्तीनामादिमूर्तिरहं पुरा॥ ११/१६/३२॥

“विष्णोः श्रियो ब्रह्मणश्च वायोः सङ्कर्षणस्य च।
सुपर्णस्य च सम्प्रोक्ताः प्रत्येकं नवमूर्तयः।
पूज्याः सात्त्वततन्त्रेषु तत्राद्या मूर्तयो हरेः।
प्रधानास्ता हि सर्वासां मूर्तीनां हरिमूर्तयः।
अभेदादेव मूर्तीनामेकमूर्तिश्च सा स्मृता॥”
इति सहस्रावरणे।
श्रियादिनवमूर्तीनां मध्ये स्वकीयनवमूर्तिरहमित्यर्थः।
“स्वरूपतश्च गुणतो न विशेषः कथञ्चन।
विष्णोस्तु नवमूर्तीनां पूजा च नवधेष्यते॥”
इति च।
अतो न स्वनवमूर्तीनाम्। अन्येभ्योऽन्यनवमूर्तीनामपि प्राधान्यकारणं सन्निधानमात्मनस्तास्वप्यस्तीति पुरेतिविशेषणम्। प्रथमतः पूज्यास्ता इत्यर्थः।
“नारायणः परम्ब्रह्म वासुदेवादिकास्तथा।
नरसिंहवराहौ च परञ्ज्योतिर्हरेर्नव।
इन्दिरा च रमा लक्ष्मीर्हिरण्या गगना तथा।
रक्ता रक्ततरा भूतिर्विभूतिश्च श्रियो नव।
ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखो धाता विधाता विधिरेव च।
कर्ता विरिञ्चो भूतेशः शतानन्दश्च ता नव।
धनञ्जयमृते चैव वायोस्तु नवमूर्तयः।
शेषोऽनन्तो नरश्चैव लक्ष्मणो बल एव च।
सङ्कर्षणो नीलवासा जगद्रक्षो जलेशयः।
सुपर्णो गरुडश्चैव वैनतेयो महाशनः।
नववर्णः पञ्चवर्णः पन्नागाशोऽमृताकरः।
तथैव सर्ववेदात्मा सुपर्णो नवधा स्मृतः॥”
इति च॥ ३२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Of the powerful I am bodily and mental strength, and I am the devotional activities of My devotees. My devotees worship Me in nine different forms, among which I am the original and primary Vāsudeva.

units.sanskrit:
विश्वावसुः पूर्वचित्तिर्गन्धर्वाप्सरसामहम्।
भूधराणामहं स्थैर्यं गन्धमात्रमहं भुवः॥ ११/१६/३३॥
units.english: Among the Gandharvas I am Viśvāvasu, and I am Pūrvacitti among the heavenly Apsaras. I am the steadiness of mountains and the fragrant aroma of the earth.

meta.english_verbatim: Among the Gandharvas I am Viśvāvasu, and I am Pūrvacitti among the heavenly Apsaras. I am the steadiness of mountains and the fragrant aroma of the earth.

units.sanskrit:
अपां रसश्च परमस्तेजिष्ठानां विभावसुः।
प्रभा सूर्येन्दुताराणां शब्दोऽहं नभसः परः॥ ११/१६/३४॥
units.english: I am the sweet taste of water, and among brilliant things I am the sun. I am the effulgence of the sun, moon and stars, and I am the transcendental sound that vibrates in the sky.

meta.english_verbatim: I am the sweet taste of water, and among brilliant things I am the sun. I am the effulgence of the sun, moon and stars, and I am the transcendental sound that vibrates in the sky.

units.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मण्यानां बलिरहं वीराणामहमर्जुनः।
भूतानां स्थितिरुत्पत्तिरहं वै प्रतिसङ्क्रमः॥ ११/१६/३५॥
units.english: Among those dedicated to brahminical culture I am King Bali, the son of Virocana, and I am Arjuna among heroes. Indeed, I am the creation, maintenance and annihilation of all living beings.

meta.english_verbatim: Among those dedicated to brahminical culture I am Bali Mahārāja, the son of Virocana, and I am Arjuna among heroes. Indeed, I am the creation, maintenance and annihilation of all living entities.

units.sanskrit:
गत्युक्त्युत्सर्गोपादानमानन्दस्पर्शलक्षणः।
आस्वादश्रुत्यवघ्राणमहं सर्वेन्द्रियेन्द्रियः॥ ११/१६/३६॥
units.english: I am the functions of the five working senses — the legs, speech, anus, hands and sex organs — as well as those of the five knowledge-acquiring senses — touch, sight, taste, hearing and smell. I am also the potency by which each of the senses experiences its particular sense object.

meta.english_verbatim: I am the functions of the five working senses — the legs, speech, anus, hands and sex organs — as well as those of the five knowledge-acquiring senses — touch, sight, taste, hearing and smell. I am also the potency by which each of the senses experiences its particular sense object.

units.sanskrit:
पृथिवी वायुराकाश आपो ज्योतिरहं महान्।
विकारः पुरुषोऽव्यक्तं रजः सत्वं तमः परः॥ ११/१६/३७॥
units.english: I am form, taste, aroma, touch and sound; false ego; the mahat-tattva; earth, water, fire, air and sky; the living being; material nature; the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance; and the transcendental Lord. All these items, along with knowledge of their individual symptoms and the steady conviction that results from this knowledge, represent Me.

meta.english_verbatim: I am form, taste, aroma, touch and sound; false ego; the mahat-tattva; earth, water, fire, air and sky; the living entity; material nature; the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance; and the transcendental Lord. All these items, along with knowledge of their individual symptoms and the steady conviction that results from this knowledge, represent Me.

units.sanskrit:
मयेश्वरेण जीवेन गुणेन गुणिना विना।
सर्वात्मनाऽपि सर्वेण न भावो विद्यते क्वचित्॥ ११/१६/३८॥
units.english: As the Supreme Lord I am the basis of the living being, of the modes of nature and of the mahat-tattva. Thus I am everything, and nothing whatsoever can exist without Me.

meta.english_verbatim: As the Supreme Lord I am the basis of the living entity, of the modes of nature and of the mahat-tattva. Thus I am everything, and nothing whatsoever can exist without Me.

units.sanskrit:
सङ्ख्यानं परमाणूनां कालेन क्रियते मया।
न तथा मे विभूतीनां सृजतोऽण्डानि कोटिशः॥ ११/१६/३९॥
units.english: Even though over a period of time I might count all the atoms of the universe, I could not count all of My opulences which I manifest within innumerable universes.

parts.sanskrit:
सङ्ख्यानं परमाणूनां कालेन क्रियते मया।
न तथा मे विभूतीनां सृजतोऽण्डानि कोटिशः॥ ११/१६/३९॥

“यस्ययस्य स्वभावो यस्तत्तन्नामा हरिः परः।
नियामकः स्वभावस्य तत्तच्छब्दादिनामवान्।
वैशेष्याख्या विभूतिश्च विभूतिश्च स्वभावजा।
द्विधा विभूतिर्विज्ञेया विष्णोस्तु परमात्मनः॥”
इति च।
“सत्त्वादिनाम विष्णोस्तु सत्त्वादिस्थस्य केवलम्।
जीवस्थस्य च तन्नाम जीवादेरुपचारतः॥”
इति च॥ ३७॥
कालेन सर्वगुणात्मकेन मयाऽसङ्ख्यत्वात् तथा न क्रियते। नाविज्ञानात्।
“अनन्तमिति वेत्तीशस्त्वनन्तं त्वन्तवत् तथा।
अनन्तस्य हि सङ्ख्याने नतु सर्वज्ञता भवेत्।
अनन्तमपि वेत्तीशः प्रत्येकं च विशेषतः।
सर्वज्ञत्वान्न सङ्ख्यानमसङ्ख्यस्य कुतो हि सा॥”
इति च॥ ३९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Even though over a period of time I might count all the atoms of the universe, I could not count all of My opulences which I manifest within innumerable universes.

units.sanskrit:
तेजः श्रीः कीर्तिरैश्वर्यं ह्वीस्त्यागः सौभगं भगः।
वीर्यं तितिक्षा विज्ञानं यत्रयत्र स मेंऽशकः॥ ११/१६/४०॥
units.english: Whatever power, beauty, fame, opulence, humility, renunciation, mental pleasure, fortune, strength, tolerance or spiritual knowledge there may be is simply an expansion of My opulence.

meta.english_verbatim: Whatever power, beauty, fame, opulence, humility, renunciation, mental pleasure, fortune, strength, tolerance or spiritual knowledge there may be is simply an expansion of My opulence.

units.sanskrit:
एतास्ते कार्तिताः सर्वाः संक्षेपेण विभूतयः।
मनोविकारा एते वै यथा वाचाऽभिधीयते॥ ११/१६/४१॥
units.english: I have briefly described to you all My spiritual opulences and also the extraordinary material features of My creation, which are perceived by the mind and defined in different ways according to circumstances.

parts.sanskrit:
एतास्ते कार्तिताः सर्वाः संक्षेपेण विभूतयः।
मनोविकारा एते वै यथा वाचाऽभिधीयते॥ ११/१६/४१॥
यथा वाचाऽभिधीयते नामादिकं जीवादीनां ते सर्वे शब्दा मनोविकाराः॥ ४१॥

meta.english_verbatim: I have briefly described to you all My spiritual opulences and also the extraordinary material features of My creation, which are perceived by the mind and defined in different ways according to circumstances.

units.sanskrit:
वाचं यच्छ मनो यच्छ प्राणं यच्छेन्द्रियाणि च।
आत्मानमात्मना यच्छ न भूयः कल्प्यसेऽध्वने॥ ११/१६/४२॥
units.english: Therefore, control your speaking, subdue the mind, conquer the life air, regulate the senses and through purified intelligence bring your rational faculties under control. In this way you will never again fall onto the path of material existence.

parts.sanskrit:
वाचं यच्छ मनो यच्छ प्राणं यच्छेन्द्रियाणि च।
आत्मानमात्मना यच्छ न भूयः कल्प्यसेऽध्वने॥ ११/१६/४२॥
स्वतो मय्येव सर्वशब्दास्तस्मान्मय्येव वाचं यच्छ। आत्मानं परमात्मानं मय्येव लक्ष्यत्वेन यच्छ॥ ४२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, control your speaking, subdue the mind, conquer the life air, regulate the senses and through purified intelligence bring your rational faculties under control. In this way you will never again fall onto the path of material existence.

units.sanskrit:
यो वै वाङ्मनसी सम्यङ् न संयच्छेद् धिया यतिः।
तस्य व्रतं तपो ज्ञानं स्रवत्यामघटाम्बुवत्॥ ११/१६/४३॥
units.english: A transcendentalist who does not completely control his words and mind by superior intelligence will find that his spiritual vows, austerities and charity flow away just as water flows out of an unbaked clay pot.

parts.sanskrit:
यो वै वाङ्मनसी सम्यङ् न संयच्छेद् धिया यतिः।
तस्य व्रतं तपो ज्ञानं स्रवत्यामघटाम्बुवत्॥ ११/१६/४३॥
यो मयि न संयच्छति। तस्य ज्ञानं स्रवति॥ ४३॥

meta.english_verbatim: A transcendentalist who does not completely control his words and mind by superior intelligence will find that his spiritual vows, austerities and charity flow away just as water flows out of an unbaked clay pot.

units.sanskrit:
तस्माद् वचोमनःप्राणान् नियच्छेन्मत्परायणः।
मद्भक्तियुक्तया बुद्ध्या ततः परिसमाप्यते॥ ११/१६/४४॥
units.english: Being surrendered to Me, one should control the speech, mind and life air, and then through loving devotional intelligence one will completely fulfill the mission of life.

parts.sanskrit:
तस्माद् वचोमनःप्राणान् नियच्छेन्मत्परायणः।
मद्भक्तियुक्तया बुद्ध्या ततः परिसमाप्यते॥ ११/१६/४४॥

“वाङ्मनःप्राणबुद्ध्यादीन् नियच्छेत् केशवे परे।
सर्वशब्दाभिधेयत्वं तस्य ज्ञात्वा विशेषतः।
मुख्यवृत्त्याऽभिधेयत्वमन्येषां मनसो भ्रमात्।
तस्मात् तथा चिन्तयतः स्रवेज्ज्ञानं यथातथम्।
तस्मान्मनोवचःप्राणान् माधवैकपरायणान्।
कुर्यात् तद्धि तपो ग्राह्यं महाधर्मोत्तमश्च सः॥”
इति धर्मविवेके।
“यच्छेद् वाङ्मनसी प्राज्ञस्तद् यच्छेज्ज्ञान आत्मनि।
ज्ञानमात्मनि महति नियच्छेच्छान्त आत्मनि॥”
इति च॥ ४४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Being surrendered to Me, one should control the speech, mind and life air, and then through loving devotional intelligence one will completely fulfill the mission of life.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
यस्त्वयाऽभिहितः पूर्वं धर्मस्त्वद्भक्तिलक्षणः।
वर्णाश्रमाचारवतां सर्वेषां द्विपदामपि॥ ११/१७/१॥
यथाऽनुष्ठीयमानेन त्वयि भक्तिर्नृणां भवेत्।
स्वधर्मेणारविन्दाक्ष तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि॥ ११/१७/२॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord, previously You described the principles of devotion that are to be practiced by followers of the varṇāśrama system and even ordinary, unregulated human beings. My dear lotus-eyed Lord, now please explain to me how all human beings can achieve loving service unto You by the execution of their prescribed duties.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord, previously You described the principles of devotional service that are to be practiced by followers of the varṇāśrama system and even ordinary, unregulated human beings. My dear lotus-eyed Lord, now please explain to me how all human beings can achieve loving service unto You by the execution of their prescribed duties.

units.sanskrit:
पुरा किल महाबाहो धर्मं परमकं भवान्।
यमाह त्वयि भक्तेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च माधव॥ ११/१७/३॥
स इदानीं सुमहता कालेनामित्रकर्शन।
प्रायोऽन्तर्भविता मर्त्यलोके प्रागनुशासितः॥ ११/१७/४॥
units.english: My dear Lord, O mighty-armed one, previously in Your form of Lord Haṁsa You spoke to Lord Brahmā those religious principles that bring supreme happiness to the practitioner. My dear Mādhava, now much time has passed, and that which You previously instructed will soon practically cease to exist, O subduer of the enemy.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord, O mighty-armed one, previously in Your form of Lord Haṁsa You spoke to Lord Brahmā those religious principles that bring supreme happiness to the practitioner. My dear Mādhava, now much time has passed, and that which You previously instructed will soon practically cease to exist, O subduer of the enemy.

units.sanskrit:
वक्ता कर्ताऽविता नान्यो धर्मस्याच्युत ते प्रभो१।
सभायामपि वैरिञ्च्यां यत्र मूर्तिधराः कलाः॥ ११/१७/५॥
कर्त्राऽवित्रा प्रवक्त्रा च भवता मधुसूदन।
त्यक्ते महीतळे देव विनष्टं कः प्रवक्ष्यति॥ ११/१७/६॥
units.english: My dear Lord Acyuta, there is no speaker, creator and protector of supreme religious principles other than Your Lordship, either on the earth or even in the assembly of Lord Brahmā, where the personified Vedas reside. Thus, my dear Lord Madhusūdana, when You, who are the very creator, protector and speaker of spiritual knowledge, abandon the earth, who will again speak this lost knowledge?

parts.sanskrit:
वक्ता कर्ताऽविता नान्यो धर्मस्याच्युत ते प्रभो१।
सभायामपि वैरिञ्च्यां यत्र मूर्तिधराः कलाः॥ ११/१७/५॥
कर्त्राऽवित्रा प्रवक्त्रा च भवता मधुसूदन।
त्यक्ते महीतळे देव विनष्टं कः प्रवक्ष्यति॥ ११/१७/६॥

“विना प्रसादं विष्णोर्न धर्मं ब्रह्माभिवक्ष्यति।
तत्प्रसादेन वक्तुं तु ब्रह्मा शक्ष्यति नापरः॥”
इति प्राधान्ये।
कलाः प्राणाद्याः।
“स प्राणमसृजत। प्राणाच्छ्रद्धां खं वायुं ज्योतिरापः पृथिवीन्द्रियं मनोऽन्नमन्नाद् वीर्यं तपो मन्त्राः कर्म लोका लोकेषु नाम च --- ता इमाः षोडशकलाः पुरुषायणाः” इति श्रुतेः॥ ५॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord Acyuta, there is no speaker, creator and protector of supreme religious principles other than Your Lordship, either on the earth or even in the assembly of Lord Brahmā, where the personified Vedas reside. Thus, my dear Lord Madhusūdana, when You, who are the very creator, protector and speaker of spiritual knowledge, abandon the earth, who will again speak this lost knowledge?

units.sanskrit:
त्वमतः सर्वधर्मज्ञ धर्मस्त्वद्भक्तिलक्षणः।
यथा यस्य विधीयेत तथा वर्णय मेऽच्युत॥ ११/१७/७॥
units.english: Śukācārya said: Uddhava, the best of devotees, thus inquired from the Lord. Hearing his question, Kṛṣṇa, was pleased and for the welfare of all conditioned souls spoke those religious principles that are eternal.

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: Śrī Uddhava, the best of devotees, thus inquired from the Lord. Hearing his question, the Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, was pleased and for the welfare of all conditioned souls spoke those religious principles that are eternal.

english_edits.rule: 'the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa' -> 'Lord Kṛṣṇa' (appositive dropped)
honorific Śrī before a name removed

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
धर्म्य एष तव प्रश्नो नैःश्रेयसकरो नृणाम्।
वर्णाश्रमाचारवतां तमुद्धव निबोध मे॥ ११/१७/८॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, your question is faithful to religious principles and thus gives rise to the highest perfection in life, pure devotion, for both ordinary human beings and the followers of the varṇāśrama system. Now please learn from Me those supreme religious principles.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, your question is faithful to religious principles and thus gives rise to the highest perfection in life, pure devotional service, for both ordinary human beings and the followers of the varṇāśrama system. Now please learn from Me those supreme religious principles.

units.sanskrit:
आदौ कृतयुगे वर्णो नृणां हंस इति स्मृतः।
कृतकृत्याः प्रजा जात्या तस्मात् कृतयुगं विदुः॥ ११/१७/९॥
units.english: In the beginning, in Satya-yuga, there is only one social class, called haṁsa, to which all human beings belong. In that age all people are unalloyed devotees of the Lord from birth, and thus learned scholars call this first age Kṛta-yuga, or the age in which all religious duties are perfectly fulfilled.

meta.english_verbatim: In the beginning, in Satya-yuga, there is only one social class, called haṁsa, to which all human beings belong. In that age all people are unalloyed devotees of the Lord from birth, and thus learned scholars call this first age Kṛta-yuga, or the age in which all religious duties are perfectly fulfilled.

units.sanskrit:
वेदः प्रणव एवाग्रे धर्मोऽहं वृषरूपधृक्।
उपासते तपोनिष्ठा हंसा मां मुक्तकिल्बिषाः॥ ११/१७/१०॥
units.english: In Satya-yuga the undivided Veda is expressed by the syllable om, and I am the only object of mental activities. I become manifest as the four-legged bull of religion, and thus the inhabitants of Satya-yuga, fixed in austerity and free from all sins, worship Me as Lord Haṁsa.

meta.english_verbatim: In Satya-yuga the undivided Veda is expressed by the syllable om, and I am the only object of mental activities. I become manifest as the four-legged bull of religion, and thus the inhabitants of Satya-yuga, fixed in austerity and free from all sins, worship Me as Lord Haṁsa.

units.sanskrit:
त्रेतामुखे महाभाग प्राणान्मे हृदयात् त्रयी।
विद्या प्रादुरभूत् तस्या अहमासं त्रिवृन्मुखः॥ ११/१७/११॥
units.english: O greatly fortunate one, at the beginning of Tretā-yuga Vedic knowledge appeared from My heart, which is the abode of the air of life, in three divisions — as Ṛg, Sāma and Yajur. Then from that knowledge I appeared as threefold sacrifice.

meta.english_verbatim: O greatly fortunate one, at the beginning of Tretā-yuga Vedic knowledge appeared from My heart, which is the abode of the air of life, in three divisions — as Ṛg, Sāma and Yajur. Then from that knowledge I appeared as threefold sacrifice.

units.sanskrit:
विप्रक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रा मुखबाहूरुपादजाः।
वैराजात् पुरुषाज्जाता य आत्माचारलक्षणाः॥ ११/१७/१२॥
units.english: In Tretā-yuga the four social orders were manifested from the universal form of the Lord. The brāhmaṇas appeared from the Lord’s face, the kṣatriyas from the Lord’s arms, the vaiśyas from the Lord’s thighs and the śūdras from the legs of that mighty form. Each social division was recognized by its particular duties and behavior.

meta.english_verbatim: In Tretā-yuga the four social orders were manifested from the universal form of the Personality of Godhead. The brāhmaṇas appeared from the Lord’s face, the kṣatriyas from the Lord’s arms, the vaiśyas from the Lord’s thighs and the śūdras from the legs of that mighty form.
