Each social division was recognized by its particular duties and behavior.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit:
गृहाश्रमो जघनतो ब्रह्मचर्यं हृदो मम।
वक्षःस्थलाद् वनेवासो न्यासः शीर्षण्यवस्थितः॥ ११/१७/१३॥
units.english: The married order of life appeared from the loins of My universal form, and the celibate students came from My heart. The forest-dwelling retired order of life appeared from My chest, and the renounced order of life was situated within the head of My universal form.

meta.english_verbatim: The married order of life appeared from the loins of My universal form, and the celibate students came from My heart. The forest-dwelling retired order of life appeared from My chest, and the renounced order of life was situated within the head of My universal form.

units.sanskrit:
वर्णानामश्रमाणां च जन्मभूम्यनुसारतः।
आसन् प्रकृतयो नॄणां नीचैर्नीचोत्तमोत्तमाः॥ ११/१७/१४॥
units.english: The various occupational and social divisions of human society appeared according to inferior and superior natures manifest in the situation of the individual’s birth.

meta.english_verbatim: The various occupational and social divisions of human society appeared according to inferior and superior natures manifest in the situation of the individual’s birth.

units.sanskrit:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं सन्तोषः क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।
मद्भक्तिश्च दया सत्यं ब्रह्मप्रकृतयस्त्विमाः॥ ११/१७/१५॥
units.english: Peacefulness, self-control, austerity, cleanliness, satisfaction, tolerance, simple straightforwardness, devotion to Me, mercy and truthfulness are the natural qualities of the brāhmaṇas.

meta.english_verbatim: Peacefulness, self-control, austerity, cleanliness, satisfaction, tolerance, simple straightforwardness, devotion to Me, mercy and truthfulness are the natural qualities of the brāhmaṇas.

units.sanskrit:
तेजो बलं धृतिः शौर्यं तितिक्षौदार्यमुद्यमः।
स्थैर्यं ब्रह्मण्यमैश्वर्यं क्षत्रप्रकृतयस्त्विमाः॥ ११/१७/१६॥
units.english: Dynamic power, bodily strength, determination, heroism, tolerance, generosity, great endeavor, steadiness, devotion to the brāhmaṇas and leadership are the natural qualities of the kṣatriyas.

meta.english_verbatim: Dynamic power, bodily strength, determination, heroism, tolerance, generosity, great endeavor, steadiness, devotion to the brāhmaṇas and leadership are the natural qualities of the kṣatriyas.

units.sanskrit:
आस्तिक्यं दाननिष्ठा च अदम्भो विप्रसेवनम्।
अतुष्टिरर्थोपचये वैश्यप्रकृतयस्त्विमाः॥ ११/१७/१७॥
units.english: Faith in Vedic civilization, dedication to charity, freedom from hypocrisy, service to the brāhmaṇas and perpetually desiring to accumulate more money are the natural qualities of the vaiśyas.

meta.english_verbatim: Faith in Vedic civilization, dedication to charity, freedom from hypocrisy, service to the brāhmaṇas and perpetually desiring to accumulate more money are the natural qualities of the vaiśyas.

units.sanskrit:
शुश्रूषणं द्विजगवां देवानां चाप्यमायया।
तत्र लब्धेन सन्तोषः शूद्रप्रकृतयस्त्विमाः॥ ११/१७/१८॥
units.english: Service without duplicity to the brāhmaṇas, cows, gods and other worshipable personalities, and complete satisfaction with whatever income is obtained in such service, are the natural qualities of śūdras.

meta.english_verbatim: Service without duplicity to the brāhmaṇas, cows, demigods and other worshipable personalities, and complete satisfaction with whatever income is obtained in such service, are the natural qualities of śūdras.

units.sanskrit:
अशौचमनृतं स्तेयं नास्तिक्यं शुष्कनिग्रहः।
कामः क्रोधश्च तर्षश्च स्वभावोऽन्तेवसायिनाम्॥ ११/१७/१९॥
units.english: Dirtiness, dishonesty, thievery, faithlessness, useless quarrel, lust, anger and hankering constitute the nature of those in the lowest position outside the varṇāśrama system.

meta.english_verbatim: Dirtiness, dishonesty, thievery, faithlessness, useless quarrel, lust, anger and hankering constitute the nature of those in the lowest position outside the varṇāśrama system.

units.sanskrit:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयमकामक्रोधलोभता।
भूतप्रियहितेहा च धर्मोऽयं सार्ववर्णिकः॥ ११/१७/२०॥
units.english: Nonviolence, truthfulness, honesty, desire for the happiness and welfare of all others and freedom from lust, anger and greed constitute duties for all members of society.

meta.english_verbatim: Nonviolence, truthfulness, honesty, desire for the happiness and welfare of all others and freedom from lust, anger and greed constitute duties for all members of society.

units.sanskrit:
द्वितीयं प्राप्यानुपूर्व्याज्जन्मोपनयनं द्विजः।
वसन् गुरुकुले दान्तो ब्रह्माधीयीत वाग्यतः॥ ११/१७/२१॥
units.english: The twice-born member of society achieves second birth through the sequence of purificatory ceremonies culminating in Gāyatrī initiation. Being summoned by the teacher, he should reside within the guru’s āśrama and with a self-controlled mind carefully study the Vedic literature.

meta.english_verbatim: The twice-born member of society achieves second birth through the sequence of purificatory ceremonies culminating in Gāyatrī initiation. Being summoned by the spiritual master, he should reside within the guru’s āśrama and with a self-controlled mind carefully study the Vedic literature.

units.sanskrit:
मेखलाजिनदण्डाक्षब्रह्मसूत्रकमण्डलून्।
जटिलोऽधौतदन्तश्च वासः पीठकुशान् दधत्॥ ११/१७/२२॥
units.english: The brahmacārī should regularly dress with a belt of straw and deerskin garments. He should wear matted hair, carry a rod and waterpot and be decorated with akṣa beads and a sacred thread. Carrying pure kuśa grass in his hand, he should never accept a luxurious or sensuous sitting place. He should not unnecessarily polish his teeth, nor should he bleach and iron his clothes.

meta.english_verbatim: The brahmacārī should regularly dress with a belt of straw and deerskin garments. He should wear matted hair, carry a rod and waterpot and be decorated with akṣa beads and a sacred thread. Carrying pure kuśa grass in his hand, he should never accept a luxurious or sensuous sitting place. He should not unnecessarily polish his teeth, nor should he bleach and iron his clothes.

units.sanskrit:
स्नानभोजनहोमेषु जपोच्चारे च वाग्यतः।
न छिन्द्यान्नखरोमाणि कक्षोपस्थगतान्यपि॥ ११/१७/२३॥
units.english: A brahmacārī should always remain silent while bathing, eating, attending sacrificial performances, chanting japa or passing stool and urine. He should not cut his nails and hair, including the armpit and pubic hair.

meta.english_verbatim: A brahmacārī should always remain silent while bathing, eating, attending sacrificial performances, chanting japa or passing stool and urine. He should not cut his nails and hair, including the armpit and pubic hair.

units.sanskrit:
रेतो नावकिरेज्जातु ब्रह्मव्रतधरः स्वयम्।
अवकार्णोऽवगाह्याप्सु यतासुस्त्रिपदीं जपेत्॥ ११/१७/२४॥
units.english: One observing the vow of celibate brahmacārī life should never pass semen. If the semen by chance spills out by itself, the brahmacārī should immediately take bath in water, control his breath by prāṇāyāma and chant the Gāyatrī mantra.

meta.english_verbatim: One observing the vow of celibate brahmacārī life should never pass semen. If the semen by chance spills out by itself, the brahmacārī should immediately take bath in water, control his breath by prāṇāyāma and chant the Gāyatrī mantra.

units.sanskrit:
अग्न्यर्काचार्यगोविप्रगुरुवृद्धसुरान् नमेत्।
*समाहित उपासीत सन्ध्ये च यतवाग् जपेत्॥ ११/१७/२५॥
units.english: Purified and fixed in consciousness, the brahmacārī should worship the fire-god, sun, ācārya, cows, brāhmaṇas, guru, elderly respectable persons and gods. He should perform such worship at sunrise and sunset, without speaking but by silently chanting or murmuring the appropriate mantras.

meta.english_verbatim: Purified and fixed in consciousness, the brahmacārī should worship the fire-god, sun, ācārya, cows, brāhmaṇas, guru, elderly respectable persons and demigods. He should perform such worship at sunrise and sunset, without speaking but by silently chanting or murmuring the appropriate mantras.

units.sanskrit:
*आचार्यं मां विजानीयान्नावमन्येत कर्हिचित्।
न मर्त्यबुद्ध्याऽसूयेत सर्वदेवमयो गुरुः॥ ११/१७/२६॥
units.english: One should know the ācārya as Myself and never disrespect him in any way. One should not envy him, thinking him an ordinary man, for he is the representative of all the gods.

meta.english_verbatim: One should know the ācārya as Myself and never disrespect him in any way. One should not envy him, thinking him an ordinary man, for he is the representative of all the demigods.

units.sanskrit:
*सायं प्रातरुपानीय भैक्ष्यं तस्मै निवेदयेत्।
यच्चान्यदप्यनुज्ञात उपभुञ्जीत संयतः॥ ११/१७/२७॥
units.english: In the morning and evening one should collect foodstuffs and other articles and deliver them to the teacher. Then, being self-controlled, one should accept for oneself that which is allotted by the ācārya.

meta.english_verbatim: In the morning and evening one should collect foodstuffs and other articles and deliver them to the spiritual master. Then, being self-controlled, one should accept for oneself that which is allotted by the ācārya.

units.sanskrit:
*शुश्रूषमाण आचार्यं सदोपसीत नीचवत्।
यानशय्यासनस्थाने नातिदूरः कृताञ्जलिः॥ ११/१७/२८॥
units.english: While engaged in serving the teacher one should remain as a humble servant, and thus when the guru is walking the servant should humbly walk behind. When the guru lies down to sleep, the servant should also lie down nearby, and when the guru has awakened, the servant should sit near him, massaging his lotus feet and rendering other, similar services. When the guru is sitting down on his āsana, the servant should stand nearby with folded hands, awaiting the guru’s order. In this way one should always worship the teacher.

meta.english_verbatim: While engaged in serving the spiritual master one should remain as a humble servant, and thus when the guru is walking the servant should humbly walk behind. When the guru lies down to sleep, the servant should also lie down nearby, and when the guru has awakened, the servant should sit near him, massaging his lotus feet and rendering other, similar services. When the guru is sitting down on his āsana, the servant should stand nearby with folded hands, awaiting the guru’s order. In this way one should always worship the spiritual master.

units.sanskrit:
एवंवृत्तो गुरुकुले वसेद् भोगविवर्जितः।
विद्या समाप्यते यावद् चरेद् व्रतमखण्डितम्॥ ११/१७/२९॥
units.english: Until the student has completed his Vedic education he should remain engaged in the āśrama of the teacher, should remain completely free of material sense enjoyment and should not break his vow of celibacy [brahmacarya].

meta.english_verbatim: Until the student has completed his Vedic education he should remain engaged in the āśrama of the spiritual master, should remain completely free of material sense gratification and should not break his vow of celibacy [brahmacarya].

units.sanskrit:
यद्यसौ च्छन्दसां लोकमारोक्ष्यन् ब्रह्मविष्टपम्।
गुरवे विन्यसेद् देहं स्वाध्यायार्थं बृहद्व्रतः॥ ११/१७/३०॥
units.english: If the brahmacārī student desires to ascend to the Maharloka or Brahmaloka planets, then he should completely surrender his activities to the teacher and, observing the powerful vow of perpetual celibacy, dedicate himself to superior Vedic studies.

meta.english_verbatim: If the brahmacārī student desires to ascend to the Maharloka or Brahmaloka planets, then he should completely surrender his activities to the spiritual master and, observing the powerful vow of perpetual celibacy, dedicate himself to superior Vedic studies.

units.sanskrit:
अग्नौ गुरावात्मनि च सर्वभूतेषु मां परम्।
अपृथग्धीरुपासीत ब्रह्मवर्चस्व्यकल्मषः॥ ११/१७/३१॥
units.english: Thus enlightened in Vedic knowledge by service to the teacher, freed from all sins and duality, one should worship Me as the Supreme Self, as I appear within fire, the teacher, one’s own self and all living beings.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus enlightened in Vedic knowledge by service to the spiritual master, freed from all sins and duality, one should worship Me as the Supersoul, as I appear within fire, the spiritual master, one’s own self and all living entities.

units.sanskrit:
स्त्रीणां निरीक्षणस्पर्शसल्लापक्ष्वेळनादिकम्।
प्राणिनो मिथुनीभूतानगृहस्थोऽग्रतस्त्यजेत्॥ ११/१७/३२॥
units.english: Those who are not married — sannyāsīs, vānaprasthas and brahmacārīs — should never associate with women by glancing, touching, conversing, joking or sporting. Neither should they ever associate with any living being engaged in sexual activities.

meta.english_verbatim: Those who are not married — sannyāsīs, vānaprasthas and brahmacārīs — should never associate with women by glancing, touching, conversing, joking or sporting. Neither should they ever associate with any living entity engaged in sexual activities.

units.sanskrit:
शौचमाचमनं स्नानं सन्ध्योपासनमार्जवम्।
तीर्थसेवा जपोऽस्पृश्याभक्ष्यासम्भाष्यवर्जनम्॥ ११/१७/३३॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, general cleanliness, washing the hands, bathing, performing religious services at sunrise, noon and sunset, worshiping Me, visiting holy places, chanting japa, avoiding that which is untouchable, uneatable or not to be discussed, and remembering My existence within all living beings as the Supreme Self — these principles should be followed by all members of society through regulation of the mind, words and body.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, general cleanliness, washing the hands, bathing, performing religious services at sunrise, noon and sunset, worshiping Me, visiting holy places, chanting japa, avoiding that which is untouchable, uneatable or not to be discussed, and remembering My existence within all living entities as the Supersoul — these principles should be followed by all members of society through regulation of the mind, words and body.

units.sanskrit:
सर्वाश्रमप्रयुक्तोऽयं नियमः कुलनन्दन।
मद्भावः सर्वभूतेषु मनोवाक्कायसंयमः॥ ११/१७/३४॥
एवं ब्रह्मव्रतधरो ब्राह्मणोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।
मद्भक्तस्तीव्रतपसा दग्धकर्माशयोऽमलः॥ ११/१७/३५॥
units.english: A brahmacārī who has completed his Vedic education and desires to enter household life should offer proper remuneration to the teacher, bathe, cut his hair, put on proper clothes, and so on. Then, taking permission from the guru, he should go back to his home.

meta.english_verbatim: A brahmacārī who has completed his Vedic education and desires to enter household life should offer proper remuneration to the spiritual master, bathe, cut his hair, put on proper clothes, and so on. Then, taking permission from the guru, he should go back to his home.

units.sanskrit:
गृहं वनं चोपविशेत् प्रव्रजेद् वा द्विजोत्तमः।
आश्रमादाश्रमं गच्छेन्नान्यथा मत्परश्चरेत्॥ ११/१७/३७॥
units.english: A brahmacārī desiring to fulfill his material desires should live at home with his family, and a householder who is eager to purify his consciousness should enter the forest, whereas a purified brāhmaṇa should accept the renounced order of life. One who is not surrendered to Me should move progressively from one āśrama to another, never acting otherwise.

meta.english_verbatim: A brahmacārī desiring to fulfill his material desires should live at home with his family, and a householder who is eager to purify his consciousness should enter the forest, whereas a purified brāhmaṇa should accept the renounced order of life. One who is not surrendered to Me should move progressively from one āśrama to another, never acting otherwise.

units.sanskrit:
गृहार्थी सदृशीं भार्यामुद्वहेदजुगुप्सिताम्।
यवीयसीं तु वयसा यां सवर्णामनुक्रमात्॥ ११/१७/३८॥
units.english: One who desires to establish family life should marry a wife of his own caste, who is beyond reproach and younger in age. If one desires to accept many wives he must marry them after the first marriage, and each wife should be of a successively lower caste.

meta.english_verbatim: One who desires to establish family life should marry a wife of his own caste, who is beyond reproach and younger in age. If one desires to accept many wives he must marry them after the first marriage, and each wife should be of a successively lower caste.

units.sanskrit:
इज्याध्ययनदानानि सर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम्।
प्रतिग्रहोऽध्यापनं च ब्राह्मणस्यैव याजनम्॥ ११/१७/३९॥
units.english: All twice-born men — brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas and vaiśyas — must perform sacrifice, study the Vedic literature and give charity. Only the brāhmaṇas, however, accept charity, teach the Vedic knowledge and perform sacrifice on behalf of others.

meta.english_verbatim: All twice-born men — brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas and vaiśyas — must perform sacrifice, study the Vedic literature and give charity. Only the brāhmaṇas, however, accept charity, teach the Vedic knowledge and perform sacrifice on behalf of others.

units.sanskrit:
प्रतिग्रहं मन्यमानस्तपस्तेजोयशोनुदम्।
अन्याभ्यामेव जीवेत सिलैर्वा दोषदृक् तयोः॥ ११/१७/४०॥
units.english: A brāhmaṇa who considers that accepting charity from others will destroy his austerity, spiritual influence and fame should maintain himself by the other two brahminical occupations, namely teaching Vedic knowledge and performing sacrifice. If the brāhmaṇa considers that those two occupations also compromise his spiritual position, then he should collect rejected grains in agricultural fields and live without any dependence on others.

meta.english_verbatim: A brāhmaṇa who considers that accepting charity from others will destroy his austerity, spiritual influence and fame should maintain himself by the other two brahminical occupations, namely teaching Vedic knowledge and performing sacrifice. If the brāhmaṇa considers that those two occupations also compromise his spiritual position, then he should collect rejected grains in agricultural fields and live without any dependence on others.

units.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणस्य हि देहोऽयं क्षुद्रकामाय नेष्यते।
कृच्छ्राय महते चेह प्रेत्यानन्तसुखाय च॥ ११/१७/४१॥
units.english: The body of a brāhmaṇa is not intended to enjoy insignificant material sense enjoyment; rather, by accepting difficult austerities in his life, a brāhmaṇa will enjoy unlimited happiness after death.

meta.english_verbatim: The body of a brāhmaṇa is not intended to enjoy insignificant material sense gratification; rather, by accepting difficult austerities in his life, a brāhmaṇa will enjoy unlimited happiness after death.

units.sanskrit:
सिलोञ्छवृत्त्या परितुष्टचित्तो धर्मं महान्तं विरजं जुषाणः।
मय्यर्पितात्मा गृह एव तिष्ठन् नातिप्रसक्तः समुपैति शान्तिम्॥ ११/१७/४२॥
units.english: A brāhmaṇa householder should remain satisfied in mind by gleaning rejected grains from agricultural fields and marketplaces. Keeping himself free of personal desire, he should practice magnanimous religious principles, with consciousness absorbed in Me. In this way a brāhmaṇa may stay at home as a householder without very much attachment and thus achieve liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: A brāhmaṇa householder should remain satisfied in mind by gleaning rejected grains from agricultural fields and marketplaces. Keeping himself free of personal desire, he should practice magnanimous religious principles, with consciousness absorbed in Me. In this way a brāhmaṇa may stay at home as a householder without very much attachment and thus achieve liberation.

units.sanskrit:
समुद्धरन्ति ये विप्रं सीदन्तं मत्परायणम्।
तानुद्धरिष्ये नचिरादापदो नौरिवार्णवात्॥ ११/१७/४३॥
units.english: Just as a ship rescues those who have fallen into the ocean, similarly, I very quickly rescue from all calamities those persons who uplift brāhmaṇas and devotees suffering in a poverty-stricken condition.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as a ship rescues those who have fallen into the ocean, similarly, I very quickly rescue from all calamities those persons who uplift brāhmaṇas and devotees suffering in a poverty-stricken condition.

units.sanskrit:
सर्वाः समुद्धरेद् राजा पितेव व्यसनात् प्रजाः।
आत्मानमात्मना धीरो यथा गजपतिर्गजान्॥ ११/१७/४४॥
units.english: Just as the chief bull elephant protects all other elephants in his herd and defends himself as well, similarly, a fearless king, just like a father, must save all of the citizens from difficulty and also protect himself.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as the chief bull elephant protects all other elephants in his herd and defends himself as well, similarly, a fearless king, just like a father, must save all of the citizens from difficulty and also protect himself.

units.sanskrit:
एवंविधो नरपतिर्विमानेनार्कवर्चसा।
विधूयेहाशुभं कृत्स्नमिन्द्रेण सह मोदते॥ ११/१७/४५॥
units.english: An earthly king who protects himself and all citizens by removing all sins from his kingdom will certainly enjoy with Lord Indra in airplanes as brilliant as the sun.

meta.english_verbatim: An earthly king who protects himself and all citizens by removing all sins from his kingdom will certainly enjoy with Lord Indra in airplanes as brilliant as the sun.

units.sanskrit:
सीदन् विप्रो वणिग्वृत्त्या पण्यैरेवापदं तरेत्।
खळ्गेन वाऽऽपदाक्रान्तो न श्ववृत्त्या कथञ्चन॥ ११/१७/४६॥
units.english: If a brāhmaṇa cannot support himself through his regular duties and is thus suffering, he may adopt the occupation of a merchant and overcome his destitute condition by buying and selling material things. If he continues to suffer extreme poverty even as a merchant, then he may adopt the occupation of a kṣatriya, taking sword in hand. But he cannot in any circumstances become like a dog, accepting an ordinary master.

meta.english_verbatim: If a brāhmaṇa cannot support himself through his regular duties and is thus suffering, he may adopt the occupation of a merchant and overcome his destitute condition by buying and selling material things. If he continues to suffer extreme poverty even as a merchant, then he may adopt the occupation of a kṣatriya, taking sword in hand. But he cannot in any circumstances become like a dog, accepting an ordinary master.

units.sanskrit:
वैश्यवृत्त्या तु राजन्यो जीवेन्मृगययाऽऽपदि।
चरेद् वा विप्ररूपेण न श्ववृत्त्या कथञ्चन॥ ११/१७/४७॥
units.english: A king or other member of the royal order who cannot maintain himself by his normal occupation may act as a vaiśya, may live by hunting or may act as a brāhmaṇa by teaching others Vedic knowledge. But he may not under any circumstances adopt the profession of a śūdra.

meta.english_verbatim: A king or other member of the royal order who cannot maintain himself by his normal occupation may act as a vaiśya, may live by hunting or may act as a brāhmaṇa by teaching others Vedic knowledge. But he may not under any circumstances adopt the profession of a śūdra.

units.sanskrit:
शूद्रवृत्तिं भजेद् वैश्यः शूद्रो वै कारुकक्रियाम्।
कृच्छ्रन्मुक्तो न गर्ह्येण वृत्तिं लिप्सेत कर्मणा॥ ११/१७/४८॥
units.english: A vaiśya, or mercantile man, who cannot maintain himself may adopt the occupation of a śūdra, and a śūdra who cannot find a master can engage in simple activities like making baskets and mats of straw. However, all members of society who have adopted inferior occupations in emergency situations must give up those substitute occupations when the difficulties have passed.

meta.english_verbatim: A vaiśya, or mercantile man, who cannot maintain himself may adopt the occupation of a śūdra, and a śūdra who cannot find a master can engage in simple activities like making baskets and mats of straw. However, all members of society who have adopted inferior occupations in emergency situations must give up those substitute occupations when the difficulties have passed.

units.sanskrit:
वेदाध्यायी स्वधास्वाहाबल्यन्नाद्यैर्यथोदयम्।
नृदेवपितृभूतानि१ मद्रूपाण्यन्वहं यजेत्॥ ११/१७/४९॥
units.english: One in the gṛhastha order of life should daily worship the sages by Vedic study, the forefathers by offering the mantra svadhā, the gods by chanting svāhā, all living beings by offering shares of one’s meals, and human beings by offering grains and water. Thus considering the gods, sages, forefathers, living beings and human beings to be manifestations of My potency, one should daily perform these five sacrifices.

meta.english_verbatim: One in the gṛhastha order of life should daily worship the sages by Vedic study, the forefathers by offering the mantra svadhā, the demigods by chanting svāhā, all living entities by offering shares of one’s meals, and human beings by offering grains and water. Thus considering the demigods, sages, forefathers, living entities and human beings to be manifestations of My potency, one should daily perform these five sacrifices.

units.sanskrit:
यदृच्छयोपपन्नेन शुक्लेनोपार्जितेन वा।
धनेनापीडयन् भृत्यान् मां यजेतान्वहं विभुम्॥ ११/१७/५०॥
units.english: A householder should comfortably maintain his dependents either with money that comes of its own accord or with that gathered by honest execution of one’s duties. According to one’s means, one should perform sacrifices and other religious ceremonies.

parts.sanskrit:
यदृच्छयोपपन्नेन शुक्लेनोपार्जितेन वा।
धनेनापीडयन् भृत्यान् मां यजेतान्वहं विभुम्॥ ११/१७/५०॥

“प्रतिमावद्धरे रूपं तिर्यङ्नरसुरादयः।
साक्षाद्रूपाणि मत्स्यादीन्यभिन्नान्येव सर्वदा॥”
इति च॥ ५०॥

meta.english_verbatim: A householder should comfortably maintain his dependents either with money that comes of its own accord or with that gathered by honest execution of one’s duties. According to one’s means, one should perform sacrifices and other religious ceremonies.

units.sanskrit:
कुडुम्बेषु न सज्जेत न प्रमाद्येत् कुटुम्ब्यपि।
विपश्चिन्नश्वरं पश्येददृष्टमपि दृष्टवत्॥ ११/१७/५१॥
units.english: A householder taking care of many dependent family members should not become materially attached to them, nor should he become mentally unbalanced, considering himself to be the lord. An intelligent householder should see that all possible future happiness, just like that which he has already experienced, is temporary.

meta.english_verbatim: A householder taking care of many dependent family members should not become materially attached to them, nor should he become mentally unbalanced, considering himself to be the lord. An intelligent householder should see that all possible future happiness, just like that which he has already experienced, is temporary.

units.sanskrit:
पुत्रदाराप्तबन्धूनां सङ्गमः पान्थसङ्गमः।
अनुदेहं भवन्त्येते स्वप्नो निद्रानुगो यथा॥ ११/१७/५२॥
units.english: The association of children, wife, relatives and friends is just like the brief meeting of travelers. With each change of body one is separated from all such associates, just as one loses the objects one possesses in a dream when the dream is over.

meta.english_verbatim: The association of children, wife, relatives and friends is just like the brief meeting of travelers. With each change of body one is separated from all such associates, just as one loses the objects one possesses in a dream when the dream is over.

units.sanskrit:
इत्थं परिमृशन् युक्तो गृहेष्वतिथिवद् वसन्।
न गृहैरनुबध्येत निर्ममो निरहंकृतिः॥ ११/१७/५३॥
units.english: Deeply considering the actual situation, a liberated soul should live at home just like a guest, without any sense of proprietorship or false ego. In this way he will not be bound or entangled by domestic affairs.

meta.english_verbatim: Deeply considering the actual situation, a liberated soul should live at home just like a guest, without any sense of proprietorship or false ego. In this way he will not be bound or entangled by domestic affairs.

units.sanskrit:
कर्मभिर्गृहमेधीयैरिष्ट्वा मामेव भक्तिमान्।
तिष्ठेद् वनं वोपविशेत् प्रजावान् वा परिव्रजेत्॥ ११/१७/५४॥
units.english: A householder devotee who worships Me by execution of his family duties may remain at home, go to a holy place or, if he has a responsible son, take sannyāsa.

meta.english_verbatim: A householder devotee who worships Me by execution of his family duties may remain at home, go to a holy place or, if he has a responsible son, take sannyāsa.

units.sanskrit:
यस्त्वासक्तमतिर्गेहे पुत्रवित्तेषणातुरः।
स्त्रैणः कृपणधीर्मूढो ममाहमिति बध्यते॥ ११/१७/५५॥
units.english: But a householder whose mind is attached to his home and who is thus disturbed by ardent desires to enjoy his money and children, who is lusty after women, who is possessed of a miserly mentality and who unintelligently thinks, “Everything is mine and I am everything,” is certainly bound in illusion.

meta.english_verbatim: But a householder whose mind is attached to his home and who is thus disturbed by ardent desires to enjoy his money and children, who is lusty after women, who is possessed of a miserly mentality and who unintelligently thinks, “Everything is mine and I am everything,” is certainly bound in illusion.

units.sanskrit:
अहो मे पितरौ वृद्धौ भार्या बालात्मजाऽऽत्मजाः।
अनाथा मामृते दीनाः कथं जीवन्ति दुःखिनः॥ ११/१७/५६॥
units.english: “O my poor elderly parents, and my wife with a mere infant in her arms, and my other young children! Without me they have absolutely no one to protect them and will suffer unbearably. How can my poor relatives possibly live without me?”

meta.english_verbatim: “O my poor elderly parents, and my wife with a mere infant in her arms, and my other young children! Without me they have absolutely no one to protect them and will suffer unbearably. How can my poor relatives possibly live without me?”

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
वनं विविक्षुः पुत्रेषु भार्यां न्यस्य सहैव वा।
वनमेव वसेच्छान्तस्तृतीयं भागमायुषः॥ ११/१८/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: One who desires to adopt the third order of life, vānaprastha, should enter the forest with a peaceful mind, leaving his wife with his mature sons, or else taking her along with him.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: One who desires to adopt the third order of life, vānaprastha, should enter the forest with a peaceful mind, leaving his wife with his mature sons, or else taking her along with him.

units.sanskrit:
कन्दमूलफलैर्वन्यैर्मेध्यैर्वृत्तिं प्रकल्पयेत्।
वसीत वल्कलं वासस्तृणपर्णाजिनानि वा॥ ११/१८/२॥
units.english: Having adopted the vānaprastha order of life, one should arrange one’s sustenance by eating uncontaminated bulbs, roots and fruits that grow in the forest. One may dress oneself with tree bark, grass, leaves or animal skins.

meta.english_verbatim: Having adopted the vānaprastha order of life, one should arrange one’s sustenance by eating uncontaminated bulbs, roots and fruits that grow in the forest. One may dress oneself with tree bark, grass, leaves or animal skins.

units.sanskrit:
३केशलोमनखश्मश्रुमलानि बिभृयाद् व्रती।
न धावेदप्सु मज्जेत त्रिकालं स्थण्डिलेशयः॥ ११/१८/३॥
units.english: The vānaprastha should not groom the hair on his head, body or face, should not manicure his nails, should not pass stool and urine at irregular times and should not make a special endeavor for dental hygiene. He should be content to take bath in water three times daily and should sleep on the ground.

meta.english_verbatim: The vānaprastha should not groom the hair on his head, body or face, should not manicure his nails, should not pass stool and urine at irregular times and should not make a special endeavor for dental hygiene. He should be content to take bath in water three times daily and should sleep on the ground.

units.sanskrit:
ग्रीष्मे तप्येत पञ्चाग्निर्वर्षास्वासारषाड् जले।
आकण्ठमग्नः शिशिर एवंवृत्तस्तपश्चरेत्॥ ११/१८/४॥
units.english: Thus engaged as a vānaprastha, one should execute penance during the hottest summer days by subjecting oneself to burning fires on four sides and the blazing sun overhead; during the rainy season one should remain outside, subjecting oneself to torrents of rain; and in the freezing winter one should remain submerged in water up to one’s neck.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus engaged as a vānaprastha, one should execute penance during the hottest summer days by subjecting oneself to burning fires on four sides and the blazing sun overhead; during the rainy season one should remain outside, subjecting oneself to torrents of rain; and in the freezing winter one should remain submerged in water up to one’s neck.

units.sanskrit:
अग्निपक्वं समश्नीयात् कालपक्वमथापि वा।
उलूखल्यश्मकुट्टो वा दन्तोलूखल एव वा॥ ११/१८/५॥
units.english: One may eat foodstuffs prepared with fire, such as grains, or fruits ripened by time. One may grind one’s food with mortar and stone or with one’s own teeth.

meta.english_verbatim: One may eat foodstuffs prepared with fire, such as grains, or fruits ripened by time. One may grind one’s food with mortar and stone or with one’s own teeth.

units.sanskrit:
स्वयं सञ्चिनुयात् सर्वमात्मनो वृत्तिकारणम्।
देशकालबलाभिज्ञो नाददीतान्यदाहृतम्॥ ११/१८/६॥
units.english: The vānaprastha should personally collect whatever he requires for his bodily maintenance, carefully considering the time, place and his own capacity. He should never collect provisions for the future.

meta.english_verbatim: The vānaprastha should personally collect whatever he requires for his bodily maintenance, carefully considering the time, place and his own capacity. He should never collect provisions for the future.

units.sanskrit:
वन्यैश्चरुपुरोडाशान् निर्वपेत् कालचोदितान्।
न तु श्रौतेन पशुना मां यजेत वनाश्रमी॥ ११/१८/७॥
units.english: One who has accepted the vānaprastha order of life should perform seasonal sacrifices by offering oblations of caru and sacrificial cakes prepared from rice and other grains found in the forest. The vānaprastha, however, may never offer animal sacrifices to Me, even those sacrifices mentioned in the Vedas.

meta.english_verbatim: One who has accepted the vānaprastha order of life should perform seasonal sacrifices by offering oblations of caru and sacrificial cakes prepared from rice and other grains found in the forest. The vānaprastha, however, may never offer animal sacrifices to Me, even those sacrifices mentioned in the Vedas.

units.sanskrit:
अग्निहोत्रं च दर्शं च पूर्णमासं च पूर्ववत्।
चातुर्मास्यानि च मुनेराम्नातानि५ च नैगमैः॥ ११/१८/८॥
units.english: The vānaprastha should perform the agnihotra, darśa and paurṇamāsa sacrifices, as he did while in the gṛhastha-āśrama. He should also perform the vows and sacrifices of cāturmāsya, since all of these rituals are enjoined for the vānaprastha-āśrama by expert knowers of the Vedas.

meta.english_verbatim: The vānaprastha should perform the agnihotra, darśa and paurṇamāsa sacrifices, as he did while in the gṛhastha-āśrama. He should also perform the vows and sacrifices of cāturmāsya, since all of these rituals are enjoined for the vānaprastha-āśrama by expert knowers of the Vedas.

units.sanskrit:
एवं चीर्णेन तपसा मुनिर्धमनिसन्ततः।
मां तपोमयमाराध्य ऋषिलोकादुपैति माम्॥ ११/१८/९॥
units.english: The saintly vānaprastha, practicing severe penances and accepting only the bare necessities of life, becomes so emaciated that he appears to be mere skin and bones. Thus worshiping Me through severe penances, he goes to the Maharloka planet and then directly achieves Me.

meta.english_verbatim: The saintly vānaprastha, practicing severe penances and accepting only the bare necessities of life, becomes so emaciated that he appears to be mere skin and bones. Thus worshiping Me through severe penances, he goes to the Maharloka planet and then directly achieves Me.

units.sanskrit:
यस्त्वेवं कृच्छ्रतश्चीर्णं तपो निःश्रेयसं महत्।
कामायाल्पीयसे युञ्ज्याद् बालिशः कोऽपरस्ततः॥ ११/१८/१०॥
units.english: One who with long endeavor executes this painful but exalted penance, which awards ultimate liberation, simply to achieve insignificant sense enjoyment must be considered the greatest fool.

meta.english_verbatim: One who with long endeavor executes this painful but exalted penance, which awards ultimate liberation, simply to achieve insignificant sense gratification must be considered the greatest fool.

units.sanskrit:
यदाऽसौ नियमेऽकल्यो जरया जातवेपथुः।
आत्मन्यग्निं समारोप्य मच्चित्तोऽग्निं समाविशेत्॥ ११/१८/११॥
units.english: If the vānaprastha is overtaken by old age and because of his trembling body is no longer able to execute his prescribed duties, he should place the sacrificial fire within his heart by meditation. Then, fixing his mind on Me, he should enter into the fire and give up his body.

meta.english_verbatim: If the vānaprastha is overtaken by old age and because of his trembling body is no longer able to execute his prescribed duties, he should place the sacrificial fire within his heart by meditation. Then, fixing his mind on Me, he should enter into the fire and give up his body.

units.sanskrit:
यदा धर्मविपाकेषु लोकेषु निरयात्मसु।
विरागो जायते सम्यङ् न्यस्ताग्निः प्रव्रजेत् ततः॥ ११/१८/१२॥
units.english: If the vānaprastha, understanding that even promotion to Brahmaloka is a miserable situation, develops complete detachment from all possible results of actions aimed at results, then he may take the sannyāsa order of life.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: If the vānaprastha, understanding that even promotion to Brahmaloka is a miserable situation, develops complete detachment from all possible results of fruitive activities, then he may take the sannyāsa order of life.

units.sanskrit:
इष्ट्वा यथोपदेशं मां दत्वा सर्वस्वमृत्विजे।
अग्नींश्च प्राण आवेश्य निरपेक्षः परिव्रजेत्॥ ११/१८/१३॥
units.english: Having worshiped Me according to scriptural injunctions and having given all one’s property to the sacrificial priest, one should place the fire sacrifice within oneself. Thus, with the mind completely detached, one should enter the sannyāsa order of life.

meta.english_verbatim: Having worshiped Me according to scriptural injunctions and having given all one’s property to the sacrificial priest, one should place the fire sacrifice within oneself. Thus, with the mind completely detached, one should enter the sannyāsa order of life.

units.sanskrit:
विप्रस्य वै सन्न्यसतो देवा दारादिरूपिणः।
विघ्नं कुर्वन्त्ययं ह्यस्मानाक्रम्य समियात् परम्॥ ११/१८/१४॥
units.english: “This man taking sannyāsa is going to surpass us and go back home, back to Godhead.” Thus thinking, the gods create stumbling blocks on the path of the sannyāsī by appearing before him in the shape of his former wife or other women and attractive objects. But the sannyāsī should pay the gods and their manifestations no heed.

parts.sanskrit:
विप्रस्य वै सन्न्यसतो देवा दारादिरूपिणः।
विघ्नं कुर्वन्त्ययं ह्यस्मानाक्रम्य समियात् परम्॥ ११/१८/१४॥

“असम्पूज्य न्यसिष्णूंस्तु देवा वै पातयन्त्यधः।
सुसम्पूज्य न्यसिष्णूंस्तु देवा एवानुजानते।
अथवा तद्यशोवृद्ध्यै विघ्नन्तीव पुनःपुनः।
तात्पर्याद् विघ्नितो देवैर्नोत्थातुं शक्नुयात् क्वचित्॥”
इति देवहार्दे॥ १४॥

meta.english_verbatim: “This man taking sannyāsa is going to surpass us and go back home, back to Godhead.” Thus thinking, the demigods create stumbling blocks on the path of the sannyāsī by appearing before him in the shape of his former wife or other women and attractive objects. But the sannyāsī should pay the demigods and their manifestations no heed.

units.sanskrit:
बिभृयाच्चेन्मुनिर्वासः कौपीनाच्छादनं परम्।
त्यक्तं न दण्डपात्राभ्यामन्यत् किञ्चिदनापदि॥ ११/१८/१५॥
units.english: If the sannyāsī desires to wear something besides a mere kaupīna, he may use another cloth around his waist and hips to cover the kaupīna. Otherwise, if there is no emergency, he should not accept anything besides his daṇḍa and waterpot.

meta.english_verbatim: If the sannyāsī desires to wear something besides a mere kaupīna, he may use another cloth around his waist and hips to cover the kaupīna. Otherwise, if there is no emergency, he should not accept anything besides his daṇḍa and waterpot.

units.sanskrit:
दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत् पादं वस्त्रपूतं पिबेज्जलम्।
सत्यपूतं वदेद् वाचं मनःपूतं समाचरेत्॥ ११/१८/१६॥
units.english: A saintly person should step or place his foot on the ground only after verifying with his eyes that there are no living creatures, such as insects, who might be injured by his foot. He should drink water only after filtering it through a portion of his cloth, and he should speak only words that possess the purity of truth. Similarly, he should perform only those activities his mind has carefully ascertained to be pure.

meta.english_verbatim: A saintly person should step or place his foot on the ground only after verifying with his eyes that there are no living creatures, such as insects, who might be injured by his foot. He should drink water only after filtering it through a portion of his cloth, and he should speak only words that possess the purity of truth. Similarly, he should perform only those activities his mind has carefully ascertained to be pure.

units.sanskrit:
मौनानीहानिलायामदण्डो वाग्देहचेतसाम्।
न ह्येते यस्य सन्त्यङ्ग वेणुभिर्न भवेद् यतिः॥ ११/१८/१७॥
units.english: One who has not accepted the three internal disciplines of avoiding useless speech, avoiding useless activities and controlling the life air can never be considered a sannyāsī merely because of his carrying bamboo rods.

meta.english_verbatim: One who has not accepted the three internal disciplines of avoiding useless speech, avoiding useless activities and controlling the life air can never be considered a sannyāsī merely because of his carrying bamboo rods.

units.sanskrit:
भिक्षां चतुर्षु वर्णेषु विगर्ह्यान् वर्जयंश्चरेत्।
सप्तागारानसम्कॢप्तांस्तुष्येल्लब्धेन तावता॥ ११/१८/१८॥
units.english: Rejecting those houses that are polluted and untouchable, one should approach without previous calculation seven houses and be satisfied with that which is obtained there by begging. According to necessity, one may approach each of the four occupational orders of society.

meta.english_verbatim: Rejecting those houses that are polluted and untouchable, one should approach without previous calculation seven houses and be satisfied with that which is obtained there by begging. According to necessity, one may approach each of the four occupational orders of society.

units.sanskrit:
बहिर्जलाशयं गत्वा तत्रोपस्पृश्य वाग्यतः।
विभज्य याचतः शेषं भुञ्जीताशेषमाहृतम्॥ ११/१८/१९॥
units.english: Taking the food gathered through begging, one should leave the populated areas and go to a reservoir of water in a secluded place. There, having taken a bath and washed one’s hands thoroughly, one should distribute portions of the food to others who may request it. One should do this without speaking. Then, having thoroughly cleansed the remnants, one should eat everything on one’s plate, leaving nothing for future consumption.

meta.english_verbatim: Taking the food gathered through begging, one should leave the populated areas and go to a reservoir of water in a secluded place. There, having taken a bath and washed one’s hands thoroughly, one should distribute portions of the food to others who may request it. One should do this without speaking. Then, having thoroughly cleansed the remnants, one should eat everything on one’s plate, leaving nothing for future consumption.

units.sanskrit:
एकश्चरेन्महीमेतां निःसङ्गः संयतेन्द्रियः।
आत्मक्राड आत्मरत आत्मवान् समदर्शनः॥ ११/१८/२०॥
units.english: Without any material attachment, with senses fully controlled, remaining enthusiastic, and satisfied in realization of the Supreme Lord and his own self, the saintly person should travel about the earth alone. Having equal vision everywhere, he should be steady on the spiritual platform.

meta.english_verbatim: Without any material attachment, with senses fully controlled, remaining enthusiastic, and satisfied in realization of the Supreme Lord and his own self, the saintly person should travel about the earth alone. Having equal vision everywhere, he should be steady on the spiritual platform.

units.sanskrit:
विविक्तक्षेमशरणो मद्भावविमलाशयः।
आत्मानं चिन्तयेदेकमभेदेन मया मुनिः॥ ११/१८/२१॥
units.english: Dwelling in a safe and solitary place, his mind purified by constant thought of Me, the sage should concentrate on the soul alone, realizing it to be nondifferent from Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Dwelling in a safe and solitary place, his mind purified by constant thought of Me, the sage should concentrate on the soul alone, realizing it to be nondifferent from Me.

units.sanskrit:
अन्वीक्षेतात्मनो बन्धं मोक्षं च ज्ञाननिष्ठया।
बन्ध इन्द्रियविक्षेपो मोक्ष एषां च संयमः॥ ११/१८/२२॥
units.english: By steady knowledge a sage should clearly ascertain the nature of the soul’s bondage and liberation. Bondage occurs when the senses are deviated to sense enjoyment, and complete control of the senses constitutes liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: By steady knowledge a sage should clearly ascertain the nature of the soul’s bondage and liberation. Bondage occurs when the senses are deviated to sense gratification, and complete control of the senses constitutes liberation.

units.sanskrit:
तस्मान्नियम्य षड्वर्गं मद्भावेन चरेन्मुनिः।
विरक्तः क्षुल्लकामेभ्यो लब्ध्वाऽऽत्मनि सुखं महत्॥ ११/१८/२३॥
units.english: Therefore, completely controlling the five senses and the mind by Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a sage, having experienced spiritual bliss within the self, should live detached from insignificant material sense enjoyment.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, completely controlling the five senses and the mind by Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a sage, having experienced spiritual bliss within the self, should live detached from insignificant material sense gratification.

units.sanskrit:
पुरग्रामव्रजान् सर्वान् भिक्षार्थं प्रविशंश्चरेत्।
पुण्यदेशसरिच्छैलवनाश्रमवतीं महीम्॥ ११/१८/२४॥
units.english: The sage should travel in sanctified places, by flowing rivers and within the solitude of mountains and forests. He should enter the cities, towns and pasturing grounds and approach ordinary working men only to beg his bare sustenance.

meta.english_verbatim: The sage should travel in sanctified places, by flowing rivers and within the solitude of mountains and forests. He should enter the cities, towns and pasturing grounds and approach ordinary working men only to beg his bare sustenance.

units.sanskrit:
वानप्रस्थाश्रमपदेष्वभीक्ष्णं भैक्ष्यमाचरेत्।
संसिद्ध्यत्याश्वसंमोहः शुद्धसत्वः सिलान्धसा॥ ११/१८/२५॥
units.english: One in the vānaprastha order of life should always practice taking charity from others, for one is thereby freed from illusion and quickly becomes perfect in spiritual life. Indeed, one who subsists on food grains obtained in such a humble manner purifies his existence.

meta.english_verbatim: One in the vānaprastha order of life should always practice taking charity from others, for one is thereby freed from illusion and quickly becomes perfect in spiritual life. Indeed, one who subsists on food grains obtained in such a humble manner purifies his existence.

units.sanskrit:
नैतद् वस्तुतया पश्येद् दृश्यमानं विनश्वरम्।
असक्तचित्तो विरमेदिहामुत्र चिकार्षितात्॥ ११/१८/२६॥
units.english: One should never see as ultimate reality those material things which obviously will perish. With consciousness free from material attachment, one should retire from all activities meant for material progress in this life and the next.

meta.english_verbatim: One should never see as ultimate reality those material things which obviously will perish. With consciousness free from material attachment, one should retire from all activities meant for material progress in this life and the next.

units.sanskrit:
यदेतदात्मनि जगन्मनोवाक्प्राणसम्भृतम्।
सर्वं मायेति तर्केण स्वस्थस्त्यक्त्वा न तत् स्मरेत्॥ ११/१८/२७॥
units.english: One should logically consider the universe, which is situated within the Lord, and one’s own material body, which is composed of mind, speech and life air, to be ultimately products of the Lord’s illusory energy. Thus situated in the self, one should give up one’s faith in these things and should never again make them the object of one’s meditation.

parts.sanskrit:
यदेतदात्मनि जगन्मनोवाक्प्राणसम्भृतम्।
सर्वं मायेति तर्केण स्वस्थस्त्यक्त्वा न तत् स्मरेत्॥ ११/१८/२७॥

“त्रिगुणा प्रकृतिर्माया तज्जत्वाद् विश्वमीदृशम्।
अनाद्यनन्तकालेषु मायेत्याहुर्विपश्चितः।
अचेतनत्वान्नैवैतत् प्रयोजकतया स्मरेत्।
चेतनत्वं स्वतन्त्रत्वं स चैको विष्णुरेव तु।
आयस्तु फलमुद्दिष्टं प्रोक्तं मायेति निष्फलम्।
फलाल्पत्वात् तु मायैषा सम्प्रोक्ता त्रिगुणादिका।
महाफलप्रदत्वात् तु विष्णुराय इतीरितः॥”
इति निवृत्ते॥ २७॥

meta.english_verbatim: One should logically consider the universe, which is situated within the Lord, and one’s own material body, which is composed of mind, speech and life air, to be ultimately products of the Lord’s illusory energy. Thus situated in the self, one should give up one’s faith in these things and should never again make them the object of one’s meditation.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञाननिष्ठो विरक्तो वा मद्भक्तो वाऽनपेक्षकः।
सलिङ्गानाश्रमान् मुक्त्वा चरेदविधिगोचरः॥ ११/१८/२८॥
units.english: A learned transcendentalist dedicated to the cultivation of knowledge and thus detached from external objects, or My devotee who is detached even from desire for liberation — both neglect those duties based on external rituals or paraphernalia. Thus their conduct is beyond the range of rules and regulations.

meta.english_verbatim: A learned transcendentalist dedicated to the cultivation of knowledge and thus detached from external objects, or My devotee who is detached even from desire for liberation — both neglect those duties based on external rituals or paraphernalia. Thus their conduct is beyond the range of rules and regulations.

units.sanskrit:
बुधो बालकवत् क्राडेत् कुशलो जडवच्चरेत्।
वदेदुन्मत्तवद् विद्वान् गोचर्यां नैगमश्चरेत्॥ ११/१८/२९॥
units.english: Although most wise, the paramahaṁsa should enjoy life like a child, oblivious to honor and dishonor; although most expert, he should behave like a stunted, incompetent person; although most learned, he should speak like an insane person; and although a scholar learned in Vedic regulations, he should behave in an unrestricted manner.

meta.english_verbatim: Although most wise, the paramahaṁsa should enjoy life like a child, oblivious to honor and dishonor; although most expert, he should behave like a stunted, incompetent person; although most learned, he should speak like an insane person; and although a scholar learned in Vedic regulations, he should behave in an unrestricted manner.

units.sanskrit:
वेदवादरतो न स्यान्न पाषण्डी न हैतुका।
शुष्कवादविवादेन कञ्चित्पक्षं न संश्रयेत्॥ ११/१८/३०॥
units.english: A devotee should never engage in the fruitive rituals mentioned in the karma-kāṇḍa section of the Vedas, nor should he become atheistic, acting or speaking in opposition to Vedic injunctions. Similarly, he should never speak like a mere logician or skeptic or take any side whatsoever in useless arguments.

parts.sanskrit:
वेदवादरतो न स्यान्न पाषण्डी न हैतुका।
शुष्कवादविवादेन कञ्चित्पक्षं न संश्रयेत्॥ ११/१८/३०॥

“वेदेन सह वादो यो वेदवाद इतीरितः।
तर्केण वेदस्यान्यार्थकल्पनं तं विदो विदुः।
तन्न कुर्यात् कदाचिच्च तत् कुर्वन् वेदहा भवेत्॥”
इति च।
“योगसाङ्ख्यकणादाक्षपादा वै हेतुवादिनः।
पश्वीशशाक्तबुद्धाद्याः पाषण्डा इति कीर्तिताः॥”
इति च॥ ३०॥

meta.english_verbatim: A devotee should never engage in the fruitive rituals mentioned in the karma-kāṇḍa section of the Vedas, nor should he become atheistic, acting or speaking in opposition to Vedic injunctions. Similarly, he should never speak like a mere logician or skeptic or take any side whatsoever in useless arguments.

units.sanskrit: देहमुद्दिश्य पशुवद् वैरं कुर्यान्न केनचित्॥ ११/१८/३२॥
units.english: A saintly person should never let others frighten or disturb him and, similarly, should never frighten or disturb other people. He should tolerate the insults of others and should never himself belittle anyone. He should never create hostility with anyone for the sake of the material body, for he would thus be no better than an animal.

meta.english_verbatim: A saintly person should never let others frighten or disturb him and, similarly, should never frighten or disturb other people. He should tolerate the insults of others and should never himself belittle anyone. He should never create hostility with anyone for the sake of the material body, for he would thus be no better than an animal.

units.sanskrit:
एक एव परो ह्यात्मा भूतेष्वात्मन्यवस्थितः।
खं यद्वदुदपात्रेषु भूतान्येकात्मकानि च॥ ११/१८/३३॥
units.english: The one Supreme Lord is situated within all material bodies and within everyone’s soul. Just as the moon is reflected in innumerable reservoirs of water, the Supreme Lord, although one, is present within everyone. Thus every material body is ultimately composed of the energy of the one Supreme Lord.

parts.sanskrit:
एक एव परो ह्यात्मा भूतेष्वात्मन्यवस्थितः।
खं यद्वदुदपात्रेषु भूतान्येकात्मकानि च॥ ११/१८/३३॥

“भूतानामेक एवात्ताऽथैको भूतेषु सन्ततः।
एको भूतानि चादत्ते तस्मादेकात्मकानि तु॥”
इति भद्रमाने।
“घटादिषु महाकाशो निर्विशेषश्च सन्ततः।
घटावयवरूपस्तु तथैवान्यो घटानुगः।
घटनाशेऽप्यनाशः सन् मध्यमाकाश इष्यते।
एकदेशाभिमानित्वादित्याकाशास्त्रयः स्मृताः।
महाकाशो विघ्नराजो विघ्नास्तत्र तु मध्यमाः।
क्षुद्रविघ्नास्तदितर एवमात्मा त्रिधा स्मृतः।
महाखवत् परस्त्वात्मा जीवा मध्यखवत् स्मृताः।
घटानुगखवत् प्रोक्ता असुरा नित्यदुःखिनः।
महाकाशवशाः सर्व आकाशा इतरे स्मृताः।
परमात्मवशे तद्वज्जीवाः सर्वेऽपि संस्थिताः।
एवं विष्ण्वात्मकमिदं जगत् पश्येद् यतिः सदा॥”
इति विनिर्णये॥ ३३॥

meta.english_verbatim: The one Supreme Lord is situated within all material bodies and within everyone’s soul. Just as the moon is reflected in innumerable reservoirs of water, the Supreme Lord, although one, is present within everyone. Thus every material body is ultimately composed of the energy of the one Supreme Lord.

units.sanskrit:
अलब्ध्वा न विषीदेत कालेकालेऽशनं क्वचित्।
लब्ध्वा न हृष्येद् धृतिमानुभयं दैवतन्त्रितम्॥ ११/१८/३४॥
units.english: If at times one does not obtain proper food one should not be depressed, and when one obtains sumptuous food one should not rejoice. Being fixed in determination, one should understand both situations to be under the control of God.

meta.english_verbatim: If at times one does not obtain proper food one should not be depressed, and when one obtains sumptuous food one should not rejoice. Being fixed in determination, one should understand both situations to be under the control of God.

units.sanskrit:
आहारार्थं समीहेत युक्तं तत्प्राणधारणम्।
तत्वं विमृश्यते तेन तद् विज्ञाय विमुच्यते॥ ११/१८/३५॥
units.english: If required, one should endeavor to get sufficient foodstuffs, because it is always necessary and proper to maintain one’s health. When the senses, mind and life air are fit, one can contemplate spiritual truth, and by understanding the truth one is liberated.

meta.english_verbatim: If required, one should endeavor to get sufficient foodstuffs, because it is always necessary and proper to maintain one’s health. When the senses, mind and life air are fit, one can contemplate spiritual truth, and by understanding the truth one is liberated.

units.sanskrit:
यदृच्छयोपपन्नान्नमद्याच्छ्रेष्ठमुतापरम्।
तथा वासस्तथा शय्यां प्राप्तं प्राप्तं भजेन्मुनिः॥ ११/१८/३६॥
units.english: A sage should accept the food, clothing and bedding — be they of excellent or inferior quality — that come of their own accord.

meta.english_verbatim: A sage should accept the food, clothing and bedding — be they of excellent or inferior quality — that come of their own accord.

units.sanskrit:
शौचमाचमनं स्नानं न तु चोदनया चरेत्।
अन्यांश्च नियमान् ज्ञानी यथाऽहं लीलयेश्वरः॥ ११/१८/३७॥
units.english: Just as I, the Supreme Lord, execute regulative duties by My own free will, similarly, one who has realized knowledge of Me should maintain general cleanliness, purify his hands with water, take bath and execute other regulative duties not by force but by his own free will.

parts.sanskrit:
शौचमाचमनं स्नानं न तु चोदनया चरेत्।
अन्यांश्च नियमान् ज्ञानी यथाऽहं लीलयेश्वरः॥ ११/१८/३७॥

“स्वभावतो धर्मपरो न विधेश्चकितश्चरेत्।
अल्पं फलं च चकिते स्वभावे फलमुत्तमम्॥”
इति च॥ ३७॥

meta.english_verbatim: Just as I, the Supreme Lord, execute regulative duties by My own free will, similarly, one who has realized knowledge of Me should maintain general cleanliness, purify his hands with water, take bath and execute other regulative duties not by force but by his own free will.

units.sanskrit:
नहि तस्य विकल्पाख्या क्रिया मद्वीक्षया हता।
आदेहान्तं क्वचित् ख्यातिस्ततः सम्पद्यते मया॥ ११/१८/३८॥
units.english: A realized soul no longer sees anything as separate from Me, for his realized knowledge of Me has destroyed such illusory perception. Since the material body and mind were previously accustomed to this kind of perception, it may sometimes appear to recur; but at the time of death the self-realized soul achieves opulences equal to Mine.

parts.sanskrit:
नहि तस्य विकल्पाख्या क्रिया मद्वीक्षया हता।
आदेहान्तं क्वचित् ख्यातिस्ततः सम्पद्यते मया॥ ११/१८/३८॥

विरुद्धत्वेन कल्पनं विकल्पः।
“निषिद्धं मनसा कल्प्य भीतो विहितमाचरेत्।
अज्ञो ज्ञस्य तु सङ्कल्पः स्वभावाद् विहितानुगः।
शरीरधर्मिणः क्वापि निषिद्धेऽपि मनो व्रजेत्।
तथाऽपि तस्य नानर्थो मोक्षे
नैवान्यथा
व्रजेत्॥”
इति धर्मतत्त्वे॥ ३८॥

meta.english_verbatim: A realized soul no longer sees anything as separate from Me, for his realized knowledge of Me has destroyed such illusory perception. Since the material body and mind were previously accustomed to this kind of perception, it may sometimes appear to recur; but at the time of death the self-realized soul achieves opulences equal to Mine.

units.sanskrit:
दुःखोदर्केषु कामेषु जातनिर्वेद आत्मवान्।
अजिज्ञासितमद्धर्मो गुरुं मुनिमुपाव्रजेत्॥ ११/१८/३९॥
units.english: One who is detached from sense enjoyment, knowing its result to be miserable, and who desires spiritual perfection, but who has not seriously analyzed the process for obtaining Me, should approach a bona fide and learned teacher.

meta.english_verbatim: One who is detached from sense gratification, knowing its result to be miserable, and who desires spiritual perfection, but who has not seriously analyzed the process for obtaining Me, should approach a bona fide and learned spiritual master.

units.sanskrit:
तावत् परिचरेद् भक्तः श्रद्धावाननसूयकः।
यावद् ब्रह्म विजानीयान्मामेव गुरुमादृतः॥ ११/१८/४०॥
यस्त्वसंयतषड्वर्गः प्रचण्डेन्द्रियसारथिः।
ज्ञानवैराग्यरहितस्त्रिदण्डमुपजीवति॥ ११/१८/४१॥
units.english: Until a devotee has clearly realized spiritual knowledge, he should continue with great faith and respect and without envy to render personal service to the guru, who is nondifferent from Me.

parts.sanskrit:
तावत् परिचरेद् भक्तः श्रद्धावाननसूयकः।
यावद् ब्रह्म विजानीयान्मामेव गुरुमादृतः॥ ११/१८/४०॥
यस्त्वसंयतषड्वर्गः प्रचण्डेन्द्रियसारथिः।
ज्ञानवैराग्यरहितस्त्रिदण्डमुपजीवति॥ ११/१८/४१॥

“शुश्रूषेत् सहितस्तावद् यावज्ज्ञानोदयो गुरुम्।
ततः परं च शुश्रूषेद् यथा तस्य प्रियं भवेत्॥”
इति च॥ ४०॥

meta.english_verbatim: Until a devotee has clearly realized spiritual knowledge, he should continue with great faith and respect and without envy to render personal service to the guru, who is nondifferent from Me.

units.sanskrit:
सुरानात्मानमात्मस्थं निह्नुते मां च धर्महा।
अविपक्वकषायोऽस्मादमुष्माच्च विहीयते॥ ११/१८/४२॥
units.english: One who has not controlled the six forms of illusion [lust, anger, greed, excitement, false pride and intoxication], whose intelligence, the leader of the senses, is extremely attached to material things, who is bereft of knowledge and detachment, who adopts the sannyāsa order of life to make a living, who denies the worshipable gods, his own self and the Supreme Lord within himself, thus ruining all religious principles, and who is still infected by material contamination, is deviated and lost both in this life and the next.

meta.english_verbatim: One who has not controlled the six forms of illusion [lust, anger, greed, excitement, false pride and intoxication], whose intelligence, the leader of the senses, is extremely attached to material things, who is bereft of knowledge and detachment, who adopts the sannyāsa order of life to make a living, who denies the worshipable demigods, his own self and the Supreme Lord within himself, thus ruining all religious principles, and who is still infected by material contamination, is deviated and lost both in this life and the next.

units.sanskrit:
भिक्षोर्धर्मः शमोऽहिंसा तप ईक्षा वनौकसाम्।
गृहिणो भूतरक्षेज्या द्विजस्याचार्यसेवनम्॥ ११/१८/४३॥
units.english: The main religious duties of a sannyāsī are equanimity and nonviolence, whereas for the vānaprastha austerity and philosophical understanding of the difference between the body and soul are prominent. The main duties of a householder are to give shelter to all living beings and perform sacrifices, and the brahmacārī is mainly engaged in serving the teacher.

meta.english_verbatim: The main religious duties of a sannyāsī are equanimity and nonviolence, whereas for the vānaprastha austerity and philosophical understanding of the difference between the body and soul are prominent. The main duties of a householder are to give shelter to all living entities and perform sacrifices, and the brahmacārī is mainly engaged in serving the spiritual master.

units.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मचर्यं तपः शौचं सन्तोषो भूतसौहृदम्।
गृहस्थस्याग्रतो गन्तुः सर्वेषां मदुपासनम्॥ ११/१८/४४॥
units.english: A householder may approach his wife for sex only at the time prescribed for begetting children. Otherwise, the householder should practice celibacy, austerity, cleanliness of mind and body, satisfaction in his natural position, and friendship toward all living beings. Worship of Me is to be practiced by all human beings, regardless of social or occupational divisions.

meta.english_verbatim: A householder may approach his wife for sex only at the time prescribed for begetting children. Otherwise, the householder should practice celibacy, austerity, cleanliness of mind and body, satisfaction in his natural position, and friendship toward all living entities. Worship of Me is to be practiced by all human beings, regardless of social or occupational divisions.

units.sanskrit:
इति मां यः स्वधर्मेण भजेन्नित्यमनन्यभाक्।
सर्वभूतेषु मद्भावो मद्भक्तिं विन्दते चिरात्॥ ११/१८/४५॥
units.english: One who worships Me by his prescribed duty, having no other object of worship, and who remains conscious of Me as present in all living beings, achieves unflinching devotion unto Me.

meta.english_verbatim: One who worships Me by his prescribed duty, having no other object of worship, and who remains conscious of Me as present in all living entities, achieves unflinching devotional service unto Me.

units.sanskrit:
भक्त्योद्धवानपायिन्या सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।
सर्वोत्पत्त्यप्ययं ब्रह्म कारणं मोपयाति सः॥ ११/१८/४६॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, I am the Supreme Lord of all worlds, and I create and destroy this universe, being its ultimate cause. I am thus the Absolute Truth, and one who worships Me with unfailing devotion comes to Me.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, I am the Supreme Lord of all worlds, and I create and destroy this universe, being its ultimate cause. I am thus the Absolute Truth, and one who worships Me with unfailing devotional service comes to Me.

units.sanskrit:
इति स्वधर्मनिर्णिक्तसत्वो निर्ज्ञातमद्गतिः।
ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नो विरक्तः समुपैति माम्॥ ११/१८/४७॥
units.english: Thus, one who has purified his existence by execution of his prescribed duties, who fully understands My supreme position and who is endowed with scriptural and realized knowledge, very soon achieves Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus, one who has purified his existence by execution of his prescribed duties, who fully understands My supreme position and who is endowed with scriptural and realized knowledge, very soon achieves Me.

units.sanskrit:
वर्णाश्रमवतां धर्म एष आचारलक्षणः।
स एव मद्भक्तियुतो निःश्रेयसकरः परः॥ ११/१८/४८॥
units.english: Those who are followers of this varṇāśrama system accept religious principles according to authorized traditions of proper conduct. When such varṇāśrama duties are dedicated to Me in loving service, they award the supreme perfection of life.

meta.english_verbatim: Those who are followers of this varṇāśrama system accept religious principles according to authorized traditions of proper conduct. When such varṇāśrama duties are dedicated to Me in loving service, they award the supreme perfection of life.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यो विद्याश्रुतसम्पन्न आत्मवानानुमानिकः।
मायामात्रमिदं ज्ञात्वा ज्ञानं च मयि सन्न्यसेत्॥ ११/१९/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: A self-realized person who has cultivated scriptural knowledge up to the point of enlightenment and who is free from impersonal speculation, understanding the material universe to be simply illusion, should surrender unto Me both that knowledge and the means by which he achieved it.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यो विद्याश्रुतसम्पन्न आत्मवानानुमानिकः।
मायामात्रमिदं ज्ञात्वा ज्ञानं च मयि सन्न्यसेत्॥ ११/१९/१॥

“त्रिगुणा प्रकृतिर्माया पश्येत् तन्मात्रकं जगत्।
निर्मिमीते जगत्सर्वमतो मायेति सा स्मृता॥”
इति प्रभवे।
“इदं ज्ञानं हरेः पूजा हरेरेवोदितं सदा।
हर्यधीनं च सर्वत्रेत्येवं न्यासो हरौ स्मृतः॥”
इति च॥ १॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: A self-realized person who has cultivated scriptural knowledge up to the point of enlightenment and who is free from impersonal speculation, understanding the material universe to be simply illusion, should surrender unto Me both that knowledge and the means by which he achieved it.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानिनस्त्वहमेवेष्टः स्वार्थो हेतुश्च सम्मतः।
स्वर्गश्चैवापवर्गश्च नान्योऽर्थो मदृते प्रियः॥ ११/१९/२॥
units.english: For learned, self-realized philosophers I am the only object of worship, the desired goal of life, the means for achieving that goal, and the settled conclusion of all knowledge. Indeed, because I am the cause of their happiness and their freedom from unhappiness, such learned souls have no effective purpose or dear object in life except Me.

meta.english_verbatim: For learned, self-realized philosophers I am the only object of worship, the desired goal of life, the means for achieving that goal, and the settled conclusion of all knowledge. Indeed, because I am the cause of their happiness and their freedom from unhappiness, such learned souls have no effective purpose or dear object in life except Me.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्बद्धाः पदं श्रेष्ठं विदुर्मम।
ज्ञानी प्रियतमोऽतो मे ज्ञानेनासौ बिभर्ति माम्॥ ११/१९/३॥
units.english: Those who have achieved complete perfection through philosophical and realized knowledge recognize My lotus feet to be the supreme transcendental object. Thus the learned transcendentalist is most dear to Me, and by his perfect knowledge he maintains Me in happiness.

meta.english_verbatim: Those who have achieved complete perfection through philosophical and realized knowledge recognize My lotus feet to be the supreme transcendental object. Thus the learned transcendentalist is most dear to Me, and by his perfect knowledge he maintains Me in happiness.

units.sanskrit:
तपस्तीर्थं जपो दानं पवित्राणीतराणि च।
नालं कुर्वन्ति तां शुद्धिं या ज्ञानकलया कृता॥ ११/१९/४॥
units.english: That perfection which is produced by a small fraction of spiritual knowledge cannot be duplicated by performing austerities, visiting holy places, chanting silent prayers, giving in charity or engaging in other pious activities.

meta.english_verbatim: That perfection which is produced by a small fraction of spiritual knowledge cannot be duplicated by performing austerities, visiting holy places, chanting silent prayers, giving in charity or engaging in other pious activities.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसहितं ज्ञात्वा स्वात्मानमुद्धव।
ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नो भज मां भक्तिभावितः॥ ११/१९/५॥
units.english: Therefore, My dear Uddhava, through knowledge you should understand your actual self. Then, advancing by clear realization of Vedic knowledge, you should worship Me in the mood of loving devotion.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, My dear Uddhava, through knowledge you should understand your actual self. Then, advancing by clear realization of Vedic knowledge, you should worship Me in the mood of loving devotion.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानयज्ञेन मामिष्ट्वाऽऽत्मानमात्मनि।
सर्वयज्ञपतिं मां वै संसिद्धिं मुनयोऽन्वगुः॥ ११/१९/६॥
units.english: Formerly, great sages, through the sacrifice of Vedic knowledge and spiritual enlightenment, worshiped Me within themselves, knowing Me to be the Supreme Lord of all sacrifice and the Supreme Self in everyone’s heart. Thus coming to Me, these sages achieved the supreme perfection.

meta.english_verbatim: Formerly, great sages, through the sacrifice of Vedic knowledge and spiritual enlightenment, worshiped Me within themselves, knowing Me to be the Supreme Lord of all sacrifice and the Supersoul in everyone’s heart. Thus coming to Me, these sages achieved the supreme perfection.

units.sanskrit:
त्वय्युद्धवाश्रयति यस्त्रिविधो विकारो मायाऽन्तराऽऽपतति नाद्यपवर्गयोर्यः।
जन्मादयोऽस्य वद मां तव तस्य किं स्युराद्यन्तयोर्यदसतोऽऽस्त तदेव मध्ये॥ ११/१९/७॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, the material body and mind, composed of the three modes of material nature, attach themselves to you, but they are actually illusion, since they appear only at the present, having no original or ultimate existence. How is it possible, therefore, that the various stages of the body, namely birth, growth, reproduction, maintenance, dwindling and death, can have any relation to your eternal self? These phases relate only to the material body, which previously did not exist and ultimately will not exist. The body exists merely at the present moment.

parts.sanskrit:
त्वय्युद्धवाश्रयति यस्त्रिविधो विकारो मायाऽन्तराऽऽपतति नाद्यपवर्गयोर्यः।
जन्मादयोऽस्य वद मां तव तस्य किं स्युराद्यन्तयोर्यदसतोऽऽस्त तदेव मध्ये॥ ११/१९/७॥

“अन्यस्थं निर्मितं जीवे जन्मादि हरिणा यतः।
तस्मान्मायेति तत् प्राहुर्माया निर्माणमुच्यते।
नहि जीवस्य जन्मादि स्वतो नित्यस्य सम्भवेत्।
सृष्टेः प्राक् प्रलये चैव यतो जन्मादि नास्य हि।
तस्मान्मध्येऽपि नास्यास्ति देहादिस्थं तु विष्णुना।
कर्मभिर्निर्मितं जीवे प्रलये यन्न जीवगम्।
यन्न विद्येत हि लये यन्न विद्येत मुक्तिगे।
जीवस्य न स्वभावोऽसौ प्रायेणेति विनिश्चितः॥”
इति प्रकाशिकायाम्।
“मायेत्युक्तं निर्मितं तु यतो जन्मादि निर्मितम्।
देहादिगं परेशेन माया जन्मादि तेन तु॥”
इति प्रकृते।
मां प्रति वद। तस्य देहादेर्जन्मादयोऽस्य चिदानन्दरूपस्य तव स्युः किम्। अस्वतन्त्रत्वादवस्तुनो जगत आद्यन्तयोर्यज्जीवस्यास्ति तदेव तस्य स्वाभाविकं संसारेऽपि। अन्यदभिमाननिमित्तं प्रलये विद्यमानस्य कथं जन्मादि स्यादिति भावः। तदा नाशाद् देहादेस्तु युज्यते। मुक्तिगमेव जीवस्य स्वाभाविकम्। किमु प्रलयेऽप्यविद्यमानं स्वतः स्यादित्यर्थः।
“आद्यन्तयोरनुगमादाद्यन्तरहितस्य तु।
आद्यन्ते भाविनो मध्ये कथमन्यादृशं वपुः॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के।
“अनित्यत्वात् तु देहस्य तस्य जन्मादिकं भवेत्।
मुक्तिप्रलयसम्बन्धे कथं जीवे तदिष्यते॥”
इति च।
“अनित्यस्य गुणा मध्ये भवेयुः स्वत एव तु।
नतु स्वतस्तु नित्यस्य कादाचित्कगुणैर्युतिः॥”
इति च॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, the material body and mind, composed of the three modes of material nature, attach themselves to you, but they are actually illusion, since they appear only at the present, having no original or ultimate existence. How is it possible, therefore, that the various stages of the body, namely birth, growth, reproduction, maintenance, dwindling and death, can have any relation to your eternal self? These phases relate only to the material body, which previously did not exist and ultimately will not exist. The body exists merely at the present moment.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
ज्ञानं विशुद्धं विपुलं यदेतद् वैराग्यविज्ञानयुतं पुराणम्।
आख्याहि विश्वेश्वर विश्वमूर्ते त्वद्भक्तियोगं च महद्विमृग्यम्॥ ११/१९/८॥
units.english: Uddhava said: O Lord of the universe! O form of the universe! Please explain to me that process of knowledge which automatically brings detachment and direct perception of the truth, which is transcendental, and which is traditional among great spiritual philosophers. This knowledge, sought by elevated personalities, describes loving devotion unto Your Lordship.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: O Lord of the universe! O form of the universe! Please explain to me that process of knowledge which automatically brings detachment and direct perception of the truth, which is transcendental, and which is traditional among great spiritual philosophers. This knowledge, sought by elevated personalities, describes loving devotional service unto Your Lordship.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
इत्थमेतत् पुरा राजा भीष्मं धर्मभृतां वरम्।
अजातशत्रुः पप्रच्छ सर्वेषामनुशृण्वताम्॥ ११/१९/९॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, just as you are now inquiring from Me, similarly, in the past King Yudhiṣṭhira, who considered no one his enemy, inquired from the greatest of the upholders of religious principles, Bhīṣma, while all of us were carefully listening.

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, just as you are now inquiring from Me, similarly, in the past King Yudhiṣṭhira, who considered no one his enemy, inquired from the greatest of the upholders of religious principles, Bhīṣma, while all of us were carefully listening.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit:
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे सुहृन्निधनविह्वलः।
श्रुत्वा धर्मान् बहून् भीष्मं मोक्षधर्मानपृच्छत॥ ११/१९/१०॥
units.english: When the great Battle of Kurukṣetra had ended, King Yudhiṣṭhira was overwhelmed by the death of many beloved well-wishers, and thus, after listening to instructions about many religious principles, he finally inquired about the path of liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: When the great Battle of Kurukṣetra had ended, King Yudhiṣṭhira was overwhelmed by the death of many beloved well-wishers, and thus, after listening to instructions about many religious principles, he finally inquired about the path of liberation.

units.sanskrit:
तानहं तेऽभिधास्यामि देवव्रतमुखाच्छ्रतान्।
ज्ञानविज्ञानवैराग्यश्रद्धाभक्त्युपबृंहितान्॥ ११/१९/११॥
units.english: I will now speak unto you those religious principles of Vedic knowledge, detachment, self-realization, faith and devotion that were heard directly from the mouth of Bhīṣmadeva.

meta.english_verbatim: I will now speak unto you those religious principles of Vedic knowledge, detachment, self-realization, faith and devotional service that were heard directly from the mouth of Bhīṣmadeva.

units.sanskrit:
नवैकादश पञ्च त्रीन् भावान् भूतेषु येन वै।
ईक्षेतान्वेकमप्येषु१ तज्ज्ञानं मम निश्चितम्॥ ११/१९/१२॥
units.english: I personally approve of that knowledge by which one sees the combination of nine, eleven, five and three elements in all living beings, and ultimately one element within those twenty-eight.

meta.english_verbatim: I personally approve of that knowledge by which one sees the combination of nine, eleven, five and three elements in all living entities, and ultimately one element within those twenty-eight.

units.sanskrit:
एतदेव हि विज्ञानं न तथैकेन येन यत्।
स्थित्युत्पत्त्यप्यया नः स्युर्भावानां त्रिगुणात्मनाम्॥ ११/१९/१३॥
units.english: When one no longer sees the twenty-eight separated material elements, which arise from a single cause, but rather sees the cause itself, the Lord — at that time one’s direct experience is called vijñāna, or self-realization.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: When one no longer sees the twenty-eight separated material elements, which arise from a single cause, but rather sees the cause itself, the Personality of Godhead — at that time one’s direct experience is called vijñāna, or self-realization.

units.sanskrit:
आदावन्ते च मध्ये च यज्ज्ञं सृज्यं यदन्वियात्।
पुनस्तत्प्रतिसङ्क्रामे यच्छिष्येत तदेव सत्॥ ११/१९/१४॥
units.english: Commencement, termination and maintenance are the stages of material causation. That which consistently accompanies all these material phases from one creation to another and remains alone when all material phases are annihilated is the one eternal.

parts.sanskrit:
आदावन्ते च मध्ये च यज्ज्ञं सृज्यं यदन्वियात्।
पुनस्तत्प्रतिसङ्क्रामे यच्छिष्येत तदेव सत्॥ ११/१९/१४॥

“एतदेव च विज्ञानं तथाऽपि न तथैव च।
ज्ञात्वा तत्त्वानि तेष्वीशं सर्वतत्त्वेश्वरं प्रभुम्।
जानन् ज्ञानी भवेत् स्वस्य योग्यं ज्ञानं विशेषतः।
पूर्वोक्त एव यो जानन् स विज्ञानी भवत्युत॥”
इति प्रभासे।
नः तत्त्वानां मध्ये येन यद् यत्र स्थित्वा च स्युः, तदेव सत्।
“सत्त्वं स्वातन्त्र्यमुद्दिष्टं तच्च कृष्णे नचापरे।
अस्वतन्त्र्यान्नचान्येषामसत्त्वं विद्धि भारत॥”
इति भारते॥ १४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Commencement, termination and maintenance are the stages of material causation. That which consistently accompanies all these material phases from one creation to another and remains alone when all material phases are annihilated is the one eternal.

units.sanskrit:
श्रुतिः प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यमनुमानं चतुष्टयम्।
प्रमाणेष्वनवस्थानाद् विकल्पात् स विरज्यते॥ ११/१९/१५॥
units.english: From the four types of evidence — Vedic knowledge, direct experience, traditional wisdom and logical induction — one can understand the temporary, insubstantial situation of the material world, by which one becomes detached from the duality of this world.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रुतिः प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यमनुमानं चतुष्टयम्।
प्रमाणेष्वनवस्थानाद् विकल्पात् स विरज्यते॥ ११/१९/१५॥
विकल्पात् विरुद्धकल्पनात्॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: From the four types of evidence — Vedic knowledge, direct experience, traditional wisdom and logical induction — one can understand the temporary, insubstantial situation of the material world, by which one becomes detached from the duality of this world.

units.sanskrit:
कर्मणां फलरूपत्वादाविरिञ्चादमङ्गळम्।
विपश्चिन्नश्वरं पश्येददृष्टमपि दृष्टवत्॥ ११/१९/१६॥
units.english: An intelligent person should see that any material activity is subject to constant transformation and that even on the planet of Lord Brahmā there is thus simply unhappiness. Indeed, a wise man can understand that just as all that he has seen is temporary, similarly, all things within the universe have a beginning and an end.

meta.english_verbatim: An intelligent person should see that any material activity is subject to constant transformation and that even on the planet of Lord Brahmā there is thus simply unhappiness. Indeed, a wise man can understand that just as all that he has seen is temporary, similarly, all things within the universe have a beginning and an end.

units.sanskrit:
भक्तियोगः पुरैवोक्तः प्रीयमाणाय तेऽनघ।
पुनश्च कथयिष्यामि मद्भक्तेः कारणं परम्॥ ११/१९/१७॥
units.english: O sinless Uddhava, because you love Me, I previously explained to you the process of devotion. Now I will again explain the supreme process for achieving loving service unto Me.

meta.english_verbatim: O sinless Uddhava, because you love Me, I previously explained to you the process of devotional service. Now I will again explain the supreme process for achieving loving service unto Me.

units.sanskrit:
श्रद्धाऽमृतकथायां मे शश्वन्मदनुकीर्तनम्।
परिनिष्ठा च पूजायां स्तुतिभिः स्तवनं मम॥ ११/१९/१८॥
units.english: Firm faith in the blissful narrations of My pastimes, constant chanting of My glories, unwavering attachment to ceremonial worship of Me, praising Me through beautiful hymns, great respect for My devotion, offering obeisances with the entire body, performing first-class worship of My devotees, consciousness of Me in all living beings, offering of ordinary, bodily activities in My devotion, use of words to describe My qualities, offering the mind to Me, rejection of all material desires, giving up wealth for My devotion, renouncing material sense enjoyment and happiness, and performing all desirable activities such as charity, sacrifice, chanting, vows and austerities with the purpose of achieving Me — these constitute actual religious principles, by which those human beings who have actually surrendered themselves to Me automatically develop love for Me. What other purpose or goal could remain for My devotee?
