meta.english_verbatim: Firm faith in the blissful narrations of My pastimes, constant chanting of My glories, unwavering attachment to ceremonial worship of Me, praising Me through beautiful hymns, great respect for My devotional service, offering obeisances with the entire body, performing first-class worship of My devotees, consciousness of Me in all living entities, offering of ordinary, bodily activities in My devotional service, use of words to describe My qualities, offering the mind to Me, rejection of all material desires, giving up wealth for My devotional service, renouncing material sense gratification and happiness, and performing all desirable activities such as charity, sacrifice, chanting, vows and austerities with the purpose of achieving Me — these constitute actual religious principles, by which those human beings who have actually surrendered themselves to Me automatically develop love for Me. What other purpose or goal could remain for My devotee?

units.sanskrit:
आदरः परिचर्यायां सर्वाङ्गैरभिवन्दनम्।
मद्भक्तपूजाऽभ्यधिका सर्वभूतेषु मन्मतिः॥ ११/१९/१९॥
units.english: When one’s peaceful consciousness, strengthened by the mode of goodness, is fixed on the Lord, one achieves religiosity, knowledge, detachment and opulence.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: When one’s peaceful consciousness, strengthened by the mode of goodness, is fixed on the Personality of Godhead, one achieves religiosity, knowledge, detachment and opulence.

units.sanskrit:
मदर्थेष्वङ्गचेष्टा च वचसा मद्गुणेरणम्।
मय्यर्पणं च मनसः सर्वकामविसर्जनम्॥ ११/१९/२०॥
मदर्थे च परित्यागो भोगस्य च सुखस्य च।
इष्टं दत्तं हुतं भुक्तं मदर्थं यद् व्रतं तपः॥ ११/१९/२१॥
एवं धर्मैर्मनुष्याणामुद्धवात्मनिवेदिनाम्।
मयि सञ्जायते भक्तिः कोऽन्योऽर्थोऽस्यावशिष्यते॥ ११/१९/२२॥
यदा मय्यर्पितं चित्तं शान्तं सत्वोपबृंहितम्।
धर्मं ज्ञानं सवैराग्यमैश्वर्यं चाभिपद्यते॥ ११/१९/२३॥
यद्यर्पितं तद् विकल्प इन्द्रियैः परिधावति।
रजस्वलमसन्निष्ठं चित्तं विद्धि विपर्ययम्॥ ११/१९/२४॥
units.english: When consciousness is fixed on the material body, home and other, similar objects of sense enjoyment, one spends one’s life chasing after material objects with the help of the senses. Consciousness, thus powerfully affected by the mode of passion, becomes dedicated to impermanent things, and in this way irreligion, ignorance, attachment and wretchedness arise.

Consciousness, thus powerfully affected by the mode of passion, becomes dedicated to impermanent things, and in this way irreligion, ignorance, attachment and wretchedness arise.

units.sanskrit:
धर्मो मद्भक्तिकृत् प्रोक्तो ज्ञानं चैकात्म्यदर्शनम्।
गुणेष्वसङ्गो वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं चाणिमादयः॥ ११/१९/२५॥
units.english: Actual religious principles are stated to be those that lead one to My devotion. Real knowledge is the awareness that reveals My all-pervading presence. Detachment is complete disinterest in the objects of material sense enjoyment, and opulence is the eight mystic perfections, such as aṇimā-siddhi.

parts.sanskrit:
धर्मो मद्भक्तिकृत् प्रोक्तो ज्ञानं चैकात्म्यदर्शनम्।
गुणेष्वसङ्गो वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं चाणिमादयः॥ ११/१९/२५॥

“एकः प्रधानमुद्दिष्टो विष्णोः प्राधान्यदर्शनम्।
ऐकात्म्यदर्शनं प्रोक्तं सर्वज्ञानोत्तमं च तत्॥”
इति त्रैकाल्ये॥ २५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Actual religious principles are stated to be those that lead one to My devotional service. Real knowledge is the awareness that reveals My all-pervading presence. Detachment is complete disinterest in the objects of material sense gratification, and opulence is the eight mystic perfections, such as aṇimā-siddhi.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
यमः कतिविधः प्रोक्तो नियमो वाऽरिकर्शन।
कः शमः को दमः कृष्ण का तितिक्षा धृतिः प्रभो॥ ११/१९/२६॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, O chastiser of the enemies, please tell me how many types of disciplinary regulations and regular daily duties there are. Also, my Lord, tell me what is mental equilibrium, what is self-control, and what is the actual meaning of tolerance and steadfastness. What are charity, austerity and heroism, and how are reality and truth to be described? What is renunciation, and what is wealth? What is desirable, what is sacrifice, and what is religious remuneration? My dear Keśava, O most fortunate one, how am I to understand the strength, opulence and profit of a particular person? What is the best education, what is actual humility, and what is real beauty? What are happiness and unhappiness? Who is learned, and who is a fool? What are the true and the false paths in life, and what are heaven and hell? Who is indeed a true friend, and what is one’s real home? Who is a rich man, and who is a poor man? Who is wretched, and who is an actual controller? O Lord of the devotees, kindly explain these matters to me, along with their opposites.

units.sanskrit:
शौचं जपस्तपो होमः श्रद्धाऽऽतिथ्यं मदर्चनम्।
तीर्थाटनं परार्थेहा तुष्टिराचार्यसेवनम्॥ ११/१९/३३॥
एते यमाः सनियमा उभयोर्द्वादश स्मृताः।
पुंसामुपासितास्तात यथाकामं दुहन्ति हि॥ ११/१९/३४॥
शमो मन्निष्ठता बुद्धेर्दम इन्द्रियसंयमः।
तितिक्षा दुःखसम्मर्षो जिह्वोपस्थजयो धृतिः॥ ११/१९/३५॥
units.english: The Lord said: Nonviolence, truthfulness, not coveting or stealing the property of others, detachment, humility, freedom from possessiveness, trust in the principles of religion, celibacy, silence, steadiness, forgiveness and fearlessness are the twelve primary disciplinary principles. Internal cleanliness, external cleanliness, chanting the holy names of the Lord, austerity, sacrifice, faith, hospitality, worship of Me, visiting holy places, acting and desiring only for the supreme interest, satisfaction, and service to the teacher are the twelve elements of regular prescribed duties. These twenty-four elements bestow all desired benedictions upon those persons who devotedly cultivate them.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Nonviolence, truthfulness, not coveting or stealing the property of others, detachment, humility, freedom from possessiveness, trust in the principles of religion, celibacy, silence, steadiness, forgiveness and fearlessness are the twelve primary disciplinary principles. Internal cleanliness, external cleanliness, chanting the holy names of the Lord, austerity, sacrifice, faith, hospitality, worship of Me, visiting holy places, acting and desiring only for the supreme interest, satisfaction, and service to the spiritual master are the twelve elements of regular prescribed duties. These twenty-four elements bestow all desired benedictions upon those persons who devotedly cultivate them.

units.sanskrit:
दण्डन्यासः परं दानं कामत्यागस्तपः स्मृतम्।
स्वभावविजयः शौर्यं सत्यं च समदर्शनम्॥ ११/१९/३६॥
ऋतं च सूनृता वाणी कविभिः परिकार्तिता।
कर्मस्वसङ्गमः शौचं त्यागः सन्न्यास उच्यते॥ ११/१९/३७॥
धर्म इष्टं धनं नॄणां यज्ञोऽहं भगवत्तमः।
दक्षिणा ज्ञानसन्देशः प्राणायामः परं बलम्॥ ११/१९/३८॥
भगो म ऐश्वरो भावो लाभो मद्भक्तिरुत्तमा।
विद्याऽऽत्मनि भिदाबोधो जुगुप्सा ह्वीर्विकर्मसु॥ ११/१९/३९॥
units.english: Absorbing the intelligence in Me constitutes mental equilibrium, and complete discipline of the senses is self-control. Tolerance means patiently enduring unhappiness, and steadfastness occurs when one conquers the tongue and genitals. The greatest charity is to give up all aggression toward others, and renunciation of lust is understood to be real austerity. Real heroism is to conquer one’s natural tendency to enjoy material life, and reality is seeing the Lord everywhere. Truthfulness means to speak the truth in a pleasing way, as declared by great sages. Cleanliness is detachment in actions aimed at results, whereas renunciation is the sannyāsa order of life. The true desirable wealth for human beings is religiousness, and I, the Lord, am sacrifice. Religious remuneration is devotion to the ācārya with the purpose of acquiring spiritual instruction, and the greatest strength is the prāṇāyāma system of breath control.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

Tolerance means patiently enduring unhappiness, and steadfastness occurs when one conquers the tongue and genitals. The greatest charity is to give up all aggression toward others, and renunciation of lust is understood to be real austerity. units.sanskrit:
श्रीर्गुणा नैरपेक्ष्याद्याः सुखं दुःखात्ययात् सुखम्।
दुःखं कामसुखापेक्षा पाण्डतो बन्धमोक्षवित्॥ ११/१९/४०॥
मूर्खो देहाद्यहम्बुद्धिः पन्था मन्निगमः स्मृतः।
उत्पथश्चित्तविक्षेपः स्वर्गः सत्वगुणोदयः॥ ११/१९/४१॥
नरकस्तमौन्नाहो बन्धुर्गुरुरहं सखे।
गृहं शरीरं मानुष्यं गुणाढ्यो ह्याढ्य उच्यते॥ ११/१९/४२॥
दरिद्रो यस्त्वसन्तुष्टः कृपणो योऽजितेन्द्रियः।
गुणेष्वसक्तः स्ववशो गुणसङ्गी विपर्ययः॥ ११/१९/४३॥
एत उध्दव ते प्रश्नाः सर्वे साधु निरूपिताः॥ ११/१९/४४॥
किं वर्णितेन बहुना लक्षणं गुणदोषयोः।
गुणदोषदृशिर्दोषो गुणस्तूभयवर्जनम्॥ ११/१९/४५॥
units.english: Actual opulence is My own nature as the Lord, through which I exhibit the six unlimited opulences. The supreme gain in life is devotion to Me, and actual education is nullifying the false perception of duality within the soul. Real modesty is to be disgusted with improper activities, and beauty is to possess good qualities such as detachment. Real happiness is to transcend material happiness and unhappiness, and real misery is to be implicated in searching for sex pleasure. A wise man is one who knows the process of freedom from bondage, and a fool is one who identifies with his material body and mind. The real path in life is that which leads to Me, and the wrong path is sense enjoyment, by which consciousness is bewildered. Actual heaven is the predominance of the mode of goodness, whereas hell is the predominance of ignorance. I am everyone’s true friend, acting as the teacher of the entire universe, and one’s home is the human body. My dear friend Uddhava, one who is enriched with good qualities is actually said to be rich, and one who is unsatisfied in life is actually poor. A wretched person is one who cannot control his senses, whereas one who is not attached to sense enjoyment is a real controller. One who attaches himself to sense enjoyment is the opposite, a slave. Thus, Uddhava, I have elucidated all of the matters about which you inquired. There is no need for a more elaborate description of these good and bad qualities, since to constantly see good and bad is itself a bad quality. The best quality is to transcend material good and evil.

“पुरुषार्थमतिर्यस्य विषयेष्वेव देहिनः।
विपरीतः स विज्ञेयः स्वात्मनो विपरीततः॥”
इति निवृत्ते।
वित्तासन्तोषमात्राद् दरिद्रः। सर्वविषयसङ्गी विपरीतः॥ ४५॥

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
विधिश्च प्रतिषेधश्च निगमो हीश्वरस्य ते।
अपेक्षतेऽरविन्दाक्ष गुणदोषं च कर्मणाम्॥ ११/२०/१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, You are the Supreme Lord, and thus the Vedic literatures, consisting of positive and negative injunctions, constitute Your order. Such literatures focus upon the good and bad qualities of work.

units.sanskrit:
वर्णाश्रमविकल्पं च प्रतिलोमानुलोमजम्।
द्रव्यदेशवयःकालान् स्वर्गं नरकमेव च॥ ११/२०/२॥
units.english: According to Vedic literature, the superior and inferior varieties found in the human social system, varṇāśrama, are due to pious and sinful modes of family planning. Thus piety and sin are constant points of reference in the Vedic analysis of the components of a given situation — namely the material ingredients, place, age and time. Indeed, the Vedas reveal the existence of material heaven and hell, which are certainly based on piety and sin.

units.sanskrit:
गुणदोषभिदादृष्टिमन्तरेण वचस्तव।
निःश्रेयसं कथं नु स्यान्निषेधविधिलक्षणम्॥ ११/२०/३॥
units.english: Without seeing the difference between piety and sin, how can one understand Your own instructions in the form of Vedic literatures, which order one to act piously and forbid one to act sinfully? Furthermore, without such authorized Vedic literatures, which ultimately award liberation, how can human beings achieve the perfection of life?

meta.english_verbatim: Without seeing the difference between piety and sin, how can one understand Your own instructions in the form of Vedic literatures, which order one to act piously and forbid one to act sinfully? Furthermore, without such authorized Vedic literatures, which ultimately award liberation, how can human beings achieve the perfection of life?

units.sanskrit:
पितृदेवमनुष्याणां वेदश्चक्षुस्तवेश्वर।
श्रेयस्त्वनुपलब्धेऽर्थे साध्यसाधनयोरपि॥ ११/२०/४॥
units.english: My dear Lord, to understand those things beyond direct experience — such as spiritual liberation or the attainment of heaven and similar material enjoyments — and in general to understand the means and end of all things, it is imperative that the forefathers, gods and human beings consult the Vedic literatures, for these literatures, being Your own laws, constitute the highest evidence and revelation.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord, to understand those things beyond direct experience — such as spiritual liberation or the attainment of heaven and similar material enjoyments — and in general to understand the means and end of all things, it is imperative that the forefathers, demigods and human beings consult the Vedic literatures, for these literatures, being Your own laws, constitute the highest evidence and revelation.

units.sanskrit:
गुणदोषभिदादृष्टिर्नियमात् तेन हि स्वतः।
नियमेनापवादश्च भिदाया इति हि भ्रमः॥ ११/२०/५॥
units.english: My dear Lord, the distinction observed between piety and sin comes from Your own Vedic knowledge and does not arise by itself. If the same Vedic literature subsequently nullifies such distinction between piety and sin, there will certainly be confusion.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Lord, the distinction observed between piety and sin comes from Your own Vedic knowledge and does not arise by itself. If the same Vedic literature subsequently nullifies such distinction between piety and sin, there will certainly be confusion.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
योगास्त्रयो मया प्रोक्ता नृणां श्रेयोविधित्सया।
ज्ञानं कर्म च भक्तिश्च नोपायोऽन्योऽस्ति कुत्रचित्॥ ११/२०/६॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, because I desire that human beings may achieve perfection, I have presented three paths of advancement — the path of knowledge, the path of work and the path of devotion. Besides these three there is absolutely no other means of elevation.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
योगास्त्रयो मया प्रोक्ता नृणां श्रेयोविधित्सया।
ज्ञानं कर्म च भक्तिश्च नोपायोऽन्योऽस्ति कुत्रचित्॥ ११/२०/६॥

“स्वतः सर्वगुणात्मा तु विष्णुरेकः सनातनः।
अन्यत् सर्वं तत्प्रियत्वाद् गुणो दोषस्तथाऽप्रियम्।
एवं ज्ञानवतां
दृष्टिरज्ञस्तन्नावगच्छति।
कालदेशविशेषेषु
प्रीतिभेदमवेक्ष्य
तु।
अविज्ञानवतस्तस्य मर्यादा वेदतः कृता।
गुणदोषभिदा नास्ति भगवत्प्रियमन्तरा।
गुणदोषदृशेर्दोषो ह्यन्यत्र भगवत्प्रियात्।
गुणा यद्दोषतामीयुर्दोषाश्च गुणतां क्वचित्।
अतो दोषो न दोषः स्यान्न गुणोऽपि गुणो भवेत्।
भगवत्प्रीतिविज्ञानाद् गुणदोषभिदां यदि।
पश्येत् तत् तु गुणायैव विपर्यासं न कारयेत्।
गुणदोषभिदा क्वापि स्वातन्त्र्येण नहि क्वचित्॥”
इति ब्रह्मनये।
“स्वतस्तु गुणदोषत्वदृशेर्भेदेन वस्तुनाम्।
दोषोऽथ गुण एव स्याद् भगवत्प्रीतितो गुणः।
दोषस्तु तद्वैपरीत्यादिति दृष्ट्या भवेद् गुणः।
कालदेशविशेषेण प्रीत्यज्ञानाज्जगत्स्थितेः।
मर्यादा गुणदोषाणां कृता वेदेषु सर्वदा॥”
इति परायणे।
एतदेवोच्यते।
“स्वेस्वेऽधिकारे या निष्ठा स गुणः परिकीर्तितः।
विपर्ययस्तु दोषः स्यादुभयोरेष निर्णयः॥”
इति च॥ ६॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, because I desire that human beings may achieve perfection, I have presented three paths of advancement — the path of knowledge, the path of work and the path of devotion. Besides these three there is absolutely no other means of elevation.

units.sanskrit:
यदृच्छया मत्कथादौ जातश्रद्धस्तु यः पुमान्।
न निर्विण्णो नातिसक्तो भक्तियोगोऽस्य सिद्धिदः॥ ११/२०/७॥
units.english: Among these three paths, jñāna-yoga, the path of philosophical speculation, is recommended for those who are disgusted with material life and are thus detached from ordinary, actions aimed at results. Those who are not disgusted with material life, having many desires yet to fulfill, should seek perfection through the path of karma-yoga.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Among these three paths, jñāna-yoga, the path of philosophical speculation, is recommended for those who are disgusted with material life and are thus detached from ordinary, fruitive activities. Those who are not disgusted with material life, having many desires yet to fulfill, should seek perfection through the path of karma-yoga.

units.sanskrit:
तावत् कर्माणि कुर्वीत न निर्विद्येत यावता।
मत्कथाश्रवणादौ वा श्रद्धा यावन्न जायते॥ ११/२०/८॥
units.english: As long as one is not satiated by fruitive activity and has not awakened his taste for devotion by śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ, one has to act according to the regulative principles of the Vedic injunctions.

parts.sanskrit:
तावत् कर्माणि कुर्वीत न निर्विद्येत यावता।
मत्कथाश्रवणादौ वा श्रद्धा यावन्न जायते॥ ११/२०/८॥

“सनकाद्या ज्ञानयोगा भक्तियोगास्तु देवताः।
मानुषाः कर्मयोगास्तु त्रिधैते योगिनः स्मृताः।
सर्वेषां सर्वयोगैश्च प्राप्या मुक्तिर्न संशयः।
तथाऽपि तु विशेषेण सस तेषां विधीयते।
भगवद्गुणानुसारेण वेदार्थो नीयते हि यैः।
भक्तियोगास्तु ते प्रोक्तास्तादृशा हि सुराः सदा।
अङ्गानुसारिवेदार्थं ज्ञात्वा तदनुसारतः।
भगवद्गुणा यैर्नीयन्ते ते प्रोक्ता ज्ञानयोगिनः।
कर्माणि शास्त्रतो ज्ञात्वा तत्प्राधान्यानुसारतः।
विज्ञाता यैर्गुणा विष्णोर्ज्ञेयास्ते कर्मयोगिनः।
भक्तिर्ज्ञानं च किञ्चित् तु पश्चात् तेष्वपि जायते।
तथाऽपि ते कर्मयोगाः कर्मपूर्वत्वकारणात्।
भगवद्गुणानुरागित्वमधिकं भक्तियोगिनाम्।
तस्मात् तेऽभ्यधिका ह्येषु देवा एव विशेषतः।
ईषद् वैराग्यमल्पं तु पूर्वं देवेषु जायते।
पश्चाद् विरागोऽभ्यधिको देवानां नात्र संशयः।
ज्ञानाधिक्यं तु देवानां भक्त्याधिक्यं तथैव च।
विरागोऽभ्यधिकस्तेषां सदैव सनकादिनाम्।
ज्ञानाधिक्यान्मनुष्येभ्यो भण्यन्ते ज्ञानयोगिनः।
नतु ज्ञानाधिकास्ते वै देवेभ्यस्तु कथञ्चन।
देवानामपि कर्मित्वं विद्यते यद्यपि स्फुटम्।
तथाऽपि प्रत्यवायित्वान्मनुष्याः कर्मयोगिनः।
त्रियोगाभ्यधिको ब्रह्मा सवेभ्यः परमो विभुः।
महायोगेश्वरेशेशस्तस्माद् ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः॥”
इति त्रियोगे॥ ७-८॥

meta.english_verbatim: As long as one is not satiated by fruitive activity and has not awakened his taste for devotional service by śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ, one has to act according to the regulative principles of the Vedic injunctions.

units.sanskrit:
स्वधर्मस्थो यजन् यज्ञैरनाशीर्मां स उद्धव।
न याति स्वर्गनरकौ यद्यन्यन्न समाचरेत्॥ ११/२०/९॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, a person who is situated in his prescribed duty, properly worshiping by Vedic sacrifices but not desiring the fruitive result of such worship, will not go to the heavenly planets; similarly, by not performing forbidden activities he will not go to hell.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, a person who is situated in his prescribed duty, properly worshiping by Vedic sacrifices but not desiring the fruitive result of such worship, will not go to the heavenly planets; similarly, by not performing forbidden activities he will not go to hell.

units.sanskrit:
आस्मल्लोके वर्तमानः स्वधर्मस्थोऽनघः शुचिः।
ज्ञानं विशुद्धमाप्नोति मद्भक्तिं वा यदृच्छया॥ ११/२०/१०॥
units.english: One who is situated in his prescribed duty, free from sinful activities and cleansed of material contamination, in this very life obtains transcendental knowledge or, by fortune, devotion unto Me.

meta.english_verbatim: One who is situated in his prescribed duty, free from sinful activities and cleansed of material contamination, in this very life obtains transcendental knowledge or, by fortune, devotional service unto Me.

units.sanskrit:
स्वर्गिणोऽप्येतमिच्छन्ति लोकं निरयिणस्तथा।
साधकं ज्ञानभक्तिभ्यामुभयं तदसाधकम्॥ ११/२०/११॥
units.english: The residents of both heaven and hell desire human birth on the earth planet because human life facilitates the achievement of transcendental knowledge and love of Godhead, whereas neither heavenly nor hellish bodies efficiently provide such opportunities.

meta.english_verbatim: The residents of both heaven and hell desire human birth on the earth planet because human life facilitates the achievement of transcendental knowledge and love of Godhead, whereas neither heavenly nor hellish bodies efficiently provide such opportunities.

units.sanskrit:
न नरः स्वर्गतिं काङ्क्षेन्नारकां च विचक्षणः।
नेमं लोकं च काङ्क्षेत देहावेशात् प्रमाद्यति॥ ११/२०/१२॥
units.english: A human being who is wise should never desire promotion to heavenly planets or residence in hell. Indeed, a human being should also never desire permanent residence on the earth, for by such absorption in the material body one becomes foolishly negligent of one’s actual self-interest.

meta.english_verbatim: A human being who is wise should never desire promotion to heavenly planets or residence in hell. Indeed, a human being should also never desire permanent residence on the earth, for by such absorption in the material body one becomes foolishly negligent of one’s actual self-interest.

units.sanskrit:
एवं विद्वान् पुरा मृत्योरभावाय घटेत सः।
अप्रमत्त इदं ज्ञात्वा मर्त्यमप्यर्थसिद्धिदम्॥ ११/२०/१३॥
units.english: A wise person, knowing that although the material body is subject to death it can still award the perfection of one’s life, should not foolishly neglect to take advantage of this opportunity before death arrives.

meta.english_verbatim: A wise person, knowing that although the material body is subject to death it can still award the perfection of one’s life, should not foolishly neglect to take advantage of this opportunity before death arrives.

units.sanskrit:
छिद्यमानं कालावयवैः कृतनीळं वनस्पतिम्।
खगः स्वदेहमुत्सृज्य क्षेमं याति ह्यलम्पटः॥ ११/२०/१४॥
units.english: Without attachment, a bird gives up the tree in which his nest was constructed when that tree is cut down by cruel men who are like death personified, and thus the bird achieves happiness in another place.

meta.english_verbatim: Without attachment, a bird gives up the tree in which his nest was constructed when that tree is cut down by cruel men who are like death personified, and thus the bird achieves happiness in another place.

units.sanskrit:
नृदेहमासाद्य सुदुर्लभं यः प्लवं सुकल्यं गुरुकर्णधारम्।
मयाऽनुकूलेन नभस्वतेरितं पुमान् भवाब्धिं न तरेत् स मार्गणः॥ ११/२०/१७॥
units.english: The human body, which can award all benefit in life, is automatically obtained by the laws of nature, although it is a very rare achievement. This human body can be compared to a perfectly constructed boat having the teacher as the captain and the instructions of the Lord as favorable winds impelling it on its course. Considering all these advantages, a human being who does not utilize his human life to cross the ocean of material existence must be considered the killer of his own soul.

parts.sanskrit:
नृदेहमासाद्य सुदुर्लभं यः प्लवं सुकल्यं गुरुकर्णधारम्।
मयाऽनुकूलेन नभस्वतेरितं पुमान् भवाब्धिं न तरेत् स मार्गणः॥ ११/२०/१७॥
मार्गणवच्छरीरान्ते पतति॥ १७॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The human body, which can award all benefit in life, is automatically obtained by the laws of nature, although it is a very rare achievement. This human body can be compared to a perfectly constructed boat having the spiritual master as the captain and the instructions of the Personality of Godhead as favorable winds impelling it on its course. Considering all these advantages, a human being who does not utilize his human life to cross the ocean of material existence must be considered the killer of his own soul.

units.sanskrit:
यदाऽऽरम्भेषु निर्विण्णो विरक्तः संयतेन्द्रियः।
अभ्यासेनात्मनो योगी धारयेदचलं मनः॥ ११/२०/१८॥
units.english: A transcendentalist, having become disgusted and hopeless in all endeavors for material happiness, completely controls the senses and develops detachment. By spiritual practice he should then fix the mind on the spiritual platform without deviation.

meta.english_verbatim: A transcendentalist, having become disgusted and hopeless in all endeavors for material happiness, completely controls the senses and develops detachment. By spiritual practice he should then fix the mind on the spiritual platform without deviation.

units.sanskrit:
धार्यमाणं मनो यर्हि भ्राम्यदाश्वनवस्थितम्।
अतन्द्रितोऽनुरोधेन मार्गेणात्मवशं नयेत्॥ ११/२०/१९॥
units.english: Whenever the mind, being concentrated on the spiritual platform, is suddenly deviated from its spiritual position, one should carefully bring it under the control of the self by following the prescribed means.

meta.english_verbatim: Whenever the mind, being concentrated on the spiritual platform, is suddenly deviated from its spiritual position, one should carefully bring it under the control of the self by following the prescribed means.

units.sanskrit:
मनोऽगतिं न विसृजेज्जितप्राणो जितेन्द्रियः।
सत्वसम्पन्नया बुद्ध्या मन आत्मवशं नयेत्॥ ११/२०/२०॥
units.english: One should never lose sight of the actual goal of mental activities, but rather, conquering the life air and senses and utilizing intelligence strengthened by the mode of goodness, one should bring the mind under the control of the self.

meta.english_verbatim: One should never lose sight of the actual goal of mental activities, but rather, conquering the life air and senses and utilizing intelligence strengthened by the mode of goodness, one should bring the mind under the control of the self.

units.sanskrit:
एष वै परमो योगो मनसः सङ्ग्रहः स्मृतः।
हृदयज्ञत्वमन्विच्छन् दमश्चैवेच्छतो मुहुः॥ ११/२०/२१॥
units.english: An expert horseman, desiring to tame a headstrong horse, first lets the horse have his way for a moment and then, pulling the reins, gradually places the horse on the desired path. Similarly, the supreme yoga process is that by which one carefully observes the movements and desires of the mind and gradually brings them under full control.

meta.english_verbatim: An expert horseman, desiring to tame a headstrong horse, first lets the horse have his way for a moment and then, pulling the reins, gradually places the horse on the desired path. Similarly, the supreme yoga process is that by which one carefully observes the movements and desires of the mind and gradually brings them under full control.

units.sanskrit:
साङ्ख्येन सर्वभावानां प्रतिलोमानुलोमतः।
भवाप्ययावनुध्यायेन्मनो यावत् प्रसीदति॥ ११/२०/२२॥
units.english: Until one’s mind is fixed in spiritual satisfaction, one should analytically study the temporary nature of all material objects, whether cosmic, earthly or atomic. One should constantly observe the process of creation through the natural progressive function and the process of annihilation through the regressive function.

meta.english_verbatim: Until one’s mind is fixed in spiritual satisfaction, one should analytically study the temporary nature of all material objects, whether cosmic, earthly or atomic. One should constantly observe the process of creation through the natural progressive function and the process of annihilation through the regressive function.

units.sanskrit:
निर्विण्णस्य विरक्तस्य पुरुषस्यात्मवेदिनः।
मनस्त्यजति दौरात्म्यं चिन्तितस्यानुचिन्तया॥ ११/२०/२३॥
units.english: When a person is disgusted with the temporary, illusory nature of this world and is thus detached from it, his mind, guided by the instructions of his teacher, considers again and again the nature of this world and eventually gives up the false identification with matter.

meta.english_verbatim: When a person is disgusted with the temporary, illusory nature of this world and is thus detached from it, his mind, guided by the instructions of his spiritual master, considers again and again the nature of this world and eventually gives up the false identification with matter.

units.sanskrit:
यमादिभिर्योगपथैरान्वीक्षिक्या च विद्यया।
ममार्चोपासनाभिर्वा नान्यैर्योगं स्मरेन्मनः॥ ११/२०/२४॥
units.english: Through the various disciplinary regulations and the purificatory procedures of the yoga system, through logic and spiritual education or through worship and adoration of Me, one should constantly engage his mind in remembering the Lord, the goal of yoga. No other means should be employed for this purpose.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: Through the various disciplinary regulations and the purificatory procedures of the yoga system, through logic and spiritual education or through worship and adoration of Me, one should constantly engage his mind in remembering the Personality of Godhead, the goal of yoga. No other means should be employed for this purpose.

units.sanskrit:
यदि कुर्यात् प्रमादेन योगी कर्म विगर्हितम्।
योगेनैव दहेदंहो नान्यं यत्नां कदाचन॥ ११/२०/२५॥
units.english: If, because of momentary inattention, a yogī accidentally commits an abominable activity, then by the very practice of yoga he should burn to ashes the sinful reaction, without at any time employing any other procedure.

meta.english_verbatim: If, because of momentary inattention, a yogī accidentally commits an abominable activity, then by the very practice of yoga he should burn to ashes the sinful reaction, without at any time employing any other procedure.

units.sanskrit:
स्वेस्वेऽधिकारे या निष्ठा स गुणः परिकार्तितः।
विपर्ययस्तु दोषः स्यादुभयोरेष निर्णयः॥ ११/२०/२६॥
units.english: It is firmly declared that the steady adherence of transcendentalists to their respective spiritual positions constitutes real piety and that sin occurs when a transcendentalist neglects his prescribed duty. One who adopts this standard of piety and sin, sincerely desiring to give up all past association with sense enjoyment, is able to subdue materialistic activities, which are by nature impure.

meta.english_verbatim: It is firmly declared that the steady adherence of transcendentalists to their respective spiritual positions constitutes real piety and that sin occurs when a transcendentalist neglects his prescribed duty. One who adopts this standard of piety and sin, sincerely desiring to give up all past association with sense gratification, is able to subdue materialistic activities, which are by nature impure.

units.sanskrit:
ततो भजेत मां प्रीतः श्रद्धाळुर्दृढनिश्चयः।
जुषमाणश्च तान् कामान् दुःखोदर्कांश्च गर्हयन्॥ ११/२०/२९॥
units.english: Having awakened faith in the narrations of My glories, being disgusted with all material activities, knowing that all sense enjoyment leads to misery, but still being unable to renounce all sense enjoyment, My devotee should remain happy and worship Me with great faith and conviction. Even though he is sometimes engaged in sense enjoyment, My devotee knows that all sense enjoyment leads to a miserable result, and he sincerely repents such activities.

meta.english_verbatim: Having awakened faith in the narrations of My glories, being disgusted with all material activities, knowing that all sense gratification leads to misery, but still being unable to renounce all sense enjoyment, My devotee should remain happy and worship Me with great faith and conviction. Even though he is sometimes engaged in sense enjoyment, My devotee knows that all sense gratification leads to a miserable result, and he sincerely repents such activities.

units.sanskrit:
प्रोक्तेन भक्तियोगेन भजतो माऽसकृन्मुनेः।
कामा हृदिस्था नश्यन्ति सर्वे मयि हृदि स्थिते॥ ११/२०/३०॥
units.english: When an intelligent person engages constantly in worshiping Me through loving devotion as described by Me, his heart becomes firmly situated in Me. Thus all material desires within the heart are destroyed.

meta.english_verbatim: When an intelligent person engages constantly in worshiping Me through loving devotional service as described by Me, his heart becomes firmly situated in Me. Thus all material desires within the heart are destroyed.

units.sanskrit:
भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिश्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः।
क्षीयन्ते चास्य कर्माणि मयि दृष्टेऽखिलात्मनि॥ ११/२०/३१॥
units.english: The knot in the heart is pierced, all misgivings are cut to pieces and the chain of actions aimed at results is terminated when I am seen as the Lord.

parts.sanskrit:
भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिश्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः।
क्षीयन्ते चास्य कर्माणि मयि दृष्टेऽखिलात्मनि॥ ११/२०/३१॥
हृदयग्रन्थिः अन्तःकरणाख्यो बन्धः॥ ३१॥

meta.english_verbatim: The knot in the heart is pierced, all misgivings are cut to pieces and the chain of fruitive actions is terminated when I am seen as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

units.sanskrit:
तस्मान्मद्भक्तियुक्तस्य योगिनो वै मदात्मनः।
न ज्ञानान्न च वैराग्यात् प्रायः श्रेयो भवेदिह॥ ११/२०/३२॥
यत् कर्मभिर्यत् तपसा ज्ञानवैराग्यतश्च यत्।
योगेन दानधर्मेण श्रेयोभिरितरैरपि॥ ११/२०/३३॥
units.english: Therefore, for a devotee engaged in My loving service, with mind fixed on Me, the cultivation of knowledge and renunciation is generally not the means of achieving the highest perfection within this world.

parts.sanskrit:
तस्मान्मद्भक्तियुक्तस्य योगिनो वै मदात्मनः।
न ज्ञानान्न च वैराग्यात् प्रायः श्रेयो भवेदिह॥ ११/२०/३२॥
यत् कर्मभिर्यत् तपसा ज्ञानवैराग्यतश्च यत्।
योगेन दानधर्मेण श्रेयोभिरितरैरपि॥ ११/२०/३३॥

मद्भक्तियुक्तस्य भक्त्यनुसारिज्ञानवैराग्ये विनाऽन्यस्माज्ज्ञानाद् वैराग्याच्च न श्रेयो भवेत्।
“रागिणोऽपि विमुच्यन्ते देवा नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
रागापनोदनार्थं च ज्ञानं साध्यं यतीश्वरैः॥”
इति च।
“स्मर्तव्या विषये दोषा यतिभिर्नतु दैवतैः।
हरिरेव सदा पूज्य इत्यर्थं दैवतैरपि॥”
इति च।
वैराग्यार्थमपि विषयदोषादिज्ञानं सनकादीनां भाव्यम्, देवानां तदपि भगवद्भजनस्यैव सारतापरिज्ञानार्थमेवेत्यर्थः॥ ३२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, for a devotee engaged in My loving service, with mind fixed on Me, the cultivation of knowledge and renunciation is generally not the means of achieving the highest perfection within this world.

units.sanskrit: सर्वं मद्भक्तियोगेन मद्भक्तो लभतेऽञ्जसा। स्वर्गापवर्गं मद्धाम कथञ्चिद् यदि वाञ्छति॥ ११/२०/३४॥
units.english: Everything that can be achieved by actions aimed at results, penance, knowledge, detachment, mystic yoga, charity, religious duties and all other means of perfecting life is easily achieved by My devotee through loving service unto Me. If somehow or other My devotee desires promotion to heaven, liberation, or residence in My abode, he easily achieves such benedictions.

meta.english_verbatim: Everything that can be achieved by fruitive activities, penance, knowledge, detachment, mystic yoga, charity, religious duties and all other means of perfecting life is easily achieved by My devotee through loving service unto Me. If somehow or other My devotee desires promotion to heaven, liberation, or residence in My abode, he easily achieves such benedictions.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

units.sanskrit: न किञ्चित् साधवो धीरा भक्त्या ह्येकान्तिनो मम। वाञ्छन्त्यपि मया दत्तं कैवल्यमपुनर्भवम्॥ ११/२०/३५॥
units.english: Because My devotees possess saintly behavior and deep intelligence, they completely dedicate themselves to Me and do not desire anything besides Me. Indeed, even if I offer them liberation from birth and death, they do not accept it.

parts.sanskrit: न किञ्चित् साधवो धीरा भक्त्या ह्येकान्तिनो मम। वाञ्छन्त्यपि मया दत्तं कैवल्यमपुनर्भवम्॥ ११/२०/३५॥
रागिणोऽपि ते भक्तियोगिनो भक्तिफलत्वेन किमपि नापेक्षन्ते॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Because My devotees possess saintly behavior and deep intelligence, they completely dedicate themselves to Me and do not desire anything besides Me. Indeed, even if I offer them liberation from birth and death, they do not accept it.

units.sanskrit:
नैरपेक्ष्यं परं प्राहुर्निःश्रेयसमकल्मषम्।
तस्मान्निराशिषो भक्तिर्निरपेक्षस्य मे भवेत्॥ ११/२०/३६॥
units.english: It is said that complete detachment is the highest stage of freedom. Therefore, one who has no personal desire and does not pursue personal rewards can achieve loving devotion unto Me.

parts.sanskrit:
नैरपेक्ष्यं परं प्राहुर्निःश्रेयसमकल्मषम्।
तस्मान्निराशिषो भक्तिर्निरपेक्षस्य मे भवेत्॥ ११/२०/३६॥

“यदि दद्याद् भक्तियोगफलं मोक्षमपीश्वरः।
भक्तियोगफलत्वेन न तद् गृह्णीयुरेव ते।
कामिनोऽपि स्वयं कामान् भुञ्जते न फलात्मना।
तस्माद् विरागेऽप्यधिका देवा एव हि तादृशाः॥”
इति च॥ ३६॥

meta.english_verbatim: It is said that complete detachment is the highest stage of freedom. Therefore, one who has no personal desire and does not pursue personal rewards can achieve loving devotional service unto Me.

units.sanskrit:
न मय्येकान्तभक्तानां गुणदोषोद्भवा गुणाः।
साधूनां समचित्तानां बुद्धेः पारमुपेयुषाम्॥ ११/२०/३७॥
units.english: Material piety and sin, which arise from the good and evil of this world, cannot exist within My unalloyed devotees, who, being free from material hankering, maintain steady spiritual consciousness in all circumstances. Indeed, such devotees have achieved Me, the Supreme Lord, who am beyond anything that can be conceived by material intelligence.

meta.english_verbatim: Material piety and sin, which arise from the good and evil of this world, cannot exist within My unalloyed devotees, who, being free from material hankering, maintain steady spiritual consciousness in all circumstances. Indeed, such devotees have achieved Me, the Supreme Lord, who am beyond anything that can be conceived by material intelligence.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
य एतां मत्कथां हित्वा भक्तिज्ञानक्रियात्मिकाम्।
क्षुद्रान् कामान् खलैः प्राणैर्जुषन्तः संसरन्ति ते॥ ११/२१/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: Those who give up these methods for achieving Me, which consist of devotion, analytic philosophy and regulated execution of prescribed duties, and instead, being moved by the material senses, cultivate insignificant sense enjoyment, certainly undergo the continual cycle of material existence.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Those who give up these methods for achieving Me, which consist of devotional service, analytic philosophy and regulated execution of prescribed duties, and instead, being moved by the material senses, cultivate insignificant sense gratification, certainly undergo the continual cycle of material existence.

units.sanskrit:
स्वेस्वेऽधिकारे या निष्ठा स गुणः परिकार्तितः।
विपर्ययस्तु दोषः स्यादुभयोरेष निश्चयः॥ ११/२१/२॥
units.english: Steadiness in one’s own position is declared to be actual piety, whereas deviation from one’s position is considered impiety. In this way the two are definitely ascertained.

meta.english_verbatim: Steadiness in one’s own position is declared to be actual piety, whereas deviation from one’s position is considered impiety. In this way the two are definitely ascertained.

units.sanskrit:
शुद्ध्यशुद्धी विधीयेते समानेष्वपि वस्तुषु।
द्रव्यस्य विचिकित्सार्थं गुणदोषौ शुभाशुभौ॥ ११/२१/३॥
units.english: O sinless Uddhava, in order to understand what is proper in life one must evaluate a given object within its particular category. Thus, in analyzing religious principles one must consider purity and impurity. Similarly, in one’s ordinary dealings one must distinguish between good and bad, and to insure one’s physical survival one must recognize that which is auspicious and inauspicious.

parts.sanskrit:
शुद्ध्यशुद्धी विधीयेते समानेष्वपि वस्तुषु।
द्रव्यस्य विचिकित्सार्थं गुणदोषौ शुभाशुभौ॥ ११/२१/३॥

विवेकेन पुण्याधिक्यं भवतीति विचिकित्सार्थं गुणदोषौ विधीयेते।
“पञ्चभूतात्मकत्वेन समता सर्ववस्तुषु।
हरिसन्निधिवैशेष्याद् विशेषश्च महान् सदा॥”
इति वैशेष्ये॥ ३॥

meta.english_verbatim: O sinless Uddhava, in order to understand what is proper in life one must evaluate a given object within its particular category. Thus, in analyzing religious principles one must consider purity and impurity. Similarly, in one’s ordinary dealings one must distinguish between good and bad, and to insure one’s physical survival one must recognize that which is auspicious and inauspicious.

units.sanskrit:
धर्मार्थं व्यवहारार्थं यात्रार्थमिति चानघ।
दर्शितोऽयं मयाऽऽचारो धर्म्यमुद्वहता धुरम्॥ ११/२१/४॥
units.english: I have revealed this way of life for those bearing the burden of mundane religious principles.

meta.english_verbatim: I have revealed this way of life for those bearing the burden of mundane religious principles.

units.sanskrit:
भूम्यम्ब्वग्न्यनिलाकाशा भूतानां पञ्च धातवः।
आब्रह्मस्थावरादीनां शरीरा आत्मसंयुताः॥ ११/२१/५॥
units.english: Earth, water, fire, air and ether are the five basic elements that constitute the bodies of all conditioned souls, from Lord Brahmā himself down to the nonmoving creatures. These elements all emanate from the one the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: Earth, water, fire, air and ether are the five basic elements that constitute the bodies of all conditioned souls, from Lord Brahmā himself down to the nonmoving creatures. These elements all emanate from the one Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit:
भेदेन नामरूपाणि विषमाणि समेष्वपि।
धातुशुद्ध्यै विकल्प्यन्त एतेषां स्वार्थसिद्धये॥ ११/२१/६॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, although all material bodies are composed of the same five elements and are thus equal, the Vedic literatures conceive of different names and forms in relation to such bodies so that the living beings may achieve their goal of life.

parts.sanskrit:
भेदेन नामरूपाणि विषमाणि समेष्वपि।
धातुशुद्ध्यै विकल्प्यन्त एतेषां स्वार्थसिद्धये॥ ११/२१/६॥

धातुः परमेश्वरः।
“यद्यद्धरेः सन्निहितं तत्तच्छुद्धतरं मतम्।
स्वतः शुचितमो विष्णुः सान्निध्यं च स्वभावतः॥”
इति च।
एतेषां जीवानाम्॥ ६॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, although all material bodies are composed of the same five elements and are thus equal, the Vedic literatures conceive of different names and forms in relation to such bodies so that the living entities may achieve their goal of life.

units.sanskrit:
देशकालादिभावानां वचनान्मम सत्तम।
गुणदोषौ विधीयेते नियमार्थं हि कर्मणाम्॥ ११/२१/७॥
units.english: O saintly Uddhava, in order to restrict materialistic activities, I have established that which is proper and improper among all material things, including time, space and all physical objects.

meta.english_verbatim: O saintly Uddhava, in order to restrict materialistic activities, I have established that which is proper and improper among all material things, including time, space and all physical objects.

units.sanskrit:
कृष्णसारोऽथ देशानां ब्राह्मणानां शुचिर्भवेत्।
कृष्णसारोऽप्यसौवीरकाकटासंस्कृतेरिणः॥ ११/२१/८॥
units.english: Among places, those bereft of the spotted antelope, those devoid of devotion to the brāhmaṇas, those possessing spotted antelopes but bereft of respectable men, provinces like Kīkaṭa and places where cleanliness and purificatory rites are neglected, where meat-eaters are prominent or where the earth is barren, are all considered to be contaminated lands.

parts.sanskrit:
कृष्णसारोऽथ देशानां ब्राह्मणानां शुचिर्भवेत्।
कृष्णसारोऽप्यसौवीरकाकटासंस्कृतेरिणः॥ ११/२१/८॥

“नदीसमुद्रगिरय आश्रमाश्च वनानि च।
नगराणि च दिव्यानि शालग्रामादयस्तथा।
तेषां समीपगाश्चैव देशा योजनमात्रतः।
कर्मण्यास्तु समाख्यातास्तदन्ये कीकटाः स्मृताः।
तदन्येऽपि तु ये देशाः कृष्णसाराोषिताः स्वतः।
कर्मण्या एव ते ज्ञेया यदि नाध्युषिताः खलैः।
खलैरध्युषिताश्चापि यदि सद्भिरधिष्ठिताः।
कर्मण्या इति विज्ञेया विष्णुलिङ्गानि यत्र च॥”
इति स्कान्दे॥ ८॥

meta.english_verbatim: Among places, those bereft of the spotted antelope, those devoid of devotion to the brāhmaṇas, those possessing spotted antelopes but bereft of respectable men, provinces like Kīkaṭa and places where cleanliness and purificatory rites are neglected, where meat-eaters are prominent or where the earth is barren, are all considered to be contaminated lands.

units.sanskrit:
कर्मण्यो गुणवान् कालो द्रव्यतः स्वत एव वा।
यतो निवर्तते कर्म सदोषोऽकर्मकः स्मृतः॥ ११/२१/९॥
units.english: A specific time is considered pure when it is appropriate, either by its own nature or through achievement of suitable paraphernalia, for the performance of one’s prescribed duty. That time which impedes the performance of one’s duty is considered impure.

meta.english_verbatim: A specific time is considered pure when it is appropriate, either by its own nature or through achievement of suitable paraphernalia, for the performance of one’s prescribed duty. That time which impedes the performance of one’s duty is considered impure.

units.sanskrit:
द्रव्यस्य शद्ध्यशुद्धी च द्रव्येण वचनेन वा।
संस्कारेणाथ कालेन महत्त्वाल्पतयाऽथ वा॥ ११/२१/१०॥
units.english: An object’s purity or impurity is established by application of another object, by words, by rituals, by the effects of time or according to relative magnitude.

meta.english_verbatim: An object’s purity or impurity is established by application of another object, by words, by rituals, by the effects of time or according to relative magnitude.

units.sanskrit:
शक्त्याऽशक्त्या च वाग्बुद्ध्या समृद्ध्या च तथाऽऽत्मनः।
अन्ये शुद्ध्यन्ति हि तथा देशावस्थानुसारतः॥ ११/२१/११॥
units.english: Impure things may or may not impose sinful reactions upon a person, depending on that person’s strength or weakness, intelligence, wealth, location and physical condition.

meta.english_verbatim: Impure things may or may not impose sinful reactions upon a person, depending on that person’s strength or weakness, intelligence, wealth, location and physical condition.

units.sanskrit:
धान्यदार्वस्थितन्तूनां रसतैजसचर्मणाम्।
कालवाय्वग्निमृत्तोयैः पार्थिवानां युतायुतैः॥ ११/२१/१२॥
units.english: Various objects such as grains, wooden utensils, things made of bone, thread, liquids, objects derived from fire, skins and earthy objects are all purified by time, by the wind, by fire, by earth and by water, either separately or in combination.

meta.english_verbatim: Various objects such as grains, wooden utensils, things made of bone, thread, liquids, objects derived from fire, skins and earthy objects are all purified by time, by the wind, by fire, by earth and by water, either separately or in combination.

units.sanskrit:
अमेध्यलिप्तं यद् येन गन्धलेपं व्यपोहति।
भजते प्रकृतिं तस्य तच्छौचमुपदिश्यते॥ ११/२१/१३॥
units.english: A particular purifying agent is considered appropriate when its application removes the bad odor or dirty covering of some contaminated object and makes it resume its original nature.

meta.english_verbatim: A particular purifying agent is considered appropriate when its application removes the bad odor or dirty covering of some contaminated object and makes it resume its original nature.

units.sanskrit:
स्नानदानतपोवस्थावीर्यसंस्कारकर्मभिः।
मदभ्यासान्मनःशौचं कृत्वा कर्माचरेद् बुधः॥ ११/२१/१४॥
units.english: The self can be cleansed by bathing, charity, austerity, age, personal strength, purificatory rituals, prescribed duties and, above all, by remembrance of Me. The brāhmaṇa and other twice-born men should be duly purified before performing their specific activities.

meta.english_verbatim: The self can be cleansed by bathing, charity, austerity, age, personal strength, purificatory rituals, prescribed duties and, above all, by remembrance of Me. The brāhmaṇa and other twice-born men should be duly purified before performing their specific activities.

units.sanskrit:
मन्त्रस्य च परिज्ञानं कर्मशुद्धिर्मदर्पणम्।
धर्मः सम्पाद्यते सद्भिरधर्मस्तु विपर्ययैः॥ ११/२१/१५॥
units.english: A mantra is purified when chanted with proper knowledge, and one’s work is purified when offered to Me. Thus by purification of the place, time, substance, doer, mantras and work, one becomes religious, and by negligence of these six items one is considered irreligious.

parts.sanskrit:
मन्त्रस्य च परिज्ञानं कर्मशुद्धिर्मदर्पणम्।
धर्मः सम्पाद्यते सद्भिरधर्मस्तु विपर्ययैः॥ ११/२१/१५॥

“आन्तरः सन्निधिर्विष्णोर्बाह्यसन्निधिरेव च।
द्विविधः सन्निधिः प्रोक्तः कृत्रिमो बाह्य उच्यते।
स्वाभाविकस्त्वान्तरः स्यात् प्रतिमा जीवगो यथा॥”
इति च॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: A mantra is purified when chanted with proper knowledge, and one’s work is purified when offered to Me. Thus by purification of the place, time, substance, doer, mantras and work, one becomes religious, and by negligence of these six items one is considered irreligious.

units.sanskrit:
क्वचिद् गुणोपि दोषः स्याद् दोषोऽपि विधिना गुणः।
गुणदोषार्थनियमस्तद्विदामेव बाधते॥ ११/२१/१६॥
units.english: Sometimes piety becomes sin, and sometimes what is ordinarily sin becomes piety on the strength of Vedic injunctions. Such special rules in effect eradicate the clear distinction between piety and sin.

parts.sanskrit:
क्वचिद् गुणोपि दोषः स्याद् दोषोऽपि विधिना गुणः।
गुणदोषार्थनियमस्तद्विदामेव बाधते॥ ११/२१/१६॥

तद्विदामेव, न तिर्यगादीनाम् ।
“वर्षाच्चतुर्दशादूर्ध्वं ये न विद्युः शुभाशुभम्।
तेषामज्ञानजो दोषः सुमहान् कर्मजादपि।
तिरश्चामिन्द्रियासक्तेर्न दोषोऽज्ञानजो भवेत्।
गुणोऽपि नैव कश्चित् स्याद् यतो ज्ञानबहिष्कृताः॥”
इति च।
अतो मूर्खाणामदोष इति न॥ १६॥

meta.english_verbatim: Sometimes piety becomes sin, and sometimes what is ordinarily sin becomes piety on the strength of Vedic injunctions. Such special rules in effect eradicate the clear distinction between piety and sin.

units.sanskrit:
समानकर्माचरणेऽपतितानां न पातकम्।
औत्पत्तिको गुणैः सङ्गो न शयानः पतत्यधः॥ ११/२१/१७॥
units.english: The same activities that would degrade an elevated person do not cause falldown for those who are already fallen. Indeed, one who is lying on the ground cannot possibly fall further. The material association that is dictated by one’s own nature is considered a good quality.

parts.sanskrit:
समानकर्माचरणेऽपतितानां न पातकम्।
औत्पत्तिको गुणैः सङ्गो न शयानः पतत्यधः॥ ११/२१/१७॥

समानकर्माचरणे आत्मयोग्यकर्माचरणे। पूर्वमपतितो येन पतति। प्रायश्चित्तत्वेन तत्समानकर्माचरणेऽपि न दोषः। तप्तसुरापानवद् देहत्यागिनः। तथा शयानः शूद्रोऽपि न पतति लशुनभक्षणादिभिर्ब्राह्मणादिपातकैः। औत्पत्तिको यतस्तस्य तादृशगुणसङ्गः। अतः स्वायोग्य एव कर्मणि पतति।
“त्रैवर्णिकाः सञ्चरन्तो वेदकर्मप्रवर्तनात्।
शयानः शूद्र उद्दिष्टो वेदकर्माप्रवर्तनात्।
न तस्याभक्ष्यजो दोषः शुश्रूषायां प्रवर्ततः।
यथा सुवर्णस्य मलं
शुक्लं
ताम्रस्य नैव तत्।
एवं विप्रादिदोषैस्तु न शूद्रो दोषितामियात्।
मलं तु तस्यापि मलं यथैवं शूद्रजन्मनः।
स्वधर्मप्रतिरूपस्य चरणं दोषदं मतम्॥”
इति च समाचारे।
“शूद्रस्यापि हरेर्दीक्षां प्रविष्टस्य तु विप्रवत्।
अभक्ष्यादिकृतो दोषः स हि शूद्रो हि मुख्यतः॥”
इति विष्णुतन्त्रे ॥ १७॥

meta.english_verbatim: The same activities that would degrade an elevated person do not cause falldown for those who are already fallen. Indeed, one who is lying on the ground cannot possibly fall further. The material association that is dictated by one’s own nature is considered a good quality.

units.sanskrit:
यतोयतो निवर्तेत विमुच्येत ततस्ततः।
एष धर्मो नृणां क्षेमः शोकमोहभयापहः॥ ११/२१/१८॥
units.english: By refraining from a particular sinful or materialistic activity, one becomes freed from its bondage. Such renunciation is the basis of religious and auspicious life for human beings and drives away all suffering, illusion and fear.

parts.sanskrit:
यतोयतो निवर्तेत विमुच्येत ततस्ततः।
एष धर्मो नृणां क्षेमः शोकमोहभयापहः॥ ११/२१/१८॥

सर्वतोऽप्यभिमानविमोकेन परमात्मसमर्पणमेव दोषहानिदमित्याह- यतोयत इत्यादिना॥
“मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि सन्न्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा” इत्यादेश्च॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: By refraining from a particular sinful or materialistic activity, one becomes freed from its bondage. Such renunciation is the basis of religious and auspicious life for human beings and drives away all suffering, illusion and fear.

units.sanskrit:
विषयेषु गुणध्यानात् पुंसः सङ्गस्ततो भवेत्।
सङ्गादेव भवेत् कामः कामादेव कलिर्नृणाम्॥ ११/२१/१९॥
units.english: One who accepts material sense objects as desirable certainly becomes attached to them. From such attachment lust arises, and this lust creates quarrel among men.

meta.english_verbatim: One who accepts material sense objects as desirable certainly becomes attached to them. From such attachment lust arises, and this lust creates quarrel among men.

units.sanskrit:
कलेर्दुविषहः क्रोधस्तमस्तदनुवर्तते।
तमसा ग्रस्यते पुंसश्चेतना व्यापिनी ततः॥ ११/२१/२०॥
units.english: From quarrel arises intolerable anger, followed by the darkness of ignorance. This ignorance quickly overtakes a man’s broad intelligence.

meta.english_verbatim: From quarrel arises intolerable anger, followed by the darkness of ignorance. This ignorance quickly overtakes a man’s broad intelligence.

units.sanskrit:
तया च रहितः साधो जन्तुः शून्याय कल्पते।
ततोऽस्य स्वार्थविभ्रंशो मूर्च्छितस्य मृतस्य च॥ ११/२१/२१॥
units.english: O saintly Uddhava, a person bereft of real intelligence is considered to have lost everything. Deviated from the actual purpose of his life, he becomes dull, just like a dead person.

meta.english_verbatim: O saintly Uddhava, a person bereft of real intelligence is considered to have lost everything. Deviated from the actual purpose of his life, he becomes dull, just like a dead person.

units.sanskrit:
विषयाभिनिवेशेन नात्मानं वेद नापरम्।
वृक्षजीविकया जीवन् व्यर्थं ग्रस्तवयाः श्वसन्॥ ११/२१/२२॥
units.english: Because of absorption in sense enjoyment, one cannot recognize himself or others. Living uselessly in ignorance like a tree, one is merely breathing just like a bellows.

parts.sanskrit:
विषयाभिनिवेशेन नात्मानं वेद नापरम्।
वृक्षजीविकया जीवन् व्यर्थं ग्रस्तवयाः श्वसन्॥ ११/२१/२२॥

“दोषिणो गुणवत्त्वेन श्रूयन्ते विषयाः सदा।
असतां सङ्गतेस्तेषु दोषाः श्रोतुं सुदुर्लभाः।
अतो नित्यगुणध्यानात् तद्गुणे प्रीतिमान् भवेत्।
अतस्तत्र भवेत् कामः कामिनं कलिराविशेत्।
अधर्माज्ञानरूपेण
कलिनाऽऽविष्टदेहिनः।
सत्सु क्रोधो दुर्विषहस्ततस्तमसि पात्यते।
अन्धे तमसि मग्नस्य चेतनेन्द्रियसन्तता।
सुखानुभवशक्तिर्या सा विनश्यति सर्वदा।
तदा शमूनभावेन शून्य इत्युच्यते नरः।
सर्वात्मना तु सम्भ्रंशस्तस्य दुःखविवर्धनः।
अमूर्च्छितस्यैव भवेन्मृत्यनन्तरमेव च।
दुःखाख्यविषयावेशान्नात्मानं परमेव च।
यथावद् वेत्ति पतितस्तमस्यन्धे कदाचन।
वृक्षवद् वृश्च्यते नित्यं निष्प्रयोजनजीवनः।
नित्यदुःखपरीतायुर्दृतिवत् प्रश्वसित्यपि॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते।
स्वार्थस्य सुखस्य भ्रंशो विपरीतमतिशयेन जनयतीति स्वार्थविभ्रंशः। तस्मात् स्वर्गादिविषयेष्वपि नेच्छेत॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Because of absorption in sense gratification, one cannot recognize himself or others. Living uselessly in ignorance like a tree, one is merely breathing just like a bellows.

units.sanskrit:
फलश्रुतिरियं नॄणां नः श्रेयोरोचनं परम्।
श्रोतुर्विवक्षया प्रोक्तं यथा भैषज्यरोचनम्॥ ११/२१/२३॥
units.english: Those statements of scripture promising fruitive rewards do not prescribe the ultimate good for men but are merely enticements for executing beneficial religious duties, like promises of candy spoken to induce a child to take beneficial medicine.

parts.sanskrit:
फलश्रुतिरियं नॄणां नः श्रेयोरोचनं परम्।
श्रोतुर्विवक्षया प्रोक्तं यथा भैषज्यरोचनम्॥ ११/२१/२३॥

“फलस्य श्रुतिरेवेयं न कामकुसुमश्रुतिः।
स्वर्गादिकामनायुक्तस्त्वैहिकेष्वपि सज्जते।
तत्रापि देवकामेभ्यो विशेषं चाभिवाञ्छति।
ततस्तमसि पातः स्यादतो वेदः कथं हि तान्।
काम्यत्वेनाभिचक्षीत सर्वं जानन् स्वयं सदा॥”
इति च।
नः श्रेयोरोचनम्। अस्मत्सकाशाच्छ्रेयो मोक्षाख्यं तदेव रोचयति फलश्रुतिः। कुसुमस्यानित्यतादिदोषज्ञानान्मोक्षस्यादोषत्वज्ञानाच्च। ईषदुत्तमस्य श्रोतुर्विवक्षया॥ २३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Those statements of scripture promising fruitive rewards do not prescribe the ultimate good for men but are merely enticements for executing beneficial religious duties, like promises of candy spoken to induce a child to take beneficial medicine.

units.sanskrit:
उत्पत्त्यैव हि कामेषु प्राणेषु स्वजनेषु च।
आसक्तमनसो मर्त्या आत्मनोऽनर्थहेतुषु॥ ११/२१/२४॥
units.english: Simply by material birth, human beings become attached within their minds to personal sense enjoyment, long duration of life, sense activities, bodily strength, sexual potency and friends and family. Their minds are thus absorbed in that which defeats their actual self-interest.

meta.english_verbatim: Simply by material birth, human beings become attached within their minds to personal sense gratification, long duration of life, sense activities, bodily strength, sexual potency and friends and family. Their minds are thus absorbed in that which defeats their actual self-interest.

units.sanskrit:
न तानविदुषः स्वार्थं भ्राम्यतो व्रजिनाध्वनि।
कथं युञ्ज्यात् पुनस्तेषु तांस्तमो विशतो बुधः॥ ११/२१/२५॥
units.english: Those ignorant of their real self-interest are wandering on the path of material existence, gradually heading toward darkness. Why would the Vedas further encourage them in sense enjoyment if they, although foolish, submissively pay heed to Vedic injunctions?

parts.sanskrit:
न तानविदुषः स्वार्थं भ्राम्यतो व्रजिनाध्वनि।
कथं युञ्ज्यात् पुनस्तेषु तांस्तमो विशतो बुधः॥ ११/२१/२५॥

बुधो वेदः कथं युञ्ज्यात्। अन्तरालागतोऽपि स्वर्ग एवंविधः किमु साक्षात्फलरूपो मोक्ष इति रोचकः। अनेकब्रह्मकालप्राप्यत्वान्मोक्षस्य तावन्तं कालं तप एव कर्तुं न शक्यत इति मन्दाधिकारिणां स्वर्गादिष्वप्यभिरुचिर्भवति, तान् प्रत्यन्ते मोक्ष एव भवति। अन्तरालेऽप्येवंविधस्वर्गादिकं सुखं भवति। तस्माद् विहितं कर्म कर्तव्यमिति रोचयति। उत्तमानां तु यस्मादेतादृशमप्यनित्यत्वादिदोषवत् स्वर्गादिकं तस्मान्मोक्षफल एव वेद इति दर्शयति। नहि सर्वप्रमाणोत्तमो वेदोऽल्पफले पर्यवसितः।
“मन्दाधिकारिणां नित्यं तपसैव प्रतीक्षितुम्।
मोक्षो न शक्यतेऽधैर्यात् ततः स्वर्गादिकं
वदेत्।
स्वर्गादिष्वल्पफलतां ज्ञापयित्वा विमोक्षदम्।
एवं वक्तुं तूत्तमानां नित्यो वेदः प्रवर्तते।
इक्षुदण्डं ददानीति यथा भैषज्यरोचनम्।
एवं मन्देषूत्तमेषु मोक्षमाहात्म्यमुच्यते।
नह्यल्पफलभाग् वेदो वासुदेवैकसंश्रयः॥”
इति विचारे॥
“अयोग्यभार्यापुत्रादिकामिताऽनर्थसाधिनी।
योग्यकामाद्धरेः प्रीतिरतो ब्रह्मादयोऽमलाः।
भार्यापुत्रादिसंयुक्ता वासुदेवमुपासते॥”
इति च॥ २५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Those ignorant of their real self-interest are wandering on the path of material existence, gradually heading toward darkness. Why would the Vedas further encourage them in sense gratification if they, although foolish, submissively pay heed to Vedic injunctions?

units.sanskrit:
एवं व्यवसितं केचिदविज्ञाय कुबुद्धयः।
फलश्रुतिं कुसुमितामवेदज्ञा वदन्ति हि॥ ११/२१/२६॥
units.english: Persons with perverted intelligence do not understand this actual purpose of Vedic knowledge and instead propagate as the highest Vedic truth the flowery statements of the Vedas that promise material rewards. Those in actual knowledge of the Vedas never speak in that way.

parts.sanskrit:
एवं व्यवसितं केचिदविज्ञाय कुबुद्धयः।
फलश्रुतिं कुसुमितामवेदज्ञा वदन्ति हि॥ ११/२१/२६॥

एवं वेदस्य व्यवसितम्। फलश्रुतिं कुसुमिताम्। फलं मोक्षः। तद्विषयां श्रुतिं स्वर्गादिकुसुमविषयां वदन्ति
“नित्यानन्दो हरेर्भक्तिज्ञानाद्याः स्वर्गशब्दिताः।
पुत्रभार्याप्तवित्ताद्यं सर्वं मोक्षगतं फलम्।
उद्दिश्य स्वर्गकामस्य यजनं श्रुतिचोदितम्।
तदविज्ञाय पुष्पाख्यमनित्यं स्वर्गमिच्छवः।
यजन्ति मन्दमतयो वेदवादपरायणाः॥”
इति च।
“स्त्रीभिर्वा यानैर्वा ज्ञातिभिर्वा” इत्यादि च।
“मोक्षाख्यं फलमेवात्र स्वर्गादिवचनं तु यत्।
पुष्पस्वर्गादिवत् तस्य वचनं मन्दरोचनम्॥”
इति च।
“असुराणामयं स्वर्गशब्दः पुष्पात्मकं वदेत्।
देवानां हरिसम्प्राप्तिं वेदो विष्णुपरो यतः॥”
इति च॥ २६॥

meta.english_verbatim: Persons with perverted intelligence do not understand this actual purpose of Vedic knowledge and instead propagate as the highest Vedic truth the flowery statements of the Vedas that promise material rewards. Those in actual knowledge of the Vedas never speak in that way.

units.sanskrit:
कामिनः कृपणा लुब्धाः पुष्पेषु फलबुद्धयः।
अग्निमुग्धा धूमतान्ताः स्वं लोकं न विदन्ति ते॥ ११/२१/२७॥
units.english: Those who are full of lust, avarice and greed mistake mere flowers to be the actual fruit of life. Bewildered by the glare of fire and suffocated by its smoke, they cannot recognize their own true identity.

parts.sanskrit:
कामिनः कृपणा लुब्धाः पुष्पेषु फलबुद्धयः।
अग्निमुग्धा धूमतान्ताः स्वं लोकं न विदन्ति ते॥ ११/२१/२७॥
स्वलोकं स्वाश्रयाम्॥ २७॥

meta.english_verbatim: Those who are full of lust, avarice and greed mistake mere flowers to be the actual fruit of life. Bewildered by the glare of fire and suffocated by its smoke, they cannot recognize their own true identity.

units.sanskrit:
न ते मामङ्ग जानन्ति हृदिस्थं य इदं यतः।
उक्थशासो ह्यसुतृपो यथा नीहारचक्षुषः॥ ११/२१/२८॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, persons dedicated to sense enjoyment obtained through honoring the Vedic rituals cannot understand that I am situated in everyone’s heart and that the entire universe is nondifferent from Me and emanates from Me. Indeed, they are just like persons whose eyes are covered by fog.

parts.sanskrit:
न ते मामङ्ग जानन्ति हृदिस्थं य इदं यतः।
उक्थशासो ह्यसुतृपो यथा नीहारचक्षुषः॥ ११/२१/२८॥

कोऽसावाश्रयः मां ते ये उक्थेन प्राणेन शास्याः।
“विष्ण्वभक्तान् सदा वायुः शासयेत् तमसि क्षिपन्।
विष्णुभक्तान् विमोक्षाय प्रापयित्वा सुखं नयेत्॥”
इति च।
“पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनाम्” इति च॥ २८॥

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, persons dedicated to sense gratification obtained through honoring the Vedic rituals cannot understand that I am situated in everyone’s heart and that the entire universe is nondifferent from Me and emanates from Me. Indeed, they are just like persons whose eyes are covered by fog.

units.sanskrit:
ते मे मतमविज्ञाय परोक्षविषयात्मकाः।
हिंसायां यदि कामः स्याद् यज्ञ एव न चोदना॥ ११/२१/२९॥
हिंसाविहारा ह्यालब्धैः पशुभिः स्वसुखेच्छया।
यजन्ते देवता यज्ञैः पितॄन् भूतपतीन् खलाः॥ ११/२१/३०॥
units.english: Those who are sworn to sense enjoyment cannot understand the confidential conclusion of Vedic knowledge as explained by Me. Taking pleasure in violence, they cruelly slaughter innocent animals in sacrifice for their own sense enjoyment and thus worship gods, forefathers and leaders among ghostly creatures. Such passion for violence, however, is never encouraged within the process of Vedic sacrifice.

parts.sanskrit:
ते मे मतमविज्ञाय परोक्षविषयात्मकाः।
हिंसायां यदि कामः स्याद् यज्ञ एव न चोदना॥ ११/२१/२९॥
हिंसाविहारा ह्यालब्धैः पशुभिः स्वसुखेच्छया।
यजन्ते देवता यज्ञैः पितॄन् भूतपतीन् खलाः॥ ११/२१/३०॥

मे मताविज्ञानात्परोक्षविषयात्मकाः। परोक्षमन्धन्तमः। तद्विषयस्वरूपाः। तद्गमनार्थस्वरूपाः। “अन्धन्तमः परोक्षं च पञ्चकष्टं तथोच्यते” इति सुव्यक्ते।
तेषामासुराणां यदा हिंसायां कामस्तदा यज्ञ एव न चोदना। यद्यदात्मनो हिंसितुमिष्टं तत्तद् विहितमिति प्रापयन्ति कुतर्कैः।
“आसुरोऽविहितां हिंसां विहितत्वेन वर्णयेत् ।
आसुरा याज्ञिकाः सर्वे नारायणपराङ्मुखाः॥”
इति च॥ २९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Those who are sworn to sense gratification cannot understand the confidential conclusion of Vedic knowledge as explained by Me. Taking pleasure in violence, they cruelly slaughter innocent animals in sacrifice for their own sense gratification and thus worship demigods, forefathers and leaders among ghostly creatures. Such passion for violence, however, is never encouraged within the process of Vedic sacrifice.

units.sanskrit:
स्वप्नोपमममुं लोकमसन्तं श्रवणप्रियम्।
आशिषो हृदि सङ्कल्प्य त्यजन्त्यर्थान् यथा वणिक्॥ ११/२१/३१॥
units.english: Just as a foolish businessman gives up his real wealth in useless business speculation, foolish persons give up all that is actually valuable in life and instead pursue promotion to material heaven, which although pleasing to hear about is actually unreal, like a dream. Such bewildered persons imagine within their hearts that they will achieve all material blessings.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as a foolish businessman gives up his real wealth in useless business speculation, foolish persons give up all that is actually valuable in life and instead pursue promotion to material heaven, which although pleasing to hear about is actually unreal, like a dream. Such bewildered persons imagine within their hearts that they will achieve all material blessings.

units.sanskrit:
रजःसत्वतमोनिष्ठा रजःसत्वतमोजुषः।
उपासते इन्द्रमुख्यान् देवादीनयथैव माम्॥ ११/२१/३२॥
units.english: Those established in material passion, goodness and ignorance worship the particular gods and other deities, headed by Indra, who manifest the same modes of passion, goodness or ignorance. They fail, however, to properly worship Me.

parts.sanskrit:
रजःसत्वतमोनिष्ठा रजःसत्वतमोजुषः।
उपासते इन्द्रमुख्यान् देवादीनयथैव माम्॥ ११/२१/३२॥

“विष्णुं विहाय ये देवान् पितॄन् भूतेशमेव वा।
साम्येन वा पूजयन्ति ते ज्ञेया आसुरा गणाः॥”
इति च।
तामसेष्वेव रजःसत्त्वतमोनिष्ठाः।
“तामसेषु तु ये सत्त्वा निरयप्रचुरास्तु ते।
ईषत्स्वर्गादिसंयुक्तास्तमोनिष्ठाश्च
ते स्मृताः।
केवलं निरये निष्ठा ये ते तामसराजसाः।
अन्धे तमसि ये निष्ठास्ते वै तामसतामसाः।
एवं त्रिभेदयुक्तास्तु याज्ञिका विष्णुवर्जिताः॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु॥ ३२॥

meta.english_verbatim: Those established in material passion, goodness and ignorance worship the particular demigods and other deities, headed by Indra, who manifest the same modes of passion, goodness or ignorance. They fail, however, to properly worship Me.

units.sanskrit:
इष्ट्वेह देवता यज्ञैर्गत्वा रंस्यामहे दिवि।
तस्यान्त इह भूयास्म महाशाला महाकुलाः॥ ११/२१/३३॥
एवं पुष्पितया वाचा व्याक्षिप्तमनसां नृणाम्।
मानिनां चातिस्तब्धानां मद्वार्ताऽपि न रोचते॥ ११/२१/३४॥
units.english: The worshipers of gods think, “We shall worship the gods in this life, and by our sacrifices we shall go to heaven and enjoy there. When that enjoyment is finished we shall return to this world and take birth as great householders in aristocratic families.” Being excessively proud and greedy, such persons are bewildered by the flowery words of the Vedas. They are not attracted to topics about Me, the Supreme Lord.

meta.english_verbatim: The worshipers of demigods think, “We shall worship the demigods in this life, and by our sacrifices we shall go to heaven and enjoy there. When that enjoyment is finished we shall return to this world and take birth as great householders in aristocratic families.” Being excessively proud and greedy, such persons are bewildered by the flowery words of the Vedas. They are not attracted to topics about Me, the Supreme Lord.

units.sanskrit:
वेदा ब्रह्मात्मविषयास्त्रिकाण्डविषया अपि।
परोक्षवादो वेदोऽयं परोक्षं मम च प्रियम्॥ ११/२१/३५॥
units.english: The Vedas, divided into three divisions, ultimately reveal the living being as pure spirit soul. The Vedic seers and mantras, however, deal in esoteric terms, and I also am pleased by such confidential descriptions.

parts.sanskrit:
वेदा ब्रह्मात्मविषयास्त्रिकाण्डविषया अपि।
परोक्षवादो वेदोऽयं परोक्षं मम च प्रियम्॥ ११/२१/३५॥

“ब्रह्मत्वं पूर्णता प्रोक्ता तद् यस्य स्वत एव तु।
स ब्रह्मात्मा समुद्दिष्टो वासुदेवः सनातनः॥”
इति च॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: The Vedas, divided into three divisions, ultimately reveal the living entity as pure spirit soul. The Vedic seers and mantras, however, deal in esoteric terms, and I also am pleased by such confidential descriptions.

units.sanskrit:
शब्दब्रह्म सुदुर्बोधं प्राणेन्द्रियमनोमयम्।
अनन्तपारं गम्भीरं दुर्विगाह्यं समुद्रवत्॥ ११/२१/३६॥
units.english: The transcendental sound of the Vedas is very difficult to comprehend and manifests on different levels within the prāṇa, senses and mind. This Vedic sound is unlimited, very deep and unfathomable, just like the ocean.

parts.sanskrit:
शब्दब्रह्म सुदुर्बोधं प्राणेन्द्रियमनोमयम्।
अनन्तपारं गम्भीरं दुर्विगाह्यं समुद्रवत्॥ ११/२१/३६॥

प्राणेन्द्रियमनोभिर्मीयते। “मेयत्वान्मय उद्दिष्टो वेदः प्राणादिभिः सदा” इति वाराहे।
“अन्तो विनाश उद्दिष्टः पारः परिमितिस्तथा।
अनन्तपारो वेदोऽयं ताभ्यां स रहितो यतः॥”
इति व्यासस्मृतौ॥ ३६॥

meta.english_verbatim: The transcendental sound of the Vedas is very difficult to comprehend and manifests on different levels within the prāṇa, senses and mind. This Vedic sound is unlimited, very deep and unfathomable, just like the ocean.

units.sanskrit:
मयोपबृंहितं भूम्ना ब्रह्मणाऽनन्तशक्तिना।
भूतेषु घोषरूपेण बिसेषूर्णेव लक्ष्यते॥ ११/२१/३७॥
units.english: As the unlimited, unchanging and omnipotent the Lord dwelling within all living beings, I personally establish the Vedic sound vibration in the form of oṁkāra within all living beings. It is thus perceived subtly, just like a single strand of fiber on a lotus stalk.

parts.sanskrit:
मयोपबृंहितं भूम्ना ब्रह्मणाऽनन्तशक्तिना।
भूतेषु घोषरूपेण बिसेषूर्णेव लक्ष्यते॥ ११/२१/३७॥
भूम्ना ब्रह्मणा अतिमहापरिपूर्णेन॥ ३७॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: As the unlimited, unchanging and omnipotent Personality of Godhead dwelling within all living beings, I personally establish the Vedic sound vibration in the form of oṁkāra within all living entities. It is thus perceived subtly, just like a single strand of fiber on a lotus stalk.

units.sanskrit:
यथोर्णनाभिर्हृयदादूर्णामुद्वहते मुखात्।
आकाशाद् घोषवान् प्राणो मनसाऽऽस्पर्शरूपिणा॥ ११/२१/३८॥
छन्दोमयोऽमृतमयः सहस्रपदवीं प्रभुः।
ओङ्कारेष्वञ्जितां स्पर्शस्वरोष्मान्तस्थभूषिताम्॥ ११/२१/३९॥
विचित्रभाषाविततां छन्दोभिश्चतुरुत्तरैः।
अनन्तपारां बृहतीं सृजत्याक्षिपते स्वयम्॥ ११/२१/४०॥
units.english: Just as a spider brings forth from its heart its web and emits it through its mouth, the Lord manifests Himself as the reverberating primeval vital air, comprising all sacred Vedic meters and full of transcendental pleasure. Thus the Lord, from the ethereal sky of His heart, creates the great and limitless Vedic sound by the agency of His mind, which conceives of variegated sounds such as the sparśas. The Vedic sound branches out in thousands of directions, adorned with the different letters expanded from the syllable om: the consonants, vowels, sibilants and semivowels. The Veda is then elaborated by many verbal varieties, expressed in different meters, each having four more syllables than the previous one. Ultimately the Lord again withdraws His manifestation of Vedic sound within Himself.

parts.sanskrit:
यथोर्णनाभिर्हृयदादूर्णामुद्वहते मुखात्।
आकाशाद् घोषवान् प्राणो मनसाऽऽस्पर्शरूपिणा॥ ११/२१/३८॥
छन्दोमयोऽमृतमयः सहस्रपदवीं प्रभुः।
ओङ्कारेष्वञ्जितां स्पर्शस्वरोष्मान्तस्थभूषिताम्॥ ११/२१/३९॥
विचित्रभाषाविततां छन्दोभिश्चतुरुत्तरैः।
अनन्तपारां बृहतीं सृजत्याक्षिपते स्वयम्॥ ११/२१/४०॥

आस्पर्शरूपिणा। आस्पर्शो विष्णुस्तं रूपयति प्रकाशयतीत्यास्पर्शरूपि प्राणस्य मनः। आसमन्तात् स्पर्शा भोगा अस्यैवेत्यास्पर्शः ।
“भुङ्क्ते यदखिलान् स्पर्शानास्पर्शो विष्णुरुच्यते।
तस्य प्रकाशकं नित्यं नमस्ये प्राणमेकलम्।
प्राणस्यैव मनो नित्यं वासुदेवं प्रकाशयेत्॥”
इति वायुप्रोक्ते।
“मीयन्तेऽनेन छन्दांसि प्राणश्छन्दोमयस्ततः”
इति च।
“त्रिमात्रमादितः कृत्वा
यावच्चानन्तमात्रकः।
प्रणवास्ते विभेदेन ह्यनन्ताः परिकीर्तिताः।
एकमात्रोत्तराः सर्वे वासुदेवाभिधायकाः।
तेषां व्याख्यानरूपा हि सर्वे वेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः।
ओङ्कारव्यञ्जितास्तस्मात् सदोच्चार्या हरेः प्रियैः॥”
इति प्रणवमहात्म्ये।
“गुह्यदर्शनभाषे च भाषा चैव समाधिका।
तिस्रस्तु मूलभाषाः स्युरेकैका च त्रिधा पुनः।
गुह्यदर्शनसञ्ज्ञा च गुह्यगुह्या तथाऽपरा।
एवमादिक्रमेणैव त्वेकाशीतिविभेदिताः।
भाषास्तत्र च गुह्या च प्रसिद्धार्थेष्वनन्विता।
गुह्यार्थतत्परैवान्धो मणिमित्यादिका च सा।
दर्शनान्यवलम्ब्यैव पशुपत्यादिनां तु या।
बहुश्रुतिविरुद्धं तु वदेत् सा दर्शनात्मिका।
अन्ते निषेधसंयुक्ता भस्मस्नानादिका च सा।
यथाप्रदृश्यमानार्था समाधिः सा प्रकीर्तिता।
विष्णुः परम इत्याद्या सा च विद्वद्भिरीरिता॥”
इति भाषाविवेके।
“भस्मस्नानविधानं तु श्रुत्युक्तं दर्शनानुगम्।
भस्मस्नानं ततोऽग्राह्यं विधानं तु नृसिंहगम्॥”
इति स्कान्दे।
गायत्र्या उष्णिक् चतुर्वर्णाधिकेत्यादि चतुरुत्तरैः। जगत्यन्तानामेव चतुरुत्तरत्वनियमः॥ ४० ॥

units.sanskrit:
गायत्र्युष्णिगनुष्टुप् च बृहती पिङ्क्तरेव च।
त्रिष्टुप् जगत्यतिच्छन्दो ह्यष्ट्यत्यष्टी जगद् विराट्॥ ११/२१/४१॥
units.english: The Vedic meters are Gāyatrī, Uṣṇik, Anuṣṭup, Bṛhatī, Paṅkti, Triṣṭup, Jagatī, Aticchanda, Atyaṣṭi, Atijagatī and Ativirāṭ.

गायत्र्युष्णिगनुष्टुप् च बृहती पिङ्क्तरेव च।
त्रिष्टुप् जगत्यतिच्छन्दो ह्यष्ट्यत्यष्टी जगद् विराट्॥ ११/२१/४१॥
“छन्दस्तु नवपादं यज्जगदित्युच्यते बुधैः” इति छन्दोविधाने॥ ४१॥

meta.english_verbatim: The Vedic meters are Gāyatrī, Uṣṇik, Anuṣṭup, Bṛhatī, Paṅkti, Triṣṭup, Jagatī, Aticchanda, Atyaṣṭi, Atijagatī and Ativirāṭ.

units.sanskrit:
किं विधत्ते किमाचष्टे किमनूद्य विकल्पयेत्।
इत्यस्या हृदयं लोके नान्यो मद् वेद कश्चन॥ ११/२१/४२॥
units.english: In the entire world no one but Me actually understands the confidential purpose of Vedic knowledge. Thus people do not know what the Vedas are actually prescribing in the ritualistic injunctions of karma-kāṇḍa, or what object is actually being indicated in the formulas of worship found in the upāsanā-kāṇḍa, or that which is elaborately discussed through various hypotheses in the jñāna-kāṇḍa section of the Vedas.

units.sanskrit: मां विधत्तेऽभिधत्ते मां विकल्प्योऽपोह्य इत्यहम्॥ ११/२१/४३॥
units.english: I am the ritualistic sacrifice enjoined by the Vedas, and I am the worshipable Deity. It is I who am presented as various philosophical hypotheses, and it is I alone who am then refuted by philosophical analysis. The transcendental sound vibration thus establishes Me as the essential meaning of all Vedic knowledge. The Vedas, elaborately analyzing all material duality as nothing but My illusory potency, ultimately completely negate this duality and achieve their own satisfaction.

parts.sanskrit: मां विधत्तेऽभिधत्ते मां विकल्प्योऽपोह्य इत्यहम्॥ ११/२१/४३॥

विविधरूपत्वेन कल्पनं विकल्पः। चत्वारि वागित्यादि। तत्र वागित्यनुवादः ।
“विधिभागे हरेः पूजैवाभिधाने च तद्गुणाः।
विकल्पे तद्बहुत्वं चाप्यपोहे तु तदप्रियम्।
उच्यते सर्ववेदेषु तच्च वेद स एव हि॥”
इत्यागमतात्पर्ये।
“सुरा हरेर्गुणाः प्रोक्तास्ते मे स्युरिति चिन्तनम्।
सुरापानमिति प्रोक्तं तन्न कुर्यात् कथञ्चन।
ब्राह्मणो विष्णुरुद्दिष्टः स नास्तीत्यभिचिन्तनम्।
ब्रह्महत्या समुद्दिष्टा तां न कुर्यात् कथञ्चन।
इत्याद्यपोहवाक्यार्थश्चिन्त्यो विष्णुर्बुधैर्जनैः॥”
इत्यादि च ।
मदन्यः कश्चन कोऽपि न वेद ॥ ४३॥

meta.english_verbatim: I am the ritualistic sacrifice enjoined by the Vedas, and I am the worshipable Deity. The transcendental sound vibration thus establishes Me as the essential meaning of all Vedic knowledge. The Vedas, elaborately analyzing all material duality as nothing but My illusory potency, ultimately completely negate this duality and achieve their own satisfaction.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
कानि तत्वानि विश्वेश संख्यातान्यृषिभिः प्रभो।
नवैकादश पञ्च त्रीण्यात्थ त्वमिह शुश्रुमः॥ ११/२२/१॥
केचित् षड्विंशतिं प्राहुरपरे पञ्चविंशतिम्।
सप्तैके नव षट् केचिच्चत्वार्येकादशापरे।
केचित् सप्तदश प्राहुः षोडशैके त्रयोदश॥ ११/२२/२॥
एतावत्त्वं हि सङ्ख्यानामृषयो यद्विवक्षया।
गायन्ति पृथगायुष्मन्निदं नो वक्तुमर्हसि॥ ११/२२/३॥
श्रीभगवानुवाच
units.english: Uddhava inquired: My dear Lord, O master of the universe, how many different elements of creation have been enumerated by the great sages? I have heard You personally describe a total of twenty-eight — God, the jīva soul, the mahat-tattva, false ego, the five gross elements, the ten senses, the mind, the five subtle objects of perception and the three modes of nature. But some authorities say that there are twenty-six elements, while others cite twenty-five or else seven, nine, six, four or eleven, and even others say that there are seventeen, sixteen or thirteen. What did each of these sages have in mind when he calculated the creative elements in such different ways? O supreme eternal, kindly explain this to me.
