Since karma thus has no ultimate basis in either the body or the soul, at whom can one become angry?

units.sanskrit:
कालोऽस्तु हेतुः सुखदुःखयोश्चेत् किमात्मनस्तत्र तदात्मनोऽसौ।
नाग्नेर्हि तापो न हिमस्य तत् स्यात् क्रुध्येत कस्मै न परस्य बोद्धुः॥ ११/२३/५६॥
units.english: If we accept time as the cause of happiness and distress, that experience still cannot apply to the spirit soul, since time is a manifestation of the Lord’s spiritual potency and the living beings are also expansions of the Lord’s spiritual potency manifesting through time. Certainly a fire does not burn its own flames or sparks, nor does the cold harm its own snowflakes or hail. In fact, the spirit soul is transcendental and beyond the experience of material happiness and distress. At whom, therefore, should one become angry?

parts.sanskrit:
कालोऽस्तु हेतुः सुखदुःखयोश्चेत् किमात्मनस्तत्र तदात्मनोऽसौ।
नाग्नेर्हि तापो न हिमस्य तत् स्यात् क्रुध्येत कस्मै न परस्य बोद्धुः॥ ११/२३/५६॥

तदात्मनः कालाधीनस्य। “स्वातन्त्र्यमात्मशब्दोक्तं स्वरूपमपि कुत्रचित्” इति विवेके। यथाऽग्नेर्हिमस्य च नैव दुःखं तापनिमित्तम्, जडत्वात्। एवं जडत्वाद् देहस्यापि कालादिसम्बन्धे विद्यमानेऽपि न दुःखं युक्तम्।
“सदा कालादिसम्बन्धाद् दुःखं देहस्य युज्यते।
तथाऽपि नैव दुःखी स जडत्वान्नियमेन तु।
आत्मनः सुखरूपत्वान्न दुःखं युज्यते क्वचित्।
तस्मान्मनोभ्रमेणैव दुःखी जीवो नचान्यथा।
सर्वेषां मनसो नेता मनोरूपस्त्रिलोचनः।
तद्वशाः सर्वदेवाश्च तेनैव सुखदुःखिनः।
नियन्ता तस्य च प्राणस्ततोऽपि बलवत्तरः।
तन्नियन्ता हरिः साक्षात् परमानन्दलक्षणः॥”
इति तात्पर्ये॥ ५६॥

meta.english_verbatim: If we accept time as the cause of happiness and distress, that experience still cannot apply to the spirit soul, since time is a manifestation of the Lord’s spiritual potency and the living entities are also expansions of the Lord’s spiritual potency manifesting through time. Certainly a fire does not burn its own flames or sparks, nor does the cold harm its own snowflakes or hail. In fact, the spirit soul is transcendental and beyond the experience of material happiness and distress. At whom, therefore, should one become angry?

units.sanskrit:
न केनचित् क्वापि कथञ्चनास्य द्वन्दोपरागः परतः परस्य।
यथाऽऽत्मनः संसृतिरूपिणः स्यादेवं प्रबुद्धो न बिभेति भूतैः॥ ११/२३/५७॥
units.english: The false ego gives shape to illusory material existence and thus experiences material happiness and distress. The spirit soul, however, is transcendental to material nature; he can never actually be affected by material happiness and distress in any place, under any circumstance or by the agency of any person. A person who understands this has nothing whatsoever to fear from the material creation.

parts.sanskrit:
न केनचित् क्वापि कथञ्चनास्य द्वन्दोपरागः परतः परस्य।
यथाऽऽत्मनः संसृतिरूपिणः स्यादेवं प्रबुद्धो न बिभेति भूतैः॥ ११/२३/५७॥

आत्मनः मनसः॥ भौमयोर्विकारयोः पीड्यपीडकयोः उभयमनसोः सतोर्दुःखं भवति। ग्रहस्य ग्रहणरूपस्य मनसः सत एव। जडे मनसि सत्येव। तदात्मनो मनसः सतः। संसृतिरूपिणः आत्मनो जीवस्य यथा तथा नहि परमस्य। अमनस्त्वात्। अतो मनोन्वयव्यतिरेक इति भावः॥ ५७॥

meta.english_verbatim: The false ego gives shape to illusory material existence and thus experiences material happiness and distress. The spirit soul, however, is transcendental to material nature; he can never actually be affected by material happiness and distress in any place, under any circumstance or by the agency of any person. A person who understands this has nothing whatsoever to fear from the material creation.

units.sanskrit:
एतां समास्थाय परात्मनिष्ठामध्यासितां पूर्वतमैर्महर्षिभिः।
अहं तरिष्यामि दुरन्तपारं तमो मुकुन्दाङ्घ्रिनिषेवयैव॥ ११/२३/५८॥
units.english: I shall cross over the insurmountable ocean of nescience by being firmly fixed in the service of the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. This was approved by the previous ācāryas, who were fixed in firm devotion to the Lord, Paramātmā, the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: I shall cross over the insurmountable ocean of nescience by being firmly fixed in the service of the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. This was approved by the previous ācāryas, who were fixed in firm devotion to the Lord, Paramātmā, the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
निर्विद्य नष्टद्रविणो गतक्ल्मः प्रव्रज्य गां पर्यटमान इत्थम्।
निराकृतोऽसद्भिरपि स्वधर्मादकम्पितोऽसौ मुनिराह गाथाम्॥ ११/२३/५९॥
units.english: Lord Kṛṣṇa said: Thus becoming detached upon the loss of his property, this sage gave up his moroseness. He left home, taking sannyāsa, and began to travel about the earth. Even when insulted by foolish rascals he remained unswerved from his duty and chanted this song.

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: Thus becoming detached upon the loss of his property, this sage gave up his moroseness. He left home, taking sannyāsa, and began to travel about the earth. Even when insulted by foolish rascals he remained unswerved from his duty and chanted this song.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

units.sanskrit:
सुखदुःखप्रदो नान्यः पुरुषस्यात्मविभ्रमः।
मित्रोदासीनरिपवः संसारः स्वमनस्ततः॥ ११/२३/६०॥
units.english: No other force besides his own mental confusion makes the soul experience happiness and distress. His perception of friends, neutral parties and enemies and the whole material life he builds around this perception are simply created out of ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: No other force besides his own mental confusion makes the soul experience happiness and distress. His perception of friends, neutral parties and enemies and the whole material life he builds around this perception are simply created out of ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
तस्मात् सर्वात्मना तात निगृह्णीष्व मनो धिया।
मय्यावेशितया युक्त एतावान् योगसङ्ग्रहः॥ ११/२३/६१॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, fixing your intelligence on Me, you should thus completely control the mind. This is the essence of the science of yoga.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, fixing your intelligence on Me, you should thus completely control the mind. This is the essence of the science of yoga.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
अथ ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि साङ्ख्यं पूर्वविनिश्चितम्।
यद् विज्ञाय पुमान् सद्यो जह्याद् वैकल्पिकं भ्रमम्॥ ११/२४/१॥
units.english: Lord Kṛṣṇa said: Now I shall describe to you the science of Sāṅkhya, which has been perfectly established by ancient authorities. By understanding this science a person can immediately give up the illusion of material duality.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: Now I shall describe to you the science of Sāṅkhya, which has been perfectly established by ancient authorities. By understanding this science a person can immediately give up the illusion of material duality.

units.sanskrit:
आसीज्ज्ञानमथो ह्यर्थश्चैकमेवाविकल्पितम्।
यदा विवेकनिपुणा आदौ कृतयुगे जनाः॥ ११/२४/२॥
units.english: Originally, during the Kṛta-yuga, when all men were very expert in spiritual discrimination, and also previous to that, during the period of annihilation, the seer existed alone, nondifferent from the seen object.

parts.sanskrit:
आसीज्ज्ञानमथो ह्यर्थश्चैकमेवाविकल्पितम्।
यदा विवेकनिपुणा आदौ कृतयुगे जनाः॥ ११/२४/२॥

“यथैवार्थस्तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञानार्थैक्यमुदाहृतम्।
तथा कृतयुगे प्रायस्तदन्येषु तु कस्यचित्॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: Originally, during the Kṛta-yuga, when all men were very expert in spiritual discrimination, and also previous to that, during the period of annihilation, the seer existed alone, nondifferent from the seen object.

units.sanskrit:
तन्मया फलरूपेण केवलेन विकल्पितम्।
वाङ्मनोगोचरं सत्यं द्विधा समभवद् बृहत्॥ ११/२४/३॥
units.english: That one Absolute Truth, remaining free from material dualities and inaccessible to ordinary speech and mind, divided Himself into two categories — the material nature and the living beings who are trying to enjoy the manifestations of that nature.

parts.sanskrit:
तन्मया फलरूपेण केवलेन विकल्पितम्।
वाङ्मनोगोचरं सत्यं द्विधा समभवद् बृहत्॥ ११/२४/३॥
फलं रूपयतीति फलरूपः। ज्ञानार्थैक्येन सत्यम्। पश्चात् तद् द्विधा समभवत्। तच्छब्दार्थात्मकमुभयं बृहत्तरम्॥ ३॥

meta.english_verbatim: That one Absolute Truth, remaining free from material dualities and inaccessible to ordinary speech and mind, divided Himself into two categories — the material nature and the living entities who are trying to enjoy the manifestations of that nature.

units.sanskrit:
तयोरेकतरो ह्यर्थः प्रकृतिः सोभयात्मिका।
ज्ञानं त्वन्यतमो भागः पुरुषः सोऽभिधीयते॥ ११/२४/४॥
units.english: Of these two categories of manifestation, one is material nature, which embodies both the subtle causes and manifest products of matter. The other is the conscious living being, designated as the enjoyer.

parts.sanskrit:
तयोरेकतरो ह्यर्थः प्रकृतिः सोभयात्मिका।
ज्ञानं त्वन्यतमो भागः पुरुषः सोऽभिधीयते॥ ११/२४/४॥

“ज्ञानाभिमानी पुरुषः स ब्रह्मा समुदाहृतः।
अर्थाभिमानी प्रकृतिर्गायत्री सा प्रकीर्तिता।
तयोर्नियामको विष्णुः श्रीश्चानुग्राहिका स्मृता।
वायुस्तु ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः प्रकृतौ समजायत।
त्रिगुणात्मा समुद्दिष्टः प्रायः सत्त्वात्मकस्तथा।
गायत्री चैव सावित्री तथैव च सरस्वती।
एवं त्रिरूपा प्रकृतिरेका सत्त्वादिभेदतः।
तासु वीर्यं समुत्सृष्टं ब्रह्मणैकत्वमागतम्।
स सूत्रात्मा समुद्दिष्टो वायुर्लोकप्रणायकः।
तस्यापि सूत्रं भगवान् धारणाद् विष्णुरव्ययः।
सूत्रपुत्रस्त्वहङ्कारः स रुद्रः समुदाहृतः।
सूत्रात्मना महांश्चापि सहजातश्चतुर्मुखः।
तस्यापि पुत्रोऽहङ्कारः स चानन्त उदाहृतः।
अनन्तादपि रुद्रोऽभूत् ब्रह्मणश्चेति स त्रिधा।
वैकारिको ब्रह्मजस्तु तैजसो वायुजः स्मृतः।
तामसोऽनन्तजश्चैव स एको गुणभेदतः॥”
इति प्राथम्ये॥ ४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Of these two categories of manifestation, one is material nature, which embodies both the subtle causes and manifest products of matter. The other is the conscious living entity, designated as the enjoyer.

units.sanskrit:
तमो रजः सत्वमिति प्रकृतेरभवन् गुणाः।
मया प्रक्षोभ्यमाणायाः पुरुषानुमतेन वा॥ ११/२४/५॥
units.english: When material nature was agitated by My glance, the three material modes — goodness, passion and ignorance — became manifest to fulfill the pending desires of the conditioned souls.

meta.english_verbatim: When material nature was agitated by My glance, the three material modes — goodness, passion and ignorance — became manifest to fulfill the pending desires of the conditioned souls.

units.sanskrit:
तेभ्यः समभवत् सूत्रं मत्सूत्रेण च संयुतम्।
ततो विकुर्वतो जज्ञे योऽहङ्कारो विमोहकः॥ ११/२४/६॥
units.english: From these modes arose the primeval sūtra, along with the mahat-tattva. By the transformation of the mahat-tattva was generated the false ego, the cause of the living beings’ bewilderment.

meta.english_verbatim: From these modes arose the primeval sūtra, along with the mahat-tattva. By the transformation of the mahat-tattva was generated the false ego, the cause of the living entities’ bewilderment.

units.sanskrit:
वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च तामसश्चेत्यहं त्रिवृत्।
तन्मात्रेन्द्रियमनसां कारणं चिदचिन्मयः॥ ११/२४/७॥
units.english: False ego, which is the cause of physical sensation, the senses and the mind, encompasses both spirit and matter and manifests in three varieties: in the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance.

parts.sanskrit:
वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च तामसश्चेत्यहं त्रिवृत्।
तन्मात्रेन्द्रियमनसां कारणं चिदचिन्मयः॥ ११/२४/७॥
“चिदचिद् यद्वशे सर्वं स रुद्रश्चिदचिन्मयः” इति च॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: False ego, which is the cause of physical sensation, the senses and the mind, encompasses both spirit and matter and manifests in three varieties: in the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
अर्थस्तन्मात्रको जज्ञे तामसादिन्द्रियाणि च।
तैजसाद् देवता आसन्नेकादश च वैकृतात्॥ ११/२४/८॥
units.english: From false ego in the mode of ignorance came the subtle physical perceptions, from which the gross elements were generated. From false ego in the mode of passion came the senses, and from false ego in the mode of goodness arose the eleven gods.

meta.english_verbatim: From false ego in the mode of ignorance came the subtle physical perceptions, from which the gross elements were generated. From false ego in the mode of passion came the senses, and from false ego in the mode of goodness arose the eleven demigods.

units.sanskrit:
मया संचोदिता भावाः सर्वे संहत्य कारिणः।
अण्डमुत्पादयामासुर्ममायतनमुत्तमम्॥ ११/२४/९॥
units.english: Impelled by Me, all these elements combined to function in an orderly fashion and together gave birth to the universal egg, which is My excellent place of residence.

meta.english_verbatim: Impelled by Me, all these elements combined to function in an orderly fashion and together gave birth to the universal egg, which is My excellent place of residence.

units.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नहं समभवमण्डे सलिलसंस्थिते।
मम नाभ्या अभूत् पदमं विश्वाख्यं तत्र चात्मभूः॥ ११/२४/१०॥
units.english: I Myself appeared within that egg, which was floating on the causal water, and from My navel arose the universal lotus, the birthplace of self-born Brahmā.

parts.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नहं समभवमण्डे सलिलसंस्थिते।
मम नाभ्या अभूत् पदमं विश्वाख्यं तत्र चात्मभूः॥ ११/२४/१०॥

“चिदानन्दशरीरस्तु प्रविष्टोऽण्डे हरिः स्वयम्।
तन्नाभेर्भूतदेहोऽभूत् पद्मादपि चतुर्मुखः।
चतुर्मुखस्तु सर्वाण्डव्याप्तदेहो महातपाः।
हरिस्तु सर्वव्याप्तोऽपि भूतदेहो नतु क्वचित्।
नैवास्य प्राकृतो देहः प्रादुर्भावेष्वपि क्वचित्॥”
इति निवृत्ते॥ १०॥

meta.english_verbatim: I Myself appeared within that egg, which was floating on the causal water, and from My navel arose the universal lotus, the birthplace of self-born Brahmā.

units.sanskrit:
सोऽसृजत् तपसा युक्तो रजसा मदनुग्रहात्।
लोकान् सपालान् विश्वात्मा भूर्भुवः स्वरिति त्रिधा॥ ११/२४/११॥
units.english: Lord Brahmā, the soul of the universe, being endowed with the mode of passion, performed great austerities by My mercy and thus created the three planetary divisions, called Bhūr, Bhuvar and Svar, along with their presiding deities.

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Brahmā, the soul of the universe, being endowed with the mode of passion, performed great austerities by My mercy and thus created the three planetary divisions, called Bhūr, Bhuvar and Svar, along with their presiding deities.

units.sanskrit:
देवानामोक आसीत् स्वर्भूतानां च भुवः पदम्।
मर्त्यादीनां च भूर्लोकः सिद्धानां त्रितयात् परम्॥ ११/२४/१२॥
units.english: Heaven was established as the residence of the gods, Bhuvarloka as that of the ghostly spirits, and the earth system as the place of human beings and other mortal creatures. Those mystics who strive for liberation are promoted beyond these three divisions.

meta.english_verbatim: Heaven was established as the residence of the demigods, Bhuvarloka as that of the ghostly spirits, and the earth system as the place of human beings and other mortal creatures. Those mystics who strive for liberation are promoted beyond these three divisions.

units.sanskrit:
अधोऽसुराणां नागानां भूमेरोकोऽसृजत् प्रभुः।
त्रिलोक्यां गतयः सर्वाः कर्मणां त्रिगुणात्मनाम्॥ ११/२४/१३॥
units.english: Lord Brahmā created the region below the earth for the demons and the Nāga snakes. In this way the destinations of the three worlds were arranged as the corresponding reactions for different kinds of work performed within the three modes of nature.

meta.english_verbatim: Lord Brahmā created the region below the earth for the demons and the Nāga snakes. In this way the destinations of the three worlds were arranged as the corresponding reactions for different kinds of work performed within the three modes of nature.

units.sanskrit:
योगस्य तपसश्चैव ज्ञानस्य गतयोऽमलाः।
महर्जनस्तपः सत्यं भक्तियोगस्य मद्गतिः॥ ११/२४/१४॥
units.english: By mystic yoga, great austerities and the renounced order of life, the pure destinations of Maharloka, Janoloka, Tapoloka and Satyaloka are attained. But by devotional yoga, one achieves My transcendental abode.

parts.sanskrit:
योगस्य तपसश्चैव ज्ञानस्य गतयोऽमलाः।
महर्जनस्तपः सत्यं भक्तियोगस्य मद्गतिः॥ ११/२४/१४॥

महरादीनामपि भक्तियोगोऽपेक्षित एव आधिक्येनापेक्षितत्वाद् भक्तियोगस्य मद्गतिरित्युक्तम्।
“नैव विष्णावभक्तस्य महर्लोकादिका गतिः।
भक्त्युद्रेकात् क्रमादूर्ध्वं यावद् विष्णुप्रवेशनम्।
एवं ज्ञानं विना साऽपि महर्लोकादिका गतिः।
ज्ञानोद्रेकात् क्रमादूर्ध्वं यावद् विष्णुप्रवेशनम्।
नित्यशो भगवद्रूपस्यापरोक्ष्येण दर्शनम्।
मुहूर्तमात्रं ज्ञानं स्यान्महाज्ञानं ततोऽधिकम्।
ज्ञानेन ब्रह्मलोकः स्यान्महाज्ञानाद्धरेर्गतिः।
सदैवाखण्डितं ज्ञानं तप इत्युच्यते बुधैः।
अपरोक्षदृशा युक्तं नित्यं षण्मात्रकालया।
अपरोक्षदृशा नित्यं एकमात्रायुजा युतम्।
योगनाम्ना समुद्दिष्टं ध्यानं नित्यमखण्डितम्।
तच्चतुर्भागया नित्यमपरोक्षदृशा युतम्।
पादयोगाख्यमुद्दिष्टं ध्यानं नित्यमखण्डितम्।
पादयोगान्महर्लोको
जनोलोकस्तु
योगतः।
तपसस्तु तपोलोकः प्राप्यते नान्यतः क्वचित्॥”
इति ध्यानयोगे॥ १४॥

meta.english_verbatim: By mystic yoga, great austerities and the renounced order of life, the pure destinations of Maharloka, Janoloka, Tapoloka and Satyaloka are attained. But by devotional yoga, one achieves My transcendental abode.

units.sanskrit:
मया कालात्मना धात्रा कर्मयुक्तमिदं जगत्।
गुणप्रवाह एतस्मिन्नुन्मज्जति निमज्जति॥ ११/२४/१५॥
units.english: All results of actions aimed at results have been arranged within this world by Me, the supreme creator acting as the force of time. Thus one sometimes rises up toward the surface of this mighty river of the modes of nature and sometimes again submerges.

parts.sanskrit:

गुणप्रवाह एतस्मिन्नुन्मज्जति निमज्जति॥ ११/२४/१५॥

units.sanskrit:
अणुर्बृहत् कृशः स्थूलो यो यो भावः प्रसिध्यति।
सर्वं ह्युभयसंयुक्तं प्रकृत्या पुरुषेण च॥ ११/२४/१६॥
units.english: Whatever features visibly exist within this world — small or great, thin or stout — certainly contain both the material nature and its enjoyer, the spirit soul.

meta.english_verbatim: Whatever features visibly exist within this world — small or great, thin or stout — certainly contain both the material nature and its enjoyer, the spirit soul.

units.sanskrit:
यस्तु यस्यादिरन्तश्च स वै मध्ये च तस्य तत्।
विकारो व्यवहारार्थो यथा तैजसपार्थिवाः॥ ११/२४/१७॥
units.english: Gold and earth are originally existing as ingredients. From gold one may fashion golden ornaments such as bracelets and earrings, and from earth one may fashion clay pots and saucers. The original ingredients gold and earth exist before the products made from them, and when the products are eventually destroyed, the original ingredients, gold and earth, will remain. Thus, since the ingredients are present in the beginning and at the end, they must also be present in the middle phase, taking the form of a particular product to which we assign for convenience a particular name, such as bracelet, earring, pot or saucer. We can therefore understand that since the ingredient cause exists before the creation of a product and after the product’s destruction, the same ingredient cause must be present during the manifest phase, supporting the product as the basis of its reality.

parts.sanskrit:

तथैवैकांशतो
भेदः सोऽपि नाभेदवर्जितः।
भेदाभेदमतः प्राहुरभेदं वा तयोर्बुधाः॥”

units.sanskrit:
यदुपादाय पूर्वस्तु भावो विकुरुते परम्।
आदिरन्तो यतो यस्मिंस्तत् सत्यमभिधीयते॥ ११/२४/१८॥
units.english: A material object, itself composed of an essential ingredient, creates another material object through transformation. Thus one created object becomes the cause and basis of another created object. A particular thing may thus be called real in that it possesses the basic nature of another object that constitutes its origin and final state.

parts.sanskrit:
यदुपादाय पूर्वस्तु भावो विकुरुते परम्।
आदिरन्तो यतो यस्मिंस्तत् सत्यमभिधीयते॥ ११/२४/१८॥

“पारमार्थिकसत्यत्वं स्वातन्त्र्यमभिधीयते।
तद् विष्णोरेव नान्यस्य तदन्येषां सदाऽस्तिता॥”
इति च।
यद् ब्रह्मोपादाय पूर्वः प्रकृत्यादिरादिरन्तश्च यद् ब्रह्मणि यस्मात् तस्माद् ब्रह्म परमार्थसत्यम्॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: A material object, itself composed of an essential ingredient, creates another material object through transformation. Thus one created object becomes the cause and basis of another created object. A particular thing may thus be called real in that it possesses the basic nature of another object that constitutes its origin and final state.

units.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिर्ह्यस्योपादानमाधारः पुरुषः परः।
सतोऽभिव्यञ्जकः कालो ब्रह्म तत् त्रितयं त्वहम्॥ ११/२४/१९॥
units.english: The material universe may be considered real, having nature as its original ingredient and final state. Lord Mahā-Viṣṇu is the resting place of nature, which becomes manifest by the power of time. Thus nature, the almighty Viṣṇu and time are not different from Me, the Supreme Absolute Truth.

parts.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिर्ह्यस्योपादानमाधारः पुरुषः परः।
सतोऽभिव्यञ्जकः कालो ब्रह्म तत् त्रितयं त्वहम्॥ ११/२४/१९॥

परः पुरुषो हिरण्यगर्भः कालोऽपि रूपान्तरेण स एव।
“कालाभिमानी ब्रह्मा तु काल इत्यभिशब्दितः।
सर्वजीवाभिमानी स परः पुरुष उच्यते।
प्रकृतिर्नाम तत्पत्नी प्रकृतेरभिमानिनी।
सा प्रसूते जगत् सर्वं सूत्रमारभ्य सर्वशः॥”
इति च।
“आधारो व्यञ्जकश्चैव प्रसवीता च केशवः।
कालप्रकृतिपुंसां च तन्मूलप्रकृतेरपि।
आधारो व्यञ्जकश्चैव सर्वस्यापि नियामकः॥”
इति च॥ १९॥

meta.english_verbatim: The material universe may be considered real, having nature as its original ingredient and final state. Lord Mahā-Viṣṇu is the resting place of nature, which becomes manifest by the power of time. Thus nature, the almighty Viṣṇu and time are not different from Me, the Supreme Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit:
सर्गः प्रवर्तते तावत् पौर्वापर्येण नित्यशः।
महान् गुणविसर्गोऽर्थः स्थित्यन्तो यावदीक्षणम्॥ ११/२४/२०॥
units.english: As long as the Lord continues to glance upon nature, the material world continues to exist, perpetually manifesting through procreation the great and variegated flow of universal creation.

parts.sanskrit:
सर्गः प्रवर्तते तावत् पौर्वापर्येण नित्यशः।
महान् गुणविसर्गोऽर्थः स्थित्यन्तो यावदीक्षणम्॥ ११/२४/२०॥
यावत्स्थितिरस्ति तावदुत्पत्तिरस्त्येव। यावदीक्षणं यावत् प्रलयः स्यादिति भगवतः स्मरणम्॥ २०॥

meta.english_verbatim: As long as the Supreme Personality of Godhead continues to glance upon nature, the material world continues to exist, perpetually manifesting through procreation the great and variegated flow of universal creation.

units.sanskrit:
विराण्मयाऽऽसाद्यमानो लोककल्पविकल्पकः।
पञ्चत्वायाविशेषाय कल्पते भुवनैः सह॥ ११/२४/२१॥
units.english: I am the basis of the universal form, which displays endless variety through the repeated creation, maintenance and destruction of the planetary systems. Originally containing within itself all planets in their dormant state, My universal form manifests the varieties of created existence by arranging the coordinated combination of the five elements.

parts.sanskrit:
विराण्मयाऽऽसाद्यमानो लोककल्पविकल्पकः।
पञ्चत्वायाविशेषाय कल्पते भुवनैः सह॥ ११/२४/२१॥
“विशेषेण गुणोद्रेकाद् विशेषः पृथिवी स्मृता” इति प्रवृत्ते। पञ्चत्वानन्तरमविशेषाय॥ २१॥

Originally containing within itself all planets in their dormant state, My universal form manifests the varieties of created existence by arranging the coordinated combination of the five elements.

units.sanskrit:
अन्ने प्रलीयते मर्त्य अन्नं धानासु लीयते।
धाना भूमौ प्रलीयन्ते भूमिर्गन्धे प्रलीयते॥ ११/२४/२२॥
अप्सु प्रलीयते गन्ध आपश्च स्वगुणे रसे।
लीयते ज्योतिषि रसो ज्योती रूपे प्रलीयते॥ ११/२४/२३॥
रूपं वायौ स च स्पर्शे लीयते सोपि चाम्बरे।
अम्बरं शब्दतन्मात्र इन्द्रियाणि स्वयोनिषु॥ ११/२४/२४॥
योनिर्वैकारिके सौम्य लीयते महतीश्वरे।
शब्दो भूतादिमप्येति भूतादिर्महति प्रभुः॥ ११/२४/२५॥
स लीयते महान् स्वेषु गुणेषु गुणवत्तमः।
तेऽव्यक्ते सम्प्रलीयन्ते तत् काले लीयतेऽव्यये॥ ११/२४/२६॥
कालो मायामये जीवे जीव आत्मनि मय्यजे।
आत्मा केवल आत्मस्थो विकल्पापायलक्षणः॥ ११/२४/२७॥
units.english: At the time of annihilation, the mortal body of the living being becomes merged into food. Food merges into the grains, and the grains merge back into the earth. The earth merges into its subtle sensation, fragrance. Fragrance merges into water, and water further merges into its own quality, taste. That taste merges into fire, which merges into form. Form merges into touch, and touch merges into ether. Ether finally merges into the sensation of sound. The senses all merge into their own origins, the presiding gods, and they, O gentle Uddhava, merge into the controlling mind, which itself merges into false ego in the mode of goodness. Sound becomes one with false ego in the mode of ignorance, and all-powerful false ego, the first of all the physical elements, merges into the total nature. The total material nature, the primary repository of the three basic modes, dissolves into the modes. These modes of nature then merge into the unmanifest form of nature, and that unmanifest form merges into time. Time merges into the Supreme Lord, present in the form of the omniscient Mahā-puruṣa, the original activator of all living beings. That origin of all life merges into Me, the unborn Supreme Soul, who remains alone, established within Himself. It is from Him that all creation and annihilation are manifested.

units.sanskrit:
एवमन्वीक्षमाणस्य कथं वैकल्पिको भ्रमः।
मनसो हृदि तिष्ठेत व्योम्नीवार्कोदये तमः॥ ११/२४/२८॥
units.english: Just as the rising sun removes the darkness of the sky, similarly, this scientific knowledge of cosmic annihilation removes all illusory duality from the mind of a serious student. Even if illusion somehow enters his heart, it cannot remain there.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as the rising sun removes the darkness of the sky, similarly, this scientific knowledge of cosmic annihilation removes all illusory duality from the mind of a serious student. Even if illusion somehow enters his heart, it cannot remain there.

units.sanskrit:
एष साङ्ख्यविधिः प्रोक्तः संशयग्रन्थिहेतिकः।
प्रतिलोमानुलोमाभ्यां परावरदृशा मया॥ ११/२४/२९॥
units.english: Thus I, the perfect seer of everything material and spiritual, have spoken this knowledge of Sāṅkhya, which destroys the illusion of doubt by scientific analysis of creation and annihilation.

parts.sanskrit:
एष साङ्ख्यविधिः प्रोक्तः संशयग्रन्थिहेतिकः।
प्रतिलोमानुलोमाभ्यां परावरदृशा मया॥ ११/२४/२९॥

“गायत्री चैव सावित्री तथैव च सरस्वती।
एवं त्रिरूपा प्रकृतिर्ब्रह्मपत्नी प्रकीर्तिता।
महत्तत्त्वात्मको ब्रह्मा तज्जत्वात् तत्र लीयते।
गुणाधिकः पतिरपि तस्याः सत्त्वादिभेदतः।
त्रिविधा मूलरूपायां प्रकृत्यां सा प्रलीयते।
प्रकृतिर्मूलरूपा सा ब्रह्मपत्नी जगन्मया।
पुरुषाभिधे विरिञ्चे तु स स्वस्मिन्
कालसञ्ज्ञके।
कालाभिधो विरिञ्चस्तु महालक्ष्म्यां विलीयते।
जीवमायेति यामाहुः सा च सत्त्वादिभेदतः।
त्रिविधैकत्वमापाद्य विष्णावेव विलीयते।
हरेरत्यन्तसामीप्यं लयो लक्ष्म्याः प्रकीर्तितः।
पुरुषेणापि सामीप्यं प्रकृतेर्लय उच्यते।
ब्रह्मा च प्रकृतिश्चैव मुक्तिगौ विलये यतः।
अतस्तौ भिन्नदेहौ तु ज्ञानमात्रौ समीपगौ॥”
इत्यादि च॥ २९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Thus I, the perfect seer of everything material and spiritual, have spoken this knowledge of Sāṅkhya, which destroys the illusion of doubt by scientific analysis of creation and annihilation.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
गुणानामप्यमिश्राणां पुमान् येन यथा भवेत्।
तन्मे पुरुषवर्येदमुपधारय शंसतः॥ ११/२५/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: O best among men, please listen as I describe to you how the living being attains a particular nature by association with individual material modes.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: O best among men, please listen as I describe to you how the living entity attains a particular nature by association with individual material modes.

units.sanskrit:
शमो दमस्तितिक्षेक्षा तपः सत्यं दया स्मृतिः।
तुष्टिस्त्यागोऽस्पृहा श्रद्धा ह्वीः क्षमा निस्तुतिर्धृतिः॥ ११/२५/२॥
काम ईहा मदस्तृष्णा स्तम्भ आशीर्भिदाऽसुखम्।
मनोत्साहो यशः प्रीतिर्धाष्र्ट्यवीर्यबलोद्यमाः॥ ११/२५/३॥
क्रोधो लोभोऽनृतं हिंसा माया डम्भोऽक्षमा कलिः।
शोकमोहौ विषादार्ती निद्राऽऽशा भीरनुद्यमः॥ ११/२५/४॥
सत्वस्य रजसश्चैताः तमसश्चानुपूर्वशः।
वृत्तयो वर्णितप्रायाः सन्निपातमथो शृणु॥ ११/२५/५॥
units.english: Mind and sense control, tolerance, discrimination, sticking to one’s prescribed duty, truthfulness, mercy, careful study of the past and future, satisfaction in any condition, generosity, renunciation of sense enjoyment, faith in the teacher, being embarrassed at improper action, charity, simplicity, humbleness and satisfaction within oneself are qualities of the mode of goodness. Material desire, great endeavor, audacity, dissatisfaction even in gain, false pride, praying for material advancement, considering oneself different and better than others, sense enjoyment, rash eagerness to fight, a fondness for hearing oneself praised, the tendency to ridicule others, advertising one’s own prowess and justifying one’s actions by one’s strength are qualities of the mode of passion. Intolerant anger, stinginess, speaking without scriptural authority, violent hatred, living as a parasite, hypocrisy, chronic fatigue, quarrel, lamentation, delusion, unhappiness, depression, sleeping too much, false expectations, fear and laziness constitute the major qualities of the mode of ignorance. Now please hear about the combination of these three modes.

parts.sanskrit:
शमो दमस्तितिक्षेक्षा तपः सत्यं दया स्मृतिः।
तुष्टिस्त्यागोऽस्पृहा श्रद्धा ह्वीः क्षमा निस्तुतिर्धृतिः॥ ११/२५/२॥
काम ईहा मदस्तृष्णा स्तम्भ आशीर्भिदाऽसुखम्।
मनोत्साहो यशः प्रीतिर्धाष्र्ट्यवीर्यबलोद्यमाः॥ ११/२५/३॥
क्रोधो लोभोऽनृतं हिंसा माया डम्भोऽक्षमा कलिः।
शोकमोहौ विषादार्ती निद्राऽऽशा भीरनुद्यमः॥ ११/२५/४॥
सत्वस्य रजसश्चैताः तमसश्चानुपूर्वशः।
वृत्तयो वर्णितप्रायाः सन्निपातमथो शृणु॥ ११/२५/५॥

“राजसेऽपि यदा दुःखं तामसे किमुतेति तत्।
राजसे दुःखवचनं तामसेऽतिविवक्षया॥”
इति प्रद्योते॥ ३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Mind and sense control, tolerance, discrimination, sticking to one’s prescribed duty, truthfulness, mercy, careful study of the past and future, satisfaction in any condition, generosity, renunciation of sense gratification, faith in the spiritual master, being embarrassed at improper action, charity, simplicity, humbleness and satisfaction within oneself are qualities of the mode of goodness. Material desire, great endeavor, audacity, dissatisfaction even in gain, false pride, praying for material advancement, considering oneself different and better than others, sense gratification, rash eagerness to fight, a fondness for hearing oneself praised, the tendency to ridicule others, advertising one’s own prowess and justifying one’s actions by one’s strength are qualities of the mode of passion. Intolerant anger, stinginess, speaking without scriptural authority, violent hatred, living as a parasite, hypocrisy, chronic fatigue, quarrel, lamentation, delusion, unhappiness, depression, sleeping too much, false expectations, fear and laziness constitute the major qualities of the mode of ignorance. Now please hear about the combination of these three modes.

units.sanskrit:
सन्निपातस्त्वहमिति ममेत्युद्धव या मतिः।
व्यवहारः सन्निपाते मनोमात्रेन्द्रियासुभिः॥ ११/२५/६॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, the combination of all three modes is present in the mentality of “I” and “mine.” The ordinary transactions of this world, which are carried out through the agency of the mind, the objects of perception, the senses and the vital airs of the physical body, are also based on the combination of the modes.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, the combination of all three modes is present in the mentality of “I” and “mine.” The ordinary transactions of this world, which are carried out through the agency of the mind, the objects of perception, the senses and the vital airs of the physical body, are also based on the combination of the modes.

units.sanskrit:
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च यदाऽसौ परिनिष्ठितः।
गुणानां सन्निकर्षोऽयं श्रद्धारतिधनावहः॥ ११/२५/७॥
units.english: When a person devotes himself to religiosity, economic development and sense enjoyment, the faith, wealth and sensual enjoyment obtained by his endeavors display the interaction of the three modes of nature.

meta.english_verbatim: When a person devotes himself to religiosity, economic development and sense gratification, the faith, wealth and sensual enjoyment obtained by his endeavors display the interaction of the three modes of nature.

units.sanskrit:
प्रवृत्तिलक्षणां निष्ठां पुमान् यर्हि गृहाश्रमे।
स्वधर्मे चानुतिष्ठेत गुणानां समितिर्हि सा॥ ११/२५/८॥
units.english: When a man desires sense enjoyment, being attached to family life, and when he consequently becomes established in religious and occupational duties, the combination of the modes of nature is manifest.

meta.english_verbatim: When a man desires sense gratification, being attached to family life, and when he consequently becomes established in religious and occupational duties, the combination of the modes of nature is manifest.

units.sanskrit:
पुरुषं सत्वसंयुक्तमनुमायाच्छमादिभिः।
कामादिभी रजोयुक्तं क्रोधाद्यैस्तमसाऽऽवृतम्॥ ११/२५/९॥
units.english: A person exhibiting qualities such as self-control is understood to be predominantly in the mode of goodness. Similarly, a passionate person is recognized by his lust, and one in ignorance is recognized by qualities such as anger.

meta.english_verbatim: A person exhibiting qualities such as self-control is understood to be predominantly in the mode of goodness. Similarly, a passionate person is recognized by his lust, and one in ignorance is recognized by qualities such as anger.

units.sanskrit:
यदा भजति मां भक्त्या निरपेक्षः स्वकर्मभिः।
तं सत्वप्रकृतिं विद्यात् पुरुषं स्त्रियमेव वा॥ ११/२५/१०॥
units.english: Any person, whether man or woman, who worships Me with loving devotion, offering his or her prescribed duties unto Me without material attachment, is understood to be situated in goodness.

meta.english_verbatim: Any person, whether man or woman, who worships Me with loving devotion, offering his or her prescribed duties unto Me without material attachment, is understood to be situated in goodness.

units.sanskrit:
यदा आशिष आशास्य मां यजेत स्वकर्मभिः।
तं रजःप्रकृतिं विद्यात् हिंसामाशास्य तामसम्॥ ११/२५/११॥
units.english: When a person worships Me by his prescribed duties with the hope of gaining material benefit, his nature should be understood to be in passion, and one who worships Me with the desire to commit violence against others is in ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: When a person worships Me by his prescribed duties with the hope of gaining material benefit, his nature should be understood to be in passion, and one who worships Me with the desire to commit violence against others is in ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
सत्वं रजस्तम इति गुणा जीवस्य नैव मे।
चित्तजा यैस्तु भूतानां सज्जमानो निबध्यते॥ ११/२५/१२॥
units.english: The three modes of material nature — goodness, passion and ignorance — influence the living being but not Me. Manifesting within his mind, they induce the living being to become attached to material bodies and other created objects. In this way the living being is bound up.

meta.english_verbatim: The three modes of material nature — goodness, passion and ignorance — influence the living entity but not Me. Manifesting within his mind, they induce the living entity to become attached to material bodies and other created objects. In this way the living entity is bound up.

units.sanskrit:
यदेतरौ जयेत् सत्वं भास्वरं विशदं शिवम्।
तदा सुखेन युज्येत धर्मज्ञानादिभिः पुमान्॥ ११/२५/१३॥
units.english: When the mode of goodness, which is luminous, pure and auspicious, predominates over passion and ignorance, a man becomes endowed with happiness, virtue, knowledge and other good qualities.

meta.english_verbatim: When the mode of goodness, which is luminous, pure and auspicious, predominates over passion and ignorance, a man becomes endowed with happiness, virtue, knowledge and other good qualities.

units.sanskrit:
यदा जयेत् तमस्सत्वे रजः सङ्गभिदाचलम्।
तदा दुःखेन युज्येत कर्मणा यशसा श्रिया॥ ११/२५/१४॥
units.english: When the mode of passion, which causes attachment, separatism and activity, conquers ignorance and goodness, a man begins to work hard to acquire prestige and fortune. Thus in the mode of passion he experiences anxiety and struggle.

meta.english_verbatim: When the mode of passion, which causes attachment, separatism and activity, conquers ignorance and goodness, a man begins to work hard to acquire prestige and fortune. Thus in the mode of passion he experiences anxiety and struggle.

units.sanskrit:
यदा जयेद् रजस्सत्वे तमो मूढो ह्ययं जनः।
युज्येत शोकमोहाभ्यां निद्रया हिंसयाऽऽशया॥ ११/२५/१५॥
units.english: When the mode of ignorance conquers passion and goodness, it covers one’s consciousness and makes one foolish and dull. Falling into lamentation and illusion, a person in the mode of ignorance sleeps excessively, indulges in false hopes, and displays violence toward others.

meta.english_verbatim: When the mode of ignorance conquers passion and goodness, it covers one’s consciousness and makes one foolish and dull. Falling into lamentation and illusion, a person in the mode of ignorance sleeps excessively, indulges in false hopes, and displays violence toward others.

units.sanskrit:
यदा चित्तं प्रसीदेत इन्द्रियाणां च निर्वृतिः।
देहेऽभयं मनोऽसङ्गं तत् सत्वं विद्धि मत्पदम्॥ ११/२५/१६॥
units.english: When consciousness becomes clear and the senses are detached from matter, one experiences fearlessness within the material body and detachment from the material mind. You should understand this situation to be the predominance of the mode of goodness, in which one has the opportunity to realize Me.

meta.english_verbatim: When consciousness becomes clear and the senses are detached from matter, one experiences fearlessness within the material body and detachment from the material mind. You should understand this situation to be the predominance of the mode of goodness, in which one has the opportunity to realize Me.

units.sanskrit:
विकुर्वन् क्रियया चाधीरनिवृत्तिश्च चेतसः।
गात्रास्वास्थ्यं मनो भ्रान्तं रज एतैर्निशामय॥ ११/२५/१७॥
units.english: You should discern the mode of passion by its symptoms — the distortion of the intelligence because of too much activity, the inability of the perceiving senses to disentangle themselves from mundane objects, an unhealthy condition of the working physical organs, and the unsteady perplexity of the mind.

meta.english_verbatim: You should discern the mode of passion by its symptoms — the distortion of the intelligence because of too much activity, the inability of the perceiving senses to disentangle themselves from mundane objects, an unhealthy condition of the working physical organs, and the unsteady perplexity of the mind.

units.sanskrit:
सीदच्चितं विलीयेत चेतसो ग्रहणेऽक्षमम्।
मनो नष्टं तमोग्लानिस्तमस्तदुपधारय॥ ११/२५/१८॥
units.english: When one’s higher awareness fails and finally disappears and one is thus unable to concentrate his attention, his mind is ruined and manifests ignorance and depression. You should understand this situation to be the predominance of the mode of ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: When one’s higher awareness fails and finally disappears and one is thus unable to concentrate his attention, his mind is ruined and manifests ignorance and depression. You should understand this situation to be the predominance of the mode of ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
एधमाने गुणे सत्त्वे देवानां बलमेधते।
असुराणां च रजसि तमस्युद्धव रक्षसाम्॥ ११/२५/१९॥
units.english: With the increase of the mode of goodness, the strength of the gods similarly increases. When passion increases, the demoniac become strong. And with the rise of ignorance, O Uddhava, the strength of the most wicked increases.

meta.english_verbatim: With the increase of the mode of goodness, the strength of the demigods similarly increases. When passion increases, the demoniac become strong. And with the rise of ignorance, O Uddhava, the strength of the most wicked increases.

units.sanskrit:
सत्वाज्जागरणं विद्याद् रजसा स्वप्नमादिशेत्।
प्रस्वापः तमसा जन्तोस्तुरीयं त्रिष्वसङ्गतम्॥ ११/२५/२०॥
units.english: It should be understood that alert wakefulness comes from the mode of goodness, sleep with dreaming from the mode of passion, and deep, dreamless sleep from the mode of ignorance. The fourth state of consciousness pervades these three and is transcendental.

meta.english_verbatim: It should be understood that alert wakefulness comes from the mode of goodness, sleep with dreaming from the mode of passion, and deep, dreamless sleep from the mode of ignorance. The fourth state of consciousness pervades these three and is transcendental.

units.sanskrit:
उपर्युपरि गच्छन्ति सत्वेनाब्रह्मणो जनाः।
तमसा अधोऽध आमुख्याद् रजसाऽन्तरचारिणः॥ ११/२५/२१॥
units.english: Learned persons dedicated to Vedic culture are elevated by the mode of goodness to higher and higher positions. The mode of ignorance, on the other hand, forces one to fall headfirst into lower and lower births. And by the mode of passion one continues transmigrating through human bodies.

meta.english_verbatim: Learned persons dedicated to Vedic culture are elevated by the mode of goodness to higher and higher positions. The mode of ignorance, on the other hand, forces one to fall headfirst into lower and lower births. And by the mode of passion one continues transmigrating through human bodies.

units.sanskrit:
सत्वे प्रलीनाः स्वर्यान्ति नरलोकं रजोलयाः।
तमोलयास्तु निरयं यान्ति मामेव निर्गुणाः॥ ११/२५/२२॥
units.english: Those who leave this world in the mode of goodness go to the heavenly planets, those who pass away in the mode of passion remain in the world of human beings, and those dying in the mode of ignorance must go to hell. But those who are free from the influence of all modes of nature come to Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Those who leave this world in the mode of goodness go to the heavenly planets, those who pass away in the mode of passion remain in the world of human beings, and those dying in the mode of ignorance must go to hell. But those who are free from the influence of all modes of nature come to Me.

units.sanskrit:
मदर्पणं निष्फलं वा सात्विकं निजकर्म तत्।
राजसं फलसङ्कल्पं हिंसाप्रायादि तामसम्॥ ११/२५/२३॥
units.english: Work performed as an offering to Me, without consideration of the fruit, is considered to be in the mode of goodness. Work performed with a desire to enjoy the results is in the mode of passion. And work impelled by violence and envy is in the mode of ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: Work performed as an offering to Me, without consideration of the fruit, is considered to be in the mode of goodness. Work performed with a desire to enjoy the results is in the mode of passion. And work impelled by violence and envy is in the mode of ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
कैवल्यं सात्विकं ज्ञानं कर्मनिष्ठं तु राजसम्।
प्राकृतं तामसं ज्ञानं मन्निष्ठं निर्गुणं स्मृतम्॥ ११/२५/२४॥
units.english: Absolute knowledge is in the mode of goodness, knowledge based on duality is in the mode of passion, and foolish, materialistic knowledge is in the mode of ignorance. Knowledge based upon Me, however, is understood to be transcendental.

parts.sanskrit:
कैवल्यं सात्विकं ज्ञानं कर्मनिष्ठं तु राजसम्।
प्राकृतं तामसं ज्ञानं मन्निष्ठं निर्गुणं स्मृतम्॥ ११/२५/२४॥

“नैर्गुण्यसाधनं यत् तन्निर्गुणं परिकीर्तितम्” इति च।
“यथाशास्त्रोक्तविज्ञानं केवलं ज्ञानमुच्यते।
स्वदृष्टशास्त्रानुकूल्याददृष्टानां च भक्तितः।
गुणानां तु हरौ भावं विनिश्चित्यैतदाश्रयात्।
यथाशास्त्रानुसन्धानं ज्ञानं तु हरिसंश्रयम्॥”
इति च॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Absolute knowledge is in the mode of goodness, knowledge based on duality is in the mode of passion, and foolish, materialistic knowledge is in the mode of ignorance. Knowledge based upon Me, however, is understood to be transcendental.

units.sanskrit:
वनं तु सात्विको वासो ग्रामो राजस उच्यते।
तामसं द्यूतसदनं मन्निकेतं तु निर्गुणम्॥ ११/२५/२५॥
units.english: Residence in the forest is in the mode of goodness, residence in a town is in the mode of passion, residence in a gambling house displays the quality of ignorance, and residence in a place where I reside is transcendental.

meta.english_verbatim: Residence in the forest is in the mode of goodness, residence in a town is in the mode of passion, residence in a gambling house displays the quality of ignorance, and residence in a place where I reside is transcendental.

units.sanskrit:
सात्विकः कारकोऽसङ्गी रागान्धो राजसः स्मृतः।
तामसः स्मृतिविभ्रष्टो निर्गुणो मदपाश्रयः॥ ११/२५/२६॥
units.english: A worker free of attachment is in the mode of goodness, a worker blinded by personal desire is in the mode of passion, and a worker who has completely forgotten how to tell right from wrong is in the mode of ignorance. But a worker who has taken shelter of Me is understood to be transcendental to the modes of nature.

meta.english_verbatim: A worker free of attachment is in the mode of goodness, a worker blinded by personal desire is in the mode of passion, and a worker who has completely forgotten how to tell right from wrong is in the mode of ignorance. But a worker who has taken shelter of Me is understood to be transcendental to the modes of nature.

units.sanskrit:
सात्विक्याध्यात्मिका श्रद्धा कर्मश्रद्धा तु राजसी।
तामस्यधर्मे या श्रद्धा मत्सेवायां तु निर्गुणा॥ ११/२५/२७॥
units.english: Faith directed toward spiritual life is in the mode of goodness, faith rooted in actions aimed at results is in the mode of passion, faith residing in irreligious activities is in the mode of ignorance, but faith in My devotion is purely transcendental.

parts.sanskrit:
सात्विक्याध्यात्मिका श्रद्धा कर्मश्रद्धा तु राजसी।
तामस्यधर्मे या श्रद्धा मत्सेवायां तु निर्गुणा॥ ११/२५/२७॥

“श्रुतशास्त्रानुसारेण या श्रद्धा परमात्मनि।
सा सात्त्विकी तदन्यस्याप्यनुसारेण निर्गुणा।
अश्रुत्वाऽपि प्रमाणं यो वासुदेवैकसंश्रयः।
स निर्गुणो भागवतः समुद्दिष्टो मनीषिभिः॥”
इति च॥२७॥

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Faith directed toward spiritual life is in the mode of goodness, faith rooted in fruitive work is in the mode of passion, faith residing in irreligious activities is in the mode of ignorance, but faith in My devotional service is purely transcendental.

units.sanskrit:
पथ्यं युक्तमनायस्तमाहार्यं सात्विकं स्मृतम्।
राजसं चेन्द्रियप्रेष्ठं तामसं चार्तिदाशुचि॥ ११/२५/२८॥
units.english: Food that is wholesome, pure and obtained without difficulty is in the mode of goodness, food that gives immediate pleasure to the senses is in the mode of passion, and food that is unclean and causes distress is in the mode of ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: Food that is wholesome, pure and obtained without difficulty is in the mode of goodness, food that gives immediate pleasure to the senses is in the mode of passion, and food that is unclean and causes distress is in the mode of ignorance.

units.sanskrit:
सात्विकं सुखमात्मोत्थं विषयोत्थं तु राजसम्।
तामसं मोहदैन्योत्थं निर्गुणं मदपाश्रयम्॥ ११/२५/२९॥
units.english: Happiness derived from the self is in the mode of goodness, happiness based on sense enjoyment is in the mode of passion, and happiness based on delusion and degradation is in the mode of ignorance. But that happiness found within Me is transcendental.

parts.sanskrit:
सात्विकं सुखमात्मोत्थं विषयोत्थं तु राजसम्।
तामसं मोहदैन्योत्थं निर्गुणं मदपाश्रयम्॥ ११/२५/२९॥

“परोक्षज्ञानमात्मोत्थमापरोक्ष्येण दर्शनम्।
विष्ण्वाश्रयं सुखं नित्यं गमयेत् तत्प्रसादतः।
नतु विष्णोः स्वरूपं तु सुखं केनचिदाप्यते।
तस्यैव विषयत्वात् तु तत्सुखं चेति भण्यते।
परोक्षज्ञानगो यस्माद् विषयः स्वमनोगतः।
अत आत्मोत्थमित्येव सुखमाहुर्विपश्चितः॥”
इति च॥ २९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Happiness derived from the self is in the mode of goodness, happiness based on sense gratification is in the mode of passion, and happiness based on delusion and degradation is in the mode of ignorance. But that happiness found within Me is transcendental.

units.sanskrit:
द्रव्यं देशः फलं कालो ज्ञानं कर्म च कारकम्।
श्रद्धाऽवस्था कृतिर्निष्ठा त्रैगुण्याः सर्व एव हि॥ ११/२५/३०॥
units.english: Therefore material substance, place, result of activity, time, knowledge, work, the performer of work, faith, state of consciousness, species of life and destination after death are all based on the three modes of material nature.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore material substance, place, result of activity, time, knowledge, work, the performer of work, faith, state of consciousness, species of life and destination after death are all based on the three modes of material nature.

units.sanskrit:
सर्वे गुणमया भावाः पुरुषाव्यक्तनिष्ठिताः।
दृष्टं श्रुतमनुध्यायेद् बुद्ध्या वा पुरुषर्षभ॥ ११/२५/३१॥
units.english: O best of human beings, all states of material being are related to the interaction of the enjoying soul and material nature. Whether seen, heard of or only conceived within the mind, they are without exception constituted of the modes of nature.

parts.sanskrit:
सर्वे गुणमया भावाः पुरुषाव्यक्तनिष्ठिताः।
दृष्टं श्रुतमनुध्यायेद् बुद्ध्या वा पुरुषर्षभ॥ ११/२५/३१॥
दृष्टं श्रुतं बुद्ध्या दृष्टं चानु परं ब्रह्म ध्यायेत्॥ ३१॥

meta.english_verbatim: O best of human beings, all states of material being are related to the interaction of the enjoying soul and material nature. Whether seen, heard of or only conceived within the mind, they are without exception constituted of the modes of nature.

units.sanskrit:
एताः संसृतयः पुंसां गुणकर्मनिबन्धनाः।
येनैते निर्जिताः सौम्य गुणा जीवेन चित्तजाः।
भक्तियोगेन मन्निष्ठो मद्भावाय प्रपद्यते॥ ११/२५/३२॥
units.english: O gentle Uddhava, all these different phases of conditioned life arise from work born of the modes of material nature. The living being who conquers these modes, manifested from the mind, can dedicate himself to Me by the process of devotion and thus attain pure love for Me.

meta.english_verbatim: O gentle Uddhava, all these different phases of conditioned life arise from work born of the modes of material nature. The living entity who conquers these modes, manifested from the mind, can dedicate himself to Me by the process of devotional service and thus attain pure love for Me.

units.sanskrit:
सत्वं चाभिजयेत् युक्तो नैरपेक्ष्येण शान्तधीः।
सम्पद्यते गुणैर्मुक्तो जीवं जीवो विहाय माम्॥ ११/२५/३३॥
units.english: Therefore, having achieved this human form of life, which allows one to develop full knowledge, those who are intelligent should free themselves from all contamination of the modes of nature and engage exclusively in loving service to Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, having achieved this human form of life, which allows one to develop full knowledge, those who are intelligent should free themselves from all contamination of the modes of nature and engage exclusively in loving service to Me.

units.sanskrit:
तस्माद् देहमिमं लब्ध्वा ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्भवम्।
मयैव ब्रह्मणा पूर्णो न बहिर्नान्तरश्चरेत्॥ ११/२५/३४॥
units.english: A wise sage, free from all material association and unbewildered, should subdue his senses and worship Me. He should conquer the modes of passion and ignorance by engaging himself only with things in the mode of goodness.

parts.sanskrit:
तस्माद् देहमिमं लब्ध्वा ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्भवम्।
मयैव ब्रह्मणा पूर्णो न बहिर्नान्तरश्चरेत्॥ ११/२५/३४॥

“सत्त्वाद् गुणाज्जातमपि व्यवधानं विनैव तु।
मुक्तिदं निर्गुणं प्रोक्तं व्यवधानेन सात्त्विकम्॥”
इति ब्राह्मे॥ ३४॥

meta.english_verbatim: A wise sage, free from all material association and unbewildered, should subdue his senses and worship Me. He should conquer the modes of passion and ignorance by engaging himself only with things in the mode of goodness.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
मल्लक्षणमिमं कायं लब्ध्वा मद्धर्ममास्थितः।
आनन्दं परमात्मानमात्मस्थं समुपैति माम्॥ ११/२६/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: Having achieved this human form of life, which affords one the opportunity to realize Me, and being situated in My devotion, one can achieve Me, the reservoir of all pleasure and the Supreme Soul of all existence, residing within the heart of every living being.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Having achieved this human form of life, which affords one the opportunity to realize Me, and being situated in My devotional service, one can achieve Me, the reservoir of all pleasure and the Supreme Soul of all existence, residing within the heart of every living being.

units.sanskrit:
गुणमय्या जीवयोन्या विमुक्तो ज्ञाननिष्ठया।
गुणेषु मायामात्रेषु दृश्यमानेष्ववस्तुतः।
वर्तमानोऽपि न पुमान् युज्यतेऽवस्तुभिर्गुणैः॥ ११/२६/२॥
units.english: A person fixed in transcendental knowledge is freed from conditioned life by giving up his false identification with the products of the material modes of nature. Seeing these products as simply illusion, he avoids entanglement with the modes of nature, although constantly among them. Because the modes of nature and their products are simply not real, he does not accept them.

parts.sanskrit:
गुणमय्या जीवयोन्या विमुक्तो ज्ञाननिष्ठया।
गुणेषु मायामात्रेषु दृश्यमानेष्ववस्तुतः।
वर्तमानोऽपि न पुमान् युज्यतेऽवस्तुभिर्गुणैः॥ ११/२६/२॥
“वस्तु स्वतन्त्रमुद्दिष्टमस्वतन्त्रमवस्तु च” इति माहात्म्ये॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: A person fixed in transcendental knowledge is freed from conditioned life by giving up his false identification with the products of the material modes of nature. Seeing these products as simply illusion, he avoids entanglement with the modes of nature, although constantly among them. Because the modes of nature and their products are simply not real, he does not accept them.

units.sanskrit:
सङ्गं न कुर्यादसतां शिश्नोदरतृपां क्वचित्।
तस्यानुगस्तमस्यन्धे पतत्यन्धानुगान्धवत्॥ ११/२६/३॥
units.english: One should never associate with materialists, those dedicated to gratifying their genitals and bellies. By following them one falls into the deepest pit of darkness, just like a blind man who follows another blind man.

meta.english_verbatim: One should never associate with materialists, those dedicated to gratifying their genitals and bellies. By following them one falls into the deepest pit of darkness, just like a blind man who follows another blind man.

units.sanskrit:
ऐळः सम्राडिमां गाधामगायत बृहच्छ्रवाः।
उर्वशीविरहान्मुह्यन् निर्विण्णः शोकविक्ल्बः॥ ११/२६/४॥
units.english: The following song was sung by the famous emperor Purūravā. When deprived of his wife, Urvaśī, he was at first bewildered, but by controlling his lamentation he began to feel detachment.

meta.english_verbatim: The following song was sung by the famous emperor Purūravā. When deprived of his wife, Urvaśī, he was at first bewildered, but by controlling his lamentation he began to feel detachment.

units.sanskrit:
त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं व्रजन्तीं तां नग्न उन्मत्तवन्नृपः।
विलपन्नन्वगाज्जाये घोरे तिष्ठेति विक्ल्बः॥ ११/२६/५॥
units.english: When she was leaving him, even though he was naked he ran after her just like a madman and called out in great distress, “O my wife, O terrible lady! Please stop!”

meta.english_verbatim: When she was leaving him, even though he was naked he ran after her just like a madman and called out in great distress, “O my wife, O terrible lady! Please stop!”

units.sanskrit:
कामानतृप्तोऽनुजुषन् क्षुल्लकान् वर्षयामिनीः।
न वेद गणनां यान्तीमुर्वश्याऽऽकृष्टचेतनः॥ ११/२६/६॥
units.english: Although for many years Purūravā had enjoyed sex pleasure in the evening hours, still he was not satisfied by such insignificant enjoyment. His mind was so attracted to Urvaśī that he did not notice how the nights were coming and going.

meta.english_verbatim: Although for many years Purūravā had enjoyed sex pleasure in the evening hours, still he was not satisfied by such insignificant enjoyment. His mind was so attracted to Urvaśī that he did not notice how the nights were coming and going.

units.sanskrit:
ऐळ उवाच
अहो मे मोहविस्तारः कामकश्मलचेतसः।
देव्या गृहीतकण्ठस्य नायुःखण्डा अनुस्मृताः॥ ११/२६/७॥
units.english: King Aila said: Alas, just see the extent of my delusion! This goddess was embracing me and held my neck in her grip. My heart was so polluted by lust that I had no idea how my life was passing.

meta.english_verbatim: King Aila said: Alas, just see the extent of my delusion! This goddess was embracing me and held my neck in her grip. My heart was so polluted by lust that I had no idea how my life was passing.

units.sanskrit:
नाहं वेदाभिनिर्मुक्तः सूर्येणाभ्युदितो मृषा।
मुषितो वर्षपूगानां बताहानि गतान्युत॥ ११/२६/८॥
units.english: That lady cheated me so much that I did not even see the rising or setting of the sun. Alas, for so many years I passed my days in vain!

meta.english_verbatim: That lady cheated me so much that I did not even see the rising or setting of the sun. Alas, for so many years I passed my days in vain!

units.sanskrit:
अहो मे आत्मसम्मोहो येनात्मा योषिता हृतः।
क्रीडामृगश्चक्रवर्ती नरदेवशिखामणिः॥ ११/२६/९॥
units.english: Alas, although I am supposed to be a mighty emperor, the crown jewel of all kings on this earth, just see how my bewilderment has rendered me a toy animal in the hands of women!

meta.english_verbatim: Alas, although I am supposed to be a mighty emperor, the crown jewel of all kings on this earth, just see how my bewilderment has rendered me a toy animal in the hands of women!

units.sanskrit:
सपरिच्छदमात्मानं हित्वा तृणमिवेश्वरम्।
यान्तीं स्त्रियं चान्वगमं नग्न उन्मत्तवद् रुदन्॥ ११/२६/१०॥
units.english: Although I was a powerful lord with great opulence, that woman gave me up as if I were no more than an insignificant blade of grass. And still, naked and without shame, I followed her, crying out to her like a madman.

meta.english_verbatim: Although I was a powerful lord with great opulence, that woman gave me up as if I were no more than an insignificant blade of grass. And still, naked and without shame, I followed her, crying out to her like a madman.

units.sanskrit:
कुतस्तस्यानुभावः स्यात् तेज ईशित्वमेव वा।
योऽन्वगच्छं स्त्रियं यान्तीं स्मरबाणविताडितः॥ ११/२६/११॥
units.english: Where are my so-called great influence, power and sovereignty? Just like an ass being kicked in the face by his she-ass, I ran after that woman, who had already given me up.

meta.english_verbatim: Where are my so-called great influence, power and sovereignty? Just like an ass being kicked in the face by his she-ass, I ran after that woman, who had already given me up.

units.sanskrit:
किं विद्यया किं तपसा किं त्यागेन श्रुतेन वा।
किं विविक्तेन मौनेन स्त्रीभिर्यस्य मनो हृतम्॥ ११/२६/१२॥
units.english: What is the use of a big education or the practice of austerities and renunciation, and what is the use of studying religious scriptures, of living in solitude and silence, if, after all that, one’s mind is stolen by a woman?

meta.english_verbatim: What is the use of a big education or the practice of austerities and renunciation, and what is the use of studying religious scriptures, of living in solitude and silence, if, after all that, one’s mind is stolen by a woman?

units.sanskrit:
स्वार्थस्याकोविदं धिङ् मां मूर्खं पण्डितमानिनम्।
योऽहमीश्वरतां प्राप्य स्त्रीभिर्गोखरवज्जितः॥ ११/२६/१३॥
units.english: To hell with me! I am such a fool that I didn’t even know what was good for me, although I arrogantly thought I was highly intelligent. Although I achieved the exalted position of a lord, I allowed myself to be conquered by women as if I were a bullock or a jackass.

meta.english_verbatim: To hell with me! I am such a fool that I didn’t even know what was good for me, although I arrogantly thought I was highly intelligent. Although I achieved the exalted position of a lord, I allowed myself to be conquered by women as if I were a bullock or a jackass.

units.sanskrit:
सेवतो वर्षपूगान्मे उर्वश्या अधरासवम्।
न तृप्त आत्मभूः कामो वह्निराहुतिभिर्यथा॥ ११/२६/१४॥
units.english: Even after I had served the so-called nectar of the lips of Urvaśī for many years, my lusty desires kept rising again and again within my heart and were never satisfied, just like a fire that can never be extinguished by the oblations of ghee poured into its flames.

meta.english_verbatim: Even after I had served the so-called nectar of the lips of Urvaśī for many years, my lusty desires kept rising again and again within my heart and were never satisfied, just like a fire that can never be extinguished by the oblations of ghee poured into its flames.

units.sanskrit:
पुंश्चल्याऽपहृतं चित्तं को न्वन्यो मोचितुं प्रभुः।
आत्मारामेश्वरमृते भगवन्तमधोक्षजम्॥ ११/२६/१५॥
units.english: Who but the Lord, who lies beyond material perception and is the Lord of self-satisfied sages, can possibly save my consciousness, which has been stolen by a prostitute?

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: Who but the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who lies beyond material perception and is the Lord of self-satisfied sages, can possibly save my consciousness, which has been stolen by a prostitute?

units.sanskrit:
बोधितस्यापि देव्या मे सूक्तवाक्येन दुर्मतेः।
मनोगतो महामोहो नापयात्यजितात्मनः॥ ११/२६/१६॥
units.english: Because I allowed my intelligence to become dull and because I failed to control my senses, the great confusion in my mind did not go away, even though Urvaśī herself gave me wise counsel with well-spoken words.

meta.english_verbatim: Because I allowed my intelligence to become dull and because I failed to control my senses, the great confusion in my mind did not go away, even though Urvaśī herself gave me wise counsel with well-spoken words.

units.sanskrit:
किं न्वेतया म एकान्ते रज्ज्वां वै सर्पचेतसः।
द्रष्टुः स्वरूपाविदुषो योऽहं यदजितेन्द्रियः॥ ११/२६/१७॥
units.english: How can I blame her for my trouble when I myself am ignorant of my real, spiritual nature? I did not control my senses, and so I am like a person who mistakenly sees a harmless rope as a snake.

meta.english_verbatim: How can I blame her for my trouble when I myself am ignorant of my real, spiritual nature? I did not control my senses, and so I am like a person who mistakenly sees a harmless rope as a snake.

units.sanskrit:
क्वायं मलीमसः कायो दौर्गन्ध्याद्यात्मकोऽशुचिः।
क्व गुणाः सौमनस्याद्या ह्यध्यासोऽविद्यया कृतः॥ ११/२६/१८॥
units.english: What is this polluted body anyway — so filthy and full of bad odors? I was attracted by the fragrance and beauty of a woman’s body, but what are those so-called attractive features? They are simply a false covering created by illusion.

meta.english_verbatim: What is this polluted body anyway — so filthy and full of bad odors? I was attracted by the fragrance and beauty of a woman’s body, but what are those so-called attractive features? They are simply a false covering created by illusion.

units.sanskrit:
पित्रोः किं स्विन्नु भार्यायाः स्वामिनोऽग्नेः श्वगृध्रयोः।
किमात्मनः किं सुहृदामिति यो नावसीयते॥ ११/२६/१९॥
तस्मिन् कळेबरे मेध्ये तुच्छनिष्ठे विषज्जते।
अहो सुभद्रं सुनसं सुस्मितं च मुखं स्त्रियः॥ ११/२६/२०॥
units.english: One can never decide whose property the body actually is. Does it belong to one’s parents, who have given birth to it, to one’s wife, who gives it pleasure, or to one’s employer, who orders the body around? Is it the property of the funeral fire or of the dogs and jackals who may ultimately devour it? Is it the property of the indwelling soul, who partakes in its happiness and distress, or does the body belong to intimate friends who encourage and help it? Although a man never definitely ascertains the proprietor of the body, he becomes most attached to it. The material body is a polluted material form heading toward a lowly destination, yet when a man stares at the face of a woman he thinks, “What a good-looking lady! What a charming nose she’s got, and see her beautiful smile!”

meta.english_verbatim: One can never decide whose property the body actually is. Does it belong to one’s parents, who have given birth to it, to one’s wife, who gives it pleasure, or to one’s employer, who orders the body around? Is it the property of the funeral fire or of the dogs and jackals who may ultimately devour it? Is it the property of the indwelling soul, who partakes in its happiness and distress, or does the body belong to intimate friends who encourage and help it? Although a man never definitely ascertains the proprietor of the body, he becomes most attached to it. The material body is a polluted material form heading toward a lowly destination, yet when a man stares at the face of a woman he thinks, “What a good-looking lady! What a charming nose she’s got, and see her beautiful smile!”

units.sanskrit:
त्वङ्मांसरुधिरस्नायुमेदोमज्जास्थिसंहतौ।
विण्मूत्रपूये रमतां कृमीणां कियदन्तरम्॥ ११/२६/२१॥
units.english: What difference is there between ordinary worms and persons who try to enjoy this material body composed of skin, flesh, blood, muscle, fat, marrow, bone, stool, urine and pus?

meta.english_verbatim: What difference is there between ordinary worms and persons who try to enjoy this material body composed of skin, flesh, blood, muscle, fat, marrow, bone, stool, urine and pus?

units.sanskrit:
अथापि नो विषज्जेत स्त्रीषु स्त्रैणेषु चार्थवित्।
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगान्मनः क्षुभ्यति नान्यदा॥ ११/२६/२२॥
units.english: Yet even one who theoretically understands the actual nature of the body should never associate with women or with men attached to women. After all, the contact of the senses with their objects inevitably agitates the mind.

meta.english_verbatim: Yet even one who theoretically understands the actual nature of the body should never associate with women or with men attached to women. After all, the contact of the senses with their objects inevitably agitates the mind.

units.sanskrit:
अदृष्टादश्रुताद् भावान्न भाव उपजायते।
असंप्रयुञ्जतः प्राणान् शाम्यति स्तिमितं मनः॥ ११/२६/२३॥
units.english: Because the mind is not disturbed by that which is neither seen nor heard, the mind of a person who restricts the material senses will automatically be checked in its material activities and become pacified.

meta.english_verbatim: Because the mind is not disturbed by that which is neither seen nor heard, the mind of a person who restricts the material senses will automatically be checked in its material activities and become pacified.

units.sanskrit:
तस्माद् सङ्गो न कर्तव्यः स्त्रीषु स्त्रैणेषु चेन्द्रियैः।
विदुषां चाप्यविस्रभ्यः षड्वर्गः किमु मादृशाम्॥ ११/२६/२४॥
units.english: Therefore one should never let his senses associate freely with women or with men attached to women. Even those who are highly learned cannot trust the six enemies of the mind; what to speak, then, of foolish persons like me.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore one should never let his senses associate freely with women or with men attached to women. Even those who are highly learned cannot trust the six enemies of the mind; what to speak, then, of foolish persons like me.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
एवं प्रगायन् नृपदेवदेवः स उर्वशीलोकमथो विहाय।
आत्मानमात्मन्यवगम्य मां वा उपारमज्ज्ञानविधूतमोहः॥ ११/२६/२५॥
units.english: The Lord said: Having thus chanted this song, King Purūravā, eminent among the gods and human beings, gave up the position he had achieved in the planet of Urvaśī. His illusion cleansed away by transcendental knowledge, he understood Me to be the Supreme Soul within his heart and so at last achieved peace.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Having thus chanted this song, Mahārāja Purūravā, eminent among the demigods and human beings, gave up the position he had achieved in the planet of Urvaśī. His illusion cleansed away by transcendental knowledge, he understood Me to be the Supreme Soul within his heart and so at last achieved peace.

units.sanskrit:
ततो दुःसङ्गमुत्सृज्य सत्सु सज्जेत बुध्दिमान्।
सन्त एवास्य छिन्दन्ति मनोव्यासङ्गमुक्तिभिः॥ ११/२६/२६॥
units.english: An intelligent person should therefore reject all bad association and instead take up the association of saintly devotees, whose words cut off the excessive attachment of one’s mind.

meta.english_verbatim: An intelligent person should therefore reject all bad association and instead take up the association of saintly devotees, whose words cut off the excessive attachment of one’s mind.

units.sanskrit:
सन्तोऽनपेक्षा मच्चित्ताः प्रशान्ताः समदर्शनाः।
निर्ममा निरहङ्कारा निर्द्वन्द्वा निष्परिग्रहाः॥ ११/२६/२७॥
units.english: My devotees fix their minds on Me and do not depend upon anything material. They are always peaceful, endowed with equal vision, and free from possessiveness, false ego, duality and greed.

meta.english_verbatim: My devotees fix their minds on Me and do not depend upon anything material. They are always peaceful, endowed with equal vision, and free from possessiveness, false ego, duality and greed.

units.sanskrit:
तेषु नित्यं महाभाग महाभागेषु मत्कथाः।
सम्भवन्ति हिता नॄणां जुषतां प्रपुनन्त्यघम्॥ ११/२६/२८॥
units.english: O greatly fortunate Uddhava, in the association of such saintly devotees there is constant discussion of Me, and those partaking in this chanting and hearing of My glories are certainly purified of all sins.

meta.english_verbatim: O greatly fortunate Uddhava, in the association of such saintly devotees there is constant discussion of Me, and those partaking in this chanting and hearing of My glories are certainly purified of all sins.

units.sanskrit:
ता ये शृण्वन्ति गायन्ति ह्यनुमोदन्ति चादृताः।
मत्पराः श्रद्धधानाश्च भक्तिं विन्दन्ति ते मयि॥ ११/२६/२९॥
units.english: Whoever hears, chants and respectfully takes to heart these topics about Me becomes faithfully dedicated to Me and thus achieves My devotion.

meta.english_verbatim: Whoever hears, chants and respectfully takes to heart these topics about Me becomes faithfully dedicated to Me and thus achieves My devotional service.

units.sanskrit:
भक्तिं लब्धवतः साधो किमन्यदवशिष्यते।
मय्यनन्तगुणे ब्रह्मण्यानन्दानुभवात्मनि॥ ११/२६/३०॥
units.english: What more remains to be accomplished for the perfect devotee after achieving devotion unto Me, the Supreme Absolute Truth, whose qualities are innumerable and who am the embodiment of all ecstatic experience?

meta.english_verbatim: What more remains to be accomplished for the perfect devotee after achieving devotional service unto Me, the Supreme Absolute Truth, whose qualities are innumerable and who am the embodiment of all ecstatic experience?

units.sanskrit:
यथोपाश्रयमाणस्य भगवन्तं विभावसुम्।
शीतं भयं तमो व्येति साधून् संसेवतस्तथा॥ ११/२६/३१॥
units.english: Just as cold, fear and darkness are eradicated for one who has approached the sacrificial fire, so dullness, fear and ignorance are destroyed for one engaged in serving the devotees of the Lord.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as cold, fear and darkness are eradicated for one who has approached the sacrificial fire, so dullness, fear and ignorance are destroyed for one engaged in serving the devotees of the Lord.

units.sanskrit:
निमज्ज्योन्मज्जतां घोरे भवाब्धौ ते परायणम्।
सन्तो ब्रह्मविदः शान्ता नौर्दृढेवाप्सु मज्जताम्॥ ११/२६/३२॥
units.english: The devotees of the Lord, peacefully fixed in absolute knowledge, are the ultimate shelter for those who are repeatedly rising and falling within the fearful ocean of material life. Such devotees are just like a strong boat that comes to rescue persons who are at the point of drowning.

meta.english_verbatim: The devotees of the Lord, peacefully fixed in absolute knowledge, are the ultimate shelter for those who are repeatedly rising and falling within the fearful ocean of material life. Such devotees are just like a strong boat that comes to rescue persons who are at the point of drowning.

units.sanskrit:
अन्नं हि प्राणिनां प्राण आर्तानां शरणं त्वहम्।
धर्मो वित्तं नृणां प्रेत्य सन्तोऽतो बिभ्यतोऽरणम्॥ ११/२६/३३॥
units.english: Just as food is the life of all creatures, just as I am the ultimate shelter for the distressed, and just as religion is the wealth of those who are passing away from this world, so My devotees are the only refuge of persons fearful of falling into a miserable condition of life.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as food is the life of all creatures, just as I am the ultimate shelter for the distressed, and just as religion is the wealth of those who are passing away from this world, so My devotees are the only refuge of persons fearful of falling into a miserable condition of life.

units.sanskrit:
सन्तो दिशन्ति चक्षूंषि बहिरर्कः समुत्थितः।
देवता बान्धवाः सन्तः पिता माताऽहमेव च॥ ११/२६/३४॥
units.english: My devotees bestow divine eyes, whereas the sun allows only external sight, and that only when it is risen in the sky. My devotees are one’s real worshipable deities and real family; they are one’s own self, and ultimately they are nondifferent from Me.

meta.english_verbatim: My devotees bestow divine eyes, whereas the sun allows only external sight, and that only when it is risen in the sky. My devotees are one’s real worshipable deities and real family; they are one’s own self, and ultimately they are nondifferent from Me.

units.sanskrit:
चेतसेळासुतोऽप्येवमुर्वश्या लोकनिःस्पृहः।
मुक्तसङ्गो महीमेतामात्मारामश्चचार ह॥ ११/२६/३५॥
units.english: Thus losing his desire to be on the same planet as Urvaśī, King Purūravā began to wander the earth free of all material association and completely satisfied within the self.

parts.sanskrit:
चेतसेळासुतोऽप्येवमुर्वश्या लोकनिःस्पृहः।
मुक्तसङ्गो महीमेतामात्मारामश्चचार ह॥ ११/२६/३५॥

भगवतोऽपि सतां मध्ये प्रधानत्वात् सन्तोऽहमेव चेत्युक्तम्।
“विष्णोश्च सत्प्रधानत्वान्न सतां विद्यते परम्।
इत्याहुर्वेदविदुषः स हि सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः॥”
इति च॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Thus losing his desire to be on the same planet as Urvaśī, Mahārāja Purūravā began to wander the earth free of all material association and completely satisfied within the self.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
क्रियायोगं समाचक्ष्व भवदाराधनं प्रभो।
येन त्वां ये यथाऽर्चन्ति सात्वताः सात्वतर्षभ॥ ११/२७/१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord, O master of the devotees, please explain to me the prescribed method of worshiping You in Your Deity form. What are the qualifications of those devotees who worship the Deity, on what basis is such worship established, and what is the specific method of worship?

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord, O master of the devotees, please explain to me the prescribed method of worshiping You in Your Deity form. What are the qualifications of those devotees who worship the Deity, on what basis is such worship established, and what is the specific method of worship?

units.sanskrit:
एतद् वदन्ति मुनयो मुहुर्निःश्रेयसं नृणाम्।
नारदो भगवान् व्यास आचार्योऽङ्गिरसः सुतः॥ ११/२७/२॥
units.english: All the great sages repeatedly declare that such worship brings the greatest benefit possible in human life. This is the opinion of Nārada Muni, the great Vyāsadeva and my own teacher, Bṛhaspati.

meta.english_verbatim: All the great sages repeatedly declare that such worship brings the greatest benefit possible in human life. This is the opinion of Nārada Muni, the great Vyāsadeva and my own spiritual master, Bṛhaspati.

units.sanskrit:
निःसृतं ते मुखाम्भोजाद् यदाह भगवानजः।
पुत्रेभ्यो भृगुमुख्येभ्यो देव्यै च भगवान् भवः॥ ११/२७/३॥
एतद् वै सर्ववर्णानामाश्रमाणां च सम्मतम्।
श्रेयसामुत्तमं मन्ये स्त्रीशूद्राणां च मानद॥ ११/२७/४॥
units.english: O most magnanimous Lord, the instructions on this process of Deity worship first emanated from Your lotus mouth. Then they were spoken by the great Lord Brahmā to his sons, headed by Bhṛgu, and by Lord Śiva to his wife, Pārvatī. This process is accepted by and appropriate for all the occupational and spiritual orders of society. Therefore I consider worship of You in Your Deity form to be the most beneficial of all spiritual practices, even for women and śūdras.

meta.english_verbatim: O most magnanimous Lord, the instructions on this process of Deity worship first emanated from Your lotus mouth. Then they were spoken by the great Lord Brahmā to his sons, headed by Bhṛgu, and by Lord Śiva to his wife, Pārvatī. This process is accepted by and appropriate for all the occupational and spiritual orders of society. Therefore I consider worship of You in Your Deity form to be the most beneficial of all spiritual practices, even for women and śūdras.

units.sanskrit:
एतद्धि कमलपत्राक्ष कर्मबन्धविमोचनम्।
भक्ताय चानुरक्ताय ब्रूहि विश्वेश्वरेश्वर॥ ११/२७/५॥
units.english: O lotus-eyed one, O Supreme Lord of all lords of the universe, please explain to Your devoted servant this means of liberation from the bondage of work.

meta.english_verbatim: O lotus-eyed one, O Supreme Lord of all lords of the universe, please explain to Your devoted servant this means of liberation from the bondage of work.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
न ह्यन्तोऽनन्तपारस्य कर्मकाण्डस्य चोद्धव।
संक्षिप्तं वर्णयिष्यामि यथावदनुपूर्वशः॥ ११/२७/६॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, there is no end to the innumerable Vedic prescriptions for executing Deity worship; so I shall explain this topic to you briefly, one step at a time.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, there is no end to the innumerable Vedic prescriptions for executing Deity worship; so I shall explain this topic to you briefly, one step at a time.

units.sanskrit:
वैदिकस्तान्त्रिको मिश्र इति मे त्रिविधो मखः।
त्रयाणामीप्सितेनैव विधिना मां समर्चयेत्॥ ११/२७/७॥
units.english: One should carefully worship Me by selecting one of the three methods by which I receive sacrifice: Vedic, tantric or mixed.

meta.english_verbatim: One should carefully worship Me by selecting one of the three methods by which I receive sacrifice: Vedic, tantric or mixed.

units.sanskrit:
यथा स्वनिगमेनोक्तं द्विजत्वं प्राप्य पूरुषः।
यथा भजेत मां भक्त्या श्रद्धया तं निबोध मे॥ ११/२७/८॥
units.english: Now please listen faithfully as I explain exactly how a person who has achieved twice-born status through the relevant Vedic prescriptions should worship Me with devotion.

meta.english_verbatim: Now please listen faithfully as I explain exactly how a person who has achieved twice-born status through the relevant Vedic prescriptions should worship Me with devotion.

units.sanskrit:
अर्चायां स्थण्डिलेऽग्नौ वा सूर्येऽप्सु हृदि वा द्विजे।
द्रव्येण भक्तियुक्तोऽर्चेत् स्वगुरुं माममायया॥ ११/२७/९॥
units.english: A twice-born person should worship Me, his worshipable Lord, without duplicity, offering appropriate paraphernalia in loving devotion to My Deity form or to a form of Me appearing upon the ground, in fire, in the sun, in water or within the worshiper’s own heart.

meta.english_verbatim: A twice-born person should worship Me, his worshipable Lord, without duplicity, offering appropriate paraphernalia in loving devotion to My Deity form or to a form of Me appearing upon the ground, in fire, in the sun, in water or within the worshiper’s own heart.

units.sanskrit:
पूर्वं स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत धौतदन्तोऽङ्गशुद्धये।
उभयैरपि च स्नानं मन्त्रैर्मृद्ग्रहणादिभिः॥ ११/२७/१०॥
units.english: One should first purify his body by cleansing his teeth and bathing. Then one should perform a second cleansing by smearing the body with earth and chanting both Vedic and tantric mantras.

meta.english_verbatim: One should first purify his body by cleansing his teeth and bathing. Then one should perform a second cleansing by smearing the body with earth and chanting both Vedic and tantric mantras.

units.sanskrit:
सन्ध्योपास्त्यादिकर्माणि विधिनाऽऽवेदितानि मे।
पूजां तैः कल्पयेत् सम्यक् सङ्कल्पः कर्मपावनः॥ ११/२७/११॥
units.english: Fixing the mind on Me, one should worship Me by his various prescribed duties, such as chanting the Gāyatrī mantra at the three junctures of the day. Such performances are enjoined by the Vedas and purify the worshiper of reactions to actions aimed at results.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Fixing the mind on Me, one should worship Me by his various prescribed duties, such as chanting the Gāyatrī mantra at the three junctures of the day. Such performances are enjoined by the Vedas and purify the worshiper of reactions to fruitive activities.

units.sanskrit:
शैली दारुमयी लौही लेप्या लेख्या च सैकती।
मनोमयी मणिमयी प्रतिमाऽष्टविधा स्मृता॥ ११/२७/१२॥
units.english: The Deity form of the Lord is said to appear in eight varieties — stone, wood, metal, earth, paint, sand, the mind or jewels.

meta.english_verbatim: The Deity form of the Lord is said to appear in eight varieties — stone, wood, metal, earth, paint, sand, the mind or jewels.

units.sanskrit:
