चलाचलेति द्विविधा प्रतिष्ठा जीवमन्दिरम्।
उद्वासावाहने न स्तः स्थिरायामुद्धवार्चने॥ ११/२७/१३॥
units.english: The Deity form of the Lord, who is the shelter of all living beings, can be established in two ways: temporarily or permanently. But a permanent Deity, having been called, can never be sent away, My dear Uddhava.

meta.english_verbatim: The Deity form of the Lord, who is the shelter of all living entities, can be established in two ways: temporarily or permanently. But a permanent Deity, having been called, can never be sent away, My dear Uddhava.

units.sanskrit:
अस्थिरायां विकल्पः स्यात् स्थण्डिले तु भवेद् द्वयम्।
स्नपनं तु विलेप्यायामन्यत्र परिमार्जनम्॥ ११/२७/१४॥
units.english: The Deity that is temporarily established can optionally be called forth and sent away, but these two rituals should always be performed when the Deity is traced upon the ground. Bathing should be done with water except if the Deity is made of clay, paint or wood, in which cases a thorough cleansing without water is enjoined.

meta.english_verbatim: The Deity that is temporarily established can optionally be called forth and sent away, but these two rituals should always be performed when the Deity is traced upon the ground. Bathing should be done with water except if the Deity is made of clay, paint or wood, in which cases a thorough cleansing without water is enjoined.

units.sanskrit:
द्रव्यैः प्रसिद्धैर्मद्यागः प्रतिमादिष्वमायिनः।
भक्त्या चैव यथालब्धैर्हृदि भावेन चैव हि॥ ११/२७/१५॥
units.english: One should worship Me in My Deity forms by offering the most excellent paraphernalia. But a devotee completely freed from material desire may worship Me with whatever he is able to obtain, and may even worship Me within his heart with mental paraphernalia.

meta.english_verbatim: One should worship Me in My Deity forms by offering the most excellent paraphernalia. But a devotee completely freed from material desire may worship Me with whatever he is able to obtain, and may even worship Me within his heart with mental paraphernalia.

units.sanskrit:
स्नानालङ्करणं प्रेष्ठमर्चायामेव तूद्धव।
स्थण्डिले तत्वविन्यासो वह्नावाज्यप्लुतं हविः॥ ११/२७/१६॥
सूर्ये चाभ्यर्हणं प्रेष्ठं सलिले सलिलादिभिः।
श्रद्धयोपहृतं प्रेष्ठं भक्तेन मम वार्यपि।
गन्धो धूपः सुमनसो दीपोऽन्नाद्यं च किं पुनः॥ ११/२७/१७॥
units.english: In worshiping the temple Deity, my dear Uddhava, bathing and decoration are the most pleasing offerings. For the Deity traced on sacred ground, the process of tattva-vinyāsa is most dear. Oblations of sesame and barley soaked in ghee are the preferred offering to the sacrificial fire, whereas worship consisting of upasthāna and arghya is preferred for the sun. One should worship Me in the form of water by offering water itself. Actually, whatever is offered to Me with faith by My devotee — even if only a little water — is most dear to Me.

meta.english_verbatim: In worshiping the temple Deity, my dear Uddhava, bathing and decoration are the most pleasing offerings. For the Deity traced on sacred ground, the process of tattva-vinyāsa is most dear. Oblations of sesame and barley soaked in ghee are the preferred offering to the sacrificial fire, whereas worship consisting of upasthāna and arghya is preferred for the sun. One should worship Me in the form of water by offering water itself. Actually, whatever is offered to Me with faith by My devotee — even if only a little water — is most dear to Me.

units.sanskrit:
शुचिः सम्भृतसम्भारः प्राग्दर्भैः कल्पितासनः।
आसीनः प्रागुदग्वाऽर्चेदर्चायां त्वथ सम्मुखः॥ ११/२७/१८॥
units.english: After cleansing himself and collecting all the paraphernalia, the worshiper should arrange his own seat with blades of kuśa grass whose tips point eastward. He should then sit facing either east or north, or else, if the Deity is fixed in one place, he should sit directly facing the Deity.

meta.english_verbatim: After cleansing himself and collecting all the paraphernalia, the worshiper should arrange his own seat with blades of kuśa grass whose tips point eastward. He should then sit facing either east or north, or else, if the Deity is fixed in one place, he should sit directly facing the Deity.

units.sanskrit:
कृतन्यासो मदर्चां च पाणिनाऽभिमृजेद् बुधः।
कलशं प्रोक्षणीयं च यथावदुपसादयेद्॥ ११/२७/१९॥
units.english: The devotee should sanctify the various parts of his body by touching them and chanting mantras. He should do the same for My Deity form, and then with his hands he should clean the Deity of old flowers and the remnants of previous offerings. He should properly prepare the sacred pot and the vessel containing water for sprinkling.

meta.english_verbatim: The devotee should sanctify the various parts of his body by touching them and chanting mantras. He should do the same for My Deity form, and then with his hands he should clean the Deity of old flowers and the remnants of previous offerings. He should properly prepare the sacred pot and the vessel containing water for sprinkling.

units.sanskrit:
तदद्भिर्देवयजनं द्रव्याण्यात्मानमेव च।
प्रोक्ष्य पात्राणि त्रीण्यद्भिस्तैस्तैर्द्रव्यैश्च सादयेत्॥ ११/२७/२०॥
units.english: Then, with the water of that prokṣaṇīya vessel he should sprinkle the area where the Deity is being worshiped, the offerings that are going to be presented, and his own body. Next he should decorate with various auspicious substances three vessels filled with water.

meta.english_verbatim: Then, with the water of that prokṣaṇīya vessel he should sprinkle the area where the Deity is being worshiped, the offerings that are going to be presented, and his own body. Next he should decorate with various auspicious substances three vessels filled with water.

units.sanskrit:
पाद्यार्ध्याचमनीयार्थं त्रीणि पात्राणि देशिकः।
हृदा शीर्ष्णाऽथ शिखया गायत्र्या वाऽभिमन्त्रयेत्॥ ११/२७/२१॥
units.english: The worshiper should then purify those three vessels. He should sanctify the vessel holding water for washing the Lord’s feet by chanting hṛdayāya namaḥ, the vessel containing water for arghya by chanting śirase svāhā, and the vessel containing water for washing the Lord’s mouth by chanting śikhāyai vaṣaṭ. Also, the Gāyatrī mantra should be chanted for all three vessels.

meta.english_verbatim: The worshiper should then purify those three vessels. He should sanctify the vessel holding water for washing the Lord’s feet by chanting hṛdayāya namaḥ, the vessel containing water for arghya by chanting śirase svāhā, and the vessel containing water for washing the Lord’s mouth by chanting śikhāyai vaṣaṭ. Also, the Gāyatrī mantra should be chanted for all three vessels.

units.sanskrit:
पिण्डे वाय्वग्निसंशुद्धे हृत्पदम्स्थां परां मम।
अण्वीं जीवकलां ध्यायेन्नादान्ते सिद्धभाविताम्॥११/२७/२२॥
units.english: The worshiper should meditate upon My subtle form — which is situated within the worshiper’s own body, now purified by air and fire — as the source of all living beings. This form of the Lord is experienced by self-realized sages in the last part of the vibration of the sacred syllable om.

parts.sanskrit:
पिण्डे वाय्वग्निसंशुद्धे हृत्पदम्स्थां परां मम।
अण्वीं जीवकलां ध्यायेन्नादान्ते सिद्धभाविताम्॥११/२७/२२॥

जीवः कला यस्याः सा जीवकला भगवन्मूर्तिः।
“हृदिस्था या हरेर्मूर्तिर्जीवो यत्प्रतिबिम्बकः।
यद्वशे वर्तते जीवः सा तु जीवकला स्मृता।
शब्दैः सर्वात्मनाऽनुक्तेर्नादान्तस्था च सा मता॥”
इति विवेके॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: The worshiper should meditate upon My subtle form — which is situated within the worshiper’s own body, now purified by air and fire — as the source of all living entities. This form of the Lord is experienced by self-realized sages in the last part of the vibration of the sacred syllable om.

units.sanskrit:
तयाऽऽत्मभूतया पिण्डे व्याप्ते सम्पद्य तन्मयः।
आवाह्यार्चादिषु स्थाप्य न्यस्ताङ्गं मां प्रपूजयेत्॥ ११/२७/२३॥
units.english: The devotee conceives of the Supreme Self, whose presence surcharges the devotee’s body, in the form corresponding to his realization. Thus the devotee worships the Lord to his full capacity and becomes fully absorbed in Him. By touching the various limbs of the Deity and chanting appropriate mantras, the devotee should invite the Supreme Self to join the Deity’s form, and then the devotee should worship Me.

parts.sanskrit:
तयाऽऽत्मभूतया पिण्डे व्याप्ते सम्पद्य तन्मयः।
आवाह्यार्चादिषु स्थाप्य न्यस्ताङ्गं मां प्रपूजयेत्॥ ११/२७/२३॥

“व्याप्तो भूतश्च नित्यं यदात्मभूतो हरिस्ततः।
जीवस्य तत्प्रधानत्वं तन्मयत्वमुदाहृतम्॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते।
“व्याप्तोऽपि भगवान् विष्णुर्देहे सर्वगतत्वतः।
भक्तस्य फलदो यस्माद् व्याप्तिकृत् तस्य तेन सः॥”
इति च॥ २३॥

meta.english_verbatim: The devotee conceives of the Supersoul, whose presence surcharges the devotee’s body, in the form corresponding to his realization. Thus the devotee worships the Lord to his full capacity and becomes fully absorbed in Him. By touching the various limbs of the Deity and chanting appropriate mantras, the devotee should invite the Supersoul to join the Deity’s form, and then the devotee should worship Me.

units.sanskrit:
पाद्योपस्पर्शनार्घ्यादीनुपचारान् प्रकल्पयेत्।
धर्मादिभिश्च नवभिः कल्पयित्वाऽऽसनं मम॥ ११/२७/२४॥
units.english: The worshiper should first imagine My seat as decorated with the personified deities of religion, knowledge, renunciation and opulence and with My nine spiritual energies. He should think of the Lord’s sitting place as an eight-petaled lotus, effulgent on account of the saffron filaments within its whorl. Then, following the regulations of both the Vedas and the tantras, he should offer Me water for washing the feet, water for washing the mouth, arghya and other items of worship. By this process he achieves both material enjoyment and liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: The worshiper should first imagine My seat as decorated with the personified deities of religion, knowledge, renunciation and opulence and with My nine spiritual energies. He should think of the Lord’s sitting place as an eight-petaled lotus, effulgent on account of the saffron filaments within its whorl. Then, following the regulations of both the Vedas and the tantras, he should offer Me water for washing the feet, water for washing the mouth, arghya and other items of worship. By this process he achieves both material enjoyment and liberation.

units.sanskrit:
पदम्मष्टदळं तत्र कर्णिकाकेसरोज्ज्वलम्।
उभाभ्यां वेदतन्त्राभ्यां मह्यं तूभयसिद्धये॥ ११/२७/२५॥
सुदर्शनं पाञ्चजन्यं गदासीषुधनुर्हलान्।
मुसलं कौस्तुभं मालां श्रीवत्सं चानुपूजयेत्॥ ११/२७/२६॥
units.english: One should worship, in order, the Lord’s Sudarśana disc, His Pāñcajanya conchshell, His club, sword, bow, arrows and plow, His muṣala weapon, His Kaustubha gem, His flower garland and the Śrīvatsa curl of hair on His chest.

meta.english_verbatim: One should worship, in order, the Lord’s Sudarśana disc, His Pāñcajanya conchshell, His club, sword, bow, arrows and plow, His muṣala weapon, His Kaustubha gem, His flower garland and the Śrīvatsa curl of hair on His chest.

units.sanskrit:
दुर्गां विनायकं व्यासं विष्वक्सेनं गुरून् सुरान्।
स्वेस्वे स्थाने त्वभिमुखान्८ पूजयेत् प्रोक्षणादिभिः॥
चन्दनोशीरकर्पूरकुङ्कुमागरुवासितैः।
सलिलैः स्नापयेन्मन्त्रैर्नित्यदा विभवे सति॥ ११/२७/२९॥
units.english: With offerings such as prokṣaṇa one should worship Durgā, Vināyaka, Vyāsa, Viṣvaksena, the teachers and the various gods. All these personalities should be in their proper places facing the Deity of the Lord.

meta.english_verbatim: With offerings such as prokṣaṇa one should worship Durgā, Vināyaka, Vyāsa, Viṣvaksena, the spiritual masters and the various demigods. All these personalities should be in their proper places facing the Deity of the Lord.

units.sanskrit:
स्वस्य घर्मानुवाकेन महापुरुषविद्यया।
पौरुषेणापि सूक्तेन धामनीराजनादिभिः॥ ११/२७/३०॥
वस्त्रोपवीताभरणपत्रस्रग्गन्धलेपनैः।
अलङ्कुर्वीत सप्रेम मद्भक्तो मां यथोचितैः॥ ११/२७/३१॥
units.english: The worshiper should bathe the Deity every day, as opulently as his assets permit, using waters scented with sandalwood, uśīra root, camphor, kuṅkuma and aguru. He should also chant various Vedic hymns, such as the anuvāka known as Svarṇa-gharma, the Mahāpuruṣa-vidyā, the Puruṣa-sūkta and various songs of the Sāma Veda, such as the Rājana and the Rohiṇya.

parts.sanskrit:
स्वस्य घर्मानुवाकेन महापुरुषविद्यया।
पौरुषेणापि सूक्तेन धामनीराजनादिभिः॥ ११/२७/३०॥
वस्त्रोपवीताभरणपत्रस्रग्गन्धलेपनैः।
अलङ्कुर्वीत सप्रेम मद्भक्तो मां यथोचितैः॥ ११/२७/३१॥

स्वस्य विष्णुसूक्तेन। धाम सूक्तं समुद्रादूर्मिरिति।
“नितरां रञ्जयेद् यस्मात् पावमानं तु मण्डलम्।
विष्णुनीराजनं तस्माद् विद्वद्भिः समुदाहृतम्॥”
इति च॥ ३०॥

meta.english_verbatim: The worshiper should bathe the Deity every day, as opulently as his assets permit, using waters scented with sandalwood, uśīra root, camphor, kuṅkuma and aguru. He should also chant various Vedic hymns, such as the anuvāka known as Svarṇa-gharma, the Mahāpuruṣa-vidyā, the Puruṣa-sūkta and various songs of the Sāma Veda, such as the Rājana and the Rohiṇya.

units.sanskrit:
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च गन्धं सुमनसोऽञ्जनम्।
धूपदीपोपहार्याणि दद्यान्मे श्रद्धयाऽर्चकः॥ ११/२७/३२॥
units.english: The worshiper should faithfully present Me with water for washing My feet and mouth, fragrant oils, flowers and unbroken grains, along with incense, lamps and other offerings.

meta.english_verbatim: The worshiper should faithfully present Me with water for washing My feet and mouth, fragrant oils, flowers and unbroken grains, along with incense, lamps and other offerings.

units.sanskrit:
गुडपायससर्पींषि शश्कुल्यापूपमोदकान्।
संयावं दधिसूपांश्च नैवेद्यं सति कल्पयेत्॥ ११/२७/३३॥
units.english: Within his means, the devotee should arrange to offer Me sugar candy, sweet rice, ghee, śaṣkulī [rice-flour cakes], āpūpa [various sweet cakes], modaka [steamed rice-flour dumplings filled with sweet coconut and sugar], saṁyāva [wheat cakes made with ghee and milk and covered with sugar and spices], yogurt, vegetable soups and other palatable foods.

meta.english_verbatim: Within his means, the devotee should arrange to offer Me sugar candy, sweet rice, ghee, śaṣkulī [rice-flour cakes], āpūpa [various sweet cakes], modaka [steamed rice-flour dumplings filled with sweet coconut and sugar], saṁyāva [wheat cakes made with ghee and milk and covered with sugar and spices], yogurt, vegetable soups and other palatable foods.

units.sanskrit:
अभ्यङ्गोन्मर्दनादर्शदन्तधावाभिषेचनम्।
अन्नादि नृत्यगीतादि पर्वणि स्युस्तथाऽन्वहम्॥ ११/२७/३४॥
units.english: On special occasions, and daily if possible, the Deity should be massaged with ointment, shown a mirror, offered a eucalyptus stick for brushing His teeth, bathed with the five kinds of nectar, offered all kinds of opulent foods, and entertained with singing and dancing.

meta.english_verbatim: On special occasions, and daily if possible, the Deity should be massaged with ointment, shown a mirror, offered a eucalyptus stick for brushing His teeth, bathed with the five kinds of nectar, offered all kinds of opulent foods, and entertained with singing and dancing.

units.sanskrit:
विधिना विहिते कुण्डे मेखलावर्तवेदिभिः।
अग्निमाधाय परितः समूह्योत्पाणिनोदितम्॥ ११/२७/३५॥
units.english: In an arena constructed according to scriptural injunctions, the devotee should perform a fire sacrifice, utilizing the sacred belt, the sacrificial pit and the altar mound. When igniting the sacrificial fire, the devotee should bring it to a blaze with wood piled up by his own hands.

meta.english_verbatim: In an arena constructed according to scriptural injunctions, the devotee should perform a fire sacrifice, utilizing the sacred belt, the sacrificial pit and the altar mound. When igniting the sacrificial fire, the devotee should bring it to a blaze with wood piled up by his own hands.

units.sanskrit:
परिस्तीर्याथ पर्युक्षेदन्वाधाय यथाविधि।
प्रोक्षणीयानि द्रव्याणि प्रोक्ष्याग्नावावहेत माम्॥ ११/२७/३६॥
units.english: After spreading kuśa grass on the ground and sprinkling it with water, one should perform the anvādhāna ritual according to the prescribed rules. Then one should arrange the items to be offered as oblations and should sanctify them with water from the sprinkling vessel. The worshiper should next meditate upon Me within the fire.

meta.english_verbatim: After spreading kuśa grass on the ground and sprinkling it with water, one should perform the anvādhāna ritual according to the prescribed rules. Then one should arrange the items to be offered as oblations and should sanctify them with water from the sprinkling vessel. The worshiper should next meditate upon Me within the fire.

units.sanskrit:
तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रख्यं शङ्खचक्रगदाम्बुजैः।
लसच्चतुर्भुजं शान्तं पदम्किञ्जल्कवाससम्॥ ११/२७/३७॥
units.english: The intelligent devotee should meditate upon that form of the Lord whose color is like molten gold, whose four arms are resplendent with the conchshell, disc, club and lotus flower, and who is always peaceful and dressed in a garment colored like the filaments within a lotus flower. His helmet, bracelets, belt and fine arm ornaments shine brilliantly. The symbol of Śrīvatsa is on His chest, along with the glowing Kaustubha gem and a garland of forest flowers. The devotee should then worship that Lord by taking pieces of firewood soaked in the sacrificial ghee and throwing them into the fire. He should perform the ritual of āghāra, presenting into the fire the various items of oblation drenched in ghee. He should then offer to sixteen gods, beginning with Yamarāja, the oblation called sviṣṭi-kṛt, reciting the basic mantras of each deity and the sixteen-line Puruṣa-sūkta hymn. Pouring one oblation after each line of the Puruṣa-sūkta, he should utter the particular mantra naming each deity.

meta.english_verbatim: The intelligent devotee should meditate upon that form of the Lord whose color is like molten gold, whose four arms are resplendent with the conchshell, disc, club and lotus flower, and who is always peaceful and dressed in a garment colored like the filaments within a lotus flower. His helmet, bracelets, belt and fine arm ornaments shine brilliantly. The symbol of Śrīvatsa is on His chest, along with the glowing Kaustubha gem and a garland of forest flowers. The devotee should then worship that Lord by taking pieces of firewood soaked in the sacrificial ghee and throwing them into the fire. He should perform the ritual of āghāra, presenting into the fire the various items of oblation drenched in ghee. He should then offer to sixteen demigods, beginning with Yamarāja, the oblation called sviṣṭi-kṛt, reciting the basic mantras of each deity and the sixteen-line Puruṣa-sūkta hymn. Pouring one oblation after each line of the Puruṣa-sūkta, he should utter the particular mantra naming each deity.

units.sanskrit:
स्फुरत्किरीटकटककटिसूत्रवराङ्गदम्।
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं भ्राजत्कौस्तुभं वनमालिनम्॥ ११/२७/३८॥
ध्यायर्न्नभ्यच्य दारूणि हविषाऽभियुतानि च।
प्रास्याज्यभागावाघार्य दत्वा चाज्यप्लुतं हविः॥ ११/२७/३९॥
जुहुयान्मूलमन्त्रेण षोडषार्चाविधानतः।
धर्मादिभ्यो यथान्यायं मन्त्रैः स्विष्टकृतं बुधः॥ ११/२७/४०॥
अर्भ्यच्याग्निं नमस्कृत्य पार्षदेभ्यो बलिं हरेत्।
मूलमन्त्रं जपेद् ब्रह्म स्मरन् नारायणात्मकम्॥ ११/२७/४१॥
units.english: Having thus worshiped the Lord in the sacrificial fire, the devotee should offer his obeisances to the Lord’s personal associates by bowing down and should then present offerings to them. He should then chant quietly the mūla-mantra of the Deity of the Lord, remembering the Absolute Truth as the Supreme Personality, Nārāyaṇa.

meta.english_verbatim: Having thus worshiped the Lord in the sacrificial fire, the devotee should offer his obeisances to the Lord’s personal associates by bowing down and should then present offerings to them. He should then chant quietly the mūla-mantra of the Deity of the Lord, remembering the Absolute Truth as the Supreme Personality, Nārāyaṇa.

units.sanskrit:
दत्वाऽऽचमनमुच्छेषं४ विष्वक्सेनाय कल्पयेत्।
मुखवासं सुरभिमत् ताम्बूलाद्यमथार्हयेत्॥ ११/२७/४२॥
units.english: Once again he should offer the Deity water for washing His mouth, and he should give the remnants of the Lord’s food to Viṣvaksena. Then he should present the Deity with fragrant perfume for the mouth and prepared betel nut.

meta.english_verbatim: Once again he should offer the Deity water for washing His mouth, and he should give the remnants of the Lord’s food to Viṣvaksena. Then he should present the Deity with fragrant perfume for the mouth and prepared betel nut.

units.sanskrit:
उपगायन् गृणन् नृत्यन्५ कर्माण्यभिनयन् मम।
मत्कथाः श्रावयन् शृण्वन् मुहूर्तक्षणिको भवेत्॥ ११/२७/४३॥
units.english: Singing along with others, chanting loudly and dancing, acting out My transcendental pastimes, and hearing and telling stories about Me, the devotee should for some time absorb himself in such festivity.

parts.sanskrit:
उपगायन् गृणन् नृत्यन्५ कर्माण्यभिनयन् मम।
मत्कथाः श्रावयन् शृण्वन् मुहूर्तक्षणिको भवेत्॥ ११/२७/४३॥
मम कर्माणि कीर्तयित्वाऽभितो नयन् सर्वेषां प्रकाशयन् मत्कथाः श्रावयन्नित्यभिनयशब्दार्थः ॥ ४३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Singing along with others, chanting loudly and dancing, acting out My transcendental pastimes, and hearing and telling stories about Me, the devotee should for some time absorb himself in such festivity.

units.sanskrit:
स्तवैरुच्चावचैः श्रौतैः पौराणैः प्राकृतैरपि।
स्तुत्वा प्रसीद भगवन्निति वन्देत दण्डवत्॥ ११/२७/४४॥
units.english: The devotee should offer homage to the Lord with all kinds of hymns and prayers, both from the Purāṇas and from other ancient scriptures, and also from ordinary traditions. Praying, “O Lord, please be merciful to me!” he should fall down flat like a rod to offer his obeisances.

meta.english_verbatim: The devotee should offer homage to the Lord with all kinds of hymns and prayers, both from the Purāṇas and from other ancient scriptures, and also from ordinary traditions. Praying, “O Lord, please be merciful to me!” he should fall down flat like a rod to offer his obeisances.

units.sanskrit:
शिरो मत्पादयोः कृत्वा बाहुभ्यां च परस्परम्।
प्रपन्नं पाहि मामीश भीतं मृत्युग्रहार्णवात्॥ ११/२७/४५॥
units.english: Placing his head at the feet of the Deity, he should then stand with folded hands before the Lord and pray, “O my Lord, please protect me, who am surrendered unto You. I am most fearful of this ocean of material existence, standing as I am in the mouth of death.”

meta.english_verbatim: Placing his head at the feet of the Deity, he should then stand with folded hands before the Lord and pray, “O my Lord, please protect me, who am surrendered unto You. I am most fearful of this ocean of material existence, standing as I am in the mouth of death.”

units.sanskrit:
ततः शेषां मया दत्तां शिरस्याधाय सादरम्।
उद्वासयेच्चेदुद्वास्यं ज्योतिर्ज्योतिषि तत् पुनः॥ ११/२७/४६॥
units.english: Praying in this way, the devotee should respectfully place upon his head the remnants I offer to him. And if the particular Deity is meant to be sent away at the end of the worship, then this should be performed, the devotee once again placing the light of the Deity’s presence inside the light of the lotus within his own heart.

meta.english_verbatim: Praying in this way, the devotee should respectfully place upon his head the remnants I offer to him. And if the particular Deity is meant to be sent away at the end of the worship, then this should be performed, the devotee once again placing the light of the Deity’s presence inside the light of the lotus within his own heart.

units.sanskrit:
अर्चादिषु यथा यत्र श्रद्धा मां तत्र चार्चयेत्।
सर्वभूतेष्वात्मनि च सर्वात्माऽहमवस्थितः॥ ११/२७/४७॥
units.english: Whenever one develops faith in Me — in My form as the Deity or in other bona fide manifestations — one should worship Me in that form. I certainly exist both within all created beings and also separately in My original form, since I am the Supreme Soul of all.

meta.english_verbatim: Whenever one develops faith in Me — in My form as the Deity or in other bona fide manifestations — one should worship Me in that form. I certainly exist both within all created beings and also separately in My original form, since I am the Supreme Soul of all.

units.sanskrit:
एवं क्रियायोगपथैः पुमान् वैदिकतान्त्रिकैः।
अर्चानुभावतः सिद्धिं मत्तो विन्दत्यभिप्सिताम्॥ ११/२७/४८॥
units.english: By worshiping Me through the various methods prescribed in the Vedas and tantras, one will gain from Me his desired perfection in both this life and the next.

meta.english_verbatim: By worshiping Me through the various methods prescribed in the Vedas and tantras, one will gain from Me his desired perfection in both this life and the next.

units.sanskrit:
मदर्चां सम्प्रतिष्ठाप्य मन्दिरं कारयेद् दृढम्।
पुष्पोद्यानानि रम्याणि पूजां तत्रोत्सवाश्रिताम्॥ ११/२७/४९॥
units.english: The devotee should more fully establish My Deity by solidly constructing a temple, along with beautiful gardens. These gardens should be set aside to provide flowers for the regular daily worship, special Deity processions and holiday observances.

meta.english_verbatim: The devotee should more fully establish My Deity by solidly constructing a temple, along with beautiful gardens. These gardens should be set aside to provide flowers for the regular daily worship, special Deity processions and holiday observances.

units.sanskrit:
पूजादीनां प्रवाहार्थं७ महापर्वसु चान्वहम्।
क्षेत्रापणपुरग्रामान् दत्वा मत्सार्ष्टितामियात्॥ ११/२७/५०॥
units.english: One who offers the Deity gifts of land, markets, cities and villages so that the regular daily worship and special festivals of the Deity may go on continually will achieve opulence equal to My own.

meta.english_verbatim: One who offers the Deity gifts of land, markets, cities and villages so that the regular daily worship and special festivals of the Deity may go on continually will achieve opulence equal to My own.

units.sanskrit:
प्रतिष्ठया सार्वभौमं सदम्ना भुवनत्रयम्।
पूजादिना ब्रह्मलोकं त्रिभिर्मत्साम्यतामियात्॥ ११/२७/५१॥
units.english: By installing the Deity of the Lord one becomes king of the entire earth, by building a temple for the Lord one becomes ruler of the three worlds, by worshiping and serving the Deity one goes to the planet of Lord Brahmā, and by performing all three of these activities one achieves a transcendental form like My own.

meta.english_verbatim: By installing the Deity of the Lord one becomes king of the entire earth, by building a temple for the Lord one becomes ruler of the three worlds, by worshiping and serving the Deity one goes to the planet of Lord Brahmā, and by performing all three of these activities one achieves a transcendental form like My own.

units.sanskrit:
मामेव नैरपेक्ष्येण भक्तियोगेन विन्दति।
स भक्तियोगं लभते एवं यः पूजयेत माम्॥ ११/२७/५२॥
units.english: But one who simply engages in devotion with no consideration of fruitive results attains Me. Thus whoever worships Me according to the process I have described will ultimately attain pure devotion unto Me.

parts.sanskrit:
मामेव नैरपेक्ष्येण भक्तियोगेन विन्दति।
स भक्तियोगं लभते एवं यः पूजयेत माम्॥ ११/२७/५२॥

नैरपेक्ष्येण भक्तियोगेनैव साम्यमिति भावः।
“निर्दुःखत्वं हरेः साम्यं न तादृशसुखात्मता।
सर्वोत्तमः सदानन्दः कथं कस्य कदाऽऽप्यते॥”
इति प्रवृत्ते।
“आधिपत्यं त्रिलोकस्य
योग्यानामिन्द्रता स्मृता।
अयोग्यानां त्रिलोकेऽपि पूज्यत्वं समुदाहृतम्।
तद् भवेत् परया भक्त्या विष्णोरालयकारिणः।
ततोऽप्युद्रिक्तया भक्त्या विष्णुं पूजयतः सदा।
अवाप्यते ब्रह्मलोकस्तदुद्रिक्तश्च मुच्यते॥”
इति च॥ ५२॥

meta.english_verbatim: But one who simply engages in devotional service with no consideration of fruitive results attains Me. Thus whoever worships Me according to the process I have described will ultimately attain pure devotional service unto Me.

units.sanskrit:
यः स्वदत्तां परैर्दत्तां हरेत सुरविप्रयोः।
वृत्तिं स जायते विड्भुग् वर्षाणामयुतायुतम्॥ ११/२७/५३॥
units.english: Anyone who steals the property of the gods or the brāhmaṇas, whether originally given to them by himself or someone else, must live as a worm in stool for one hundred million years.

meta.english_verbatim: Anyone who steals the property of the demigods or the brāhmaṇas, whether originally given to them by himself or someone else, must live as a worm in stool for one hundred million years.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
परस्वभावकर्माणि न प्रशंसेन्न गर्हयेत्।
विश्वमेकात्मकं पश्यन् प्रकृत्या पुरुषेण च॥ ११/२८/१॥
units.english: The Lord said: One should neither praise nor criticize the conditioned nature and activities of other persons. Rather, one should see this world as simply the combination of material nature and the enjoying souls, all based on the one Absolute Truth.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
परस्वभावकर्माणि न प्रशंसेन्न गर्हयेत्।
विश्वमेकात्मकं पश्यन् प्रकृत्या पुरुषेण च॥ ११/२८/१॥

“न प्रशंसेत निन्द्यांस्तु प्रशंस्यान् नैव निन्दयेत्।
उभयं यः करोत्येतदसत्यात् स पतत्यधः।
यः प्रशंस्यान् न प्रशंसेन्निन्द्यो येन न निन्द्यते।
सोऽपि तद्वदधो याति यतोऽरिवदुदासकः॥”
इति सत्कारे।
प्रकृत्या पुरुषेण च सहैकेन परमात्मना व्याप्तमेकात्मकम्। तथा पश्यत एव यथार्थज्ञानं भवति॥ १॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: One should neither praise nor criticize the conditioned nature and activities of other persons. Rather, one should see this world as simply the combination of material nature and the enjoying souls, all based on the one Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit:
परस्वभावकर्माणि यः प्रशंसति निन्दति।
स आशु भ्रंशते स्थानादसत्याभिनिवेशतः॥ ११/२८/२॥
units.english: Whoever indulges in praising or criticizing the qualities and behavior of others will quickly become deviated from his own best interest by his entanglement in illusory dualities.

meta.english_verbatim: Whoever indulges in praising or criticizing the qualities and behavior of others will quickly become deviated from his own best interest by his entanglement in illusory dualities.

units.sanskrit:
तैजसे निद्रयाऽऽपन्ने पिण्डस्थो नष्टचेतनः।
मायां प्राप्नोति मृत्युं वा तद्धि नानार्थदं मनः॥ ११/२८/३॥
units.english: Just as the embodied spirit soul loses external consciousness when his senses are overcome by the illusion of dreaming or the deathlike state of deep sleep, so a person experiencing material duality must encounter illusion and death.

parts.sanskrit:
तैजसे निद्रयाऽऽपन्ने पिण्डस्थो नष्टचेतनः।
मायां प्राप्नोति मृत्युं वा तद्धि नानार्थदं मनः॥ ११/२८/३॥

“तैजसाहङ्कृतेर्जात इन्द्रियग्रामके परात्।
निद्रया वशमापन्ने जीवः स्यान्नष्टचेतनः।
अतो विष्णोर्वशे सर्वं तेन व्याप्तमिति स्मरेत्॥”
इति च।
“निद्रा चैव सुनिद्रा च द्विधा निद्रा प्रकीर्तिता।
तत्र निद्रा भवेन्नित्या सुनिद्रा मृतिकालगा॥”
इति पाद्मे।
“मनोमात्रस्वरूपत्वात् स्वप्नो मायेति कथ्यते”
इति च ।
तथा नानार्थदं मन एव। मनसा हि विषयाः प्रतीयन्ते॥ ३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Just as the embodied spirit soul loses external consciousness when his senses are overcome by the illusion of dreaming or the deathlike state of deep sleep, so a person experiencing material duality must encounter illusion and death.

units.sanskrit:
किं भद्रं किमभद्रं वा द्वैतस्यावस्तुनः कियत्।
वाचोदितं तदनृतं मनसा ध्यातमेव च॥ ११/२८/४॥
units.english: That which is expressed by material words or meditated upon by the material mind is not ultimate truth. What, therefore, is actually good or bad within this insubstantial world of duality, and how can the extent of such good and bad be measured?

parts.sanskrit:
किं भद्रं किमभद्रं वा द्वैतस्यावस्तुनः कियत्।
वाचोदितं तदनृतं मनसा ध्यातमेव च॥ ११/२८/४॥

“एकं तु शुभमुद्दिष्टमशुभं द्वैतमुच्यते।
पुंसोऽशुभस्य किं भद्रं किमभद्रं विशेषतः।
सर्वदाऽशुभरूपत्वाद् विशेषोऽत्यल्प एव हि॥”
इति भारते॥
द्वैतस्याशुभस्य पुरुषस्य कियदल्पमेव हि भद्रमभद्रं वा स्वयोग्यादाधिक्येन न भवति यत्नवतोऽपीत्यर्थः। अतस्तद्विषये ध्यातमुक्तं च शुभमनृतमेव।
“उच्यते ध्यायते वाऽपि कुनरं प्रति यच्छुभम्।
असत्यमेव भवति स्वभावोऽसत्यमेव यत्॥”
इति प्रद्योते॥ ४॥

meta.english_verbatim: That which is expressed by material words or meditated upon by the material mind is not ultimate truth. What, therefore, is actually good or bad within this insubstantial world of duality, and how can the extent of such good and bad be measured?

units.sanskrit:
छायाप्रत्युदकाभासा ह्यसन्तोऽप्यर्थकारिणः।
एवं देहादयो भावा यच्छन्त्यामृत्युतो भयम्॥ ११/२८/५॥
units.english: Although shadows, echoes and mirages are only illusory reflections of real things, such reflections do cause a semblance of meaningful or comprehensible perception. In the same way, although the identification of the conditioned soul with the material body, mind and ego is illusory, this identification generates fear within him even up to the moment of death.

parts.sanskrit:
छायाप्रत्युदकाभासा ह्यसन्तोऽप्यर्थकारिणः।
एवं देहादयो भावा यच्छन्त्यामृत्युतो भयम्॥ ११/२८/५॥

स्वभावतोऽशुभस्याशुभदेहादिकं नाशुभकारणं तर्हीत्यत आह- छायाप्रत्युदकाभासा इति।
“व्यपेक्ष्य जीवं देहादि निःशक्तत्वादवस्त्वपि।
पुनः शुभाशुभनृणां यच्छेदेव शुभाशुभम्।
छायानीहारकाभासा निःशक्ता अपि कार्यदाः।
एवं शुभादिदेहादेर्भवेत् कार्यं शुभादिकम्॥”
इति सुमते।
“नीहारः प्रत्युदं चैव धूम्रमित्यभिशब्द्यते”
इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ ५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Although shadows, echoes and mirages are only illusory reflections of real things, such reflections do cause a semblance of meaningful or comprehensible perception. In the same way, although the identification of the conditioned soul with the material body, mind and ego is illusory, this identification generates fear within him even up to the moment of death.

units.sanskrit:
आत्मैव तदिदं विश्वं सृज्यते सृजति प्रभुः।
त्रायते त्राति विश्वात्मा ह्वियते हरतीश्वरः॥ ११/२८/६॥
तस्मान्न ह्यात्मनोऽमुष्मादन्यो भावो निरूपितः।
निरूपितेयं त्रिविधा निर्मूला मतिरात्मनि॥ ११/२८/७॥
units.english: The Supreme Self alone is the ultimate controller and creator of this world, and thus He alone is also the created. Similarly, the Soul of all existence Himself both maintains and is maintained, withdraws and is withdrawn. No other entity can be properly ascertained as separate from Him, the Supreme Soul, who nonetheless is distinct from everything and everyone else. The appearance of the threefold material nature, which is perceived within Him, has no actual basis. Rather, you should understand that this material nature, composed of the three modes, is simply the product of His illusory potency.

parts.sanskrit:
आत्मैव तदिदं विश्वं सृज्यते सृजति प्रभुः।
त्रायते त्राति विश्वात्मा ह्वियते हरतीश्वरः॥ ११/२८/६॥
तस्मान्न ह्यात्मनोऽमुष्मादन्यो भावो निरूपितः।
निरूपितेयं त्रिविधा निर्मूला मतिरात्मनि॥ ११/२८/७॥

इदं विश्वं सृजति त्राति हरति च स्वयं स्वात्मनैव सृज्यते त्रायते ह्रियते च।
“दीपाद् दीपान्तरं यद्वत् सृष्टिरीशस्य कीर्त्यते।
एतावत्कालमाशिष्ये मानुषेष्विति चिन्तनम्।
विष्णोस्त्राणं समुद्दिष्टं स्वस्यैव स्वेच्छयैव तु।
दीपे दीपान्तरस्येव ह्येकीभावश्च संहृतिः॥”
इति च।
“पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात् पूर्णमुदच्यते।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते॥”
इति च॥ ६॥
आत्मनः परमेश्वरस्य तस्मादन्यो भावो नास्ति।
“सृष्टिः स्थितिश्च संहारो भावनं समुदाहृतम्।
तद् यः करोति पुरुषः स भाव इति कीर्त्यते॥”
इति विवेके।
अन्येन सृष्टिः स्थितिः संहार इति त्रिविधा मतिर्विद्वद्भिर्नैव निरूपिता निर्मूला प्रमाणवर्जिता।
“अन्यस्मात् सृष्टिसंहारौ स्थितिश्च परमात्मनः।
निरूपिता न विद्वद्भिः प्रमाणाभावतो हरेः॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: The Supersoul alone is the ultimate controller and creator of this world, and thus He alone is also the created. Similarly, the Soul of all existence Himself both maintains and is maintained, withdraws and is withdrawn. No other entity can be properly ascertained as separate from Him, the Supreme Soul, who nonetheless is distinct from everything and everyone else. The appearance of the threefold material nature, which is perceived within Him, has no actual basis. Rather, you should understand that this material nature, composed of the three modes, is simply the product of His illusory potency.

units.sanskrit:
एतद् विद्वान् मदुदितं ज्ञानविज्ञाननैपुणम्।
न निन्दति न च स्तौति लोके चरति सूर्यवत्॥ ११/२८/९॥
units.english: One who has properly understood the process of becoming firmly fixed in theoretical and realized knowledge, as described herein by Me, does not indulge in material criticism or praise. Like the sun, he wanders freely throughout this world.

meta.english_verbatim: One who has properly understood the process of becoming firmly fixed in theoretical and realized knowledge, as described herein by Me, does not indulge in material criticism or praise. Like the sun, he wanders freely throughout this world.

units.sanskrit:
प्रत्यक्षेणानुमानेन निगमेनात्मसंविदा।
आद्यन्तवदसज्ज्ञात्वा निःसङ्गो विचरेदिह॥ ११/२८/१०॥
units.english: By direct perception, logical deduction, scriptural testimony and personal realization, one should know that this world has a beginning and an end and so is not the ultimate reality. Thus one should live in this world without attachment.

parts.sanskrit:
प्रत्यक्षेणानुमानेन निगमेनात्मसंविदा।
आद्यन्तवदसज्ज्ञात्वा निःसङ्गो विचरेदिह॥ ११/२८/१०॥
“असमर्थमसत् प्रोक्तं सत् समर्थं प्रकीर्तितम्” इति च॥ १०॥

meta.english_verbatim: By direct perception, logical deduction, scriptural testimony and personal realization, one should know that this world has a beginning and an end and so is not the ultimate reality. Thus one should live in this world without attachment.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
नैवात्मनो न देहस्य संसृतिर्द्रष्टृदृश्ययोः।
अनात्मस्वदृशोरीश कस्येयमुपलभ्यते॥ ११/२८/११॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord, it is not possible for this material existence to be the experience of either the soul, who is the seer, or of the body, which is the seen object. On the one hand, the spirit soul is innately endowed with perfect knowledge, and on the other hand, the material body is not a conscious, living being. To whom, then, does this experience of material existence pertain?

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord, it is not possible for this material existence to be the experience of either the soul, who is the seer, or of the body, which is the seen object. On the one hand, the spirit soul is innately endowed with perfect knowledge, and on the other hand, the material body is not a conscious, living entity. To whom, then, does this experience of material existence pertain?

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

units.sanskrit:
आत्माऽव्ययोऽगुणः शुद्धः स्वयञ्ज्योतिरनावृतः।
अग्निवद् दारुवदपि देहः कस्येह संसृतिः॥ ११/२८/१२॥
units.english: The spirit soul is inexhaustible, transcendental, pure, self-luminous and never covered by anything material. It is like fire. But the nonliving material body, like firewood, is dull and unaware. So in this world, who is it that actually undergoes the experience of material life?

meta.english_verbatim: The spirit soul is inexhaustible, transcendental, pure, self-luminous and never covered by anything material. It is like fire. But the nonliving material body, like firewood, is dull and unaware. So in this world, who is it that actually undergoes the experience of material life?

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यावद् देहेन्द्रियप्राणैरात्मनः सन्निकर्षणम्।
संसारः फलवांस्तावदपार्थोऽप्यविवेकिनः॥ ११/२८/१३॥
units.english: The Lord said: As long as the foolish spirit soul remains attracted to the material body, senses and vital force, his material existence continues to flourish, although it is ultimately meaningless.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यावद् देहेन्द्रियप्राणैरात्मनः सन्निकर्षणम्।
संसारः फलवांस्तावदपार्थोऽप्यविवेकिनः॥ ११/२८/१३॥

“फलवान् मोक्षहेतुत्वान्नित्यानन्दादपार्थकः।
जीवात्मनस्तु संसारः स्वप्नवच्चञ्चलत्वतः॥”
इति तत्त्वविवेके॥ १३॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: As long as the foolish spirit soul remains attracted to the material body, senses and vital force, his material existence continues to flourish, although it is ultimately meaningless.

units.sanskrit:
अर्थेऽप्यविद्यमानेऽपि१ संसृतिर्न निवर्तते।
ध्यायतो विषयानस्य स्वप्नेऽनर्थागमो यथा॥ ११/२८/१४॥
units.english: Actually, the living being is transcendental to material existence. But because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and, just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages.

parts.sanskrit:
अर्थेऽप्यविद्यमानेऽपि१ संसृतिर्न निवर्तते।
ध्यायतो विषयानस्य स्वप्नेऽनर्थागमो यथा॥ ११/२८/१४॥
संसृत्यभावस्यैव फलरूपत्वान्निरर्थ एव संसार इत्यवधारयति। अर्थेऽपीति। “उच्यते निष्फलत्वेन यदत्यल्पफलं भवेत्” इति च॥ १४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Actually, the living entity is transcendental to material existence. But because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and, just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages.

units.sanskrit:
यथा ह्यप्रतिबुद्धस्य प्रस्वापो बह्वनर्थकृत्।
स एव प्रतिबुद्धस्य न वै मोहाय कल्पते॥ ११/२८/१५॥
units.english: Although while dreaming a person experiences many undesirable things, upon awakening he is no longer confused by the dream experiences.

parts.sanskrit:
यथा ह्यप्रतिबुद्धस्य प्रस्वापो बह्वनर्थकृत्।
स एव प्रतिबुद्धस्य न वै मोहाय कल्पते॥ ११/२८/१५॥
अतोऽफलत्त्वावधारणार्थं च पुनर्वचनम्॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: Although while dreaming a person experiences many undesirable things, upon awakening he is no longer confused by the dream experiences.

units.sanskrit:
शोकहर्षभयक्रोधलोभमोहस्पृहादयः।
अहङ्कारस्य दृश्यन्ते जन्म मृत्युश्च नात्मनः॥ ११/२८/१६॥
units.english: Lamentation, elation, fear, anger, greed, confusion and hankering, as well as birth and death, are experiences of the false ego and not of the pure soul.

parts.sanskrit:
शोकहर्षभयक्रोधलोभमोहस्पृहादयः।
अहङ्कारस्य दृश्यन्ते जन्म मृत्युश्च नात्मनः॥ ११/२८/१६॥

अहङ्कारस्य सकाशाद् दृश्यन्ते। नात्मनः स्वतः।
“अहङ्कारात् तु संसारो भवेज्जीवस्य न स्वतः।
कुतश्चिदानन्दतनोः स्वरूपेच्छायुतस्य सः॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते॥ १६॥

meta.english_verbatim: Lamentation, elation, fear, anger, greed, confusion and hankering, as well as birth and death, are experiences of the false ego and not of the pure soul.

units.sanskrit:
देहेन्द्रियप्राणमनोभिमानो जीवोऽन्तरात्मा गुणकर्ममूर्तिः।
सूत्रं महानित्युरुधेह गीतः संसार आधावति कालतन्त्रः॥ ११/२८/१७॥
units.english: The living being who falsely identifies with his body, senses, life air and mind, and who dwells within these coverings, assumes the form of his own materially conditioned qualities and work. He is designated variously in relation to the total material energy, and thus, under the strict control of supreme time, he is forced to run here and there within material existence.

parts.sanskrit:
देहेन्द्रियप्राणमनोभिमानो जीवोऽन्तरात्मा गुणकर्ममूर्तिः।
सूत्रं महानित्युरुधेह गीतः संसार आधावति कालतन्त्रः॥ ११/२८/१७॥

देहेन्द्रियप्राणमनसामभिमानयुक्तः। सूत्रं महानित्याद्यधिकारनामभिर्युक्तः। प्रधानजीवो हिरण्यगर्भोऽप्याधावति संसारे किमुतान्य इत्याशयः।
“संसारयुग् यो ब्रह्माऽपि सर्वजीवेश्वरेश्वरः।
विष्ण्वधीनः सदा ज्ञानी किमुतान्येऽल्पचित्तिनः॥”
इति सत्तत्त्वे॥ १७॥

meta.english_verbatim: The living entity who falsely identifies with his body, senses, life air and mind, and who dwells within these coverings, assumes the form of his own materially conditioned qualities and work. He is designated variously in relation to the total material energy, and thus, under the strict control of supreme time, he is forced to run here and there within material existence.

units.sanskrit:
अमूलमेतद् बहुरूपरूपं मनोवचःप्राणशरीरकर्म।
ज्ञानासिनोपासनया शितेन च्छित्त्वा मुनिर्गां विचरत्यतृष्णः॥ ११/२८/१८॥
units.english: Although the false ego has no factual basis, it is perceived in many forms — as the functions of the mind, speech, life air and bodily faculties. But with the sword of transcendental knowledge, sharpened by worship of a bona fide teacher, a sober sage will cut off this false identification and live in this world free from all material attachment.

parts.sanskrit:
अमूलमेतद् बहुरूपरूपं मनोवचःप्राणशरीरकर्म।
ज्ञानासिनोपासनया शितेन च्छित्त्वा मुनिर्गां विचरत्यतृष्णः॥ ११/२८/१८॥
अमूलं विष्णुमूलम्। बहुरूपेण तेनैव रूप्यते मनआदीनां विषयः॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: Although the false ego has no factual basis, it is perceived in many forms — as the functions of the mind, speech, life air and bodily faculties. But with the sword of transcendental knowledge, sharpened by worship of a bona fide spiritual master, a sober sage will cut off this false identification and live in this world free from all material attachment.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं विवेको निगमस्तपश्च प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यमथानुमानम्।
आद्यन्तयोरस्य यदेव केवलं कालश्च हेतुश्च तदेव मध्ये॥ ११/२८/१९॥
units.english: Real spiritual knowledge is based on the discrimination of spirit from matter, and it is cultivated by scriptural evidence, austerity, direct perception, reception of the Purāṇas’ historical narrations, and logical inference. The Absolute Truth, which alone was present before the creation of the universe and which alone will remain after its destruction, is also the time factor and the ultimate cause. Even in the middle stage of this creation’s existence, the Absolute Truth alone is the actual reality.

parts.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं विवेको निगमस्तपश्च प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यमथानुमानम्।
आद्यन्तयोरस्य यदेव केवलं कालश्च हेतुश्च तदेव मध्ये॥ ११/२८/१९॥

केवलं स्वतन्त्रम्। आद्यन्तयोर्यत् स्वतन्त्रं तदेव मध्येऽपि स्वतन्त्रम्। परम्ब्रह्म ज्ञानविवेकादिस्वरूपम्। परिपूर्णगुणत्वात् कालः। अन्यतो विविक्तत्वाद् विवेकः। सर्वं निगमयति प्रापयतीति निगमः। सर्वैरालोच्यत्वात् तपः। प्रतिप्रत्यक्षेषु स्थितत्वात् प्रत्यक्षम्। आचार्यसम्प्रदायसिद्धत्वादैतिह्यम्। अनुमेयत्वादनुमानम्॥ १९॥

meta.english_verbatim: Real spiritual knowledge is based on the discrimination of spirit from matter, and it is cultivated by scriptural evidence, austerity, direct perception, reception of the Purāṇas’ historical narrations, and logical inference. The Absolute Truth, which alone was present before the creation of the universe and which alone will remain after its destruction, is also the time factor and the ultimate cause. Even in the middle stage of this creation’s existence, the Absolute Truth alone is the actual reality.

units.sanskrit:
यथा हिरण्यं स्वकृतं पुरस्तात् पश्चाच्च सर्वस्य हिरण्मयस्य।
तदेव मध्ये व्यवहार्यमाणं नानापदेशैरहमस्य तद्वत्॥ ११/२८/२०॥
units.english: Gold alone is present before its manufacture into gold products, the gold alone remains after the products’ destruction, and the gold alone is the essential reality while it is being utilized under various designations. Similarly, I alone exist before the creation of this universe, after its destruction and during its maintenance.

parts.sanskrit:
यथा हिरण्यं स्वकृतं पुरस्तात् पश्चाच्च सर्वस्य हिरण्मयस्य।
तदेव मध्ये व्यवहार्यमाणं नानापदेशैरहमस्य तद्वत्॥ ११/२८/२०॥

हिरण्यखचितत्वेन हिरण्यप्रधानं हिरण्मयम्। शङ्खमञ्चकरथादिषु मध्येपि केवलं प्राधान्येन व्यवहार्यमाणं तदेव।
“रथोपस्थे परिष्कारात् पूर्वं दारुमयाद् रथात्।
सुवर्णं व्यवहाराय मुख्यं रथपरिष्कृतम्।
मध्ये चान्ते रथोपस्थान्निष्कृष्य पृथगास्थितम्।
यद्वदेवं हरिः साक्षाज्जगद्देहात् पृथक् स्थितः।
पूर्वं जगति संस्थश्च जगदन्ते पृथक् स्थितः।
स एव मुख्यो जगतः स्वातन्त्र्यात् परमेश्वरः॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के।
सुरपितृमनुजादिकल्पनादिभिरित्याद्यन्तर्याम्यपेक्षया।
“यथा सुवर्णमकृतं क्रियते कुण्डलादिकम्।
पुनरेकीभवत्यद्धा तद्वद् विष्णुरजोऽपि सन्।
सुराद्यन्तःस्थितो भूत्वा पुनरेकीभवेद् विभुः॥”
इति च।
“तत्तन्नियामकस्यैव नाम सर्वं सुरादिकम्।
तत्सम्बन्धादुदीर्येत व्यवहृत्यै सुरादिषु॥”
इति शब्दनिर्णये।
“एकलं केवलं चेति स्वतन्त्रमभिधीयते।
स्वतन्त्रस्तु हरिः साक्षात् परिष्कृतहिरण्यवत्॥”
इति प्रवृत्ते।
“प्रत्येकं नतु दार्वादि स्वतन्त्रं विक्रियागतम्।
महाफलं स्यात् स्वर्णं तु स्वतन्त्रं विक्रियोपगम्।
तद्वत् स्वतन्त्रो भगवान्
प्रवृत्तावन्यदन्यथा
॥”
इति च॥ २०॥

meta.english_verbatim: Gold alone is present before its manufacture into gold products, the gold alone remains after the products’ destruction, and the gold alone is the essential reality while it is being utilized under various designations. Similarly, I alone exist before the creation of this universe, after its destruction and during its maintenance.

units.sanskrit:
विज्ञानमेतत् त्रिपदस्थमङ्ग गुणत्रयं कारणकार्यकर्तृ।
समन्वयेन व्यतिरेकतश्च येनैव तुर्येण तदेव सत्यम्॥ ११/२८/२१॥
units.english: The material mind manifests in three phases of consciousness — wakefulness, sleep and deep sleep — which are products of the three modes of nature. The mind further appears in three different roles — the perceiver, the perceived and the regulator of perception. Thus the mind is manifested variously throughout these threefold designations. But it is the fourth factor, existing separately from all this, that alone constitutes the Absolute Truth.

parts.sanskrit:
विज्ञानमेतत् त्रिपदस्थमङ्ग गुणत्रयं कारणकार्यकर्तृ।
समन्वयेन व्यतिरेकतश्च येनैव तुर्येण तदेव सत्यम्॥ ११/२८/२१॥

मोक्षदं संसारदं तमःप्रदं चेति त्रिपदस्थं विज्ञानम्। तदिच्छायाः सत्त्व एतत् सर्वमस्ति, अन्यथा नास्ति - इत्यन्वयव्यतिरेकौ। तदेव केवलं सत्यमिति सर्वत्र सम्बध्यते।
“स्वातन्त्र्यमेव सत्यत्वं विष्णोरन्यस्य सत्यता।
प्रवाहतः सदाऽस्तित्वं पुम्प्रकृत्योः सदाऽस्तिता॥”
इति वस्तुतत्वे॥ २१॥

meta.english_verbatim: The material mind manifests in three phases of consciousness — wakefulness, sleep and deep sleep — which are products of the three modes of nature. The mind further appears in three different roles — the perceiver, the perceived and the regulator of perception. Thus the mind is manifested variously throughout these threefold designations. But it is the fourth factor, existing separately from all this, that alone constitutes the Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit:
न यत् पुरस्तादुत यन्न पश्चान्मध्ये च तन्न व्यपदेशमात्रम्।
भूतं प्रसिद्धं च परेण यद्यत् तदेव सत् स्यादिति मे मनीषा॥ ११/२८/२२॥
units.english: That which did not exist in the past and will not exist in the future also has no existence of its own for the period of its duration, but is only a superficial designation. In My opinion, whatever is created and revealed by something else is ultimately only that other thing.

parts.sanskrit:
न यत् पुरस्तादुत यन्न पश्चान्मध्ये च तन्न व्यपदेशमात्रम्।
भूतं प्रसिद्धं च परेण यद्यत् तदेव सत् स्यादिति मे मनीषा॥ ११/२८/२२॥

मध्ये च तत् केवलं नेति सम्बध्यते।
“तत् स्वातन्त्र्येण नैवास्ति यदुत्पत्तिविनाशवत्।
स्वातन्त्रेणास्तिता तस्य यत् सत्ताज्ञानदं सदा॥”
इति वैभवे॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: That which did not exist in the past and will not exist in the future also has no existence of its own for the period of its duration, but is only a superficial designation. In My opinion, whatever is created and revealed by something else is ultimately only that other thing.

units.sanskrit:
अविद्यमानोऽप्यवभासते यो वैकारिको राजससर्ग एषः।
ब्रह्म स्वयञ्ज्योतिरतो विभाति ब्रह्मेन्द्रियार्थात्मविकारचित्रम्॥ ११/२८/२३॥
units.english: Although thus not existing in reality, this manifestation of transformations created from the mode of passion appears real because the self-manifested, self-luminous Absolute Truth exhibits Himself in the form of the material variety of the senses, the sense objects, the mind and the elements of physical nature.

parts.sanskrit:
अविद्यमानोऽप्यवभासते यो वैकारिको राजससर्ग एषः।
ब्रह्म स्वयञ्ज्योतिरतो विभाति ब्रह्मेन्द्रियार्थात्मविकारचित्रम्॥ ११/२८/२३॥

“जगतो नास्तिता सैव या पराधीनता सदा।
अभावस्तु कुतस्तस्य यद् विभातीह सर्वदा॥”
इति प्राकाश्ये।
“अविद्यमानता नाम जगतः परतन्त्रता।
यथाऽशक्तस्तु पुत्रादिरसन्नित्युच्यते जनैः॥”
इति विवेके।
अतो ब्रह्मण एव विभाति। द्वितीयं ब्रह्म प्रकृतिः। आत्मा जीवः। प्रकृतीन्द्रियविषयजीवादिविचित्रं जगद् ब्रह्मत एव विभातीत्यर्थः॥ २३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Although thus not existing in reality, this manifestation of transformations created from the mode of passion appears real because the self-manifested, self-luminous Absolute Truth exhibits Himself in the form of the material variety of the senses, the sense objects, the mind and the elements of physical nature.

units.sanskrit:
एवं स्फुटं ब्रह्म विविच्य हेतुभिः परापवादेन विवेकबुद्ध्या।
छित्वाऽऽत्मसन्देहमुपारमेत स्वानन्दतुष्टोऽखिलकामुकेभ्यः॥ ११/२८/२४॥
units.english: Thus clearly understanding by discriminating logic the unique position of the Absolute Truth, one should expertly refute one’s misidentification with matter and cut to pieces all doubts about the identity of the self. Becoming satisfied in the soul’s natural ecstasy, one should desist from all lusty engagements of the material senses.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus clearly understanding by discriminating logic the unique position of the Absolute Truth, one should expertly refute one’s misidentification with matter and cut to pieces all doubts about the identity of the self. Becoming satisfied in the soul’s natural ecstasy, one should desist from all lusty engagements of the material senses.

units.sanskrit:
नात्मा वपुः पार्थिवमिन्द्रियाणि देवा ह्यसुर्वायुजलं हुताशः।
मनोऽन्नमात्रं धिषणा च सत्वमहङ्कृतिः खं कृतिरर्थसाम्यम्॥ ११/२८/२५॥
units.english: The material body made of earth is not the true self; nor are the senses, their presiding gods or the air of life; nor is the external air, water or fire or one’s mind. All these are simply matter. Similarly, neither one’s intelligence, material consciousness nor ego, nor the elements of ether or earth, nor the objects of sense perception, nor even the primeval state of material equilibrium can be considered the actual identity of the soul.

parts.sanskrit:
नात्मा वपुः पार्थिवमिन्द्रियाणि देवा ह्यसुर्वायुजलं हुताशः।
मनोऽन्नमात्रं धिषणा च सत्वमहङ्कृतिः खं कृतिरर्थसाम्यम्॥ ११/२८/२५॥

“वायुरेव स्वयं प्राणस्तत्रस्थे चोदतेजसी।
उदेन तेजसा चैव प्राणस्य हि कृतं वपुः॥”
इति प्रकाशिकायाम्।
“प्राणस्य वायुरूपस्य भूतत्रयकृतं वपुः।
ततो हि पार्थिवं नात्र खं चात्यल्पमुदाहृतम्॥”
इति सन्धारणे।
सत्त्वं मूलबुद्धिः। अहं शृणोम्यहं स्पृशाम्यहं पश्यामीति सर्वार्थेषु समत्वादहङ्कारोऽर्थसाम्यम्।
“न देहो नेन्द्रियप्राणमनोबुद्ध्यहमादयः।
विष्णुश्चिदानन्दतनुः स हि जीवाधिपः सदा॥”
इति सत्तत्त्वे॥ २५॥

meta.english_verbatim: The material body made of earth is not the true self; nor are the senses, their presiding demigods or the air of life; nor is the external air, water or fire or one’s mind. All these are simply matter. Similarly, neither one’s intelligence, material consciousness nor ego, nor the elements of ether or earth, nor the objects of sense perception, nor even the primeval state of material equilibrium can be considered the actual identity of the soul.

units.sanskrit:
समाहितैः कः करणैर्गुणात्मभिर्गुणो भवेत् तत्सुविविक्तधाम्नः।
विक्षिप्यमाणैरुत किं नु दूषणं घनैरुपेतैर्विगतै रवेः किम्॥ ११/२८/२६॥
units.english: For one who has properly realized My personal identity as the Supreme Godhead, what credit is there if his senses — mere products of the material modes — are perfectly concentrated in meditation? And on the other hand, what blame is incurred if his senses happen to become agitated? Indeed, what does it mean to the sun if the clouds come and go?

parts.sanskrit:
समाहितैः कः करणैर्गुणात्मभिर्गुणो भवेत् तत्सुविविक्तधाम्नः।
विक्षिप्यमाणैरुत किं नु दूषणं घनैरुपेतैर्विगतै रवेः किम्॥ ११/२८/२६॥

भगवतो गुणदोषाभावेऽपि जीवस्य सङ्गोऽवर्जनीय एव मुक्तिपर्यन्तम्।
“समाहितेऽपि जीवेन विक्षिप्ते वा नतु क्वचित्।
विशेषो विद्यते विष्णोस्तथाऽपि तु समाहिते।
प्रीतो भवति वै नित्यं सर्वधर्मकृतोऽपि च॥”
इति पाद्मे॥ २६॥

meta.english_verbatim: For one who has properly realized My personal identity as the Supreme Godhead, what credit is there if his senses — mere products of the material modes — are perfectly concentrated in meditation? And on the other hand, what blame is incurred if his senses happen to become agitated? Indeed, what does it mean to the sun if the clouds come and go?

units.sanskrit:
यथा नभो वाय्वनलाम्बुभूगुणैर्गतागतैर्वा त्रिगुणैर्न सज्जते।
तथाऽक्षरं सत्वरजस्तमोमलैरसङ्गतं संसृतिहेतुभिः परम्॥ ११/२८/२७॥
units.english: The sky may display the various qualities of the air, fire, water and earth that pass through it, as well as such qualities as heat and cold, which continually come and go with the seasons. Yet the sky is never entangled with any of these qualities. Similarly, the Supreme Absolute Truth is never entangled with the contaminations of goodness, passion and ignorance, which cause the material transformations of the false ego.

meta.english_verbatim: The sky may display the various qualities of the air, fire, water and earth that pass through it, as well as such qualities as heat and cold, which continually come and go with the seasons. Yet the sky is never entangled with any of these qualities. Similarly, the Supreme Absolute Truth is never entangled with the contaminations of goodness, passion and ignorance, which cause the material transformations of the false ego.

units.sanskrit:
तथापि सङ्गः परिवर्जनीयो गुणेषु मायारचितेषु तावत्।
मद्भक्तियोगेन दृढेन यावद्रजो निरस्येत तमः कषायम्॥ ११/२८/२८॥
units.english: Nevertheless, until by firmly practicing devotion to Me one has completely eliminated from his mind all contamination of material passion, one must very carefully avoid associating with the material modes, which are produced by My illusory energy.

meta.english_verbatim: Nevertheless, until by firmly practicing devotional service to Me one has completely eliminated from his mind all contamination of material passion, one must very carefully avoid associating with the material modes, which are produced by My illusory energy.

units.sanskrit:
यथाऽमयोऽसाधुचिकित्सितो नृणां पुनःपुनः सन्तुदति प्ररोहन्।
एवं मनोऽपक्वकषायकर्म कुयोगिनं विद्ध्यति सर्वसङ्गम्॥ ११/२८/२९॥
units.english: Just as an improperly treated disease recurs and gives repeated distress to the patient, the mind that is not completely purified of its perverted tendencies will remain attached to material things and repeatedly torment the imperfect yogī.

meta.english_verbatim: Just as an improperly treated disease recurs and gives repeated distress to the patient, the mind that is not completely purified of its perverted tendencies will remain attached to material things and repeatedly torment the imperfect yogī.

units.sanskrit:
कुयोगिनो ये विहता ह्यन्तरायैर्मनुष्यभूतैस्त्रिदशोपसृष्टैः।
ते प्राक्कृताभ्यासबलेन भूयो युञ्जन्ति योगं न तु कर्मतन्त्रम्॥ ११/२८/३०॥
units.english: Sometimes the progress of imperfect transcendentalists is checked by attachment to family members, disciples or others, who are sent by envious gods for that purpose. But on the strength of their accumulated advancement, such imperfect transcendentalists will resume their practice of yoga in the next life. They will never again be trapped in the network of actions aimed at results.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: Sometimes the progress of imperfect transcendentalists is checked by attachment to family members, disciples or others, who are sent by envious demigods for that purpose. But on the strength of their accumulated advancement, such imperfect transcendentalists will resume their practice of yoga in the next life. They will never again be trapped in the network of fruitive work.

units.sanskrit:
करोति कर्म क्रियते च जन्तुः केनाप्यसौ चोदित आनिपातात्।
न तत्र विद्वान् प्रकृतौ स्थितोऽपि निवृत्ततृष्णः स्वसुखानुभूत्या॥ ११/२८/३१॥
units.english: An ordinary living being performs material work and is transformed by the reaction to such work. Thus he is driven by various desires to continue working fruitively up to the very moment of his death. A wise person, however, having experienced his own constitutional bliss, gives up all material desires and does not engage in actions aimed at results.

meta.english_verbatim: An ordinary living entity performs material work and is transformed by the reaction to such work. Thus he is driven by various desires to continue working fruitively up to the very moment of his death. A wise person, however, having experienced his own constitutional bliss, gives up all material desires and does not engage in fruitive work.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

units.sanskrit:
तिष्ठन्तमासीनमुत व्रजन्तं शयानमुद्यन्तमदन्तमन्नम्।
स्वभावमन्यत् किमपीहमानमात्मानमात्मस्थमतिर्न वेद॥ ११/२८/३२॥
units.english: The wise man, whose consciousness is fixed in the self, does not even notice his own bodily activities. While standing, sitting, walking, lying down, urinating, eating or performing other bodily functions, he understands that the body is acting according to its own nature.

parts.sanskrit:
तिष्ठन्तमासीनमुत व्रजन्तं शयानमुद्यन्तमदन्तमन्नम्।
स्वभावमन्यत् किमपीहमानमात्मानमात्मस्थमतिर्न वेद॥ ११/२८/३२॥
आत्मस्थमतिः परमात्मस्थमतिः॥ ३२॥

meta.english_verbatim: The wise man, whose consciousness is fixed in the self, does not even notice his own bodily activities. While standing, sitting, walking, lying down, urinating, eating or performing other bodily functions, he understands that the body is acting according to its own nature.

units.sanskrit:
यदि स्म पश्यत्यसदिन्द्रियार्थं नानानुमानेन विरुद्धमन्यत्।
न मन्यते वस्तुतया मनीषी स्वाप्नं यथोत्थाय तिरोदधानम्॥ ११/२८/३३॥
units.english: Although a self-realized soul may sometimes see an impure object or activity, he does not accept it as real. By logically understanding impure sense objects to be based on illusory material duality, the intelligent person sees them to be contrary to and distinct from reality, in the same way that a man awakening from sleep views his fading dream.

parts.sanskrit:
यदि स्म पश्यत्यसदिन्द्रियार्थं नानानुमानेन विरुद्धमन्यत्।
न मन्यते वस्तुतया मनीषी स्वाप्नं यथोत्थाय तिरोदधानम्॥ ११/२८/३३॥

परमात्मनोऽन्यत् पारतन्त्र्यादेः।
“नानामानविरुद्धं हि स्वातन्त्र्यं जगतः सदा।
स्वतन्त्रो भगवान् विष्णुरेक एव न संशयः॥”
इति च।
वस्तुतया स्वतन्त्रत्वेन विरुद्धं तथा न मन्यते।
“अस्त्येव स्वाप्नमखिलं वासनारूपमात्मनि।
जाग्रदेतदिति ज्ञानं यत् तदेव भ्रमात्मकम्।
तद्वज्जगदिदं सर्वं विद्यमानं न संशयः।
स्वतन्त्रमेतदिति तु यज्ज्ञानं तद् भ्रमात्मकम्॥”
इति च।
“उत्थितो नैव जाग्रत्त्वं क्वचित् स्वप्नस्य पश्यति।
स्वातन्त्र्यमेवं जगतो ज्ञानवान् नैव पश्यति॥”
इति विवेके॥ ३३॥

meta.english_verbatim: Although a self-realized soul may sometimes see an impure object or activity, he does not accept it as real. By logically understanding impure sense objects to be based on illusory material duality, the intelligent person sees them to be contrary to and distinct from reality, in the same way that a man awakening from sleep views his fading dream.

units.sanskrit:
पूर्वं गृहीतं गुणकर्मचित्रमज्ञानमात्मन्यविविक्तमङ्ग।
निवर्तते तत् पुनरीक्षयैव न गृह्यते नापि विसृज्य आत्मा॥ ११/२८/३४॥
units.english: Material nescience, which expands into many varieties by the activities of the modes of nature, is wrongly accepted by the conditioned soul to be identical with the self. But through the cultivation of spiritual knowledge, My dear Uddhava, this same nescience fades away at the time of liberation. The eternal self, on the other hand, is never assumed and never abandoned.

parts.sanskrit:
पूर्वं गृहीतं गुणकर्मचित्रमज्ञानमात्मन्यविविक्तमङ्ग।
निवर्तते तत् पुनरीक्षयैव न गृह्यते नापि विसृज्य आत्मा॥ ११/२८/३४॥

भगवद्गुणविषयं तत्कर्मविषयं चेति गुणकर्मचित्रम्। आत्मनि परमात्मविषयम्। एतन्न जानामीत्यप्यविविक्तम्।
“अन्यैर्ज्ञातेऽपि वाऽज्ञाते न विशेषो हरेः क्वचित्।
तेषामेव विशेषः स्यादज्ञानापगमेन तु॥”
इति च॥ ३४॥

meta.english_verbatim: Material nescience, which expands into many varieties by the activities of the modes of nature, is wrongly accepted by the conditioned soul to be identical with the self. But through the cultivation of spiritual knowledge, My dear Uddhava, this same nescience fades away at the time of liberation. The eternal self, on the other hand, is never assumed and never abandoned.

units.sanskrit:
यथा हि भानोरुदयो नृचक्षुषां तमो निहन्यान्न तु संविधत्ते।
एवं समीक्षा निपुणा सती मे हन्यात् तमिस्रं पुरुषस्य बुद्धेः॥ ११/२८/३५॥
units.english: When the sun rises it destroys the darkness covering men’s eyes, but it does not create the objects they then see before them, which in fact were existing all along. Similarly, potent and factual realization of Me will destroy the darkness covering a person’s true consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: When the sun rises it destroys the darkness covering men’s eyes, but it does not create the objects they then see before them, which in fact were existing all along. Similarly, potent and factual realization of Me will destroy the darkness covering a person’s true consciousness.

units.sanskrit:
एष स्वयञ्ज्योतिरजोऽप्रमेयो महानुभूतिः सकलानुभूतिः।
एकोऽद्वितीयो वचसां विरामो येनेरिता वाग्रचनाश्चरन्ति॥ ११/२८/३६॥
units.english: The Supreme Lord is self-luminous, unborn and immeasurable. He is pure transcendental consciousness and perceives everything. One without a second, He is realized only after ordinary words cease. By Him the power of speech and the life airs are set into motion.

parts.sanskrit:
एष स्वयञ्ज्योतिरजोऽप्रमेयो महानुभूतिः सकलानुभूतिः।
एकोऽद्वितीयो वचसां विरामो येनेरिता वाग्रचनाश्चरन्ति॥ ११/२८/३६॥

“ज्ञानानन्दाद्यभिन्नत्वादेकः सर्वोत्तमत्वतः।
अद्वितीयो महाविष्णुः पूर्णत्वात् पुरुषः स्मृतः॥”
इति च॥ ३६॥

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Lord is self-luminous, unborn and immeasurable. He is pure transcendental consciousness and perceives everything. One without a second, He is realized only after ordinary words cease. By Him the power of speech and the life airs are set into motion.

units.sanskrit:
एतावानात्मसम्मोहो यद् विकल्पस्तु केवले।
आत्माऽमृते स्वमात्मानमचलं यन्न पश्यति॥ ११/२८/३७॥
units.english: Whatever apparent duality is perceived in the self is simply the confusion of the mind. Indeed, such supposed duality has no basis to rest upon apart from one’s own soul.

parts.sanskrit:
एतावानात्मसम्मोहो यद् विकल्पस्तु केवले।
आत्माऽमृते स्वमात्मानमचलं यन्न पश्यति॥ ११/२८/३७॥

“एतावानात्मसम्मोहो यद् विरुद्धस्य कल्पनम्।
यत् परात्माश्रयान् जीवान् निश्चयेन न पश्यति॥”
इति तन्त्रभागवते।
अचलमिति क्रियाविशेषणम्॥ ३७॥

meta.english_verbatim: Whatever apparent duality is perceived in the self is simply the confusion of the mind. Indeed, such supposed duality has no basis to rest upon apart from one’s own soul.

units.sanskrit:
यन्नामाकृतिभिर्ग्राह्यं पञ्चवर्णमबाधितम्।
व्यर्थो नाप्यर्थवादोऽयं द्वयं विन्दन्ति सूरयः॥ ११/२८/३८॥
units.english: The duality of the five material elements is perceived only in terms of names and forms. Those who say this duality is real are pseudoscholars vainly proposing fanciful theories without basis in fact.

parts.sanskrit:
यन्नामाकृतिभिर्ग्राह्यं पञ्चवर्णमबाधितम्।
व्यर्थो नाप्यर्थवादोऽयं द्वयं विन्दन्ति सूरयः॥ ११/२८/३८॥

अयं व्यर्थवादो न भवति किन्त्वर्थवादः। जगत् परमेश्वरं च द्वयं विन्दन्ति ज्ञानिनः।
“पञ्चभूतात्मकं विश्वं भ्रान्तिसिद्धमपण्डिताः।
वदन्ति पण्डितास्त्वद्धा जगदाहुरबाधितम्।
प्रवाहरूपेण सदा विष्णोरिच्छावशे स्थितम्॥”
इति च॥ ३८॥

meta.english_verbatim: The duality of the five material elements is perceived only in terms of names and forms. Those who say this duality is real are pseudoscholars vainly proposing fanciful theories without basis in fact.

units.sanskrit:
योगिनोऽपक्वयोगस्य युञ्जतः काल उत्थितैः।
उपसर्गैर्विहन्येत तत्रायं विहितो विधिः॥ ११/२८/३९॥
units.english: The physical body of the endeavoring yogī who is not yet mature in his practice may sometimes be overcome by various disturbances. Therefore the following process is recommended.

meta.english_verbatim: The physical body of the endeavoring yogī who is not yet mature in his practice may sometimes be overcome by various disturbances. Therefore the following process is recommended.

units.sanskrit:
योगधारणया कांश्चिदुपसर्गान् विनिर्दहेत्।
तपोमन्त्रौषधैः कांश्चिदासनैर्धारणान्वितैः॥ ११/२८/४०॥
units.english: Some of these obstructions may be counteracted by yogic meditation or by sitting postures, practiced together with concentration on controlled breathing, and others may be counteracted by special austerities, mantras or medicinal herbs.

meta.english_verbatim: Some of these obstructions may be counteracted by yogic meditation or by sitting postures, practiced together with concentration on controlled breathing, and others may be counteracted by special austerities, mantras or medicinal herbs.

units.sanskrit:
कांश्चिन्ममानुध्यानेन नामसङ्कीर्तनादिभिः।
योगेश्वरानुवृत्त्या वा हन्यादशुभदान् शुभैः॥ ११/२८/४१॥
units.english: These inauspicious disturbances can be gradually removed by constant remembrance of Me, by congregational hearing and chanting of My holy names, or by following in the footsteps of the great masters of yoga.

meta.english_verbatim: These inauspicious disturbances can be gradually removed by constant remembrance of Me, by congregational hearing and chanting of My holy names, or by following in the footsteps of the great masters of yoga.

units.sanskrit:
केचिद् देहमिमं धार्यं सुकल्यं वयसि स्थितम्।
विधाय विविधोपायैरथ युञ्जान्त सिद्धये॥ ११/२८/४२॥
units.english: By various methods, some yogīs free the body from disease and old age and keep it perpetually youthful. Thus they engage in yoga for the purpose of achieving material mystic perfections.

meta.english_verbatim: By various methods, some yogīs free the body from disease and old age and keep it perpetually youthful. Thus they engage in yoga for the purpose of achieving material mystic perfections.

units.sanskrit:
इह वर्षशताशीत्या तदायासो ह्यपार्थकः।
अन्तवत्त्वाच्छरीरस्य फलस्येव वनस्पतेः॥ ११/२८/४३॥
units.english: This mystic bodily perfection is not valued very highly by those expert in transcendental knowledge. Indeed, they consider endeavor for such perfection useless, since the soul, like a tree, is permanent, but the body, like a tree’s fruit, is subject to destruction.

meta.english_verbatim: This mystic bodily perfection is not valued very highly by those expert in transcendental knowledge. Indeed, they consider endeavor for such perfection useless, since the soul, like a tree, is permanent, but the body, like a tree’s fruit, is subject to destruction.

units.sanskrit:
योगं निषेवतो नित्यं कायश्चेत् कल्यतामियात्।
तच्छ्रद्धध्यान्न मतिमान् योगमुत्सृज्य मत्परः॥ ११/२८/४४॥
units.english: The yogī who has taken shelter of Me remains free from hankering because he experiences the happiness of the soul within. Thus while executing this process of yoga, he is never defeated by obstacles.

meta.english_verbatim: The yogī who has taken shelter of Me remains free from hankering because he experiences the happiness of the soul within. Thus while executing this process of yoga, he is never defeated by obstacles.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
सुदुश्चरामिमां मन्ये योगचर्यामनात्मनः।
यथाऽञ्जसा पुमान् सिध्येत् तन्मे ब्रूह्यञ्जसाऽच्युत॥ ११/२९/१॥
units.english: Uddhava said: My dear Lord Acyuta, I fear that the method of yoga described by You is very difficult for one who cannot control his mind. Therefore please explain to me in simple terms how someone can more easily execute it.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: My dear Lord Acyuta, I fear that the method of yoga described by You is very difficult for one who cannot control his mind. Therefore please explain to me in simple terms how someone can more easily execute it.

units.sanskrit:
प्रायशः पुण्डरीकाक्ष युञ्जतो योगिनो मनः।
विषीदत्यसमाधानान्मौनसंयमकर्शितम्॥ ११/२९/२॥
units.english: O lotus-eyed Lord, generally those yogīs who try to steady the mind experience frustration because of their inability to perfect the state of trance. Thus they weary in their attempt to bring the mind under control.

meta.english_verbatim: O lotus-eyed Lord, generally those yogīs who try to steady the mind experience frustration because of their inability to perfect the state of trance. Thus they weary in their attempt to bring the mind under control.

units.sanskrit:
अथो त आनन्ददुघं पदाम्बुजं हंसाः श्रयेरन्नरविन्दलोचन।
सुखं तु विश्वेश्वर योगकर्मभिस्त्वन्माययाऽमी विहता न मानिनः॥ ११/२९/३॥
units.english: Therefore, O lotus-eyed Lord of the universe, swanlike men happily take shelter of Your lotus feet, the source of all transcendental ecstasy. But those who take pride in their accomplishments in yoga and karma fail to take shelter of You and are defeated by Your illusory energy.

meta.english_verbatim: Therefore, O lotus-eyed Lord of the universe, swanlike men happily take shelter of Your lotus feet, the source of all transcendental ecstasy. But those who take pride in their accomplishments in yoga and karma fail to take shelter of You and are defeated by Your illusory energy.

units.sanskrit:
किं चित्रमच्युत तवैतदशेषबन्धोः
दासेष्वनन्यशरणेषु यदात्मदस्त्वम्।
योऽरोचयश्च पशुपैः स्वयमीश्वराणां
श्रीमत्किरीटमणिघट्टितपादपीठः॥ ११/२९/४॥
units.english: My dear infallible Lord, it is not very astonishing that You intimately approach Your servants who have taken exclusive shelter of You. After all, during Your appearance as Lord Rāmacandra, even while great gods like Brahmā were vying to place the effulgent tips of their helmets upon the cushion where Your lotus feet rested, You displayed special affection for monkeys such as Hanumān because they had taken exclusive shelter of You.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear infallible Lord, it is not very astonishing that You intimately approach Your servants who have taken exclusive shelter of You. After all, during Your appearance as Lord Rāmacandra, even while great demigods like Brahmā were vying to place the effulgent tips of their helmets upon the cushion where Your lotus feet rested, You displayed special affection for monkeys such as Hanumān because they had taken exclusive shelter of You.

units.sanskrit:
तं त्वाऽखिलात्मदयितेश्वरमाश्रितानां
सर्वार्थदं सुकृतविद् विसृजेत को नु।
को वा भजेत् किमपि विस्मृतचित्तवृत्तिः
किं वा न वेद तव पादरजोऽमृताम्भः॥ ११/२९/५॥
units.english: Who, then, could dare reject You, the very Soul, the most dear object of worship, and the Supreme Lord of all — You who give all possible perfections to the devotees who take shelter of You? Who could be so ungrateful, knowing the benefits You bestow? Who would reject You and accept something for the sake of material enjoyment, which simply leads to forgetfulness of You? And what lack is there for us who are engaged in the service of the dust of Your lotus feet?

meta.english_verbatim: Who, then, could dare reject You, the very Soul, the most dear object of worship, and the Supreme Lord of all — You who give all possible perfections to the devotees who take shelter of You? Who could be so ungrateful, knowing the benefits You bestow? Who would reject You and accept something for the sake of material enjoyment, which simply leads to forgetfulness of You? And what lack is there for us who are engaged in the service of the dust of Your lotus feet?

units.sanskrit:
नैवोपयान्त्यपचितिं कवयस्तवेश
ब्रह्मादयोऽपि नतमूर्द्धसदा स्मरन्तः।
योऽन्तर्बहिस्तनुभृतामशुभं विधुन्वन्
नाचार्यचैत्यवपुषा स्वगतिं व्यनङ्क्षि॥ ११/२९/६॥
units.english: O my Lord! Transcendental poets and experts in spiritual science could not fully express their indebtedness to You, even if they were endowed with the prolonged lifetime of Brahmā, for You appear in two features — externally as the ācārya and internally as the Supreme Self — to deliver the embodied living being by directing him how to come to You.

meta.english_verbatim: O my Lord! Transcendental poets and experts in spiritual science could not fully express their indebtedness to You, even if they were endowed with the prolonged lifetime of Brahmā, for You appear in two features — externally as the ācārya and internally as the Supersoul — to deliver the embodied living being by directing him how to come to You.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीशुक उवाच
इत्युद्धवेनात्यनुरक्तचेतसा पृष्टो जगत्क्राडनकः स्वशक्तिभिः।
गृहीतमूर्तित्रय ईश्वरेश्वरो जगाद सप्रेम मनोहरस्मितः॥ ११/२९/७॥
units.english: Śukācārya said: Thus questioned by the most affectionate Uddhava, Lord Kṛṣṇa, the supreme controller of all controllers, who takes the entire universe as His plaything and assumes the three forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva, began to reply, lovingly displaying His all-attractive smile.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीशुक उवाच
इत्युद्धवेनात्यनुरक्तचेतसा पृष्टो जगत्क्राडनकः स्वशक्तिभिः।
गृहीतमूर्तित्रय ईश्वरेश्वरो जगाद सप्रेम मनोहरस्मितः॥ ११/२९/७॥

“आत्माऽन्तरामा परमात्मेति मूर्तित्रयं हरेः।
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तीनां सृष्ट्यादेश्च प्रवर्तकम्॥”
इति त्रैकाल्ये॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: Thus questioned by the most affectionate Uddhava, Lord Kṛṣṇa, the supreme controller of all controllers, who takes the entire universe as His plaything and assumes the three forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva, began to reply, lovingly displaying His all-attractive smile.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
हन्त ते वर्णयिष्यामि मम धर्मान् सुमङ्गळान्।
यान् शुद्धानाचरन् मर्त्यो मृत्युं जयति दुर्जयम्॥ ११/२९/८॥
units.english: The Lord said: Yes, I shall describe to you the principles of devotion to Me, by executing which a mortal human being will conquer unconquerable death.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Yes, I shall describe to you the principles of devotion to Me, by executing which a mortal human being will conquer unconquerable death.

units.sanskrit:
कुर्यात् सर्वाणि कर्माणि मदर्थं शनकैः स्मरन्।
मय्यर्पितमनश्चित्तो मद्धर्मात्ममनोरतिः॥ ११/२९/९॥
units.english: Always remembering Me, one should perform all his duties for Me without becoming impetuous. With mind and intelligence offered to Me, one should fix his mind in attraction to My devotion.

meta.english_verbatim: Always remembering Me, one should perform all his duties for Me without becoming impetuous. With mind and intelligence offered to Me, one should fix his mind in attraction to My devotional service.

units.sanskrit:
देशान् पुण्यान् संश्रयेत मद्भक्तैः साधुभिः श्रितान्।
देवासुरमनुष्येषु मद्भक्ताचरितानि च॥ ११/२९/१०॥
units.english: One should take shelter of holy places where My saintly devotees reside, and one should be guided by the exemplary activities of My devotees, who appear among the gods, demons and human beings.

meta.english_verbatim: One should take shelter of holy places where My saintly devotees reside, and one should be guided by the exemplary activities of My devotees, who appear among the demigods, demons and human beings.

units.sanskrit:
पृथक् सत्रेण वा मह्यं मम यात्रामहोत्सवम्।
कारयेन्नृत्यगीताद्यैर्महाराजविभूतिभिः॥ ११/२९/११॥
units.english: Either alone or in public gatherings, with singing, dancing and other exhibitions of royal opulence, one should arrange to celebrate those holy days, ceremonies and festivals set aside specially for My worship.

parts.sanskrit:
पृथक् सत्रेण वा मह्यं मम यात्रामहोत्सवम्।
कारयेन्नृत्यगीताद्यैर्महाराजविभूतिभिः॥ ११/२९/११॥
पृथक् स्वयमेव सत्रेण बहुभिः सह वा मम यात्रामहोत्सवं कुर्यात्॥ ११॥

meta.english_verbatim: Either alone or in public gatherings, with singing, dancing and other exhibitions of royal opulence, one should arrange to celebrate those holy days, ceremonies and festivals set aside specially for My worship.

units.sanskrit:
मामेव सर्वभूतेषु बहिरन्तरवस्थितम्।
ईक्षेतात्मनि५ चात्मानं यथा खममलाशयः॥ ११/२९/१२॥
units.english: With a pure heart one should see Me, the Supreme Soul within all beings and also within oneself, to be both unblemished by anything material and also present everywhere, both externally and internally, just like the omnipresent sky.

meta.english_verbatim: With a pure heart one should see Me, the Supreme Soul within all beings and also within oneself, to be both unblemished by anything material and also present everywhere, both externally and internally, just like the omnipresent sky.

units.sanskrit:
इति सर्वाणि भूतानि मद्भावेन महाद्युते।
सभाजयेन्मन्यमानो ज्ञानं केवलमाश्रयन्॥ ११/२९/१३॥
ब्राह्मणे पुल्कसे स्तेने ब्रह्मण्यर्के स्फुलिङ्गके।
अक्रूरे क्रूरके चैव समदृक् पण्डितो मतः॥ ११/२९/१४॥
units.english: O brilliant Uddhava, one who thus views all living beings with the idea that I am present within each of them, and who by taking shelter of this divine knowledge offers due respect to everyone, is considered actually wise. Such a man sees equally the brāhmaṇa and the outcaste, the thief and the charitable promoter of brahminical culture, the sun and the tiny sparks of fire, the gentle and the cruel.

parts.sanskrit:
इति सर्वाणि भूतानि मद्भावेन महाद्युते।
सभाजयेन्मन्यमानो ज्ञानं केवलमाश्रयन्॥ ११/२९/१३॥
ब्राह्मणे पुल्कसे स्तेने ब्रह्मण्यर्के स्फुलिङ्गके।
अक्रूरे क्रूरके चैव समदृक् पण्डितो मतः॥ ११/२९/१४॥

“सर्वभूतेष्वस्ति विष्णुरिति भावः सतां मतः।
अर्चने सर्वभूतानामादित्ये तद्गतात्मना॥”
इति च॥ १३॥
