meta.english_verbatim: O brilliant Uddhava, one who thus views all living entities with the idea that I am present within each of them, and who by taking shelter of this divine knowledge offers due respect to everyone, is considered actually wise. Such a man sees equally the brāhmaṇa and the outcaste, the thief and the charitable promoter of brahminical culture, the sun and the tiny sparks of fire, the gentle and the cruel.

units.sanskrit:
नरेष्वभीक्ष्णं मद्भावः पुंसो भावयतोऽचिरात्।
स्याद्वा माया तिरस्कारं साहङ्काराऽपि याति हि॥ ११/२९/१५॥
units.english: For him who constantly meditates upon My presence within all persons, the bad tendencies of rivalry, envy and abusiveness, along with false ego, are very quickly destroyed.

meta.english_verbatim: For him who constantly meditates upon My presence within all persons, the bad tendencies of rivalry, envy and abusiveness, along with false ego, are very quickly destroyed.

units.sanskrit:
विसृज्य स्वयमात्मस्थां दृश्यव्रीळां च दैहिकाम्।
प्रणमेद् दण्डवद् भूमावाश्वचण्डालगोखरम्॥ ११/२९/१६॥
units.english: Disregarding the ridicule of one’s companions, one should give up the bodily conception and its accompanying embarrassment. One should offer obeisances before all — even the dogs, outcastes, cows and asses — falling flat upon the ground like a rod.

meta.english_verbatim: Disregarding the ridicule of one’s companions, one should give up the bodily conception and its accompanying embarrassment. One should offer obeisances before all — even the dogs, outcastes, cows and asses — falling flat upon the ground like a rod.

units.sanskrit:
यावत् सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भावो नोपजायते।
तावदेवमुपासीत वाङ्मनःकायवृत्तिभिः॥ ११/२९/१७॥
units.english: Until one has fully developed the ability to see Me within all living beings, one must continue to worship Me by this process with the activities of his speech, mind and body.

meta.english_verbatim: Until one has fully developed the ability to see Me within all living beings, one must continue to worship Me by this process with the activities of his speech, mind and body.

units.sanskrit:
सर्वं ब्रह्मात्मकं तस्य विद्ययाऽऽत्ममनीषया।
परिपश्यति च परं परमात्मानमच्युतम्॥ ११/२९/१८॥
units.english: By such transcendental knowledge of the all-pervading the Lord, one is able to see the Absolute Truth everywhere. Freed thus from all doubts, one gives up actions aimed at results.

parts.sanskrit:
सर्वं ब्रह्मात्मकं तस्य विद्ययाऽऽत्ममनीषया।
परिपश्यति च परं परमात्मानमच्युतम्॥ ११/२९/१८॥

“ब्रह्मणाऽऽत्तमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्चित् सचराचरम्।
इति पश्येत यो विद्वान् स हि ब्रह्मात्मविन्मतः॥”
इति ब्राह्मे॥ १८॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: By such transcendental knowledge of the all-pervading Personality of Godhead, one is able to see the Absolute Truth everywhere. Freed thus from all doubts, one gives up fruitive activities.

units.sanskrit:
अयं हि सर्वकल्पानां सध्रीचीनो मतो मम।
मद्भावः सर्वभूतेषु मनोवाक्कायवृत्तिभिः॥ ११/२९/१९॥
units.english: Indeed, I consider this process — using one’s mind, words and bodily functions for realizing Me within all living beings — to be the best possible method of spiritual enlightenment.

meta.english_verbatim: Indeed, I consider this process — using one’s mind, words and bodily functions for realizing Me within all living beings — to be the best possible method of spiritual enlightenment.

units.sanskrit:
नह्यङ्गोपक्रमे ध्वंसो न धूरस्योद्धवाण्वपि।
मया व्यवसितं सम्यङ् निर्गुणत्वादनाशिषः॥ ११/२९/२०॥
units.english: My dear Uddhava, because I have personally established it, this process of devotion unto Me is transcendental and free from any material motivation. Certainly a devotee never suffers even the slightest loss by adopting this process.

meta.english_verbatim: My dear Uddhava, because I have personally established it, this process of devotional service unto Me is transcendental and free from any material motivation. Certainly a devotee never suffers even the slightest loss by adopting this process.

units.sanskrit:
यो योऽपरो मनोधर्मः कल्पते निष्फलाय ते।
तदायासो निरर्थः स्यान्नयादेरिव सत्तम॥ ११/२९/२१॥
units.english: O Uddhava, greatest of saints, in a dangerous situation an ordinary person cries, becomes fearful and laments, although such useless emotions do not change the situation. But activities offered to Me without personal motivation, even if they are externally useless, amount to the actual process of religion.

parts.sanskrit:
यो योऽपरो मनोधर्मः कल्पते निष्फलाय ते।
तदायासो निरर्थः स्यान्नयादेरिव सत्तम॥ ११/२९/२१॥
“नयादिर्दुनयः प्रोक्तो यन्नयं सोऽत्ति सर्वदा” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥२१॥

meta.english_verbatim: O Uddhava, greatest of saints, in a dangerous situation an ordinary person cries, becomes fearful and laments, although such useless emotions do not change the situation. But activities offered to Me without personal motivation, even if they are externally useless, amount to the actual process of religion.

units.sanskrit:
एषा बुद्धिमतां बुद्धिर्मनीषा च मनीषिणाम्।
यत् सत्यममृतेनेह मर्त्येनाप्नोति माऽमृतम्॥ ११/२९/२२॥
units.english: This process is the supreme intelligence of the intelligent and the cleverness of the most clever, for by following it one can in this very life make use of the temporary and unreal to achieve Me, the eternal reality.

parts.sanskrit:
एषा बुद्धिमतां बुद्धिर्मनीषा च मनीषिणाम्।
यत् सत्यममृतेनेह मर्त्येनाप्नोति माऽमृतम्॥ ११/२९/२२॥

“एकदा ज्ञातरूपेण यन्न तिष्ठति सर्वदा।
चञ्चलत्वात् सत्यमपि ह्यनृतं जगदुच्यते॥”
इति च।
“सर्वदैकप्रकारत्वात् सत्यं ब्रह्म सदोच्यते” इति च॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: This process is the supreme intelligence of the intelligent and the cleverness of the most clever, for by following it one can in this very life make use of the temporary and unreal to achieve Me, the eternal reality.

units.sanskrit:
एष तेऽभिहितः कृत्स्नो ब्रह्मवादस्य सङ्ग्रहः।
समासव्यासविधिना देवानामपि दुर्गमः॥ ११/२९/२३॥
units.english: Thus have I related to you — both in brief and in detail — a complete survey of the science of the Absolute Truth. Even for the gods, this science is very difficult to comprehend.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus have I related to you — both in brief and in detail — a complete survey of the science of the Absolute Truth. Even for the demigods, this science is very difficult to comprehend.

units.sanskrit:
अभीक्ष्णशस्ते गदितं ज्ञानं विस्पष्टयुक्तिमत्।
एतद् विज्ञाय मुच्येत पुरुषो नष्टसंशयः॥ ११/२९/२४॥
units.english: I have repeatedly spoken this knowledge to you with clear reasoning. Anyone who properly understands it will become free from all doubts and attain liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: I have repeatedly spoken this knowledge to you with clear reasoning. Anyone who properly understands it will become free from all doubts and attain liberation.

units.sanskrit:
सुविविक्तं तव प्रश्नं मयोक्तमपि धारयन्।
सनातनं ब्रह्मगुह्यं परब्रह्माधिगच्छति॥ ११/२९/२५॥
units.english: Anyone who fixes his attention on these clear answers to your questions will attain to the eternal, confidential goal of the Vedas — the Supreme Absolute Truth.

meta.english_verbatim: Anyone who fixes his attention on these clear answers to your questions will attain to the eternal, confidential goal of the Vedas — the Supreme Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit:
य एतन्मम भक्तेषु सम्प्रदद्यात् सुपुष्कळम्।
तस्याहं ब्रह्मदायस्य ददाम्यात्मानमात्मना॥ ११/२९/२६॥
units.english: One who liberally disseminates this knowledge among My devotees is the bestower of the Absolute Truth, and to him I give My very own self.

meta.english_verbatim: One who liberally disseminates this knowledge among My devotees is the bestower of the Absolute Truth, and to him I give My very own self.

units.sanskrit:
य एतत् समधीयीत पवित्रं परमं शुचि।
स पूयेताहरहर्मां ज्ञानदीपेन दर्शयन्॥ ११/२९/२७॥
units.english: He who loudly recites this supreme knowledge, which is the most lucid and purifying, becomes purified day by day, for he reveals Me to others with the lamp of transcendental knowledge.

meta.english_verbatim: He who loudly recites this supreme knowledge, which is the most lucid and purifying, becomes purified day by day, for he reveals Me to others with the lamp of transcendental knowledge.

units.sanskrit:
य एतच्छ्रद्धया नित्यमव्यग्रं शृणुयान्नरः।
मयि भक्तिं परां कुर्वन् कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते॥ ११/२९/२८॥
units.english: Anyone who regularly listens to this knowledge with faith and attention, all the while engaging in My pure devotion, will never become bound by the reactions of material work.

meta.english_verbatim: Anyone who regularly listens to this knowledge with faith and attention, all the while engaging in My pure devotional service, will never become bound by the reactions of material work.

units.sanskrit:
अप्युद्धव त्वया ब्रह्म सखे समुपधारितम्।
अपि ते विगतो मोहः शोकश्चासौ मनोभवः॥ ११/२९/२९॥
units.english: My dear friend Uddhava, have you now completely understood this transcendental knowledge? Are the confusion and lamentation that arose in your mind now dispelled?

meta.english_verbatim: My dear friend Uddhava, have you now completely understood this transcendental knowledge? Are the confusion and lamentation that arose in your mind now dispelled?

units.sanskrit:
नैतत् त्वया डाम्भिकाय नास्तिकाय शठाय च।
अशुश्रूषोरभक्ताय दुर्विनीताय दीयताम्॥ ११/२९/३०॥
units.english: You should not share this instruction with anyone who is hypocritical, atheistic or dishonest, or with anyone who will not listen faithfully, who is not a devotee, or who is simply not humble.

meta.english_verbatim: You should not share this instruction with anyone who is hypocritical, atheistic or dishonest, or with anyone who will not listen faithfully, who is not a devotee, or who is simply not humble.

units.sanskrit:
एतैर्दोषैर्विहीनाय ब्रह्मण्याय प्रियाय च।
साधवे शुचये ब्रूयाद् भक्तिः स्याच्छूद्रयोषिताम्॥ ११/२९/३१॥
units.english: This knowledge should be taught to one who is free from these bad qualities, who is dedicated to the welfare of the brāhmaṇas, and who is kindly disposed, saintly and pure. And if common workers and women are found to have devotion for the Supreme Lord, they are also to be accepted as qualified hearers.

meta.english_verbatim: This knowledge should be taught to one who is free from these bad qualities, who is dedicated to the welfare of the brāhmaṇas, and who is kindly disposed, saintly and pure. And if common workers and women are found to have devotion for the Supreme Lord, they are also to be accepted as qualified hearers.

units.sanskrit:
नैतद् विज्ञाय जिज्ञासोर्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।
पीत्वा पीयूषममृतं पातव्यं नावशिष्यते॥ ११/२९/३२॥
units.english: When an inquisitive person comes to understand this knowledge, he has nothing further to know. After all, one who has drunk the most palatable nectar cannot remain thirsty.

meta.english_verbatim: When an inquisitive person comes to understand this knowledge, he has nothing further to know. After all, one who has drunk the most palatable nectar cannot remain thirsty.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञाने कर्मणि योगे च वार्तायां दण्डधारणे।
यावानर्थो नृणां तात तावान् मोहश्चतुर्विधः॥ ११/२९/३३॥
units.english: Through analytic knowledge, ritualistic work, mystic yoga, mundane business and political rule, people seek to advance in religiosity, economic development, sense enjoyment and liberation. But because you are My devotee, whatever men can accomplish in these multifarious ways you will very easily find within Me.

meta.english_verbatim: Through analytic knowledge, ritualistic work, mystic yoga, mundane business and political rule, people seek to advance in religiosity, economic development, sense gratification and liberation. But because you are My devotee, whatever men can accomplish in these multifarious ways you will very easily find within Me.

units.sanskrit:
मर्त्यो यदा त्यक्तसमस्तकर्मा निवेशितात्मा च चिकार्षितो मे।
तदाऽमृतत्वं प्रतिपद्यमानो मयाऽऽत्मभूयाय च कल्पतेऽसौ॥ ११/२९/३४॥
units.english: A person who gives up all actions aimed at results and offers himself entirely unto Me, eagerly desiring to render service unto Me, achieves liberation from birth and death and is promoted to the status of sharing My own opulences.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: A person who gives up all fruitive activities and offers himself entirely unto Me, eagerly desiring to render service unto Me, achieves liberation from birth and death and is promoted to the status of sharing My own opulences.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीशुक उवाच
स एवमादर्शितयोगमार्गस्तदोत्तमश्लोकवचो निशम्य।
बद्धाञ्जलिः प्रीत्युपरुद्धकण्ठो न किञ्चिदूचेऽश्रुपरिप्लुताक्षः॥ ११/२९/३५॥
units.english: Śukācārya said: Hearing these words spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa, and having thus been shown the entire path of yoga, Uddhava folded his hands to offer obeisances. But his throat choked up with love and his eyes overflowed with tears; so he could say nothing.

meta.english_verbatim: Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: Hearing these words spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa, and having thus been shown the entire path of yoga, Uddhava folded his hands to offer obeisances. But his throat choked up with love and his eyes overflowed with tears; so he could say nothing.

units.sanskrit:
विष्टभ्य चित्तं प्रणयेन पूर्णं धैर्येण राजन् बहुमन्यमानः।
कृताञ्जलिः प्राह यदुप्रवीरं शीर्ष्णा स्पृशंस्तच्चरणारविन्दम्॥ ११/२९/३६॥
units.english: Steadying his mind, which had become overwhelmed with love, Uddhava felt extremely grateful to Lord Kṛṣṇa, the greatest hero of the Yadu dynasty. My dear King Parīkṣit, Uddhava bowed down to touch the Lord’s lotus feet with his head and then spoke with folded hands.

meta.english_verbatim: Steadying his mind, which had become overwhelmed with love, Uddhava felt extremely grateful to Lord Kṛṣṇa, the greatest hero of the Yadu dynasty. My dear King Parīkṣit, Uddhava bowed down to touch the Lord’s lotus feet with his head and then spoke with folded hands.

units.sanskrit:
उद्धव उवाच
विद्रावितो मोहमयोऽन्धकारो य आश्रितो मे तव सन्निधानात्।
विभावसोः किन्नु समीपगस्य शीतं तमोऽभिप्रभवत्यजाद्य॥ ११/२९/३७॥
units.english: Uddhava said: O unborn, primeval Lord, although I had fallen into the great darkness of illusion, my ignorance has now been dispelled by Your merciful association. Indeed, how can cold, darkness and fear exert their power over one who has approached the brilliant sun?

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: Śrī Uddhava said: O unborn, primeval Lord, although I had fallen into the great darkness of illusion, my ignorance has now been dispelled by Your merciful association. Indeed, how can cold, darkness and fear exert their power over one who has approached the brilliant sun?

units.sanskrit:
प्रवर्धिता मे भवताऽनुकम्पिता दत्तो हि विज्ञानमयः प्रदीपः।
हित्वा कृतज्ञस्तव पादमूलं कोऽज्ञः समीयाच्छरणं त्वदन्यम्॥ ११/२९/३८॥
units.english: In return for my insignificant surrender, You have mercifully bestowed upon me, Your servant, the torchlight of transcendental knowledge. Therefore, what devotee of Yours who has any gratitude could ever give up Your lotus feet and take shelter of another master?

meta.english_verbatim: In return for my insignificant surrender, You have mercifully bestowed upon me, Your servant, the torchlight of transcendental knowledge. Therefore, what devotee of Yours who has any gratitude could ever give up Your lotus feet and take shelter of another master?

units.sanskrit:
वृक्णश्च रूढः स्नेहपाशो मदीयो१ दाशार्हवृष्ण्यन्धकसात्वतेषु।
प्रसारितः सृष्टिविवृद्धये त्वया स्वमायया ह्यात्मसुबोधहेतिना॥ ११/२९/३९॥
units.english: The firmly binding rope of my affection for the families of the Dāśārhas, Vṛṣṇis, Andhakas and Sātvatas — a rope You originally cast over me by Your illusory energy for the purpose of developing Your creation — is now cut off by the weapon of transcendental knowledge of the self.

meta.english_verbatim: The firmly binding rope of my affection for the families of the Dāśārhas, Vṛṣṇis, Andhakas and Sātvatas — a rope You originally cast over me by Your illusory energy for the purpose of developing Your creation — is now cut off by the weapon of transcendental knowledge of the self.

units.sanskrit:
नमोऽस्तु ते महायोगिन् प्रपन्नमनुशाधि माम्।
यथा त्वच्चरणाम्भोजे रतिः स्यादनपायिनी॥ ११/२९/४०॥
units.english: Obeisances unto You, O greatest of yogīs. Please instruct me, who am surrendered unto You, how I may have undeviating attachment to Your lotus feet.

meta.english_verbatim: Obeisances unto You, O greatest of yogīs. Please instruct me, who am surrendered unto You, how I may have undeviating attachment to Your lotus feet.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
गच्छोद्धव मदादेशाद् बदर्याख्यं मदाश्रमम्।
तत्र मत्पादतीर्थोदैः स्नानोपस्पर्शनैः शुचिः॥ ११/२९/४१॥
ईक्षयाऽळकनन्दाया विधूतक्लेशकल्मषः।
वसानो वल्कलान्यङ्ग वन्यभक्षश्च निःस्पृहः॥ ११/२९/४२॥
तितिक्षुर्द्वन्द्वमात्राणां सुशीलः संयतेन्द्रियः।
शान्तः समाहितधिया ज्ञानविज्ञानसंयुतः॥ ११/२९/४३॥
मत्तोऽनुशिक्षितं यत्ते विविक्तमनुभावयन्।
मय्यावेशितवाक्चित्तो मद्धर्मनिरतो भव॥ ११/२९/४४॥
units.english: The Lord said: My dear Uddhava, take My order and go to My āśrama called Badarikā. Purify yourself by both touching and also bathing in the holy waters there, which have emanated from My lotus feet. Rid yourself of all sinful reactions with the sight of the sacred Alakanandā River. Dress yourself in bark and eat whatever is naturally available in the forest. Thus you should remain content and free from desire, tolerant of all dualities, good-natured, self-controlled, peaceful and endowed with transcendental knowledge and realization. With fixed attention, meditate constantly upon these instructions I have imparted to you and assimilate their essence. Fix your words and thoughts upon Me, and always endeavor to increase your realization of My transcendental qualities. In this way you will cross beyond the destinations of the three modes of nature and finally come back to Me.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: My dear Uddhava, take My order and go to My āśrama called Badarikā. units.sanskrit:
श्रीशुक उवाच
स एवमुक्तो हरिमेधसोद्धवः प्रदक्षिणं तं परिवृत्य पादयोः।
शिरो निधायाश्रुकळाभिरार्द्रधीः सिञ्चन् पदद्वन्द्वमथो न चक्रमे॥ ११/२९/४६॥
units.english: Śukācārya said: Thus addressed by Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose intelligence destroys all the suffering of material life, Uddhava circumambulated the Lord and then fell down, placing his head upon the Lord’s feet. Although Uddhava was free from the influence of all material dualities, his heart was breaking, and at this time of departure he drenched the Lord’s lotus feet with his tears.

meta.english_verbatim: Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: Thus addressed by Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose intelligence destroys all the suffering of material life, Śrī Uddhava circumambulated the Lord and then fell down, placing his head upon the Lord’s feet. Although Uddhava was free from the influence of all material dualities, his heart was breaking, and at this time of departure he drenched the Lord’s lotus feet with his tears.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

units.sanskrit:
सुदुस्त्यजस्नेहवियोगकातरो न शक्नुवंस्तं परिहर्तुमातुरः।
कृच्छ्रं ययौ मूर्धनि भर्तृपादुके बिभ्रन्नमस्कृत्य ययौ पुनःपुनः॥ ११/२९/४७॥
units.english: Greatly fearing separation from Him for whom he felt such indestructible affection, Uddhava was distraught, and he could not give up the Lord’s company. Finally, feeling great pain, he bowed down to the Lord again and again, placed the slippers of his master upon his head, and departed.

meta.english_verbatim: Greatly fearing separation from Him for whom he felt such indestructible affection, Uddhava was distraught, and he could not give up the Lord’s company. Finally, feeling great pain, he bowed down to the Lord again and again, placed the slippers of his master upon his head, and departed.

units.sanskrit:
ततस्तमन्तर्हृदि सन्निवेश्य गतो महाभागवतो विशालाम्।
यथोपदिष्टं जगदेकबन्धुना तपः समास्थाय हरेरगाद् गतिम्॥ ११/२९/४८॥
units.english: Thereupon, placing the Lord deeply within his heart, the great devotee Uddhava went to Badarikāśrama. By engaging there in austerities, he attained to the Lord’s personal abode, which had been described to him by the only friend of the universe, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

meta.english_verbatim: Thereupon, placing the Lord deeply within his heart, the great devotee Uddhava went to Badarikāśrama. By engaging there in austerities, he attained to the Lord’s personal abode, which had been described to him by the only friend of the universe, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

units.sanskrit:
यदेतदानन्दसमुद्रसम्भृतं
ज्ञानामृतं भागवताय भाषितम्।
कृष्णेन योगेश्वरसेविताङ्घ्रिणा
सच्छ्रद्धयाऽऽसेव्य जगद् विमुच्यते॥ ११/२९/४९॥
units.english: Thus Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose lotus feet are served by all great yoga masters, spoke to His devotee this nectarean knowledge, which comprises the entire ocean of spiritual bliss. Anyone within this universe who receives this narration with great faith is assured of liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: Thus Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose lotus feet are served by all great yoga masters, spoke to His devotee this nectarean knowledge, which comprises the entire ocean of spiritual bliss. Anyone within this universe who receives this narration with great faith is assured of liberation.

notes: Vedabase SB 11.7-11.29 correspond to Setutila's chapters 7-29. Sanskrit is verse-only in 'sanskrit' (Setutila mula, speaker lines attached to the verse they introduce); Madhva's commentary blocks are in bhashya part and are NOT translated by the English. English = Prabhupada's verse translation per Vedabase 'Text' entry, fetched from the chapter pages. Setutila's verse numbers (from its own '॥ s/c/v ॥' marks) were matched to Vedabase 'Text' numbers; a chapter keeps number pairing only if the Sanskrit and English lengths stay proportional for at least 85% of pairs (align='number'; 875 units). In the other chapters (the two recensions split or number some verses differently, e.g. Setutila 11.8.20 = Vedabase Text 21) the whole chapter was aligned by Sanskrit-to-English length with 1-1, 1-2, 2-1 beads (align='length'; 40 units); spot checks were right but errors can accumulate, so filter on align == 'number' for the safest pairs. Units with align='none' have Sanskrit only (no Vedabase text found for that verse, typically the speaker-intro verse 1). A unit with several Sanskrit verses or Vedabase texts is a group. Prabhupada's translation is interpretive (purport-influenced) rather than literal, so `english` keeps his published wording untouched and `english` is a rule-based neutral variant: only the term swaps listed in meta.english_edits (per unit, with counts) were applied, e.g. '(Supreme) Personality of Godhead' -> 'the Lord', 'devotional service' -> 'devotion', 'living entity' -> 'living being', 'Supersoul' -> 'the Supreme Self', 'demigod' -> 'god', 'sense gratification' -> 'sense enjoyment', 'fruitive activities' -> 'actions aimed at results', 'spiritual master' -> 'teacher', 'pure devotee' -> 'devotee'; honorifics are dropped ('Sūta Gosvāmī' -> 'Sūta Paurāṇika', 'Śukadeva Gosvāmī' -> 'Śukācārya', other 'X Gosvāmī' -> 'X', 'Śrīla' and the honorific 'Śrī' before a name removed; 'Mahārāja X' and 'X Mahārāja' become 'King X'). Nothing was deleted or rewritten beyond these swaps; terms with no neutral equivalent are only listed in meta.english_flags (e.g. 'Kṛṣṇa consciousness'). english is an edit of the source text made for this benchmark, not a published translation; cite meta.english_verbatim, which is the text as published. [6 units with no english in any source were dropped so every unit is scoreable: 0 colophon units and 6 others (11.18.49, 11.20.38, 11.21.44, 11.23.62, 11.28.45, 11.29.50).] [Realigned by content: the Setutila Sanskrit and the Vedabase verse numbers drift apart inside chapters, so units were re-paired with a monotone dynamic-programming alignment over LaBSE sentence-embedding similarity between each Sanskrit verse and each Vedabase translation (232 units now carry a different translation than before). 21 Sanskrit verses with no counterpart were dropped (11.7.58, 11.8.2, 11.8.19, 11.8.22, 11.9.2, 11.17.36, 11.17.57, 11.18.31, 11.19.27, 11.19.28-32, 11.20.15, 11.20.27-28, 11.22.26, 11.22.53, 11.22.60, 11.23.35, 11.23.36, 11.27.27, 11.27.54, 11.28.8, 11.29.45); the leading '[Text N]' labels were stripped from the english.]
